Gıda güvenliğinin kalbi soğuk zincirdir:.en: The cold chain is the heart of food safety: the chiller (0-4°C), the freezer (-18°C and below) and the dry store (cool, dry) must be kept at their target temperatures. The cook reads these temperatures daily (usually at least once or twice a day) and records them in the cold chain log. A calibrated thermometer/temperature indicator is used; the equipment's own indicator is verified periodically against a reference thermometer.

Tehlikeli sıcaklık aralığı (kabaca 5-63°.en: The danger zone (roughly 5-63°C) is the range in which bacteria multiply rapidly; keeping refrigerated food below this range reduces the risk of foodborne illness. A door left open, overfilling, a damaged seal or a fault raises the temperature; the cook catches these deviations early.

Kayıtta bir sapma (örn. soğutucu 4°C üst.en: When a deviation is seen in the record (e.g. the chiller has risen above 4°C), the cook starts corrective action: checking the door/seal/filling level, moving the products to another unit if necessary, reporting the fault and assessing/destroying the affected food. A product suspected of having had its cold chain broken is not risked. These actions are the practical application of "critical control point" management in HACCP terms (details in the food safety task).

İyi gemi catering pratiği ve birçok bayr.en: Good ship catering practice and many flag/company procedures call for reference samples to be kept from the main meals served: a representative portion (typically around ~100 g) of each main dish is taken in a clean, labeled container and kept in the chiller for reference, typically for 48 hours. If a foodborne illness (food poisoning) is suspected, this sample can be sent to a laboratory to identify the source.

Numune steril/temiz kaba alınır, üzerine.en: The sample is taken in a sterile/clean container, labeled with the name of the dish, the date and the time, and stored in a separate compartment (protected from cross-contamination). When the retention period ends, it is disposed of safely. In an outbreak investigation, this discipline both protects the ship (evidence) and allows a fast root-cause analysis.

Birden fazla mürettebatta benzer belirti.en: If similar symptoms (diarrhea, vomiting) appear in more than one crew member, a foodborne illness is suspected; the cook informs the Master, the retained samples are preserved, the suspect product/batch is isolated and, if necessary, the matter is coordinated with telemedicine/the port health authority. The samples and the cold chain/cleaning records are the main evidence for the root-cause investigation.

Aşçının tuttuğu/destek olduğu temel kayı.en: The main records kept or supported by the cook: drinking water residual chlorine and test logs, potable water tank cleaning/disinfection and calibration records, cold chain (chiller/freezer/store) temperature logs, the food sample record, and cleaning and pest control records. These records are kept regularly, dated and accurately; the rule is real-time recording, not filling them in afterwards in bulk.

Kayıtlar, MLC 2006 denetimi, liman devle.en: The records are examined during MLC 2006 inspections, by Port State Control (PSC) and by the port health authority (Ship Sanitation). Well-kept records both protect the ship legally and allow fast diagnosis when a problem arises.

MLC 2006, gıda ve içme suyu alanının düz.en: MLC 2006 requires the food and drinking water areas to be inspected and the inspections recorded regularly; the Ship Sanitation Control Certificate documents that the ship is acceptable from a public health point of view. The cook ensures that these records are always up to date and ready for inspection. Missing/falsified records are a serious nonconformity and can lead to detention of the ship.

İçme suyu ve gıda kalite kontrolü, aşçın.en: Drinking water and food quality control is the essence of the cook's role as guardian of public health. Monitoring residual chlorine and bacteriological safety, recording the cold chain daily, keeping food samples for reference and linking all this into a chain of records that can be inspected is the only reliable way to prevent a food- or waterborne outbreak and to manage it quickly if one occurs. Accurately kept records are the quiet foundation of both crew health and the ship's legal protection.

Entegre haşere yönetimi (Integrated Pest.en: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) leaves chemical intervention to the last step and is based first on environmental control. The basic principle is to cut off three kinds of access: access to food (closed containers, cleaning up spilled food immediately, keeping garbage covered), access to water (eliminating leaks/pools) and access to harborage/breeding sites (sealing cracks and holes, removing accumulated cardboard). Pests settle when they find one of these three resources; cutting off all three is the strongest control.

Aşçı, galley ve depo temizliğini (bkz. m.en: The cook carries out galley and store cleaning (see the galley organization task) as a direct pest prevention measure: "clean as you go", leaving the galley clean/dry at night, transferring opened packets into closed containers. Cardboard packaging (which may carry cockroach eggs) is disposed of quickly; incoming provisions are checked for insects/larvae before entering the stores.

IPM, sürekli izlemeye dayanır: düzenli g.en: IPM is based on continuous monitoring: signs of pests are detected early through regular visual inspection. The signs looked for are droppings, gnaw marks, greasy rub marks (rodent runs), egg cases/larvae, dead insects, odor and consumption of traps/bait. The cook checks the galley and stores weekly (more often if necessary) and records the findings. Early detection deals with a small presence before it becomes an established infestation.

Kemirgenlerin gemiye en yaygın giriş yol.en: The most common way for rodents to get on board is via the mooring lines and the ramp/gangway in port. Therefore, when the ship is moored in port, rat guards (cone- or disc-shaped barriers) are correctly fitted on all mooring lines; the guard must be positioned and oriented so as to stop rodents climbing along the line. In addition, the gangway is lit at night, holds/doors are closed and no open food is left on the ramp.

Gemiye giriş noktaları (kapılar, havalan.en: Entry points to the ship (doors, ventilation openings, cable penetrations) are kept rodent-proof; holes must be sealed with metal/filler (rodents can gnaw through wood/plastic but struggle with metal). The cook checks that the galley and food stores are protected in this respect.

Kemirgen izleme/mücadelesi için bait sta.en: For rodent monitoring/control, bait stations and mechanical/sticky traps are placed along rodent runs (along the base of walls, in corners, at store entrances) according to a designated layout plan. The stations are numbered and checked regularly; consumption/catches are recorded. Toxic bait is not used on food preparation surfaces; stations are placed at safe points away from food and out of reach.

Hamamböcekleri sıcak, nemli ve karanlık.en: Cockroaches like warm, humid and dark places; the galley, the dishwashing area and the stores are the main high-risk areas. They are very commonly brought on board in cardboard packaging, so provision cartons are not taken into the stores or are disposed of quickly. Control uses monitoring with sticky traps, filling cracks and crevices, rigorous cleaning (leaving no food source overnight) and, if necessary, gel bait/professional treatment.

Hamamböceği gıdayı patojenle (Salmonella.en: Cockroaches can contaminate food with pathogens (Salmonella etc.); their presence is a serious food safety threat. Since even a single insect may be a sign of an established population, a sighting is never underestimated and action is taken immediately.

Un, pirinç, makarna, baklagil gibi kuru.en: Grain insects and moths can breed in dry stores such as flour, rice, pasta and pulses; a warm, humid store speeds up this breeding. Prevention consists of cool/dry storage, FIFO rotation, closed/labeled containers and regular inspection. An infested batch (containing live/dead insects, webbing, larvae) is destroyed; to prevent cross-infestation, neighboring products are checked and the store is cleaned.

Sinekler hem rahatsızlık hem de patojen.en: Flies are both a nuisance and a carrier of pathogens; they contaminate food surfaces by landing on them. Control consists of not leaving food/garbage uncovered, fly screens on doors/ventilation openings, electric fly killers (insect-o-cutor) and regular emptying of garbage. Galley windows/doors are kept closed and screened as far as possible.

Bazı bölgelerde (tropikal limanlar) sivr.en: In some regions (tropical ports), mosquitoes can be vectors of diseases such as malaria/dengue; the ship is expected to eliminate standing water (pools, open containers) and, if necessary, to apply vector control. IHR 2005 requires ships to be kept free of vectors; these points are checked during port health authority inspections. The cook does not leave standing water or open pools in food/water areas.

Önleme ve hedefli mücadele yetersiz kala.en: In a widespread infestation where prevention and targeted control are not enough, professional ULV (ultra low volume) treatment or fumigation may be needed; this is coordinated by the person designated by the ship and is usually carried out in port with licensed operators/the port health authority. Fumigation uses powerful, toxic gases/chemicals; therefore human safety is the absolute priority. Before application, the area is evacuated, food is protected/removed and entry is prohibited.

Fumigasyon sonrası alan, güvenli gaz kon.en: After fumigation, the area is kept closed until a safe gas concentration has been verified (by measurement) and an authorized "gas-free / safe for entry" approval has been given. The cook follows the fumigation plan on the food/galley side: protects or removes the products, cleans the surfaces afterwards and destroys any uncovered food at risk of contamination.

Gemi içinde kullanılan tüm pestisit/biyo.en: All pesticides/biocides used on board are applied in accordance with the label and the safety data sheet (SDS), away from food areas and with suitable PPE. Food preparation surfaces, stores and water systems are protected from the chemicals. The cook makes sure there is no cross-contact between food and pesticides; a product suspected of having been in contact is not consumed. The chemical and the method used are recorded.

IHR 2005 kapsamında her gemi, geçerli bi.en: Under IHR 2005, every ship must carry a valid Ship Sanitation Control Exemption Certificate (SSCEC — no risk found/measures adequate) or Ship Sanitation Control Certificate (SSCC — control measures applied); these have replaced the historical "Deratting Certificate". The certificates are typically valid for 6 months and are renewed at authorized ports. The cook contributes to the smooth renewal of this certificate by keeping the galley/food area ready for inspection and recording pest findings.

Bir bulaşma (özellikle kemirgen veya yay.en: If an infestation (especially rodents or a widespread infestation) is detected, the cook immediately informs the Master; when required, the Master notifies the port health authority and control measures are coordinated. An infestation is never concealed — concealing it is both a public health risk and grounds for heavy sanctions. Affected food is destroyed, the source is sealed and the process is recorded.

Pest control, aşçının halk sağlığı ve gı.en: Pest control is an integral part of the cook's public health and food safety responsibility. Prevention (cleaning, cutting off access, rat guards), monitoring (traps/bait, visual inspection) and, when necessary, safe professional intervention (ULV/fumigation) form a whole; completing this with valid Ship Sanitation certificates and transparent reporting protects the ship from both an outbreak and heavy sanctions after inspections. On a well-managed ship, pests are noticed and dealt with before they become established.

Sistemin ana bileşenleri: yakıt sistemi.en: The main components of the system are the fuel system (booster, viscotherm, common rail / camshaft), the lubrication system (cylinder lube oil + system oil), the cooling system (jacket water + piston cooling + LT/HT FW), the turbocharger group (T/C + air cooler + scavenge air receiver), the exhaust system (uniflow scavenging ports + exhaust valve), the crankshaft/shafting and the propeller.

Bu parametrelerin günlük \"engine perfor.en: These parameters must be entered completely in the daily "engine performance log". The Chief Engineer checks the log every day and cross-checks deviation trends with the performance monitoring software on the ECR (Engine Control Room) computer (e.g. CoCoS-EDS, WiCE, MAPEX-PM). Cylinder balance, exhaust gas spread and T/C matching are reported automatically by this software.

Pmax dengesizliği; injector arızası, fue.en: Pmax imbalance points to causes such as injector faults, fuel cam timing drift, a leaking exhaust valve seat, T/C imbalance or ring blow-by. The Chief Engineer inspects the unbalanced cylinder as a priority and opens a PMS work order.

IHP = (Pmean × L × A × N) / (60 × 75) kl.en: IHP is calculated with the classic formula IHP = (Pmean × L × A × N) / (60 × 75). SFOC = (fuel consumption [g/h]) / (IHP × 0.7355) — on modern engines it should be in the range 165-175 g/kWh. If SFOC keeps rising, loss of compression, injector wear or fuel quality is suspected.

Bunker operasyonunda Baş Mühendis bizzat.en: During bunkering, the Chief Engineer personally supervises the process: the BDN (Bunker Delivery Note), continuous drip sampling (4-way sampler), the pre-bunker checklist (SOLAS + MARPOL Annex VI), communication with the barge, the vapor line (if any), the ship's tank levels and the ROB (Remaining On Board) records.

HFO/VLSFO için purifier (centrifugal sep.en: For HFO/VLSFO, the purifier (centrifugal separator) is operated at an optimum of 90-98 °C. The gravity disc / interface setting is made according to the fuel density. With the viscotherm, injection viscosity is kept within 10-15 cSt (if the fuel viscosity is low, cooling is required; if it is high, heating). An incorrect viscotherm setting causes injector wear and impairs atomization quality.

Cylinder oil, yakıt sülfür içeriğine gör.en: Cylinder oil is selected according to the sulfur content of the fuel. Oils of 70-100 TBN (Base Number) are suitable for high-sulfur HFO, and oils of 25-40 TBN for low-sulfur VLSFO/MGO. Choosing the wrong TBN leads to cold corrosion or deposit problems.

Surging (compressor durağan akım kaybı).en: Surging (loss of stable flow in the compressor) is a very serious warning; it causes major damage to the T/C shaft bearings. If a surge alarm occurs, the engine load is reduced and the cause is investigated (exhaust valve leakage, scavenge air leak etc.).

Air cooler temizliği yakıt verimini doğr.en: Air cooler cleanliness directly affects fuel efficiency. A chemical cleaning procedure is applied for sea-water-side fouling (marine growth, sand), and periodic washing for the air side. In the scavenge air receiver, oil or particles dripping from the scavenge ports may be a sign of a "scavenge fire"; temperature monitoring and regular inspection are essential.

Şaft hattı, intermediate bearings + ster.en: The shaft line consists of the intermediate bearings + stern tube bearing + propeller shaft + propeller. Incorrect alignment leads to hot bearings, vibration and, in the long term, shaft cracking. Gap & sag measurements and bearing weight measurement are mandatory at class survey.

Stern tube bearing yağ sıcaklığı (geneld.en: Stern tube bearing oil temperature (generally <60 °C), the condition of the forward/aft seals and the oil consumption (check for water ingress) are monitored daily. If stern tube oil is found in the bilge tank, there is a seal leak; if necessary, drydocking is planned.

Pervane verimi; sefer süresince fouling.en: Propeller efficiency falls over time in service due to fouling, erosion and cavitation pitting. Hull & propeller polishing is carried out periodically (typically every 6-12 months); this can give 3-5% fuel savings.

Pompalar, T/C, jeneratörler, separator v.en: Periodic vibration measurements (ISO 10816 standard) on pumps, T/Cs, generators, separators and shaft bearings are recorded. A rising trend indicates a bearing or alignment problem. Thermography cameras detect hot spots in electrical switchboards, bearings and steam piping.

Aylık spectroanalysis (Al, Cr, Cu, Fe, P.en: Monthly spectroanalysis (the metals Al, Cr, Cu, Fe, Pb, Sn, Si, and V, Na for fuel contamination) is plotted on a trend chart. An increase in Si means ingress of sand via the fuel or the air filter; Cu, wear of bearing surfaces; Fe, ring or liner wear.

Tüm jeneratörlerin kaybı (black-out) dur.en: If all generators are lost (blackout), the emergency generator starts automatically; under SOLAS II-1/43 it supplies the essential services within 45 seconds. Starting air is used for dead ship recovery (main air receiver + emergency air compressor; IACS UR M61 required).

Baş Mühendis için drill senaryosu: emerg.en: Drill scenario for the Chief Engineer: starting the emergency generator, paralleling the main generators, closing the bus-tie, the main engine restart sequence, restoration of navigation and communication services. The annual dead ship drill must be recorded.

Crankcase explosion; hot spot (yatak ove.en: A crankcase explosion occurs through the chain hot spot (bearing overheating) → atomized oil + air mixture → ignition. The oil mist detector (Schaller, Visatron) and bearing temperature sensors give early warning. On alarm: engine load to zero, stop immediately, opening the crankcase doors is prohibited (controlled opening after 15-30 min of cooling down), boundary cooling.

Jacket cooling water düşüşü kompresyon r.en: A drop in jacket cooling water creates severe thermal shock in the compression rings and the liner. Immediate action: reduce load gradually, look for the cause (pump trip, expansion tank dry, tube leak), stop if necessary. Re-cooling must be done slowly; otherwise the liner will crack.

Modern gemilerin çoğu 5 yıllık özel sörv.en: Most modern ships are managed under the CMS program within the 5-year special survey cycle. Each item of equipment is surveyed once every 5 years; PMS records are used as evidence. The Chief Engineer keeps crank deflection measurements, exhaust valve overhaul records, T/C overhaul records and ME safety device test records ready for the class surveyor.

Baş Mühendis için en güçlü kanıt, sürekl.en: For the Chief Engineer, the strongest evidence is a continuously and honestly kept log book and ECR decision log. Abnormal observations, interventions made, spare parts used, measurements taken and decisions made are recorded in writing. This discipline is the only documentation that protects the ship in survey, vetting, PSC and insurance processes.

Ana makine ve itki sisteminin sürekli op.en: Keeping the main engine and propulsion system continuously operational requires not only technical knowledge but a culture of systematic monitoring, careful decision-making and meticulous documentation. The modern Chief Engineer is not only a mechanical expert but also a data analyst, regulatory specialist and systems manager.

Element 10.3 ayrıca \"kritik ekipman\" (.en: Element 10.3 also introduces the concept of "critical equipment"; for equipment whose sudden failure could lead to a hazardous situation, additional protective measures, redundancy and functional tests are mandatory. The Chief Engineer keeps the list of critical equipment in the engine room up to date and tracks the tests of this equipment on a separate schedule.

Modern gemilerin çoğu klas tarafından 5.en: Most modern ships are managed by class in a 5-year Continuous Survey of Machinery (CMS) cycle. In this cycle each machinery item is surveyed at least once within 5 years; about one fifth of the surveys are completed each year. On ships with an approved PMS (Approved Planned Maintenance Scheme), class accepts the Chief Engineer's PMS records (chief engineer survey) instead of opening up and surveying certain equipment.

Bu ayrıcalık ciddi bir sorumluluk getiri.en: This privilege brings serious responsibility: if a PMS record is late, incomplete or inconsistent, class may remove that item from the CMS and return it to physical survey; this means unplanned opening-up, delays and cost. The Chief Engineer keeps the records of items for which "PMS credit" is taken with the rigor of a surveyor.

PMS yazılımları (AMOS, ShipManager/StarI.en: PMS software (AMOS, ShipManager/StarIPS, BASSnet, Kaiko, TM Master, Mastery) models equipment as a hierarchical tree: ship → system (e.g. propulsion) → main equipment (main engine) → component (fuel injector, exhaust valve) → job (overhaul). Each job card contains the interval (hour-based, calendar-based or condition-based), the required spare parts, manpower, procedure reference and safety warnings.

Saat-bazlı joblar running hours counter'.en: Hour-based jobs are linked to the running hours counter; for example, the main engine fuel injector overhaul is triggered at 8,000 running hours. Calendar-based jobs are linked to dates (e.g. annual liferaft service). The Chief Engineer checks that running hours are entered correctly; a counter error shifts the whole chain.

Gemi PMS veritabanı ile şirket (office).en: The ship's PMS database and the company (office) database are synchronized regularly (replication). The Chief Engineer checks that synchronization has succeeded and that no jobs are missing; a break in synchronization leads to the superintendent in the office seeing incomplete data and making wrong decisions. In the job completion record, actual hours, spare parts consumption (ROB update) and the "remarks" field are filled in completely.

Bir work order; PMS tarafından otomatik.en: A work order is opened by the PMS automatically (when due) or manually (following a fault or inspection finding — corrective work order). At the weekly planning meeting, the Chief Engineer reviews the jobs due that week and those coming up, and prioritizes them according to manpower, spare parts availability, ship operations (in port or at sea) and safety risk.

İş, sorumlu mühendise atanır (örneğin ge.en: The job is assigned to the responsible engineer (e.g. generator overhaul to the Second Engineer, separator maintenance to the Third Engineer). For critical jobs or jobs requiring enclosed space entry, a separate permit to work is issued and a risk assessment is carried out. The work is scheduled so as not to affect main engine load and navigational safety.

İş tamamlandığında sorumlu mühendis; bul.en: When the job is completed, the responsible engineer enters the findings (e.g. liner wear measurement, ring end gap, clearance values), the spares used, the time spent and any anomalies in the work order. The Chief Engineer reviews this record and approves closure (sign-off). Before approval, the measured values are checked against the tolerances in the manual; if a value is out of tolerance, a follow-up job is opened.

Baş Mühendis'in onayı sadece bir tıklama.en: The Chief Engineer's approval is not just a click but a quality gate: if a measured value is illogical, there are no photographs or the remarks are empty, the job is sent back. This discipline is the guarantee that the PMS is carried out "on site, not on paper".

Baş Mühendis, PMS kayıtlarının sahaya ya.en: The Chief Engineer confirms that the PMS records reflect reality on site through regular "walk-around" inspections. Whether a job marked as completed has actually been done can be seen from the cleanliness of the equipment, new seals/gaskets, the oil color, the condition of the safety wires on bolts/nuts and the general condition. This inspection sends the team the message that "falsified records will be noticed".

Özellikle kritik ekipmanlarda (steering.en: Especially for critical equipment (steering gear, generators, fire/bilge pumps, emergency systems), testing requires not just a record but live functional verification: the emergency generator coming on load, the fire pump delivering pressure, the bilge alarm actually being triggered.

Yapılan bir overhaul mutlaka yedek parça.en: An overhaul always consumes spare parts (gaskets, O-rings, bearings, injector nozzles). If a job is "completed" in the PMS but the ROB (Remaining On Board) has not gone down at all, the job has most probably not been done. The Chief Engineer performs this cross-check periodically; vetting and class inspectors use the same method.

Bir job; yedek parça gelmediği, hava/ope.en: A job may not be done on its due date because spare parts have not arrived, weather/operations do not permit, or there is not enough manpower. In this case, instead of an uncontrolled delay, a formal deferral record is opened: the reason, a risk assessment, temporary measures (mitigation) and a new target date are documented. Postponing jobs on critical equipment requires company (superintendent) approval.

Sınıf kredisi (PMS credit) alınan kaleml.en: For items with class credit (PMS credit), if the class tolerance (generally the interval +10% or a set number of months) is exceeded, class approval (an extension) must be obtained. Exceeding it without approval may cause that item to be removed from the CMS.

Sabit saat-bazlı bakım her zaman optimum.en: Fixed hour-based maintenance is not always optimal; needlessly replacing a bearing in good condition creates both cost and a risk of failure (assembly errors). A modern PMS uses condition monitoring data (vibration, oil analysis, thermography, performance trends) as a job trigger. The Chief Engineer decides, with class and manufacturer approval, which equipment is suitable for CBM.

Baş Mühendis, PMS sağlığını sayısal göst.en: The Chief Engineer reports the health of the PMS to the office with numerical indicators. These are the total numbers of due/completed/overdue jobs, overdue jobs on critical equipment, the ratio of planned to unplanned maintenance (a high unplanned ratio is a sign of poor reliability), the average job completion time and the number of spare-part stock-outs.

Tekrarlayan arızalar (örn. aynı pompa me.en: Recurring failures (e.g. the mechanical seal of the same pump failing every 3 months) point to an inadequate PMS interval or procedure. The Chief Engineer carries out a root-cause analysis (RCA — 5 Why, fishbone); the solution is sometimes to shorten the interval, sometimes to upgrade the spare part quality and sometimes to revise the assembly procedure. This lesson is fed back into the PMS job card.

PMS, spare parça modülüyle entegredir. H.en: The PMS is integrated with the spare parts module. Minimum and maximum stock levels are defined for each critical part; when the ROB falls to the minimum, the system automatically proposes a requisition. Through "forward planning", the Chief Engineer brings forward the spares needs of jobs due in the next 3-6 months and reduces logistics costs with a single consolidated order.

CMS sörveyinde surveyor, kredi alınan ka.en: In the CMS survey, the surveyor asks for the job records, measured values and trends of the credited items. The Chief Engineer keeps the crank deflection measurements, exhaust valve/piston overhaul reports, T/C overhaul records and safety device (overspeed trip, low LO pressure trip) test records filed and accessible. Incomplete or inconsistent records lead to the item being transferred to physical survey.

PSC denetçisi PMS üzerinden emergency ve.en: The PSC inspector looks at the test records of emergency and safety equipment through the PMS; the SIRE 2.0 / TMSA inspector questions the integrity of the system, overdue critical jobs and whether the records match the situation on site. The Chief Engineer defends the ship in these inspections by keeping the PMS transparent and honest; behind every closed job there must always be real work and measurable evidence.

PMS statik değildir; her arıza, her yakı.en: The PMS is not static; every failure, every near-miss and every recurring problem is input for revising job cards and intervals. The Chief Engineer regularly sends improvement proposals (interval changes, procedure updates, new jobs) from the ship to the office. Similar equipment failures across the fleet are passed on to all ships by the office.

Yeni nesil gemilerde sürekli sensör veri.en: On new-generation ships, continuous sensor data (temperature, pressure, vibration, load) is sent to cloud-based analytics platforms; through anomaly detection, failures are predicted before they happen. This moves the PMS from calendar-based to condition-based/predictive maintenance. The Chief Engineer owns the accuracy of this data, the alarm thresholds and the response on site; however rich the data, the final technical decision belongs to the engineer.

PMS yönetiminde Baş Mühendis'in başarısı.en: The Chief Engineer's success in PMS management is not just a matter of filling in software; it is ensuring that maintenance is actually done, correctly recorded and keeps the equipment reliable. A well-managed PMS minimizes unplanned failures, survey surprises and the risk of detention; it is an invisible but decisive discipline that protects the ship's technical reputation and the company's inspection performance.

Scrubber'sız gemiler ECA'ya girmeden önc.en: Ships without scrubbers must change over to 0.10% compliant fuel (LSMGO/MGO or a very low sulfur distillate) before entering the ECA. The Chief Engineer designs the procedure according to the ship's compliance strategy (changeover or scrubber).

MARPOL Annex VI Reg. 14, kullanılan yakı.en: MARPOL Annex VI Reg. 14 requires the sulfur content of the fuel used to be within the limit and this to be demonstrated by the BDN, the fuel sample and the changeover record. During PSC inspections, sulfur compliance is verified by sample analysis and examination of the records.

Uyumsuzluk (non-compliance), gemi tutmay.en: Non-compliance leads to detention of the ship, heavy fines and problems with the charterer. Therefore correct timing and recording of the changeover is a primary duty of the Chief Engineer.

Changeover, ECA sınırına ulaşmadan ÖNCE.en: The changeover must be completed BEFORE reaching the ECA boundary. The Chief Engineer starts the changeover early enough, allowing for the ship's speed, the volume of HFO/VLSFO in the system and the purging time. Typically it is started hours before the ECA boundary.

Geçiş ECA içinde tamamlanırsa, gemi bir.en: If the changeover is completed inside the ECA, the ship will have navigated for some time with sulfur above the limit — this is a violation. Therefore the principle "enter the ECA on compliant fuel" is absolute and is planned with a safety margin.

HFO yaklaşık 130-150 °C'de servis edilir.en: HFO is supplied at about 130-150 °C, MGO/LSMGO at a much lower temperature. A sudden temperature change creates a risk of thermal shock, seizing and leakage in the fuel pumps and injectors. Therefore the changeover is carried out gradually and under control.

Geçiş sırasında fuel oil sıcaklık değişi.en: During the changeover, the rate of change of fuel oil temperature is kept below the limit specified by the engine maker (typically around 2 °C/minute). This allows the fuel system components to adapt gradually and prevents mechanical damage.

Changeover gerçek anlamda, fuel sistemin.en: In real terms, the changeover is completed when all the high-sulfur fuel in the fuel system (service tank, supply/booster line, fuel pumps, injectors) has been replaced by low-sulfur fuel. Until the HFO remaining in the system has been "purged" by the new fuel, the emission limit is exceeded.

Purging süresi; sistem hacmine ve yakıt.en: The purging time depends on the system volume and the fuel flow rate. Using the total volume of the system (piping + heater + filter + pumps) and the consumption rate, the Chief Engineer calculates the required changeover time and adds a safety margin.

Birçok gemide otomatik veya yarı-otomati.en: Many ships have an automatic or semi-automatic changeover system and "changeover calculator" software, which calculates the changeover duration and timing from the system parameters. The Chief Engineer verifies the result with engineering logic and does not trust it blindly.

Geçiş, sülfür içeriğinin %0.10 altına in.en: The changeover is considered complete when it has been confirmed that the sulfur content has fallen below 0.10%. For verification, the mixing ratio and the system flushing time are monitored; if there is any doubt, an extra margin is allowed.

MGO/LSMGO viskozitesi HFO'dan çok düşükt.en: The viscosity of MGO/LSMGO is much lower than that of HFO. For lubrication of the fuel pumps and injectors, the injection viscosity must not fall below a minimum value (generally ~2 cSt); otherwise pump seizure and injector wear occur. This is why some ships use a fuel cooler / chiller.

Viscotherm, HFO'da yakıtı ısıtırken; düş.en: While the viscotherm heats the fuel on HFO, it provides cooling if necessary on low-viscosity distillate. The Chief Engineer manages the viscosity control mode (heating vs. cooling) correctly during the changeover.

Düşük sülfürlü yakıt kullanımında, yükse.en: When using low-sulfur fuel, continuing to use high-TBN cylinder oil leads to deposit (ash build-up) problems. The Chief Engineer plans a cylinder oil with a TBN suited to the fuel sulfur content (~25-40 TBN for low sulfur) and the feed rate setting.

Geçiş süresince geçici TBN uyumsuzluğu k.en: A temporary TBN mismatch is acceptable during the changeover, but on long ECA passages the right choice of cylinder oil is essential. The wrong TBN triggers cold corrosion or deposit problems.

MARPOL, her changeover için yazılı kayıt.en: MARPOL requires a written record for each changeover: the start and end date/time of the changeover, the ship's position (lat/long), the fuel volume in each tank and the type of fuel used. This record is the legal proof that the ship entered the ECA on compliant fuel.

Baş Mühendis, kaydın gerçek operasyonla.en: The Chief Engineer ensures that the record is complete and consistent with the actual operation. ECA entry/exit positions are cross-checked with the bridge; inconsistent records create problems during inspections.

Her yakıt için BDN (Bunker Delivery Note.en: For each fuel, the BDN (Bunker Delivery Note) and the representative sample are kept for a set period as required by MARPOL (BDN 3 years, sample 12 months). PSC inspections ask for the BDN of the fuel in use and, if required, its sample.

Sülfür uyumu şüphesinde, gemide saklanan.en: If sulfur compliance is in doubt, analysis of the sample retained on board (MARPOL sample) and of the in-use/onboard sample is decisive. The sample chain of custody is carefully preserved.

Uyumsuz yakıtların karışması, asfalten ç.en: Mixing incompatible fuels can lead to asphaltene precipitation and filter/separator clogging; this creates a risk of loss of power inside the ECA. The Chief Engineer selects compatible fuels where possible and monitors the filter differential pressure during the changeover.

Sistem tıkanması veya viskozite sorunu n.en: Loss of power due to system clogging or a viscosity problem is critical inside an ECA for both safety and compliance. Therefore extra monitoring and readiness to respond (spare filter, fallback plan) are required during the changeover.

Uyumlu yakıt temin edilemediğinde, gemi.en: When compliant fuel cannot be obtained, the ship submits a FONAR documenting that it has made its best efforts. A FONAR is not an exemption but a declaration; it is notified to the relevant authority and the flag State and is subject to inspection.

Baş Mühendis, FONAR'a yol açan koşulları.en: The Chief Engineer carefully documents the conditions that led to the FONAR (bunker planning, efforts to obtain fuel). A FONAR is not a routine way out but is for genuine exceptions; misuse results in sanctions.

PSC inspector; changeover kaydını, BDN'l.en: The PSC inspector checks the changeover record, the BDNs, the in-use fuel sample and, if necessary, a spot sample taken from the system. These inspections intensify during sulfur CICs (Concentrated Inspection Campaigns).

Portable sülfür analizörü ile hızlı tara.en: A quick screening can be carried out with a portable sulfur analyzer; in a suspicious case, laboratory analysis is requested. The Chief Engineer keeps the records and the sample chain ready for inspection.

Baş Mühendis, AB sularındaki bu ek gerek.en: The Chief Engineer integrates these additional requirements in European Union waters into the changeover plan and adjusts fuel management according to the length of the port stay.

Aşağıdaki kontrol listesi, ECA yakıt geç.en: The checklist below summarizes the basic steps of managing an ECA fuel changeover and should be applied at every ECA approach.

ECA yakıt geçişi, mevzuat uyumu ile maki.en: The ECA fuel changeover is a sensitive operation where regulatory compliance and machinery safety intersect. Correct timing, an accurate purging calculation, viscosity control and meticulous records protect against both penalties and loss of power. The modern Chief Engineer manages this changeover not as a routine but as a technical process that is carefully planned every time.

Gece, makine dairesinin en kırılgan zama.en: Night is the most vulnerable time in the engine room: the team is smaller, fatigue increases and an error may be noticed late. Through night orders, the Chief Engineer clearly tells the engineer officer of the watch what to pay attention to that night, which risks to expect and what his or her limits are.

Bu pratik, vardiya zabitinin karar yetki.en: This practice clarifies the limits of the decision-making authority of the engineer officer of the watch and prevents preventable major failures from growing unreported. Written orders make up for the parts of a verbal briefing that are forgotten and provide evidence during inspections.

Gece talimatları, Engine Resource Manage.en: Night orders are part of the Engine Resource Management philosophy: effective use of resources (people, equipment, information) and clear communication. While using his or her authority, the Chief Engineer involves the team in decision-making and supports a "speak up" culture.

İyi bir gece talimatı tek yönlü emir değ.en: A good night order is not a one-way command; it is a two-way communication tool that also encourages the engineer officer of the watch to pass his or her observations and concerns to the Chief Engineer.

İyi yapılandırılmış bir gece talimatı; g.en: A well-structured night order covers the ship's status (at sea/maneuvering/in port), the specific equipment to be monitored that night, the expected risks, planned tasks and the "call the Chief" criteria. It must be clear, brief and action-oriented.

Baş Mühendis, o geceye özgü bağlamı (örn.en: The Chief Engineer reflects the context specific to that night in the orders (for example an ECA approach, heavy weather, follow-up of an ongoing fault, a newly joined junior officer). It is orders written for that particular night, not template orders, that are effective.

Baş Mühendis, o gece özellikle izlenmesi.en: The Chief Engineer clearly writes down the parameters to be specially monitored that night and their threshold values: for example "call me if the ME exhaust temperature difference exceeds 40 °C", "inform me if the stern tube oil tank level drops", "take action if the generator load imbalance exceeds X".

Bu somut eşikler, vardiya zabitinin \"no.en: These concrete thresholds make it easier for the engineer officer of the watch to distinguish between a "normal deviation" and a "situation requiring action", and prevent late intervention.

Gece talimatı, vardiya zabitinin hangi k.en: The night order clarifies which decisions the engineer officer of the watch may take alone: routinely starting a standby pump, minor adjustments, normal transfers. The Chief Engineer calibrates this authority to the officer's level of experience.

Junior bir zabit için sınırlar daha dar.en: For a junior officer, the limits are kept narrower and the principle "when in doubt, hold and call" is emphasized. Greater independence is given to an experienced Second/Third Engineer. The orders must clearly reflect this difference.

Gece talimatının en kritik bölümü, Baş M.en: The most critical part of the night order is a clear definition of the situations in which the Chief Engineer is to be woken. These criteria must leave no room for hesitation: safety/pollution risk, a critical alarm, an unexpected parameter, any doubt.

\"Şüphedeysen, ara\" altın kuraldır. Baş.en: "If in doubt, call" is the golden rule. The Chief Engineer must make it clear to the team that he or she does not mind being woken unnecessarily and that being informed late is much worse.

UMS (E0) sınıflı gemilerde makine daires.en: On UMS (E0) class ships, the engine room is unattended at night with no watch kept; the duty engineer is responsible via the call system. In this case the night order covers the duty engineer's rounds discipline, alarm response times and confirmation that the UMS conditions are met.

Baş Mühendis, UMS'e geçiş ön koşullarını.en: Through the night orders, the Chief Engineer reinforces that the preconditions for switching to UMS (alarms working, dead-man alarm active, standby equipment ready) are met every night. An alarm that is silenced and forgotten is a lethal risk.

Duty engineer, gece periyodik rounds yap.en: The duty engineer makes periodic rounds at night and activates the dead-man alarm (engineer's safety) system when working in the engine room. This system alerts the bridge if the engineer does not respond within a set time.

Gece talimatı, rounds sıklığını ve özell.en: The night order specifies the frequency of rounds and the points requiring particular attention. The Chief Engineer stresses that UMS means not "nobody there" but "monitored remotely, with a response ready".

Gece vardiyasında tank sounding, yakıt/y.en: During the night watch, tasks such as tank sounding, fuel/oil transfers, separator cleaning, monitoring FW production and generator changeover are planned. The Chief Engineer specifies in the orders in what order and with what care these are to be done.

Özellikle yakıt transferi gibi taşma (ov.en: Jobs with a risk of overflow, especially fuel transfers, are managed carefully at night with threshold warnings. The orders remind the watch of the checks that prevent overflow (level monitoring, confirming valve positions).

Eğer gündüzden devam eden bir sorun (örn.en: If there is a problem carried over from the day (e.g. a bearing temperature being monitored, a temporary repair, a rising trend), the night order specifically flags it and gives monitoring instructions.

Bu süreklilik, sorunun gece gözden kaçma.en: This continuity prevents the problem from being missed and growing during the night. The Chief Engineer clearly writes down the items being followed up and the intervention thresholds.

Etkili gece talimatı, otoriteyle birlikt.en: Effective night orders encourage open communication alongside authority. The engineer officer of the watch must be able to pass on observations and concerns without hesitation. A culture is established in which the Chief Engineer is bothered not by late news but by late intervention.

Hiyerarşi, emniyet-kritik bilginin yukar.en: Hierarchy must not prevent safety-critical information from reaching the top. Many machinery accidents have arisen from situations in which a junior officer kept silent out of concern about "not disturbing" anyone.

Gece talimatları imzalı bir defterde vey.en: Night orders are kept in a signed book or in a digital system; the engineer officer of the watch signs to confirm having read them. This record both documents the communication and is evidence of departmental discipline during inspections (vetting/PSC).

Baş Mühendis, talimatların düzenli, okun.en: The Chief Engineer ensures that the orders are orderly, legible and action-oriented. Vague or general orders do not serve their purpose; concreteness is essential.

Sık hatalar; her gece aynı kopyala-yapış.en: Common mistakes are writing the same copy-and-paste orders every night, leaving threshold values vague, omitting the call-out criteria and not allowing for the junior officer's level of experience. These mistakes make the orders useless.

Bir diğer hata, talimatı sadece bir form.en: Another mistake is to treat the orders as a mere formality and not reflect the real risks. The orders must be the product of real thought about that particular night.

İyi uygulamalar; talimatı o geceye özgü.en: Good practices are writing the orders specifically for that night, giving concrete thresholds, stating the call-out criteria clearly, providing extra guidance to junior officers and reinforcing the "if in doubt, call" culture.

Baş Mühendis ayrıca sabah, gece boyunca.en: In the morning, the Chief Engineer also reviews what happened during the night and gives feedback if necessary; this cycle continuously improves night operations.

Aşağıdaki kontrol listesi, etkili bir ge.en: The checklist below summarizes the elements of effective night orders.

Baş Mühendis gece talimatları, küçük bir.en: The Chief Engineer's night orders are a small document but a major safety tool. Clear thresholds, clear limits of authority and a strong "if in doubt, call" culture stop preventable failures from growing in the quiet hours of the night. Good night orders are an invisible lookout that carries the Chief Engineer's experience and priorities through the night.

Yağ analizi üç temel amaca hizmet eder:.en: Oil analysis serves three basic purposes: monitoring the oil's fitness for use (its condition), early detection of machinery wear and detection of contamination (water, fuel, sand). Together, these three are a cornerstone of predictive maintenance.

Baş Mühendis, analiz programını saatlik.en: The Chief Engineer uses the analysis program as a decision tool that replaces routine oil changes based on running hours. When managed correctly, it both extends equipment life and reduces the cost of unnecessary oil changes.

Program; ana makine system oil (crankcas.en: The program covers the main engine system oil (crankcase), generator crankcase oils, T/C oil, steering gear hydraulic oil, deck machinery (cranes/winches) and, if necessary, cylinder drain oil. Different parameters and limits apply to each item of equipment.

Cylinder drain oil analizi (scrape-down.en: Cylinder drain oil analysis (scrape-down analysis) is a separate and valuable technique, especially on 2-stroke main engines, for monitoring liner/ring wear and cylinder oil performance.

Analiz kalitesi, numune kalitesiyle başl.en: Analysis quality begins with sample quality. The sample must be taken while the machinery is running and the oil is hot, from a representative point in the system (running line / sampling valve). A sample taken from the bottom of a tank or from stagnant oil is misleading.

Numune kabı temiz, etiketleme doğru (eki.en: The sample container must be clean, the labeling correct (equipment, date, running hours, oil brand), and the sampling point must be flushed beforehand. A wrong sample leads to a wrong diagnosis and to unnecessary or insufficient action.

Baş Mühendis, standart bir numune alma p.en: The Chief Engineer applies a standard sampling procedure: same point, same conditions, same method. Consistency is essential for reliable trend analysis; using a different method each time distorts the trend.

Her numunenin alma tarihi, ekipman çalış.en: For each sample, the date taken, the equipment running hours and the oil's hours in service are recorded. This information is needed to interpret the result correctly and to enter it into the PMS.

Viskozite (ASTM D445); yağın taşıma kapa.en: Viscosity (ASTM D445) is an indicator of the oil's load-carrying capacity. An increase generally indicates oxidation, soot or heavy fuel contamination; a decrease indicates distillate/fuel dilution. The maker typically gives a deviation limit of ±10-20% from the initial value.

TBN (Total Base Number); yağın asit nötr.en: TBN (Total Base Number) is the oil's acid-neutralizing reserve; it provides protection against sulfurous combustion products. A fall in TBN to a critical level shows loss of protection. An increase in TAN (Total Acid Number), on the other hand, indicates oxidation and acidification.

Silikon (Si) genelde dış kaynaklı kum/to.en: Silicon (Si) generally indicates ingress of sand/dust from outside (an air filter problem) and accelerates abrasive wear. Sodium (Na) suggests seawater ingress. Each metal points to a particular component like a fingerprint.

Baş Mühendis, her parametreyi bir trend.en: The Chief Engineer tracks each parameter on a trend chart and establishes a baseline for a new machinery/oil combination. Deviations are assessed against the baseline; it is the trend that is read, not a single point.

Birden fazla parametrenin aynı anda anor.en: Several parameters becoming abnormal at the same time (e.g. an increase in water + Cu) is a strong diagnostic signal: in this example a cooler tube leak (seawater + copper from the cooler) is highly likely. Parameters are interpreted together.

Anormal sonuç alındığında Baş Mühendis ö.en: When an abnormal result is received, the Chief Engineer first questions the sample and possible errors (re-sample), then moves on to mechanical diagnosis. A critical result calls for immediate action; at a moderate level, monitoring frequency is increased and a plan is made.

Her teşhis, somut bir aksiyona bağlanır:.en: Every diagnosis is linked to a concrete action: filter check, cooler test, water leak investigation, additional sample or planned opening-up. The result is filed and entered in the PMS.

Analiz sonucu, üç olası kararı doğurur:.en: The analysis result leads to one of three possible decisions: change the oil (condition critical), top up with make-up oil (TBN/level low but oil sound), or clean it by purifier/filtration (water/particles present but oil chemistry good). The Chief Engineer makes the right decision.

Sağlam bir yağı erken atmak israftır; bo.en: Discarding a sound oil early is wasteful; continuing to use a degraded oil damages the machinery. Analysis strikes this balance with objective data.

System oil ve generator yağında purifier.en: In system oil and generator oil, the purifier (centrifuge) and fine filtration extend oil life by removing water and particles. The Chief Engineer ensures that the purifier setting (gravity disc, temperature) and filter condition are managed in line with the analysis results.

Düzgün purifikasyon, çoğu zaman yağ deği.en: Proper purification often delays an oil change or makes it unnecessary; this reduces costs and the volume of waste oil (sludge).

Numuneler, akredite ve denizcilik ekipma.en: Samples are sent to a laboratory that is accredited and familiar with marine equipment (e.g. the oil supplier's program or an independent analysis service). Using the same laboratory consistently is important for reliable trends.

Modern programlar, online portal üzerind.en: Modern programs provide results, trend charts and expert comments through an online portal. The Chief Engineer combines these comments with his or her own observations on site to make the final decision and does not trust the report blindly.

Laboratuvar sonucu beklenirken, gemide b.en: While waiting for the laboratory result, simple test kits on board (water detection — crackle test/hot plate, TBN/TAN test kit, viscosity comparison) provide a preliminary assessment. This is valuable for quick decisions in an emergency.

Gemi-içi testler laboratuvarın yerini tu.en: On-board tests do not replace the laboratory but provide early warning and confirmation. The Chief Engineer uses the two as complementary tools.

Tüm analiz sonuçları PMS kayıtlarına işl.en: All analysis results are entered in the PMS records; sample dates, results, actions taken and oil changes form a traceable history. These records are presented when requested by the class surveyor or the superintendent.

Yağ analizi, condition monitoring'in res.en: Oil analysis is included in the PMS scheme as a formal part of condition monitoring; regular and complete records are evidence of the program during inspections.

Yağ analizi trend'i, kişiden bağımsız ol.en: The oil analysis trend must be preserved independently of individuals. When the Chief Engineer is relieved, open follow-up items and the trend history are part of the handover; the new Chief Engineer continues the program without interruption.

Trend'in kesintiye uğraması, gelişen bir.en: An interrupted trend leads to a developing failure being missed. This is why the discipline of the program requires continuity in ship management.

Aşağıdaki kontrol listesi, yağlama yağı.en: The checklist below summarizes the basic steps of the lubricating oil analysis program.

Yağlama yağı analiz programı, Baş Mühend.en: The lubricating oil analysis program is the most powerful predictive tool that lets the Chief Engineer "see inside" the machinery without opening it up. Disciplined sampling, correct interpretation of parameters and trend tracking catch internal wear early, prevent unnecessary oil changes and optimize both equipment life and cost-effectiveness. Like a tribology specialist, the modern Chief Engineer reads the story the oil tells.

EEDI (Energy Efficiency Design Index) ye.en: EEDI (Energy Efficiency Design Index) is a design index applied to newbuildings; it measures the energy efficiency of the ship's design in g CO2/tonne-mile. EEXI is an equivalent index applied to existing ships; it assesses the ship's technical/design efficiency and requires one-time compliance.

CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator) ise ope.en: CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator), on the other hand, is an operational indicator: it is based on the ship's actual annual fuel consumption and the distance traveled. EEXI answers the question "how efficiently was the ship designed?" and CII the question "how efficiently is the ship operated in practice?".

Baş Mühendis, bu indekslerin teknik tara.en: The Chief Engineer manages the technical side of these indices: correct collection of fuel consumption data, implementation of energy efficiency measures and optimal operation of the machinery/propulsion systems. As CII is operational, the Chief Engineer's daily decisions directly affect the rating.

Bu rol; mevzuat bilgisi, veri yönetimi v.en: This role combines regulatory knowledge, data management and engineering optimization. The Chief Engineer implements the compliance strategy together with the Master and shore management.

EEXI; ana ve yardımcı makine gücüne, SFC.en: EEXI is calculated with a formula based on main and auxiliary engine power, SFC (specific fuel consumption), the fuel carbon factor, the ship's DWT/capacity and the reference speed. The attained EEXI must be below the required EEXI determined by ship type/size.

EEXI uyumu, gemi inşa edildiğinden bağım.en: EEXI compliance is a one-time requirement imposed on the existing fleet, regardless of when the ship was built. If compliance cannot be achieved, technical measures are taken.

En yaygın EEXI uyum yöntemi, Engine Powe.en: The most common EEXI compliance method is limiting the maximum available power with Engine Power Limitation (EPL) or Shaft Power Limitation (ShaPoLi). This lowers the attained EEXI by restricting the engine's MCR by software or mechanical means.

EPL/ShaPoLi'de, acil durumda (kötü hava,.en: With EPL/ShaPoLi, an override facility is provided so that the limit can be exceeded in an emergency (heavy weather, safety of maneuvering); however, any override must be recorded and justified. The Chief Engineer is responsible for the correct operation of this system and for override discipline.

Attained CII, geminin bir yıldaki toplam.en: Attained CII is calculated by dividing the ship's total CO2 emissions in a year (fuel consumption × carbon factor) by its transport work (capacity × distance traveled). This value is compared with the required CII reference line specific to the ship type/size.

Sonuç, A (çok iyi) ile E (kötü) arasında.en: The result is converted into a rating from A (very good) to E (poor). Because the reduction factor tightens every year, the rating can drop over time even with the same performance; this makes continuous improvement mandatory.

Bir gemi üst üste üç yıl D veya bir yıl.en: If a ship receives a D rating for three consecutive years or an E rating for one year, it must prepare a Corrective Action Plan (CAP), to be included in the SEEMP, and have it approved. The CAP contains concrete measures to bring the rating up to C or better.

Baş Mühendis, CAP'in teknik içeriğini (h.en: The Chief Engineer prepares the technical content of the CAP (speed profile, hull/propeller cleaning, energy efficiency investments) and manages its implementation. The CAP must not be just a document; it must be a workable action plan.

Hız, CII üzerinde en güçlü operasyonel k.en: Speed is the strongest operational lever on CII; since consumption varies roughly with the cube of speed, a small reduction in speed gives a large reduction in emissions. Slow steaming is planned together with the Master within the limits of the charter party and ETA constraints.

Just-in-time arrival (limanda demir bekl.en: Just-in-time arrival (arriving at optimum speed instead of waiting at anchor off the port) saves both fuel and emissions. The Chief Engineer adapts the main engine's low-load efficiency (de-rating, tuning) to this profile.

Optimum trim, gövde direncini azaltarak.en: Optimum trim reduces hull resistance and lowers fuel consumption. Trim optimization software recommends the most efficient trim for the cargo/draft condition. The Chief Engineer helps the ship get close to this optimum through ballast management and cargo distribution.

Küçük trim değişiklikleri bile, uzun sef.en: Even small trim changes give meaningful savings on long voyages. This is a zero-investment efficiency measure and should be applied regularly.

Gövde ve pervane fouling (kabuklanma), d.en: Hull and propeller fouling increases resistance dramatically and raises consumption. Regular hull cleaning and propeller polishing can save 3-8% fuel. The Chief Engineer plans the timing of cleaning by looking at the performance trend (rising SFOC, falling speed).

Düşük sürtünmeli (anti-fouling / foul-re.en: The choice of low-friction (anti-fouling / foul-release) paint also affects long-term efficiency; this is evaluated in drydock planning. Hull performance monitoring (ISO 19030) makes these decisions objective.

Atık ısı geri kazanımı (Waste Heat Recov.en: Waste heat recovery (Waste Heat Recovery System — WHRS) increases overall efficiency by producing steam/electricity from exhaust gas heat. Where fitted, the Chief Engineer manages the optimum operation of the WHRS and the maintenance of the exhaust gas economizer.

Yardımcı yük (auxiliary load) yönetimi d.en: Auxiliary load management is also important: avoiding unnecessary pump/fan operation, using variable frequency drives (VFD) and running the correct number of generators in parallel lower generator fuel consumption.

Dekarbonizasyon yolunda LNG (düşük CO2,.en: On the path to decarbonization, the options assessed are LNG (low CO2, risk of methane slip), methanol (ease of storage), biofuel (drop-in, limited supply) and ammonia/hydrogen (zero carbon, high technical difficulty). Each has a different emissions, storage and safety profile.

Baş Mühendis, geminin mevcut/planlanan y.en: The Chief Engineer evaluates the ship's existing/planned fuel flexibility (dual-fuel, biofuel-ready) and its effect on carbon intensity. Biofuel blending is a practical transition option that can lower CII on existing engines.

AB ETS, denizcilik CO2 emisyonlarına kar.en: The EU ETS has put a carbon price on shipping CO2 emissions; FuelEU Maritime sets a progressively tighter limit on the life-cycle GHG intensity of the fuel used. These regulations add a direct financial dimension to fuel choice.

Baş Mühendis, bu düzenlemelerin gemi ope.en: The Chief Engineer understands the technical and cost impact of these regulations on ship operation; accurate data collection and reporting are critical for a correct cost calculation.

SEEMP Part II, yakıt tüketim verisinin (.en: SEEMP Part II defines the method for collecting fuel consumption data (IMO DCS); Part III contains the CII targets and the implementation plan for achieving them. The Chief Engineer ensures that the data are collected consistently, completely and in line with the approved plan.

Veri kalitesi, CII hesabının ve dolayısı.en: Data quality determines the accuracy of the CII calculation and therefore of the rating. The noon report, bunker records and DCS data must be consistent with each other; inconsistency causes problems at verification.

Yıllık DCS verisi, yetkili bir doğrulayı.en: Annual DCS data are checked by an authorized verifier (RO), and a Statement of Compliance (SoC) is issued to a compliant ship. The Chief Engineer keeps all records and evidence ready for verification.

Doğrulama süreci, verinin izlenebilir ve.en: The verification process requires the data to be traceable and consistent; missing evidence delays the SoC. This in turn can affect the ship's certification status.

Aşağıdaki kontrol listesi, karbon perfor.en: The following checklist summarizes the key elements of carbon performance management.

EEDI/EEXI/CII karbon performans yönetimi.en: EEDI/EEXI/CII carbon performance management is the fastest-growing area of responsibility for the modern Chief Engineer. Technical optimization (speed, trim, hull, WHRS), accurate data collection and knowledge of the regulations must be pursued together. Carbon performance is no longer just a compliance matter; it is a strategic parameter that determines the ship's commercial competitiveness and the future of the fleet.

Şaft hattı; thrust bearing, intermediate.en: The shaft line consists of the thrust bearing, intermediate shaft(s), intermediate bearings, stern tube (forward + aft bearing), propeller shaft (tail shaft) and the propeller. The stern tube is the critical section that carries the shaft through the hull and acts as both bearing and seal.

Stern tube içinde aft bearing (pervaneye.en: Inside the stern tube are the aft bearing (closest to the propeller, the most heavily loaded bearing) and the forward bearing; at the ends, the aft seal (sea side) and fore seal (engine room side) prevent water ingress and oil leakage.

Stern tube iki temel tipte olabilir: oil.en: There are two basic types of stern tube: oil-lubricated (white metal bearing, lubricated by oil — the most common) and water-lubricated (usually a composite/synthetic bearing, lubricated by seawater). A water-lubricated system eliminates the risk of oil pollution, but bearing life and weardown management are different.

Oil-lubricated sistemlerde, çevre düzenl.en: Because of environmental regulations (in particular the US VGP), EAL (Environmentally Acceptable Lubricant) oils are increasingly used in oil-lubricated systems. The Chief Engineer applies oil and seal management suited to the system type.

Oil-lubricated stern tube sisteminde, ya.en: In an oil-lubricated stern tube system, the oil pressure is set by the gravity (header) tank so as to balance the seawater pressure at the aft seal. Depending on the draft, the tank height keeps the stern tube pressure slightly above sea pressure; in this way seawater cannot enter and the oil stays under control.

Baş Mühendis, header tank seviyesini gün.en: The Chief Engineer monitors the header tank level daily. A falling level (oil consumption) indicates an aft or fore seal leak; a sudden change indicates a serious seal failure. The tank level is the most important early warning indicator of the system.

Normal stern tube yağ tüketimi düşük ve.en: Normal stern tube oil consumption is low and steady. An increase in consumption indicates a leak; an increase of water in the oil (in the analysis) indicates seawater ingress through the aft seal. The Chief Engineer assesses these two indicators together.

Su girişi, white metal aft bearing'i cid.en: Water ingress severely wears the white metal aft bearing and accelerates weardown. Early detection can prevent an expensive tail-shaft draw repair.

Modern stern tube seal'leri genelde lip-.en: Modern stern tube seals are usually of the lip-seal type; the aft seal (sea side) uses more than one lip to prevent water ingress and oil leakage. As the lips wear, sealing deteriorates; most systems allow an adjustment that changes the contact point of the lip on the liner.

Bazı modern sistemlerde air seal veya em.en: Some modern systems are fitted with an air seal or emergency seal arrangement; if the aft seal fails, it temporarily stops water ingress and buys time until drydock. The Chief Engineer knows whether these emergency arrangements are fitted and how they work.

Aft seal arızası, ya denize yağ sızıntıs.en: Aft seal failure results either in oil leakage to sea (pollution) or in water ingress (bearing damage). The Chief Engineer assesses the direction and severity of the leak; temporary control is achieved by adjusting the gravity tank level or by bringing the emergency seal into service.

Kalıcı seal değişimi genellikle drydock.en: Permanent seal replacement usually requires drydock or an in-water seal repair (possible with some types). The Chief Engineer records the leak, coordinates with class/the company and plans the repair.

Stern tube yağı periyodik olarak analiz.en: Stern tube oil is analyzed periodically: water content (seawater ingress), white metal (Sn/Pb — aft bearing wear), Fe (shaft/liner), viscosity (contamination) and cleanliness (ISO 4406 particle count). These parameters show the condition of the bearing and seals without opening up.

White metal (kalay/kurşun) içeriğinin ar.en: An increase in white metal (tin/lead) content is an early sign that the aft bearing has started to wear seriously, and it is assessed together with the weardown measurement. A simultaneous rise in water and white metal indicates a chain of seal failure + bearing damage.

Oil-lubricated stern tube ve onaylı seal.en: On ships with an oil-lubricated stern tube and an approved seal system, class requires regular oil analysis for extending the tail-shaft survey interval (Extended Tail Shaft Survey). Analysis results must be within the acceptance criteria and the trend must not deteriorate.

Baş Mühendis, bu analiz disiplinini sürd.en: By keeping up this analysis discipline, the Chief Engineer both monitors machinery health and can postpone the expensive, time-consuming shaft withdrawal survey. Missing analyses forfeit the right to a survey extension.

Aft bearing weardown, şaftın yatak içind.en: Aft bearing weardown measures how far the shaft has dropped in the bearing due to wear; it is usually measured with a poker gauge / wear-down gauge from the aft seal area. Regular measurement shows the wear trend and remaining life of the bearing.

Weardown sınıf limitine yaklaştığında, a.en: When weardown approaches the class limit, aft bearing renewal is planned. Accelerating weardown is usually caused by water ingress (poor lubrication) or by high load/misalignment, and the root cause is investigated.

Yanlış şaft alignment, belirli yataklard.en: Incorrect shaft alignment leads to excessive load on certain bearings, hot bearings, vibration and, in the long term, shaft fatigue cracks. Alignment is verified in drydock by gap & sag measurements and bearing reaction (jack-up) tests.

Baş Mühendis, seyirde intermediate ve th.en: At sea, the Chief Engineer monitors intermediate and thrust bearing temperatures; a sudden rise in temperature points to an alignment or lubrication problem. A hot bearing is a warning that requires immediate action.

Controllable Pitch Propeller (CPP) veya.en: On Controllable Pitch Propellers (CPP) and some fixed pitch systems, an injection/monitoring system is fitted to protect the oil inside the propeller hub/boss cap against seawater pressure. This system prevents and monitors seawater ingress into the hub oil (sea water leak).

Baş Mühendis, boss cap/hub oil seviyesin.en: The Chief Engineer monitors the boss cap/hub oil level and pressure and, if water ingress is detected (rising water in the analysis), assesses whether there is a seal/O-ring problem. On CPP systems, hydraulic pitch control and oil cleanliness are also managed separately.

Pervane cavitation, kanat yüzeyinde pitt.en: Propeller cavitation causes pitting (erosion) on the blade surface, noise and loss of efficiency. Excessive cavitation leads to blade damage and vibration. Regular propeller polishing and correct pitch/load management limit cavitation.

Pervane fouling ve erozyon verimi düşürd.en: Since propeller fouling and erosion reduce efficiency, the condition of the propeller is assessed during the in-water survey and polishing is planned. This is important for both efficiency and CII.

Şaft hattında torsional, axial ve latera.en: Torsional, axial and lateral vibrations are monitored on the shaft line. Bearing/shaft vibration measurements to ISO 20816 give early warning of developing misalignment, bearing wear or propeller damage. At sea, the barred speed range (critical rpm range) is passed through as quickly as possible.

Sürekli titreşim monitoring (varsa) tren.en: Continuous vibration monitoring (where fitted) provides a trend; periodic hand-held measurements are also valuable. A rising trend triggers a planned inspection and intervention.

Stern tube aft seal'den denize yağ sızın.en: Oil leakage from the stern tube aft seal to sea is marine pollution under MARPOL Annex I. If a leak is detected, the relevant records (for example the ORB and a leak report) must be kept and, where required, the authorities must be notified.

Baş Mühendis, header tank seviye trend'i.en: By monitoring the header tank level trend and oil consumption, the Chief Engineer tries to catch even small, invisible leaks. Using EAL reduces the environmental impact of a leak but does not remove the obligation to record it.

Aşağıdaki kontrol listesi, şaft ve stern.en: The following checklist summarizes the key elements of shaft and stern tube system management.

Şaft ve stern tube sistemi yönetimi, gör.en: Shaft and stern tube system management is an unseen but vital responsibility of the Chief Engineer. A seal failure caught early through discipline in header tank level, oil analysis and weardown prevents an expensive drydock repair, bearing damage and MARPOL pollution all at once. The modern Chief Engineer uses data to "see" a system that cannot be opened up, and intervenes before trends grow.

In-water survey, klas onayıyla bazı sörv.en: With class approval, an in-water survey allows some surveys to be carried out while the ship is afloat and can extend the drydock interval. Propeller polishing and hull cleaning reduce friction and save fuel. The Chief Engineer coordinates both the technical and the safety aspects of these operations.

Operasyon, yetkin (IMCA standartlarına u.en: The operation is carried out by a competent dive team (meeting IMCA standards) under an approved dive plan. The plan covers the task, depth, duration, communications, emergency and decompression aspects. The Chief Engineer ensures that, on the ship's part, the machinery systems are prepared in accordance with the plan.

Dalgıç su altındayken; ana pervane, bow/.en: While a diver is under water, the main propeller, bow/stern thrusters, side thrusters and sea suction valves must on no account be operated. These systems are isolated under LOTO, locked and tagged; the bridge and the engine room are informed. Accidental start-up of a thruster is fatal for a diver.

Operasyon, permit-to-work ile başlatılır.en: The operation is started under a permit to work; all isolations are verified, the responsible persons sign, and the isolation is maintained until the job is finished. At a watch change, the incoming team confirms the isolation.

Pervane parlatma yüzey pürüzlülüğünü aza.en: Propeller polishing reduces surface roughness and increases efficiency; hull cleaning removes biofouling (accumulated marine growth). The Chief Engineer monitors the performance gain after cleaning. When removing biofouling, port environmental rules (invasive species/biocide) are observed.

Gövde, korozyona karşı sacrificial anode.en: The hull is protected against corrosion by sacrificial anodes or Impressed Current Cathodic Protection (ICCP). During the underwater inspection, anode wastage is measured and ICCP system performance (potential readings) is recorded. Insufficient protection accelerates hull and propeller corrosion.

Dalgıç video/fotoğrafları, ölçümler (ano.en: Diver video/photographs, measurements (anodes, thickness), surveyor findings and work done are recorded and reported to class/the company. These records form the basis for planning the next drydock and for class compliance.

Sualtı bakım koordinasyonu, teknik kazan.en: Underwater maintenance coordination is an area where technical gains have value only together with absolute safety. The Chief Engineer's rigorous LOTO discipline, verified isolation and careful record-keeping safeguard both the diver's life and the integrity of the ship's hull.

Baş Mühendis, voyage instruction'a göre.en: Based on the voyage instructions, the Chief Engineer calculates the total fuel requirement: main engine consumption (sea consumption × steaming days), auxiliary engine consumption (auxiliary load × port + sea days), boiler/inert gas consumption and a safety margin (usually 10-15% reserve). The ROB (Remaining On Board) is verified by sounding/ullage, and the stem quantity is determined accordingly.

Tank kapasitesi planlaması kritiktir: sü.en: Tank capacity planning is critical: fuels of different sulfur content (HSFO on a ship with a scrubber, VLSFO, MGO) are segregated in separate tanks, and the ban on commingling and the 85% maximum filling rule (ullage allowance for thermal expansion) are observed. A wrong tank plan can make the ECA changeover impossible.

VLSFO'lar 2020 sonrası market'e girmiş \.en: VLSFOs are "blend" fuels that entered the market after 2020; they are more sensitive than conventional HFO in terms of stability (sediment), compatibility (incompatibility/asphaltene precipitation) and cold flow properties (high pour point). Commingling different VLSFO batches can lead to asphaltene precipitation and filter clogging; a compatibility test (spot test ASTM D4740) is therefore recommended.

Bunker öncesi Baş Mühendis bir pre-trans.en: Before bunkering, the Chief Engineer applies a pre-transfer checklist (based on ISGOTT/SMS): all valve line-ups must be verified, the overflow tank empty, save-all trays and scuppers plugged (closed), SOPEP equipment ready, fire extinguishers in place, the emergency stop signal agreed and communication with the barge (VHF/radio) tested. Duties are assigned to all deck personnel.

Quantity dispute'ı önlemek için bunkerin.en: To avoid a quantity dispute, both parties take tank measurements before and after bunkering (joint measurement). The barge tank table figures are converted to metric tons by applying trim/list correction and temperature-density correction (VCF — Volume Correction Factor). Watch out for artificial inflation of volume by aerated fuel (cappuccino effect).

BDN (Bunker Delivery Note) MARPOL Annex.en: Under MARPOL Annex VI Reg. 18.5, the BDN (Bunker Delivery Note) must be kept on board for at least 3 years and must contain: ship's name/IMO number, port, date of delivery, supplier details, product name, quantity (MT), density@15°C, sulfur content (% m/m) and the supplier's declaration of MARPOL compliance.

Catalytic fines (alüminyum + silikon oks.en: Catalytic fines (aluminum + silicon oxide particles) are hard, abrasive particles that come from the refinery FCC process. They cause dramatic wear in the fuel injection system and especially at the liner-piston ring contact surface. The ISO 8217 limit is 60 mg/kg, but it is recommended to reduce them to below 15 mg/kg at the engine inlet (after the purifier).

Catfines yönetimi: settling tank residen.en: Catfines management means settling tank residence time, running two purifiers in series (purifier + clarifier), correct gravity disc selection and an optimum separation temperature of 98°C. If high catfines are detected, the feed rate is reduced to increase separation efficiency.

Centrifugal separator HFO/VLSFO için opt.en: The centrifugal separator is operated at an optimum 95-98°C for HFO/VLSFO. With modern high-density fuels, control of the interface (water-oil boundary) becomes difficult; this is why most ships use "self-cleaning + density independent" type separators without a gravity disc (Alfa Laval S-separator, GEA). Feed rate directly affects separation quality; low feed = high separation efficiency.

Separator bowl temizliği, sludge boşaltm.en: Separator bowl cleaning, sludge discharge frequency and heater performance are monitored regularly. In separators operating with water (purifier mode), if the seal water is not set correctly, breakthrough (fuel escaping to the water side) occurs. In clarifier mode (no water seal), only particles are separated.

Tank sounding/ullage günlük yapılır; ROB.en: Tank sounding/ullage is taken daily, and ROB consistency is monitored. Free water (water collected at the tank bottom) is drained regularly. For tank atmosphere/flashpoint safety, the flashpoint ≥60°C rule (SOLAS) is observed; low-flashpoint fuel (e.g. after accidental MGO/HFO commingling) is a serious fire risk.

Baş Mühendis, yakıt tüketim verilerini (.en: The Chief Engineer is responsible for correctly reporting fuel consumption data (IMO DCS — Data Collection System). If a D rating is received for 3 consecutive years or an E rating in a single year, a corrective action plan under SEEMP Part III is mandatory. Fuel choice, speed profile and hull/propeller performance directly affect CII.

Cylinder oil TBN'i (Base Number) yakıt s.en: Cylinder oil TBN (Base Number) is selected according to fuel sulfur content. 70-100 TBN is suitable for high-sulfur HSFO (scrubber ship), 40-70 TBN for VLSFO and 25-40 TBN for low-sulfur MGO/ULSFO. Choosing the wrong (too low) TBN leads to cold corrosion (sulfuric acid corrosion); too high a TBN leads to calcium deposits and bore polishing.

Modern Alpha Lubricator / SIP (Swirl Inj.en: Modern Alpha Lubricator / SIP (Swirl Injection Principle) systems adjust the feed rate automatically according to engine load and sulfur. Feed rate is usually 0.6-1.4 g/kWh; the minimum guaranteed feed rate is maintained in accordance with the engine maker's specification. Scrape-down (drain) oil analysis is the basis for feed rate optimization.

System oil aylık/üç-aylık spectroanalysi.en: System oil is monitored by monthly/quarterly spectroanalysis (spectro metals, FT-IR oxidation, water, TBN, viscosity). A trend graph is far more valuable than a single measurement. If water ingress rises above 0.2%, a jacket cooler or stuffing box leak is suspected; fuel ingress (fuel dilution) lowers viscosity and creates a flashpoint risk.

ECA'ya girişten önce sistemin tamamen dü.en: Before entering an ECA, the system must have been completely changed over to low-sulfur fuel.
