A painting job left half-done because of insufficient paint stock throws away all the surface preparation already done; this is the most expensive waste of all. The balance lies in planned consumption and timely resupply.

Reis, bakım programını ve stok durumunu.en: By considering the maintenance program and the stock situation together, the Bosun prepares a requisition for the next supply port. A good requisition includes the item name, technical description (brand/specification/IMPA code), quantity, unit and urgency. Instead of a vague "some paint", it says "brand X epoxy primer, gray, 20 L, 4 units".

IMPA (International Marine Purchasing As.en: The IMPA (International Marine Purchasing Association) catalog is the common language of ship supply. Using IMPA codes prevents the supplier from sending the wrong part. The Bosun knows these codes for frequently used items or has access to the catalog.

Reisin hazırladığı liste Birinci Zabit t.en: The list prepared by the Bosun is reviewed by the Chief Officer, combined with the budget and priorities, and sent to the company purchasing department. The Bosun separates recurring needs (paint, consumables) from one-off needs (special equipment that has broken or been used up), so that the approval chain does not get blocked.

İkmal limanına yaklaşırken Reis, tedarik.en: When approaching a supply port, the Bosun knows that the delivery window is limited; a requisition submitted late is carried over to the next port. Needs are therefore identified in advance and in a planned way, not reactively.

Malzeme gemiye geldiğinde Reis, teslimat.en: When material arrives on board, the Bosun compares the delivery note with the order list: items, quantities and specifications are checked, and the goods are checked for damage. Missing, wrong or damaged items are written on the delivery note as a "remark" and reported to the Chief Officer; a shortage accepted silently later becomes the ship's problem.

Teslim alınan kalemler vakit kaybetmeden.en: Items received are put in their places in the store without delay, following FIFO (new items at the back, old ones at the front). Certified items (rope, wire, LSA equipment) are recorded together with their certificates.

Tel makarası, boya fıçısı, demir teçhiza.en: Heavy items such as wire reels, paint drums and metal fittings are usually lowered into the store with a crane or the provision crane. During this operation, the Bosun checks the SWL of the lifting gear, the slinging points and that nobody stands under the load. For manual handling, correct lifting technique (legs, not back) and suitable PPE are essential.

Bir PSC, SIRE/CDI vetting veya klas dene.en: When a PSC, SIRE/CDI vetting or class inspector enters the store, the inspector looks at a few things: order, labeling, segregation of dangerous substances, presence of LSA/spare equipment and traceability of certificates. A store that is untidy, unlabeled or has incompatible substances mixed together immediately produces a "housekeeping" finding and gives a negative impression of the ship's general maintenance culture.

Reis, denetimden önce değil, sürekli den.en: The Bosun keeps the store ready for inspection at all times, not just before an inspection. The "always ready" philosophy removes the last-minute rush and its risks.

Sertifikalı teçhizat (halat, tel, kaldır.en: For certified equipment (rope, wire, lifting gear, LSA), there must be an immediate answer to the question "what is where, and with which certificate". The Bosun matches the physical tag to the digital record. In an investigation after an accident, traceability is also evidence that the ship exercised "due diligence".

Aşağıdaki liste, düzenli ve denetime haz.en: The list below summarizes the minimum daily/weekly/per-voyage checks for a tidy, inspection-ready bosun's store. Once the Bosun makes these items routine, the store becomes an asset that speeds up the team's work.

Bosun's store yönetimi, dışarıdan basit.en: Although managing the bosun's store may look from the outside like a simple "storekeeping job", it is in fact a discipline that directly determines the ship's maintenance capability. Having the right material ready at the right time, safely and traceably, keeps planned maintenance running without interruption, keeps the crew safe and lets the ship pass inspections without problems.

Reis, store'u bir maliyet kalemi değil,.en: The Bosun sees the store not as a cost item but as a managed asset. A well-kept store reduces waste, makes resupply predictable and becomes one of the most visible signs of the ship's professional maintenance culture.

Pilot ladder, accommodation ladder ve ga.en: Pilot ladders, accommodation ladders and gangways carry people every day; a defect can lead directly to a fall and death. The Bosun knows that this equipment must actually be safe, not just "look good", and manages its maintenance seriously.

Pilot ladder; basamak çatlağı/eksikliği,.en: The pilot ladder is checked before every use for cracked/missing steps, worn/rotten ropes, the condition of the spreaders and its overall integrity. It must be certified, undamaged and rigged at the correct height. The Bosun verifies that the combination arrangement (accommodation + pilot ladder) is safe.

Accommodation ladder ve gangway; vinç/ha.en: Accommodation ladders and gangways are checked for the winch/falls system, the condition of the steps/platforms, the railings (stanchions/ropes) and the safety net. The Bosun ensures that lubrication, wear checks and load tests are carried out. The safety net, which protects against falls, must always be taut and correctly rigged.

Erişim ekipmanı altında safety net ve ya.en: A safety net is rigged under the access equipment, and a lifebuoy + light + heaving line is kept nearby. These preparations are essential for a quick response if someone falls into the water. The Bosun ensures that these safety arrangements are always in place.

Bosun's chair ile yüksekte (aloft) veya.en: Working aloft or overside in a bosun's chair is high-risk work; the integrity of the rope/chair, a separate safety line (independent lifeline), a full body harness and a permit to work are mandatory. The Bosun checks these preparations and does not let inexperienced personnel work aloft unsupervised.

Working aloft/overside, permit-to-work v.en: Working aloft/overside requires a permit to work and a risk assessment; the weather, ship motion and risk of falling are assessed. The Bosun holds a toolbox talk, checks the PPE/harnesses and maintains supervision throughout the work.

Borda iskelesi, merdiven ve erişim ekipm.en: Maintenance of accommodation ladders, ladders and access equipment is one of the Bosun's most sensitive duties, as it relates directly to the safety of life. Certified equipment, correct rigging, a secondary safety line and constant supervision ensure that every embarkation/disembarkation and every overside job is completed safely.

Yeni katılan tayfa; gemiyi, ekipmanı ve.en: Newly joined deckhands do not yet fully know the ship, the equipment and the risks. This is why new personnel stand out in accident statistics. The Bosun knows that giving them the right start protects both their lives and the safety of the whole team.

Yeni personel; muster station, can kurta.en: On their first day on board, new personnel are briefed on the muster station, the locations of life-saving and fire-fighting equipment, escape routes, alarm signals and basic safety rules (familiarization). The Bosun gives the practical familiarization on the deck side and completes the checklist.

Reis; halat işleri, raspa-boya, ekipman.en: The Bosun teaches rope work, chipping and painting, the use of equipment and deck routines by demonstration. The "watch first, then do it under supervision, then on your own" approach is the most reliable way of building safe competence. New personnel are encouraged to ask questions.

Overside work, working aloft, enclosed s.en: In high-risk work such as overside work, working aloft, enclosed spaces and mooring, inexperienced personnel are never allowed to work alone. The Bosun pairs them with an experienced team member and supervises them directly. Supervision continues until competence has been proven.

Reis, yeni personeli ekibe katar; görev.en: The Bosun brings new personnel into the team, introducing them to the distribution of duties, communication within the team and the culture of the ship. A well-integrated deckhand feels safe, shares problems and works more safely. Personnel who are excluded or left on their own become both unhappy and a risk.

Acemilik eğitimi ve yeni personel desteğ.en: Training newcomers and supporting new personnel is the most valuable investment of the Bosun's leadership; a deckhand taught correctly today is a safe and competent team member tomorrow. Patient training, close supervision and sincere integration protect both the individual's life and the team's safety.

Demir operasyonunda Reis, baş kasara güv.en: In anchor operations, the Bosun leads the team on the forecastle deck and is the link between the bridge and the station. The Bosun carries out the orders, keeps the team in safe positions, watches the condition of the cable/anchor and reports it to the bridge. In these intense moments, clear communication and composure are vital.

Reis, seyir öncesi demir zincirini kontr.en: Before sailing, the Bosun checks the anchor cable: link wear, cracks, deformation and the legibility of the markings. If abnormal load, vibration or noise is noticed, the bridge is warned. A weakness in the cable can lead to loss of the anchor or an accident during the operation.

Demir atarken/alırken zincirin yönü (lea.en: When anchoring/weighing anchor, the lead and tension of the cable are reported to the bridge ("cable leading ahead, moderate strain"). This information is critical for the Master's assessment of the maneuver and of whether the anchor is holding.

Ekip baret, eldiven, çelik burunlu ayakk.en: The team wears hard hats, gloves, steel-toed shoes and eye protection; goggles are important because of the dust/particles around the cable. Radio communication with the bridge is clear and confirmed. In a noisy environment, hand signals are also agreed in advance.

Demir operasyonlarında ekip liderliği, R.en: Leading the team in anchor operations is the peak of the Bosun's command on deck; in an intense, noisy and risky environment, the Bosun keeps the team safe while putting the bridge's intentions into effect. Clear communication, safe positioning and the ability to "read" the cable make the anchor operation controlled and safe.

Giriş, Birinci Zabitten alınan Enclosed.en: Entry is made with an Enclosed Space Entry Permit obtained from the Chief Officer. The Bosun passes the permit conditions on to the team, ensures ventilation, organizes atmosphere testing and makes sure that entry does not begin until every step has been completed. Entry without a permit is strictly prohibited.

Girişten önce ve giriş boyunca atmosfer.en: The atmosphere is tested before and throughout entry: oxygen (target 20.9%), flammable gas (LEL), H2S and CO. The gas detector must be calibrated, and measurements must be taken at different levels (top/middle/bottom); some gases collect at the bottom, others at the top. The Bosun makes sure that the testing is done correctly.

Giren personel, sürekli okuyan kişisel g.en: Personnel entering carry a continuously reading personal gas detector; if the atmosphere deteriorates, it gives an alarm and the space is left immediately. Measurement is not a one-off; conditions can change, so monitoring is continuous.

Menhol/kapı başında bir standby kişi sür.en: A standby person is always present at the manhole/door, keeps in constant communication with the personnel inside and monitors the situation. If there is a problem, the standby person does not rush in, but raises the alarm and calls in the rescue team/SCBA standing by. The rescue line (lifeline) and harness allow the personnel inside to be pulled out.

Atmosferi şüpheli veya solunamaz mekânla.en: In spaces where the atmosphere is suspect or unbreathable, SCBA (with its own air supply) or SAA (supplied through an air line) is used. The Bosun checks that this equipment is ready, charged and used correctly.

Kapalı mekan girişi hazırlığı, Reisin \".en: Preparing for enclosed space entry is the Bosun's most serious duty, one where "a single skipped step means death". Full compliance with the permit, continuous atmosphere monitoring, a standby person who does not rush in and a rescue team ready to act bring this invisible hazard under control and ensure that the team comes out alive.

Vardiyayı devralan Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühen.en: The Third/Fourth Engineer taking over the watch does not accept the watch on arrival in the engine control room (ECR) without first making a round. The outgoing engineer verbally hands over the main engine load and speed (rpm), the generators put on or taken off load, the service tank levels, the running pump configuration, the status of standby equipment and the alarms/events of the last 4 hours.

Devralan mühendis; manuel/UMS modu, deva.en: The relieving engineer is briefed on the manual/UMS mode, ongoing maintenance work, isolated equipment (under LOTO), pending work orders and requests from the bridge (e.g. an upcoming maneuver, a request for main engine stand-by). The watch is not taken over until this information has been verified.

Devir tamamlandığında engine room logboo.en: When the handover is complete, the time of handover and the names of the outgoing and relieving engineers are entered in the engine room logbook. From that moment, responsibility for the safety of the engine room passes to the relieving engineer. If there is any doubt or uncertainty, the relieving engineer delays taking over and informs the Second Engineer.

Manlı (manned) makine dairesinde tur tip.en: In a manned engine room, rounds are typically made every hour, or at the latest every two hours; in UMS mode, daytime checks + alarm-based response apply. A round follows a systematic route: main engine platform, generator flat, boiler and FO unit, purifier room, pump flat, separator/OWS area, shaft tunnel and steering gear.

Mühendis sadece göstergelere bakmaz; beş.en: The engineer does not just look at the gauges but uses all five senses. Abnormal noise (knocking, cavitation, bearing hum), vibration, oil/water/fuel leaks, smells (burnt insulation, hot bearing), heat (hot spots) and traces of leakage are detected. Suspect points are measured with a thermometer/IR gun.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis bu eğilimleri l.en: The Third/Fourth Engineer follows these trends through successive entries in the logbook and on the trend screens of the alarm/monitoring system. Early action as a trend approaches its limits prevents a sudden trip and a major breakdown.

Scavenge air pressure, turbocharger rpm.en: Scavenge air pressure, turbocharger rpm and scavenge temperature show the health of the turbocharger and the air system. A sudden rise in scavenge box temperature is a forerunner of a scavenge fire (ignition of oil deposits) and requires immediate action.

Jacket cooling water, piston cooling oil.en: Jacket cooling water, piston cooling oil and the cylinder lube oil dosage (feed rate) are monitored. On modern engines, the cylinder oil feed rate is adjusted to the sulfur content of the fuel; overdosing high-BN oil on low-sulfur fuel leaves deposits, while underdosing on high-sulfur fuel leads to corrosion.

Main bearing, crankpin ve thrust bearing.en: Main bearing, crankpin and thrust bearing temperatures and the sump LO level are monitored. The crankcase oil mist detector (OMD) must be in working order; a high oil mist alarm is a warning of an impending crankcase explosion — the engine is slowed down/stopped immediately, and the crankcase is not opened until it has cooled down sufficiently.

Devredeki jeneratörlerin yükü, exhaust s.en: The load, exhaust temperatures, LO pressure, jacket water temperature and fuel consumption of the generators on line are monitored. With generators running in parallel, load sharing must be balanced; one set taking noticeably more load than the other points to a governor/AVR setting problem.

Ana switchboard'da bus bar voltajı (örn..en: On the main switchboard, the bus bar voltage (e.g. 440V), frequency (60 Hz or 50 Hz), megger/insulation condition and the current of major consumers are monitored. It is verified that auto-start of the standby generator is enabled; its automatic start on a sudden load increase or when a set trips prevents a blackout.

Vardiya mühendisi olası blackout senaryo.en: The watch engineer is prepared for a possible blackout: whether the emergency generator starts automatically, whether there is enough starting air for a dead-ship start, and the restart procedure after a main engine emergency stop are all known. During maneuvering or in restricted waters, a second generator is put on line to provide redundancy.

Auxiliary/exhaust gas boiler için buhar.en: For the auxiliary/exhaust gas boiler, steam pressure, water level (gauge glass + remote), feed water temperature and burner status are monitored. Water level is the most critical parameter; at low-low level, the boiler shuts off firing automatically (flame failure/low water cut-off). Care is taken to guard against priming/foaming and cascade tank contamination.

Exhaust gas economiser'da soot fire risk.en: The risk of a soot fire in the exhaust gas economizer is monitored; soot deposits can ignite during standby/low-load periods. Soot blowing is carried out regularly and the outlet gas temperature is monitored.

Starting air kompresörleri ve servis hav.en: The delivery pressure, temperature and oil level of the starting air compressors and the service air compressor are monitored; main air receiver pressure (typically 25-30 bar) is critical for the main engine's ability to start. If the automatic drain does not work, the receivers are drained manually (accumulated water reduces the number of starts available).

Ballast, bilge, transfer, FO/LO servis p.en: The discharge pressure, sealing (gland/seal), vibration and bearing temperature of the ballast, bilge, transfer and FO/LO service pumps are checked. It is verified that auto-start of the standby pumps is enabled.

Sea water inlet basıncı ve coolerların g.en: Sea water inlet pressure and the inlet/outlet temperature difference across the coolers are monitored; a blocked sea chest or an MGPS fault reduces the efficiency of the central cooler. In a central fresh water cooling system, the expansion tank level and system pressure are checked; a fall indicates a leak, and a rise indicates gas/steam ingress.

FO settling/service tank seviyeleri, vis.en: FO settling/service tank levels, the viscosity control unit (heater outlet viscosity), FO booster pressure and filter ΔP are monitored. On entering an ECA, the timing of the changeover to low-sulfur fuel and the rate of temperature change are controlled; a sudden temperature change causes the fuel pumps to stick.

MARPOL Annex VI kapsamında kullanılan ya.en: Under MARPOL Annex VI, the sulfur content of the fuel used (BDN), flowmeter readings and the required records are kept. The Third/Fourth Engineer records the changeover in the logbook with the time and position.

Birden çok alarm aynı anda çalarsa kök n.en: If several alarms sound at the same time, the root cause is sought; for example, after a blackout, dozens of alarms may stem from a single loss of power. The engineer turns to systematic diagnosis, not to panic.

Anormal her durum derhal İkinci Mühendis.en: Every abnormal situation is reported immediately to the Second Engineer or the Chief Engineer. The Third/Fourth Engineer knows the limits of their authority: jobs they can deal with on their own are kept separate from jobs that need a senior engineer's approval/support. When in doubt, a senior engineer is called — this is not a weakness but correct practice.

Saatlik/vardiya bazlı parametreler engin.en: Hourly/per-watch parameters are entered in the engine room logbook and the electronic recording system: main engine load/rpm, exhaust temperatures, cooling values, generator loads, tank levels, bunkers/daily consumption and any events. Records must be legible, true and made on time; false/backdated entries are a serious disciplinary offense.

Oil Record Book (Part I) kapsamına giren.en: Operations covered by the Oil Record Book (Part I) (bilge transfer, OWS discharge, sludge transfer, fuel transfer) are also entered in the ORB. These records serve as evidence for PSC and in court.

Günlük yakıt/yağ tüketimi, sefer raporla.en: Daily fuel/lube oil consumption is the basic data for voyage reports (noon reports). A deviation from the expected consumption may indicate a decline in engine performance or a measurement/leakage problem. These data are critical for EEXI/CII performance monitoring.

Manevra öncesi \"stand-by main engine\".en: Before maneuvering, on a "stand-by main engine" request, the engine is put into maneuvering mode: the second generator is on line, the starting air receivers are full, FO heating is correct, the control test (ahead/astern) has been carried out and the telegraph test has been completed. Throughout the maneuver, the Third/Fourth Engineer closely monitors the telegraph orders and the engine's response.

Manevra sırasında ani komut değişiklikle.en: During maneuvering, the engine room is ready for sudden changes of order, many starts/stops and crash astern maneuvers; starting air consumption and scavenge temperature are watched closely.

Limanda ana makine durur ancak jeneratör.en: In port, the main engine is stopped, but generator, boiler, cooling, bunkering and cargo (pumps on tankers) operations continue. During bunkering, the engineer monitors tank levels, leaks and the overflow alarm; SOPEP equipment is kept ready against marine pollution.

Makine vardiyası, görünmeyen bir başarı.en: An engine room watch is an art of invisible success: on a well-kept watch nothing happens, because the engineer has caught problems before any alarm sounds, read the trends and acted in time. The Third/Fourth Engineer's disciplined rounds, honest records and correct reporting reflex are the engine room's first line of defense.

Her yardımcı makine için PMS yazılımında.en: For each item of auxiliary machinery, a job is defined in the PMS software (AMOS, TM Master, ShipManager); the job is opened when triggered by running hours or by the calendar. The Third/Fourth Engineer allocates open work orders according to the watch schedule, confirms the required spare parts and consumables with a ROB (remaining on board) check and, when the job is finished, closes it in the system with the counter reading + a description of the work done.

PMS kayıtları yalnızca şirket için değil.en: PMS records are evidence not only for the company but also for class and PSC (Port State Control) inspections. For equipment under CMS (Continuous Machinery Survey), open-up work carried out by the engineers can be reported to class as a "crew survey"; for this reason, photographs, measurements and clearance values before/after the work are recorded.

Hiçbir bakım, ekipman enerjisi izole edi.en: No maintenance starts until the equipment's energy has been isolated. For a pump/compressor driven by an electric motor, the breaker is set "OFF + LOTO (Lock Out Tag Out)"; in a pressurized system, the suction/discharge valves are closed and the pressure is released by draining. For work involving hot oil or steam lines (boiler, FO purifier heater), the work waits until the system has cooled down.

İş öncesi Risk Assessment (RA) formu dol.en: Before the work, a Risk Assessment (RA) form is completed; for work that requires a permit to work (PTW) (hot work, enclosed space, electrical work), the relevant permit is submitted to the duty engineer/Chief Engineer for approval. The job is not considered complete until the permit has been closed.

Gemideki SW/FW santrifüj pompalarında en.en: In the ship's SW/FW centrifugal pumps, the component that fails most often is the mechanical seal. Seal leakage results from dry running, cavitation or excessive axial force. During maintenance, the seal faces are inspected for scratches/wear, the O-rings are replaced, the shaft sleeve is measured and the bearing clearance is checked with a feeler/dial gauge.

Pompa motoru ile pompa arasındaki coupli.en: The coupling alignment between the pump motor and the pump is checked with a dial gauge or laser; misalignment seriously shortens bearing and seal life. The measurement is interpreted allowing for the difference between the cold and hot (operating) conditions.

Bilge sistemi, gemi su altı bütünlüğünün.en: The bilge system is the last line of defense for the ship's underwater integrity; the bilge pump is therefore regarded as "critical equipment". For self-priming, the tightness of the air-water separator and the non-return valve (NRV) is critical; if the NRV does not seat, the pump cannot prime. During maintenance, the suction valve is overhauled, the NRV is ground in and the strainer is cleaned.

Bilge well high-level alarm switch'leri.en: Bilge well high-level alarm switches (float/capacitive) are tested. Under MARPOL Annex I, bilge water may be discharged to sea only through the OWS (Oily Water Separator), below the 15 ppm limit and with OCM (Oil Content Meter) approval; the bilge pump must not be bypassed to pump directly overboard.

Ana makine yol verme havası (starting ai.en: Main engine starting air is typically around 25–30 bar and is produced by two/three-stage reciprocating compressors. Compressor efficiency depends on the tightness of the suction/discharge valves (reed/plate valves). A leaking valve raises the interstage pressure and the discharge temperature; this creates a risk of carbon build-up and explosion (crankcase/air pipe explosion).

Bakımda valf plakaları, yaylar ve segman.en: During maintenance, the valve plates, springs and piston rings are inspected for wear, the intercooler/aftercooler is cleaned and the relief valve setting is verified. The air receiver (bullet) is opened periodically, drained and checked for internal corrosion; the air bottle survey is a class requirement.

Service air (kontrol/iş havası) genelde.en: Service air (control/working air) is usually reduced to 7–8 bar and, for control air, passed through an air dryer; humid air damages control valves and pneumatic equipment. Automatic drain valves (auto-drain) are tested regularly; a blocked drain lets water collect inside the receiver and causes corrosion.

Her starting air receiver üzerinde fusib.en: Each starting air receiver is fitted with a fusible plug and a relief valve; these are the last safeguards against overpressure and overheating and are covered by survey.

Bowl montajında işaret hizalaması (match.en: When the bowl is assembled, the matchmarks are aligned and the tightening torque follows the manufacturer's values exactly. Incorrect assembly creates a risk of imbalance (vibration), water leakage or bursting. In these high-speed machines, imbalance is extremely dangerous.

Ağır yakıt (HFO) purifier öncesi buhar/e.en: Before the purifier, heavy fuel oil (HFO) is heated by a steam/electric heater to ~98 °C; the correct separation temperature depends on viscosity and density. The heater high temperature alarm and trip circuit are tested regularly; overheating leads to fuel degradation and a safety risk.

Sludge tank seviyesi ve sludge pompası,.en: The sludge tank level and the sludge pump are monitored for the transfer of sludge to the incinerator or to shore reception. All sludge transfers are recorded in the Oil Record Book (ORB) Part I; this record is central to MARPOL inspections.

Yardımcı kazan, limanda ve düşük yük sey.en: The auxiliary boiler supplies steam (fuel heating, heating, services) in port and at sea at low engine load. Most maintenance is on the burner unit: the nozzle/tip that determines the quality of atomization is cleaned, the electrodes are adjusted, the glass of the photocell (flame eye) is cleaned, and the air-fuel ratio (combustion) is checked by flue gas analysis. Poor atomization causes soot build-up, uptake fires and loss of efficiency.

Su tarafında ise gauge glass, scum/blowd.en: On the water side, the gauge glass, scum/blowdown valves and water level alarms (low/low-low water level) are tested. Automatic burner shut-off at low water level (flame failure + low water cut-off) is a vital safety function.

Kazan suyu kimyasal olarak şartlandırılı.en: Boiler water is chemically treated; chloride, phosphate, alkalinity (pH) and condensate hardness tests are carried out regularly. Incorrect water chemistry leads to internal boiler corrosion, scale and carry-over. Test results are entered in the water treatment log.

Emniyet valfleri (safety valve), kazanın.en: Safety valves are the boiler's last protection against overpressure; the set pressure and the lifting (lift/easing gear) test are verified during survey. Unauthorized tampering with these valves is strictly prohibited.

Yardımcı sistem hatlarındaki valfler (gl.en: Valves in auxiliary system lines (globe, gate, butterfly, NRV) are overhauled periodically for tightness and function. On a globe valve, the seat/disc is lapped/ground with grinding paste, the gland packing is renewed and the spindle is checked for straightness. NRVs are tested to confirm that they are fitted in the correct direction and move freely; an NRV fitted the wrong way round has disastrous consequences.

Gasket malzemesi akışkan, sıcaklık ve ba.en: Gasket material is selected according to the fluid, temperature and pressure: CNAF (fiber) for water/oil, spiral-wound or graphite for steam/high temperature, and an oil-resistant type for fuel. The wrong gasket material creates a risk of leakage, fire (fuel/oil) or steam burns.

Yatak arızası, yardımcı makinelerde en s.en: Bearing failure is the most common cause of unplanned downtime of auxiliary machinery. Noise/vibration is monitored on rolling bearings, and clearance and temperature on plain bearings. Worn bearing clearance is measured with a feeler gauge or lead wire ("bridge gauge"); if it is outside the manufacturer's tolerance, the bearing is replaced.

Titreşim ölçümü ve yatak sıcaklığı trend.en: Vibration measurement and bearing temperature trend monitoring (condition-based maintenance) catch a failure before it causes unplanned downtime. An abnormal value points to an alignment problem, imbalance or insufficient lubrication.

LO/FO/SW devrelerindeki dubleks (duplex).en: Duplex filters in LO/FO/SW circuits are cleaned according to the ΔP (pressure drop) gauge. When ΔP rises, the filter is changed over to the clean side and the dirty element is removed and cleaned; on auto-backflush filters, the solenoid and the differential switch are checked.

Filtre üzerindeki metalik partiküller (ö.en: Metallic particles on a filter (especially an LO filter) can be an early sign of bearing/surface wear; the finding is assessed together with oil analysis and reported to the Chief Engineer.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, basit elektrik.en: In simple electrical maintenance, the Third/Fourth Engineer works with the electrical engineer/ETO: tightness of motor terminal boxes, megger (insulation resistance) measurement, greasing of motor bearings, checks of contactors/overcurrent relays, and engine room lighting (especially escape route and emergency lighting). All electrical work is done with isolation and LOTO.

Acil jeneratör ve acil yangın pompası gi.en: Weekly tests of critical electrical equipment such as the emergency generator and the emergency fire pump are recorded; these are among the first items that PSC and class inspections look at.

Mekanik montajda üretici tork değerleri,.en: In mechanical assembly, the manufacturer's torque values are applied with the correct spanner and a torque wrench; tightening by eye/feel is not accepted on critical connections. When the job is complete, the system is re-energized, a leak test is carried out and the parameters (pressure, temperature, current, vibration) are monitored on the first start.

İş sonrası alan temizlenir, sökülen cont.en: After the job, the area is cleaned, removed gaskets/waste oil are put into the correct waste stream (MARPOL/garbage management), the spare parts used are deducted in the PMS and the job is closed.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis için yardımcı m.en: For the Third/Fourth Engineer, success in auxiliary machinery maintenance does not come from being able to "take equipment apart and put it back together", but from a discipline that is planned (PMS), isolated (LOTO), measured (clearance/ΔP/vibration) and recorded (ORB/PMS). A bearing noise or a filter ΔP caught early prevents an unplanned blackout or a pollution incident in mid-ocean.

Tipik bir gemide ballast, ayrı bir balla.en: On a typical ship, ballasting is done with a separate ballast pump (centrifugal) or an eductor (jet pump). The system consists of sea chests (high/low suction), the main ballast line, branch valves and a separate butterfly/remote-controlled valve for each tank. The valves may be hydraulically/pneumatically remote-controlled; their open/closed status is monitored on the mimic panel.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, ballast operas.en: Before a ballast operation, the Third/Fourth Engineer verifies the line-up: correct suction/discharge selection, sea chest open, status of the overboard valve, and closing of the valves that prevent water from passing into unintended tanks. An incorrect line-up leads to list/trim problems through the wrong tank being flooded or through backflow.

Tank seviyeleri hem otomatik (remote tan.en: Tank levels are verified both automatically (remote tank gauging) and manually with a sounding tape. If the automatic system and the manual measurement do not agree, a sensor fault or a line leak is suspected. Keeping sounding pipes clear and their self-closing caps in working order is a SOLAS requirement.

Ballast alırken/basarken kademeli soundi.en: When ballasting/deballasting, changes in trim and list are monitored by soundings at intervals; a sudden change is a sign of a valve fault or a wrong line-up. Operation records (start/finish levels, pump running time, quantity) are kept.

BWM Convention, ballast suyuyla taşınan.en: The BWM Convention prevents invasive species carried in ballast water from spreading into marine ecosystems. There are two ways of complying: D-1 (ballast water exchange — exchange in the open sea, at least 200 nautical miles offshore and in water at least 200 m deep, with 95% volumetric exchange) and D-2 (ballast water treatment — meeting the biological standard with an approved BWMS). The implementation schedule has been completed; modern ships carry a BWMS for D-2.

D-1 exchange üç yöntemle yapılır: sequen.en: D-1 exchange is carried out by three methods: sequential (empty and refill), flow-through (pumping through three times the tank volume) and dilution. In the sequential method, stability, strength and the risk of slamming/sloshing while tanks are being emptied are coordinated with the bridge; with some tanks empty, the ship may approach its strength limits.

İki yaygın BWMS tipi vardır: UV (ultravi.en: There are two common types of BWMS: UV (ultraviolet) systems disinfect with a filter + UV reactor, and electrochlorination (EC) systems disinfect by generating chlorine in situ from seawater. The Third/Fourth Engineer monitors filter backflush, UV lamp/sensor condition, TRO (Total Residual Oxidant) measurement and neutralization (neutralizing the chlorine during discharge) parameters. In EC systems, hydrogen gas ventilation is critical for preventing explosions.

BWMS arızası veya bypass durumunda conti.en: If the BWMS fails or is bypassed, the contingency procedure is applied; if a bypass has been made, it is entered in the BWRB and reported to the port authority. An unauthorized bypass leads to heavy sanctions in USCG/PSC inspections.

Bilge sistemi, makine dairesi ve hold bi.en: The bilge system is a safety system that collects oily/dirty water accumulating in the engine room and hold bilge wells. Each bilge well has a high-level alarm; these alarms are tested regularly. A steady rise in the engine room bilge level is an early sign of a leak (seawater, cooling water, oil) and is investigated immediately.

Bilge suyu, bilge primary tank/holding t.en: Bilge water is collected in the bilge primary tank/holding tank and is discharged to sea only through the OWS, below the 15 ppm limit. In an emergency (flooding), the emergency bilge suction can connect the main SW pump directly to the bilge; this is used only for the safety of the ship and is recorded.

Bilge well ve sludge/bilge holding tank.en: Bilge well and sludge/bilge holding tank levels are monitored by daily soundings; trend monitoring points to the source of a leak. An abnormal increase in bilge water is entered in the watch report and reported to the Chief Engineer.

OWS, yer çekimi/coalescer prensibiyle bi.en: The OWS separates oil from bilge water on the gravity/coalescer principle; the oil content at the outlet is measured continuously by the Oil Content Meter (OCM/15 ppm monitor). If the oil content exceeds 15 ppm, the three-way valve automatically diverts the water back to the bilge tank (recirculation), and it cannot be pumped overboard. This automatic stopping device is a MARPOL requirement and must not be disabled.

OWS işletimi öncesi OCM kalibrasyonu, ze.en: Before the OWS is operated, the OCM calibration, zero/span check and condition of the coalescer element are verified. A cloudy emulsion (bilge water mixed with detergent/chemicals) upsets the OWS and causes constant alarms; for this reason, unnecessary use of detergents in the engine room is avoided.

OWS ile denize basma, bilge transferi, s.en: Pumping overboard through the OWS, bilge transfers, sludge burning (incinerator) and deliveries to shore reception are entered in ORB Part I with the operation codes, correctly and on time. Entries carry the signature of the crew member concerned and the Master's approval. An inconsistency in the ORB (e.g. the sludge produced not matching the quantity disposed of) is a main red flag in a PSC inspection.

Ballast, bilge, FO/DO/LO ve FW tankların.en: The levels of ballast, bilge, FO/DO/LO and FW tanks are monitored by daily soundings. Manual measurement is done with a sounding tape + dip paste (to distinguish water from oil) and is cross-checked against automatic gauging (pneumercator, radar, capacitive). A discrepancy indicates a sensor fault or a line/valve leak.

Sounding sonuçları, kalibrasyon tablosu.en: Sounding results are converted into volume using the calibration table (tank calibration/ullage table), and trim/list corrections are applied. The results are entered in the tank sounding log and feed into bunker/FW/ballast management.

Kısmen dolu (slack) tanklar serbest yüze.en: Partially filled (slack) tanks create a free surface effect and reduce the ship's effective GM. In ballast operations, tanks are kept either full (pressed up) or empty as far as possible; having many slack tanks at the same time weakens stability. The engine room manages this risk in coordination with the bridge.

Ballast/bilge santrifüj pompaları suctio.en: Ballast/bilge centrifugal pumps cannot prime when there is air on the suction side; therefore a self-priming arrangement or a priming pump is used. Insufficient NPSH (Net Positive Suction Head) causes cavitation; cavitation produces noise, vibration and impeller erosion. At low tank levels, an eductor (jet pump) is used for stripping (removing the last of the water); the eductor driving water pressure must be sufficient.

Hidrolik/pnömatik uzaktan kumandalı valf.en: With hydraulically/pneumatically remote-controlled valves, the mimic panel indication may not match the actual valve position (limit switch fault, hydraulic leak). In case of doubt, the valve is checked manually/locally. A wrong valve position leads to a serious list/trim incident through the wrong tank being pumped or through backflow; therefore, during critical operations, the valve position is physically verified.

ABD sularında USCG, type-approved BWMS v.en: In US waters, the USCG requires a type-approved BWMS and detailed reporting (BWMR — Ballast Water Management Report); states such as California may have additional rules. Australia, New Zealand and some ports also apply their own biosecurity requirements. Before the operation, port information (port agent + company instructions) is checked.

Bazı limanlarda exchange/treatment belir.en: In some ports, exchange/treatment must be carried out at specified coordinates or at a specified depth; records are kept with GPS position and time stamp. PSC cross-checks the records against the actual situation.

Ballast tanklarında biriken sediment (ça.en: Sediment (mud) accumulating in ballast tanks may harbor invasive species; periodic sediment removal and disposal are planned under the BWMP. Entry into a tank is made with an enclosed space entry permit; atmosphere testing (O2/LEL/H2S) and standby personnel are mandatory.

Makine dairesine kontrolsüz su girişinde.en: In the event of uncontrolled water ingress into the engine room (cooler burst, sea valve failure, hull damage), the source is isolated first, then the bilge pumps and, if necessary, the emergency bilge suction are brought into use. The bridge is informed, and if necessary the effect on stability/draft is assessed. This scenario is drilled regularly.

BWMS arızasında contingency planı uygula.en: If the BWMS fails, the contingency plan is applied (alternative method, adjustment of the voyage plan, port notification). If the OWS fails, bilge water is not pumped overboard; holding tank capacity is managed and shore reception is planned. In both cases, the records (BWRB/ORB) are kept complete and the Chief Engineer/company is informed.

Ballast ve bilge sistemleri, hem geminin.en: Ballast and bilge systems are zero-tolerance areas, both for the safety of the ship (stability, underwater integrity) and for environmental compliance (BWM and 15 ppm). The Third/Fourth Engineer's work is built on correct line-ups, verified valve positions, working automatic safeguards and complete records. Every shortcut taken here comes back either as a pollution fine or as a flooding incident.

Modern ana makinelerde safety system, pa.en: On modern main engines, the safety system monitors the parameters and, when a threshold is exceeded, first gives an alarm and, if the condition continues, applies a slowdown or shutdown. Some hazards (e.g. low LO pressure, overspeed) are linked directly to a trip, because any delay would wreck the engine. In certain situations, the bridge may temporarily override a shutdown for the safety of maneuvering (e.g. in confined waters); however, this is a conscious acceptance of risk and is recorded.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, her cihazın ha.en: The Third/Fourth Engineer must know which level (alarm/slowdown/shutdown) each device is linked to, its setpoint and its test method. Tests are usually done without actually stopping the engine, by simulation (imitating the sensor signal) or with an independent test function.

Emniyet testleri PMS'te calendar job ola.en: Safety tests are defined in the PMS as calendar jobs (weekly/monthly/quarterly). Before a test, the bridge is informed (for trip tests), and the necessary isolation and duty engineer preparations are made. The test result (setpoint, measured value, response time, pass/fail) is entered in the safety test log and the PMS; a faulty device is reported immediately and temporary protective measures are taken.

Bilge well high-level alarmları genellik.en: Bilge well high-level alarms are usually floater-type or capacitive level switches. The test is done by physically raising the switch (lifting the floater) or with the test button; it is verified that the alarm appears both on the local panel and on the repeater panel on the bridge/CCR (cargo control / engine control room). The automatic start function of the connected bilge pump is also tested.

Bilge alarmları yağ/kir nedeniyle yapışa.en: Bilge alarms can stick because of oil/dirt; periodic cleaning and function testing are therefore done together. A bilge alarm that does not work allows water to collect silently in the engine room, with the risk that flooding is noticed late.

Bilge seviyesi yönetimi yalnızca emniyet.en: Bilge level management matters not only for safety but also for pollution prevention. The bilge alarm feeds into bilge holding tank management; OWS operations are planned according to this level. Tests and findings are recorded.

Test, dahili test fonksiyonu (referans/d.en: The test is carried out with the built-in test function (reference/dummy chamber, optical signal simulation); the cleanliness of the measuring heads and sampling pipes is verified. A dirty/blocked sampling path gives false readings. It is confirmed that the alarm/slowdown signal reaches the bridge.

OMD alarmı asla \"false alarm\" varsayıl.en: An OMD alarm is never silenced on the assumption that it is a "false alarm". When mist is detected, the engine is slowed down/stopped, and the crankcase doors are kept closed for at least 20–30 minutes (so that the hot spot cools down and a sudden inflow of air does not trigger an explosion) before an inspection is made. This procedure is reinforced through drills.

Ana yatak, krank yatağı, kam mili yatağı.en: Temperature sensors (Pt100/thermocouple) are fitted to the main bearings, crankpin bearings, camshaft bearings and turbocharger bearings. The test is carried out by applying a simulated value to the sensor input (decade box / test resistor) and verifying that the alarm/slowdown setpoint triggers correctly. In actual operation, bearing temperature is monitored as a trend; a slowly rising trend is a sign of early wear.

Yatak sıcaklık alarmı, OMD ile birlikte.en: Together with the OMD, the bearing temperature alarm is the second layer of crankcase protection. A sudden jump in temperature indicates loss of lubrication or metal-to-metal contact; in this case, the load is reduced and an inspection is made.

Test sonucu, setpoint değeri ve tetiklen.en: The test result is recorded with the setpoint value and the level triggered (alarm/slowdown). If sensor drift (deviation from the actual value) is found, calibration or replacement is planned. A bearing temperature alarm that does not work means that a mechanical failure in the bearing is noticed late.

Ana makine ve jeneratörler, devrin tehli.en: The main engine and the generators are protected by an overspeed trip that prevents the speed from rising to a dangerous level. The mechanical type (spring-loaded bolt/flyweight) trips at a set speed; the electronic type works with a pickup sensor + governor. Overspeed occurs on loss of load (e.g. a generator breaker opening, the propeller coming out of the water) or on governor failure, and can wreck the engine.

Test, kontrollü şekilde (genelde yüksüz,.en: The test is carried out in a controlled way (usually without load, in coordination with the bridge/Chief Engineer) by raising the speed, or by tripping the mechanism manually/with the test function. The tripping speed (rpm) is measured and compared with the manufacturer's/class value.

Over-speed koruması, governor (devir reg.en: Overspeed protection is integrated with the governor (speed regulator). A governor fault causes either hunting (speed oscillation) or overspeed through loss of control. On generators, load sharing and frequency control depend on the governor; governor maintenance and the overspeed test are therefore planned together.

Yağlama yağı (LO) basıncının düşmesi, ya.en: A drop in lubricating oil (LO) pressure means that the bearings run dry and are destroyed within minutes; this is why, on most engines, LO low pressure is linked first to an alarm and then to an automatic shutdown. The test is done by simulating the pressure switch/transmitter input or by reducing the pressure in a controlled way; it is verified that the alarm and trip setpoints trigger correctly.

Aynı test, stand-by LO pompasının otomat.en: The same test also covers the automatic start function of the standby LO pump: when the pressure of the main LO pump drops, the standby pump must cut in automatically. This auto-start function is vital on UMS ships.

LO basınç düşüşü; tıkalı filtre (yüksek.en: A drop in LO pressure may be caused by a clogged filter (high ΔP), pump wear, a line leak or air on the suction side (low sump). When a real alarm occurs after the test, the cause is quickly narrowed down by checking the filter ΔP, the sump level and the condition of the pump. The LO low-pressure trip is never disabled for being a "nuisance".

Ağır yakıt (HFO), enjeksiyon için uygun.en: Heavy fuel oil (HFO) is heated in the FO heater (steam/electric) to bring it to the correct viscosity for injection. Overheating leads to fuel degradation, coking and a safety risk; this is why there is a high-temperature alarm and, where necessary, a heater cut-off. The test verifies, by simulating the temperature sensor, that the alarm/cut-off setpoint works correctly.

Viskozite kontrol sistemi (viscotherm) h.en: The viscosity control system (viscotherm) adjusts the heater according to fuel viscosity; a sensor/control fault causes overheating or insufficient heating. On electric heaters, there is a risk of dry heating at low fuel flow; the low-flow protection is tested.

Buhar ısıtıcılarda kondensat hattındaki.en: On steam heaters, the condensate line is checked for traces of oil (internal heater leak); if fuel leaks into the steam side, the boiler becomes contaminated. Tests and checks are recorded together with heater maintenance.

Makine dairesi yangın emniyeti, yakıt/ya.en: Engine room fire safety includes the quick-closing valves of fuel/oil tanks (which shut off the fuel flow remotely in a fire), the remote emergency stops of pumps, and the ventilation damper/fan stop functions. These devices are tested periodically; it is verified that the fire pump, fuel shut-off and air shut-off can be operated from a single point in a fire. They are covered by SOLAS II-2 and are a focus of PSC inspections.

Alarm monitoring system (AMS) düzenli \".en: The alarm monitoring system (AMS) is checked regularly with a "lamp test" and for signal integrity. Frequently recurring false alarms (nuisance alarms) either get silenced and ignored, which is dangerous, or their root cause (sensor/cable) is eliminated. The right approach is not to ignore a false alarm but to fix its source.

Emniyet sistemi testleri, \"her şey yolu.en: Safety system tests are the one layer that "seems unnecessary when everything is fine" but one day saves the engine, the ship and the crew. For the Third/Fourth Engineer, the measure is not having done the test, but having proved and recorded that the device actually works at the correct setpoint and at the correct level (alarm/slowdown/trip). A silenced alarm is an invitation to a future crankcase explosion or bearing seizure.

Sıcak çalışma; açık alev, kıvılcım veya.en: Hot work covers any operation that involves an open flame or sparks, or that can raise a surface temperature to ignition point: electric arc welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, grinding, drilling, hot chipping. Because of fuel, oil vapor, hot surfaces and limited ventilation, the engine room is by its nature a hazardous environment for such work.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, işin \"rutin\".en: The Third/Fourth Engineer knows that a job looking "routine" does not make it any less dangerous. Many engine room fires in the past started when sparks from a short grinding job, done without a permit or without supervision, ignited an oil-soaked rag or bilge residue.

Hiçbir sıcak çalışma, geçerli bir Hot Wo.en: No hot work may start without a valid Hot Work Permit. The permit records the job, its location, the time window, the precautions taken and the approving officer (usually the Chief Engineer and/or the Master). The Third/Fourth Engineer verifies that the permit conditions are actually met on site.

Her sıcak çalışma öncesinde bir risk değ.en: Before every hot work job, a Risk Assessment or Job Safety Analysis is carried out. The hazards are listed one by one and rated on a likelihood/severity matrix, and a control measure is defined for each hazard. The Third/Fourth Engineer personally helps to complete the form and confirms that it matches the reality on site.

Hiyerarşik kontrol uygulanır: önce işi o.en: The hierarchy of controls is applied: first eliminate the work (e.g. by taking the part to the workshop/deck and working on it there) or substitute it; if that is not possible, engineering controls (screens, ventilation), administrative controls (permit, fire watch) and finally PPE come into play.

İş başlamadan önce işi yapacak ekip, fir.en: Before the job starts, the team doing the work, the fire watch and the supervising engineer hold a short toolbox talk: the sequence of work, who does what, who does what in an emergency, where the nearest extinguisher/hose is and what the escape route is. This short talk is the most practical step for preventing most accidents.

Dönen veya enerjili ekipman üzerinde çal.en: Before work on rotating or energized equipment, all energy sources (electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, pressurized fluid, potential/gravity) are safely isolated and prevented from being unexpectedly activated. Lock Out is done with a physical lock, and Tag Out with a warning tag.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis; breaker'ı açar.en: The Third/Fourth Engineer opens the breaker, locks it, tags it and, where possible, verifies with a "try-out" (start attempt) that the equipment is actually de-energized. Stop valves are closed and locked, pressure is released, and "stored energy" (accumulators, pressurized lines, springs) is made safe.

En sık görülen hatalar: yalnızca lokal s.en: The most common errors are: relying only on the local stop without isolating the breaker, not releasing stored energy, not doing a try-out, and the oncoming team not verifying the isolation at the watch change. The Third/Fourth Engineer does not skip these steps; pressure because "we're in a hurry" can never justify relaxing the isolation.

Sintine kuyusu, tank, kofferdam, çift di.en: Entry into enclosed spaces such as bilge wells, tanks, cofferdams, double bottoms, boilers and the main engine crankcase requires a separate enclosed space entry permit. The atmosphere is tested before and during entry: oxygen (target 20.9%), flammable gas (LEL 0%), toxic gases (H2S, CO). The Third/Fourth Engineer verifies that the gas detector is calibrated and assists with the measurements.

Giriş süresince kapı/menhol başında bir.en: During entry, a standby person/watchman is present at the door/manhole, continuous communication is maintained and a rescue plan is kept ready. Most enclosed space deaths are caused by low oxygen or toxic gas that comes without warning, and the toll multiplies when a second person goes in unprepared "to help".

Bir tank veya kapalı alanda sıcak çalışm.en: If hot work is to be done in a tank or enclosed space, the risk multiplies: the atmosphere must be gas-free, and the welding/cutting fumes and gases must be removed by continuous ventilation. It is also verified that adjacent tanks and pipelines have been cleared of flammable residues.

Her sıcak çalışmada, işi yapan kişiden a.en: For every hot work job, there is a fire watch separate from the person doing the work. The fire watch's task is to keep continuous watch on the area where sparks fall, on hidden voids and on adjacent compartments, and to keep the first-response equipment at hand. The fire watch continues for at least 30-60 minutes (according to company procedure) after the job is finished, because smoldering material can burst into flame later.

İş tamamlanınca ekipman soğutulur, alan.en: When the job is complete, the equipment is cooled, the area is checked, the fire watch period is completed and the permit is "closed". The Third/Fourth Engineer verifies that the area is clean, that the fire-fighting equipment has been put back in place, and that the LOTO isolation was removed only once the job was completely finished.

Sıcak çalışmada standart KKD; kaynak mas.en: Standard PPE for hot work includes a welding mask/dark-lens face shield, flame-resistant gloves, a leather apron/coverall, steel-toed shoes, ear protection and, when needed, respiratory protection. For grinding, a face shield and dust mask are mandatory. The PPE is checked every time to make sure it is undamaged and suitable for the job.

Birçok makine dairesi yangını soruşturma.en: In many engine room fire investigations, the common factor is a short grinding/welding job done without a permit or without a fire watch. The spark ignited unseen bilge residue or oil-soaked insulation, and by the time the flames were noticed, the fire had grown. Lesson: no hot work is "small"; permit, isolation and fire watch are not negotiable.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis için sıcak ve i.en: For the Third/Fourth Engineer, safety in hot work and isolated work is a habit earned through disciplined adherence to procedure. A single skipped step — pressure not released, isolation not verified, a fire watch withdrawn — can cancel out dozens of correct steps.

Engine room logbook (veya elektronik eşd.en: The engine room logbook (or its electronic equivalent) records the condition of the machinery every watch: main engine speed/load, auxiliary engine loads, temperatures and pressures, tank levels, water production, fuel/oil consumption and any abnormalities observed. The Third/Fourth Engineer enters the data for their own watch completely and legibly.

Kayıt \"gerçek zamanlı ve dürüst\" olmal.en: Entries must be "real-time and honest". Logs filled in later from memory or padded with "copied" values make failure analysis impossible and destroy trust during inspections.

Engine room logbook, Oil Record Book Par.en: The engine room logbook must be consistent with the Oil Record Book Part I. Bilge transfers, OWS (Oily Water Separator) operation, oil transfers and sludge operations are also entered in the ORB; the raw data in the logbook supports this statutory record.

PMS, her ekipman için üreticinin önerdiğ.en: The PMS turns the maintenance intervals recommended by the manufacturer for each item of equipment (based on running hours or the calendar) into work orders. When maintenance is done, the work order is closed with the work done, the parts used, the values measured (clearance, pressure) and the running hours. The Third/Fourth Engineer enters the records of the jobs under their responsibility on time and completely.

Kapatılmayan veya geç kapatılan iş emirl.en: Work orders that are not closed, or are closed late, fall into the "overdue" list. Too many overdue jobs damage both class CMS compliance and the impression given to PSC; maintenance is therefore recorded as soon as it is done.

Continuous Machinery Survey (CMS) kapsam.en: Opening-up/measurement records of equipment covered by the Continuous Machinery Survey (CMS) are essential for the class surveyor to give survey credit. Proper PMS records make the survey easier and avoid unnecessary repeat opening-up.

Conta, o-ring, filtre, kayış, yağ, gres,.en: The use of consumables such as gaskets, O-rings, filters, belts, oil, grease and chemicals is recorded and the stock is updated. This record shows the rate of consumption, identifies items that fall below the minimum stock (ROB – Remaining On Board) and prevents unnecessary over-ordering.

Minimum seviyenin altına düşen veya yakl.en: Items that fall below or approach the minimum level are reported in good time to the Second Engineer (and, when necessary, to the Chief Engineer). The report includes the part name, the IMPA/maker part number, the current ROB, the quantity required and the urgency. Late reporting means that a critical spare cannot be supplied within the port window.

Makine kayıtları sadece geçmişi belgelem.en: Engine records do not just document the past; they manage the future. Wrong or invented data leads to wrong maintenance decisions, unexpected breakdowns and loss of trust during inspections. The Third/Fourth Engineer does not fill in a value that could not be measured with an estimate; the value is either measured or noted as "could not be measured".

Modern gemilerde PMS, AMOS, TM Master ve.en: On modern ships, the PMS is run with AMOS, TM Master or similar software, and the data are synchronized with the shore office. The Third/Fourth Engineer learns to enter work orders against the correct equipment, to update running hours and to verify that the records are complete before synchronization.

Bir yatak sıcaklığındaki kademeli yüksel.en: If a gradual rise in a bearing temperature is not entered in the logs, the trend can grow unnoticed and eventually lead to bearing damage. A well-kept trend record could have predicted the same failure weeks in advance. Recording discipline is machinery health, directly.

İyi bir mühendisin kayıtları, kendisi va.en: A good engineer's records describe the machinery even when the engineer is not on watch. For the Third/Fourth Engineer, careful record-keeping is the foundation of both professional discipline and the ship's technical safety.

Bakım üç temel yaklaşımla ele alınır: re.en: Maintenance follows three basic approaches: reactive (repair when it fails), preventive (planned maintenance based on time/running hours) and predictive/condition-based (according to the actual condition of the equipment). A modern ship uses all three in balance. While carrying out preventive maintenance, the Third/Fourth Engineer also learns to catch failures early from condition data.

Deneyimli bir mühendis, makineyi gözle (.en: An experienced engineer "listens" to the machinery with the eyes (leaks, color, smoke), the ears (knocking, rubbing), the hands (vibration, temperature) and the nose (burning, smell of fuel). This "human sensor" scan catches changes that even the most expensive monitoring system may miss.

Sıcaklık, basınç, titreşim, yağ analizi.en: Temperature, pressure, vibration, oil analysis and performance (load/speed/consumption) are the most commonly monitored indicators. The direction and rate of a deviation point to the problem: a slowly rising bearing temperature may mean lubrication problems/wear; a sudden pressure drop, a leak/blockage; increasing vibration, imbalance/bearing damage.

Periyodik yağ numune analizi (viskozite,.en: Periodic oil sample analysis (viscosity, water, metal particles, TBN) reveals internal wear before it shows from the outside. An increase in metals indicates bearing/piston ring wear, and water/glycol indicates a cooling water leak. The Third/Fourth Engineer assists with taking samples and following up the results.

Filtre tıkanıklığı, gevşek bağlantı, küç.en: Problems such as a clogged filter, a loose connection, a small gasket leak, bleeding air (priming) or a simple electrical connection are within the authority and competence of a junior engineer. Before intervening, the LOTO and permit rules are followed; the solution and the outcome are recorded.

Belirti kapsamı aşıyorsa, güvenlik riski.en: If the symptoms go beyond this scope, if there is a safety risk or if the solution is unclear, the work is stopped and a senior engineer is called. Pressing ahead on an unfamiliar system "just to try" can turn a small problem into major damage.

Bir filtreyi sürekli değiştirmek belirti.en: Changing a filter again and again manages the symptom; finding the source of the contamination that clogs the filter solves the failure. With simple methods such as 5-Why and fishbone, the chain of "why" is traced back to the root cause. The Third/Fourth Engineer contributes to this analysis with observations and data.

Karmaşık arızalar, üst mühendise yapılan.en: Complex failures are reported to the senior engineer in a structured way: what was observed, when it started, which values changed, what action was taken and what state the equipment is in. Presenting measured data and a timeline instead of a vague "it broke down" speeds up the right decision.

Bazı bakımlar makine durdurularak yapılı.en: Some maintenance is done with the engine stopped; it is therefore planned in line with the voyage/port schedule. The Third/Fourth Engineer prepares their own jobs for these windows (parts, tools and permits ready), so that downtime is kept to a minimum.

Önleyici bakım ve arıza analizi, genç mü.en: Preventive maintenance and failure analysis is the area where the junior engineer turns from a "repairer" into a "diagnostician". The engineer who sees the cause rather than the symptom, and catches a small deviation before it grows, is the engine room's most valuable safeguard.

UMS, makine dairesinin belirli periyotla.en: UMS means that class and the flag State have approved unattended operation of the engine room for certain periods (especially at night); the class notation is often "E0". Approval requires adequate automatic control, a comprehensive alarm system, automatic fire detection, transfer of alarms to the bridge and a duty engineer who can be reached quickly.

UMS, \"makineye bakılmıyor\" demek değil.en: UMS does not mean "nobody is looking after the machinery"; it means "reliable automation + a duty engineer on call, instead of constant manning". The price of this trust is disciplined preparation before every unmanned period.

Hazırlığın kalbi alarm sistemidir. Tüm k.en: The heart of the preparation is the alarm system. It is verified that all critical alarm setpoints are correctly set and active; the transfer of alarms to the bridge and the engineers' cabins (extension alarm) is tested. If any alarm is suppressed (inhibit/override), the reason for it and the risk are assessed.

Sintine yüksek seviye alarmı ve high-lev.en: The bilge high-level alarm and the high-level floater switches are tested, because they are the first to report water ingress during an unmanned period. A bilge alarm that does not work can turn into a serious danger through undetected water ingress.

İnsansız periyot süresince beklenen tüke.en: The expected consumption during the unmanned period is calculated, and it is verified that the fuel service tank, oil service/storage tanks, settling tank and fresh water tanks are at levels that will comfortably cover the period. Automatic transfer/filling systems must be active and in good order; even so, a manual reserve level is kept.

Standby pompaların (yağ, soğutma suyu, y.en: The automatic start function of the standby pumps (lube oil, cooling water, fuel) (auto start on low pressure) is tested. It is verified that automatic generator start (blackout/load-dependent) and the auto synchronization system are ready, because during an unmanned period it is the automation that will respond to a pump or generator failure.

İnsansız periyotta nöbetçi (duty) mühend.en: A duty engineer is designated for the unmanned period; this person must be rested, reachable and able to get down to the engine room quickly when an alarm sounds. The communication channel between the bridge and the engine room, the dead-man alarm and the telephone/radio are tested.

Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, hazırlığı tama.en: After completing the preparations, the Third/Fourth Engineer hands over the engine room as "ready for UMS" and records this; the duty engineer and the bridge are informed.

Alarm çaldığında nöbetçi mühendis vakit.en: When an alarm sounds, the duty engineer goes down to the engine room without delay, assesses the situation and, if necessary, informs the bridge. For a critical alarm such as fire or water ingress, the emergency procedure is put into action. The better the preparation, the fewer and more manageable the night alarms.

UMS hazırlığı, \"yokluğunda makineye bir.en: UMS preparation is a professional assurance that "nothing will happen to the machinery in your absence". This assurance only becomes real through checks carried out in full before every unmanned period; a single skipped step can turn the night into an emergency.

Bir buhar sıkıştırmalı soğutma çevrimi d.en: A vapor-compression refrigeration cycle consists of four basic components: the compressor (raises pressure/temperature), the condenser (rejects heat, gas→liquid), the expansion valve (lowers pressure) and the evaporator (takes heat from the space, liquid→gas). Knowing the "normal" pressures and temperatures of this cycle, the Third/Fourth Engineer diagnoses deviations.

Provizyon tesisi genelde tek/çok odalı d.en: The provision plant is usually a single/multi-room direct-expansion system; each room is kept at the required temperature by a thermostat (e.g. meat −18°C, vegetables +4°C). The HVAC system air-conditions the accommodation. The reefer cargo plant (if fitted) has a much higher capacity and is critical for the integrity of the cargo.

Vardiya sırasında kompresör emiş/basma b.en: During the watch, compressor suction/discharge pressures, condenser and evaporator temperatures, compressor oil pressure and room temperatures are read and recorded. A deviation from normal is often the first sign of a problem: low suction pressure may mean a shortage of refrigerant/a restriction; high discharge pressure may mean a condenser problem/air in the system.

Sıvı hat sight glass'ında kabarcık görül.en: Bubbles in the liquid line sight glass usually indicate a low refrigerant charge or a restriction in the line. The Third/Fourth Engineer checks this simple indicator regularly and reports to the Chief Engineer if in doubt.

Kaçak; düşen performans, sık şarj ihtiya.en: A leak shows itself through falling performance, frequent need for recharging, bubbles in the sight glass, unusual noise or temperature imbalance. Leak points are searched for with an electronic detector or a bubble test. A leak both reduces performance and creates environmental/legal liability.

Refrigerant ilavesi, geri kazanım ve dev.en: Adding refrigerant, recovering it and opening the circuit usually require expertise and special equipment; the Third/Fourth Engineer detects and reports signs of leaks/faults and carries out any intervention under the supervision of the Chief Engineer. Ignoring a leak brings both loss of food/cargo and legal risk.

Provizyon odalarının doğru sıcaklıkta tu.en: Keeping the provision rooms at the correct temperature is essential for food safety and crew health. Temperature deviations are monitored in coordination with the cook/steward; if a room fails, quick action (alternative cooling, priority of consumption) is taken to save the food.

HVAC, yaşam mahallini konforlu ve MLC st.en: The HVAC keeps the accommodation comfortable and in line with MLC standards. Filter cleanliness, fan/damper operation and air quality are monitored. A clogged filter both reduces comfort and increases energy consumption.

Reefer kargo taşıyan gemilerde soğutma a.en: On ships carrying reefer cargo, a refrigeration failure means direct loss of cargo and large claims. Set temperatures, alarm limits and recording systems are monitored continuously; any deviation is reported immediately. For reefer containers, plug/power and temperature monitoring are carried out in coordination with the deck department.

Soğutma ve klima sistemleri \"görünmez\".en: Refrigeration and air-conditioning systems go unnoticed while they work "invisibly"; when they fail, food, comfort or cargo is suddenly at risk. The Third/Fourth Engineer's regular, recorded checks ensure the reliability of these silent systems.

Dümen donanımı arızası, geminin yön kont.en: A steering gear failure means that the ship loses directional control; in confined waters, in traffic or during maneuvering, this can end in disaster. This is why SOLAS requires redundancy (main + auxiliary power unit), regular testing and an emergency steering arrangement for the steering gear.

Çoğu ticari gemide elektro-hidrolik düme.en: Most merchant ships have electro-hydraulic steering gear: ram type (cylinder-tiller) or rotary vane. Hydraulic pumps (usually variable displacement) move the rams; the gear is controlled from the bridge by telemotor or electric signal. The Third/Fourth Engineer monitors the oil, pressure and mechanical condition of this system.

Günlük kontrolde hidrolik yağ seviyesi (.en: In the daily check, the hydraulic oil level (tank and replenishing tank), leaks at the ram/cylinder seals, leaks at hose/pipe connections and general cleanliness are checked. A leak from a ram seal means loss of oil and a slip/fire hazard on the floor; it also lets air into the system and reduces performance.

Sistem çalışma basıncı normal aralıkta o.en: The system working pressure must be within the normal range; if the relief valve opens early or the pressure fluctuates, there may be a pump/valve problem. The filter differential pressure (ΔP) is monitored; a rising ΔP indicates clogging. Dirty hydraulic oil is the most common cause of valve and pump wear.

Acil dümen pompası ve lokal (steering ge.en: The emergency steering pump and the local (steering gear room) control arrangement are tested; communication (telephone/radio) between the bridge and the steering gear room is verified. It is confirmed that, if one power unit fails, the second unit cuts in, and that the rudder moves from hard over to hard over within the required time.

Acil dümen tatbikatında ekip, lokal kuma.en: In the emergency steering drill, the team rehearses steering the ship with the local control and communications. The Third/Fourth Engineer takes part in the drill and reports deficiencies, and the tests are entered in the logbook.

Ambar kapakları, krenler ve ırgat/güvert.en: Hatch covers, cranes and windlasses/deck winches are driven by hydraulic power packs. Oil level, filter ΔP, leaks and pressure are checked regularly. These systems directly affect the safety of the deck crew during cargo operations and anchor/mooring work.

Yavaş dümen yanıtı, anormal ses, aşırı y.en: Slow steering response, abnormal noise, excessive oil temperature, pressure fluctuation and recurring leaks are the main symptoms. If there is air in the system, it is bled. For a symptom that is beyond the engineer's scope or affects safety, the work is stopped and the bridge and the Chief Engineer are informed; "trial and error" is unacceptable on steering gear.

Steering gear, gemide \"asla arıza verme.en: Steering gear is one of the foremost systems on board that "must never fail". The Third/Fourth Engineer's disciplined daily checks, serious conduct of the SOLAS tests and clean hydraulic oil keep this critical system running quietly but reliably.

LSA ekipmanları; personal (bireysel), su.en: LSA equipment is grouped as personal, survival craft, launching appliances and distress/locating equipment. The personal group includes lifejackets, immersion suits, anti-exposure suits, thermal protective aids (TPA) and lifebuoys; the survival craft group includes lifeboats and liferafts; the launching group includes davits, winches and release gear; and the distress group includes pyrotechnics, EPIRB, SART, line-throwing apparatus and two-way VHFs.

Safety Officer, geminin SOLAS Record of.en: The Safety Officer compares the LSA list in the ship's SOLAS Record of Equipment (Form E/C) item by item with the physical inventory. There must be no difference between the quantity stated in the document (e.g. lifeboats of 100% + 100% capacity, 25% additional liferafts, one immersion suit per person) and the actual number on board.

Modern gemilerde LSA kayıtları hem fizik.en: On modern ships, LSA records are kept both in a physical logbook and in the electronic PMS (Planned Maintenance System). Each inspection is opened as a job and closed when done; expiry dates are tracked in a separate "expiry tracker" table. The Safety Officer's golden rule: work that has not been done is not recorded, and work that has not been recorded is considered not done.

Kayıt tutarlılığı, denetimin en kırılgan.en: Consistency of records is the most fragile point in an inspection. If a lifeboat engine has been run, the logbook must show the date, the duration, the person who ran it and the observations. A contradiction between the records and the physical condition (e.g. the logbook says "tested" but the HRU has expired) produces a PSC deficiency directly.

Safety Officer; filika içi inventory'i (.en: The Safety Officer checks the lifeboat inventory (sea anchor, paddles, hatchet, first-aid kit, rations, water, fishing kit, signaling mirror, whistle, bailer) against the MSC/Circ.1047 list. Missing or expired items (e.g. water tablets, rations) are listed and a resupply request is raised.

Safety Officer ayrıca salın throw-over e.en: The Safety Officer also checks that there is a clear working area from which the raft can be thrown over, that the lashings can be released freely and that the hydrostatic release unit (HRU) is connected correctly. Painted lashings or a cradle seized with rust prevent the raft from floating free in a real emergency — a common and deadly defect.

HRU değişimi, sal servisine denk getiril.en: HRU replacement can be timed to coincide with the raft service, but it must also be tracked independently. Incorrect installation (mixing up the weak link and the strong point, attaching the painter to the HRU incorrectly) leads either to the raft not deploying at all or to it being dragged down with the sinking ship.

Her mürettebat üyesi için bir adet can y.en: There must be one lifejacket for each crew member (in the cabin + spares at the muster station + spares for the bridge/engine room watchkeepers). The Safety Officer checks the light (automatic/manual), whistle, retro-reflective tape, body strap and gas capsule condition. Inflatable lifejackets are subject to periodic servicing.

Can simitleri gemi boyutuna göre belirli.en: Lifebuoys are provided in a specified number according to the size of the ship and are distributed evenly on the bridge wings and decks. At least half are fitted with self-igniting lights, some with self-activating smoke signals, some with buoyant lifelines, and at least two with a quick-release MOB (man-overboard) marker arrangement.

Safety Officer; light battery expiry'ler.en: The Safety Officer checks the expiry of the light batteries, the expiry of the smoke signals, the condition of the lines and that the bracket holding the lifebuoy can be released freely. MOB lifebuoys must be releasable from the bridge wing with a single action; the bracket must not be seized with rust.

406 MHz EPIRB (Emergency Position-Indica.en: The 406 MHz EPIRB (Emergency Position-Indicating Radio Beacon) floats free with its HRU when the ship sinks and transmits the ship's identity + GPS position to the COSPAS-SARSAT satellites. The Safety Officer tracks the EPIRB battery expiry, the HRU expiry, the self-test function (weekly), up-to-date MMSI registration and the requirement for an annual shore-based or onboard test.

SART (Search and Rescue Transponder), 9.en: The SART (Search and Rescue Transponder) responds to a 9 GHz X-band radar signal and produces a line of 12 dots on the rescue ship's radar. Battery expiry and the self-test are checked. Replacement of the EPIRB battery and HRU is documented with service records.

Pyrotechnics; rocket parachute flare (en.en: Pyrotechnics consist of rocket parachute flares (at least 12 on the bridge), hand flares and buoyant smoke signals; lifeboats and liferafts also have their own sets.
