Yağcı, OWS başında bekleyerek operasyonu.en: The Oiler stays at the OWS and monitors the operation, verifying that the separator is working correctly, that the 15 ppm alarm is active and not bypassed, and that the three-way valve is in the correct position. The separated oil goes to the sludge/waste oil tank. The operation is carried out only under permitted conditions (outside special areas, en route).

Sintine kuyuları, holding/bilge tankına.en: The contents of the bilge wells are transferred to the holding/bilge tank; from there they are processed by the OWS or delivered to a shore facility. Sludge (purifier sludge, waste oil) is collected in a separate tank and burned in the incinerator or delivered to a shore reception facility. Every transfer is entered in the ORB; tank levels must be consistent.

Yağcı, bilge ve sludge seviyelerini izle.en: The Oiler monitors the bilge and sludge levels, informs the engineer before the tanks become full and provides on-site support for OWS/incinerator operation. Non-oil waste (detergent, chemicals) mixing with the bilge water impairs OWS performance; chemicals are therefore prevented from being poured into the bilge.

Güverte tahliye delikleri (scupper), nor.en: Deck drain holes (scuppers) normally discharge rain/sea water overboard; however, during bunkering/transfer they are plugged (scupper plugs) to prevent a possible spill from going into the sea. The plugs remain fitted throughout the operation and any accumulated liquid is monitored; when rainwater collects, the clean water is drained off in a controlled manner.

Drip tray (damlama tepsisi), manifold ve.en: Drip trays are placed under the manifold and connection points to catch small leaks. The Oiler checks the drip trays regularly and empties their contents into the sludge/waste tank (never into the sea/bilge).

Güverteye dökülme olursa: önce kaynağı d.en: If there is a spill on deck: first stop the source (emergency stop), then limit the spread (absorbent kit, verify that the scuppers are plugged), clean up and report. Even the smallest amount of oil reaching the sea is managed by activating the SOPEP and informing the port authority. Procedure, not panic, is what counts.

Yağcı, yakıt buharı kokusu veya gaz alar.en: In the event of a smell of fuel vapor or a gas alarm, the Oiler reports immediately. Gas accumulation in pump rooms and enclosed transfer areas is dangerous; entry into these spaces requires a gas test and ventilation.

Akan yakıt statik elektrik üretir; uygun.en: Flowing fuel generates static electricity; if this is not handled properly, there is a risk of sparks and ignition. At hose connections, the insulating flange/bonding practice is applied in accordance with company procedure, and a low rate at the start reduces static build-up. The Oiler watches that these precautions are applied.

Bunker Delivery Note (BDN), alınan yakıt.en: The Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) documents the quantity, type and sulfur content of the fuel received; it is kept on board as required by MARPOL Annex VI. The ORB Part I records all oil operations. Tank levels, quantities received/transferred and discharge records must be consistent with each other; in an inspection, a contradiction is regarded as a "suspicious record".

Yağcı, gözlemlediği operasyon verilerini.en: By reporting the operational data observed accurately, the Oiler ensures that the records reflect reality. False/inconsistent records are among the most serious PSC findings and can lead to detention of the ship.

OWS deşarjları, 15 ppm alarm olayları ve.en: Records of OWS discharges, 15 ppm alarm events and OCM calibration are kept; PSC inspects this system closely. The operability of the OWS, the alarm being active, the correct functioning of the three-way valve and tightness are checked. Signs of a bypass (hidden hose/flange) are the main finding looked for.

En yaygın hatalar: scupper'ı tıkamayı un.en: The most common mistakes are: forgetting to plug the scuppers, reducing the rate too late when topping off, setting up the valve line-up wrongly (wrong tank/overflow), emptying the drip tray too late and bypassing the OWS alarm in the belief that it is a "fault". Another is not reporting a small spill and trying to conceal it — this turns a small incident into a serious offense.

İletişim kopukluğu da tehlikelidir; mani.en: A breakdown in communication is also dangerous; without clear and continuous communication between the manifold and the control room/terminal, an emergency stop is delayed. The Oiler keeps a communication device (UHF) with them and knows the signals by heart.

İyi bir operasyon: kapsamlı hazırlık (ch.en: A good operation means thorough preparation (checklist, scuppers, drip trays, SOPEP), starting at a low rate, a constant watch, care when topping off, honest records and immediate reporting of every deviation. "Do not rush, do not look away, do not conceal" are the three basic principles.

Bunker, transfer ve sintine operasyonlar.en: Bunkering, transfer and bilge operations are jobs in which attention must not slacken even for a moment. Correct preparation, a constant watch, honest records and the discipline of "zero pollution" protect both the ship from heavy fines and the sea from pollution. A good Oiler is someone who does not forget the scupper plugs, does not take their eyes off the manifold when topping off and never bypasses an alarm. There is no hiding anything here; there is only doing it right and recording it right.

Separatör bowl'u (kovan) çok yüksek devi.en: The separator bowl rotates at a very high speed (usually around 6000-10000 rpm); this rotation forces the denser water and solid particles outward and the less dense clean fuel/oil inward. The disc stack makes the liquid flow in thin layers, which increases the separation surface and the efficiency. Clean fuel/oil leaves at the top, while water and sludge collect at the outside.

Separatör iki modda çalışabilir: purifie.en: A separator can operate in two modes: purifier (separating water + solids, with a water seal) and clarifier (separating solids only, if there is no water ingress). For HFO, purifier mode is generally used because both water and cat fines must be removed. The Oiler knows which mode the separator is in and why it is in that mode.

Ayrım verimi büyük ölçüde besleme sıcakl.en: Separation efficiency depends largely on the feed temperature; as the temperature rises, the viscosity of the fuel/oil falls and water/solids separate more easily. For HFO, the typical separator feed temperature is raised to ~98°C (without reaching boiling point); the preheater provides this temperature. For LO, lower values (~90-95°C) are used.

Debi (flow rate) düşük tutuldukça ayrım.en: The lower the flow rate, the longer the separation time and the higher the efficiency; better separation is therefore achieved by running the separator below its nominal capacity (e.g. at the rate recommended by the manufacturer). The Oiler monitors the feed temperature and the flow rate; a low temperature or a high flow rate means poor separation.

Purifier modunda, su ile yakıt arasındak.en: In purifier mode, keeping the dividing line between water and fuel (interface) in the correct position depends on the diameter of the gravity disc (dam ring / regulating ring). The higher the density of the fuel, the smaller the diameter of the gravity disc selected. Selecting the wrong disc results in the interface shifting, the water seal breaking and either fuel mixing into the water or water mixing into the fuel.

Yüksek yoğunluklu yakıtlarda gravity dis.en: Because the gravity disc is inadequate for high-density fuels, manufacturers have developed systems without a gravity disc that monitor the interface automatically by means of a water sensor/conductivity. When these systems detect water, they trigger automatic water draining or a desludge. The Oiler knows which generation the ship's separator belongs to and the daily check points that go with it.

Separatör çalıştıkça dış çeperde (bowl p.en: As the separator runs, sludge and water accumulate at the outer wall (bowl periphery); at set intervals this accumulation is discharged (desludge / sludge discharge). In modern separators this is done automatically by a timer; the moving part at the bottom of the bowl (sliding bowl bottom) moves down by means of the operating water, opening the sludge ports so that the sludge is thrown out by centrifugal force, and then closes again.

Desludge aralığı, yakıt kirliliğine ve y.en: The desludge interval is set according to fuel contamination and load: frequent for very dirty fuel, less frequent for clean fuel. If the interval is too long, the bowl clogs and separation deteriorates; if it is too short, there is unnecessary loss of fuel/oil and consumption of operating water. The Oiler verifies that the desludge takes place completely and properly (sound, vibration, observation of the discharge).

Desludge düzgün olmazsa (partial dischar.en: If the desludge does not take place properly (partial discharge / no discharge), sludge accumulates in the bowl; this leads to imbalance (vibration), loss of separation and eventually clogging of the bowl. Signs: increasing vibration, the housing getting hot, a drop in the quantity of water/sludge separated and a loss of quality at the clean fuel outlet. The Oiler recognizes these signs and reports them to the engineer.

Operating water (kumanda suyu), separatö.en: Operating water drives the hydraulic mechanism of the separator: it opens and closes the sliding bowl bottom (desludge) and holds the bowl in the closed position. Clean fresh water (at the appropriate pressure and flow) is generally used; dirty operating water or operating water at insufficient pressure leads to incomplete desludging or to the bowl not closing properly.

Yağcı, operating water basıncını, debisi.en: The Oiler monitors the pressure, flow and cleanliness of the operating water and checks the operating water filter/strainer. A fault in the operating water system (low pressure, clogged nozzle) translates directly into desludge failure.

Yağcı, separatör start ve her desludge s.en: The Oiler watches that the water seal has been established at separator start-up and after every desludge (clean water coming from the water outlet, no fuel escaping). Water at the fuel outlet or fuel at the water outlet indicates a seal/gravity disc problem and is reported.

Otomatik desludge'a rağmen bowl ve disc.en: Despite automatic desludging, the bowl and disc stack become coated over time with sticky sludge, asphaltenes and scale; periodically (according to the PMS interval), the separator is stopped and the bowl is dismantled and cleaned by hand. Before dismantling, the separator is stopped and allowed to cool down, and LOTO/energy isolation is applied; the high-speed bowl is not opened until it has come to a complete stop.

Bowl bileşenleri (bowl hood, sliding bow.en: The bowl components (bowl hood, sliding bowl bottom, disc stack, top disc, distributor) are dismantled in sequence; since each part is marked/numbered, it is refitted in the same sequence. The discs are cleaned one by one (with a suitable solvent/brush) without being scratched or deformed. The number and sequence of the discs in the stack are critical; a missing disc or a wrong sequence impairs separation.

Geri montajda parçalar doğru sırada, doğ.en: On reassembly, the parts are fitted in the correct sequence, in the correct orientation and to the manufacturer's tightening torque (particularly the lock ring / large nut). Incorrect assembly can lead to imbalance (vibration) and even to a disaster with the bowl flying apart. The alignment marks of the lock ring are lined up; over- or under-tightening is dangerous.

O-ring ve seal ring'ler her açımda kontr.en: O-rings and seal rings are checked every time the bowl is opened and renewed if necessary. An old/hardened O-ring leaks and impairs the seal. The Oiler inspects all the seals removed and replaces any that are worn.

Separatör performansı sürekli izlenir: b.en: Separator performance is monitored continuously: the feed temperature, the quality of the clean fuel/oil outlet, the water drainage and the sludge discharge are observed. A dark sludge discharge is normal; however, clean fuel/oil escaping into the water (oil loss) or fuel appearing at the water outlet indicates a seal/disc problem. The Oiler makes these observations every watch.

Backwash/operating water sıcaklığı ve di.en: The backwash/operating water temperature and the discharge temperature are monitored; an abnormal change in temperature points to a preheater or separation problem. A drop in performance (rising filter DP, water/dirt reaching the engine) is indirect evidence of separator inefficiency.

Separatör, filtreden önceki ana temizlem.en: The separator is the main cleaning stage before the filter; if its efficiency falls, the load on the filter increases and the DP rises quickly. Cat fines (Al+Si) are a particular target of the separator; a well-functioning purifier removes most of the cat fines. If the Oiler sees sand-like particles in the filter contents, they question the separator's efficiency.

FO separatörü ağır/kirli yakıtı işler; y.en: The FO separator processes heavy/dirty fuel; it focuses on high temperature, frequent desludging and the removal of cat fines/water. The LO separator, on the other hand, cleans the system oil continuously (bypass purification); it works with a cleaner feed and removes water and wear metals. The feed temperature, flow rate and desludge frequency of the two are different and must not be confused.

Yağcı, hangi separatörün hangi sisteme h.en: The Oiler knows which separator serves which system, the condition of the standby separator and the procedure for putting it into service. When a separator is taken out for maintenance, the standby one is put into service, so the supply to the engine is not interrupted.

Bazı gemilerde sludge'ı daha da konsantr.en: Some ships have a separate sludge separator/decanter that concentrates the sludge further; by reducing the oil content of the liquid discharged, it reduces the volume to be disposed of. The separated sludge goes to the sludge tank under MARPOL Annex I and is burned in the incinerator or delivered ashore. Under no circumstances is it discharged into the sea.

En sık görülen sorunlar: water seal kayb.en: The most frequent problems are: loss of the water seal (wrong gravity disc, low feed/sealing water), oil loss (broken seal, excessive flow rate), vibration (sludge build-up in the bowl, incorrect assembly, bearing wear), incomplete desludge (operating water pressure/clogging problem) and water/dirt reaching the engine (general drop in efficiency). The root cause of each symptom is looked for systematically.

Düşük besleme sıcaklığı ayrımı bozar; pr.en: A low feed temperature impairs separation; a preheater or thermostat fault is a typical cause. High vibration is always taken seriously and the separator is stopped. The Oiler carries out simple checks (temperature, pressure, operating water) and passes on to the engineer whatever cannot be solved.

Bir gemide separatör su çıkışından yakıt.en: On one ship, the Oiler noticed fuel coming from the separator's water outlet (oil loss); the investigation revealed that the gravity disc had not been changed although the bunker density had changed. When the correct disc was fitted, the water seal was re-established, the fuel loss stopped and water was prevented from reaching the engine. Daily observation prevented both fuel waste and risk to the engine.

Separatör hem çok sıcaktır (~98°C beslem.en: The separator is both very hot (~98°C feed, heater, hot fuel) and a mass rotating at very high speed; both carry a risk of serious injury. Contact with hot surfaces, leaking hot fuel and the rotating bowl are the main hazards. Maintenance is done only on equipment that has been stopped, has cooled down and has been energy-isolated.

Yağcı, separatör çalışırken muhafazaları.en: While the separator is running, the Oiler does not remove guards, does not approach the rotating part and wears gloves against hot surfaces. If leaking fuel meets a hot surface, there is a fire risk; for this reason, cleanliness of the separator room and leak checks are critical.

Separatör bakımı ve desludge'dan çıkan t.en: All oily waste from separator maintenance and desludging goes to the sludge tank; fuel/oil spilled during maintenance is collected and is not mixed into the bilge. Sludge transfers and disposal are entered in the ORB. By directing maintenance waste correctly, the Oiler maintains MARPOL compliance.

Separatör bakımı, makineyi cat fines ve.en: Separator maintenance is an invisible shield that protects the engine from cat fines and water. The correct temperature, the correct gravity disc, a sound water seal, proper desludging and meticulous periodic cleaning both prevent fuel/oil loss and protect the injection equipment and the bearings. A good Oiler/Fitter is someone who checks the separator's water and clean outlets every watch, takes vibration seriously and touches the bowl only when it has come to a complete stop. Clean fuel means a sound engine.

Termodinamik sistem, incelenmek üzere se.en: A thermodynamic system is a quantity of matter or a region in space chosen for study and separated from its surroundings by its boundaries. Everything outside the system is called the surroundings, and the surface that separates the system from its surroundings is called the boundary.

Sınır sabit veya hareketli olabilir. Bir.en: The boundary may be fixed or movable. The top surface of a piston in a cylinder is an example of a movable boundary, while the cylinder walls are a fixed boundary.

Kapalı sistemde sınırdan kütle geçişi yo.en: In a closed system there is no mass transfer across the boundary; only energy (heat and work) can cross it. A cylinder-piston arrangement is an example: as the piston moves, the mass of gas inside does not change, but work is done through the change in volume and heat is received or rejected.

Açık sistemde hem kütle hem enerji sınır.en: In an open system, both mass and energy can cross the boundary. Ship turbines, compressors and heat exchangers are examples of open systems. An open system is also called a control volume, and its boundary is called the control surface.

Süreklilik denklemi gereği, kararlı hald.en: According to the continuity equation, the mass flow rate entering an open system at steady state is equal to the mass flow rate leaving it.

Yalıtılmış sistemde ne kütle ne de enerj.en: In an isolated system, neither mass nor energy crosses the boundary. According to the second law of thermodynamics, the entropy of an isolated system never decreases. In practice, a perfectly isolated system does not exist, but modeling the universe as an isolated system is common in theoretical analysis.

Sınırından ısı geçişi olmayan ancak iş y.en: A system across whose boundary there is no heat transfer, but which can do work, is defined as adiabatic. A perfectly insulated cylinder-piston arrangement is an example of an adiabatic closed system.

Eğer A cismi C cismiyle termal dengede i.en: If body A is in thermal equilibrium with body C, and body B is also in thermal equilibrium with body C, then bodies A and B are in thermal equilibrium with each other. This statement is the zeroth law of thermodynamics.

Termal denge, iki sistem arasında net ıs.en: Thermal equilibrium is the state in which there is no net heat flow between two systems. If no heat transfer takes place between two systems when they are brought into contact, the systems are at the same temperature.

Sıfırıncı yasa, termometre kullanılarak.en: The zeroth law provides the physical basis for measuring temperature with a thermometer. When a thermometer (body C) reaches thermal equilibrium with the system to be measured (body A), the value shown by the thermometer is the temperature of the system.

Tersinir süreç, sistem ve çevre birlikte.en: A reversible process is an ideal process after which the system and the surroundings can both be returned to their initial states. In such a process there are no sources of irreversibility such as friction, turbulence, mixing or heat transfer across a finite temperature difference.

Tersinir süreçler doğada mevcut değildir.en: Reversible processes do not occur in nature, but they are used to establish ideal performance limits.

Gemi makine dairesinde karşılaşılan başl.en: The main sources of irreversibility encountered in a ship's engine room are friction (bearings, piston-cylinder), heat transfer across a finite temperature difference (heat exchangers), mixing (fuel-air), throttling (valves) and electrical resistance.

İdeal gaz denklemi PV = mRT veya Pv = RT.en: The ideal gas equation is written as PV = mRT or Pv = RT. Here P is the absolute pressure, V the total volume, m the mass, R the specific gas constant and T the absolute temperature.

İdeal gaz denklemi, düşük basınç ve yüks.en: The ideal gas equation gives a good approximation for real gases at low pressure and high temperature. At high pressure or low temperature (close to a phase change), the deviation increases.

Gemi motorlarında çalışma gazı genellikl.en: Since the working gas in marine engines is generally at a high temperature, the ideal gas assumption gives sufficient accuracy for engineering calculations.

Diesel çevrimi dört süreçten oluşur: (1-.en: The Diesel cycle consists of four processes: (1-2) adiabatic compression; (2-3) heat addition at constant pressure (fuel injection and combustion); (3-4) adiabatic expansion; (4-1) heat rejection at constant volume.

Diesel çevrimi verimi, sıkıştırma oranı.en: The efficiency of the Diesel cycle depends on the compression ratio (r) and the cut-off ratio (ρ).

Gerçek motorda yanma sabit basınçta gerç.en: In a real engine, combustion does not take place at constant pressure, there are heat losses, gas properties vary with temperature and there are friction losses. For these reasons, the real efficiency is about 60-70% of the ideal cycle efficiency.

Fourier yasasına göre birim zamanda ilet.en: According to Fourier's law, the amount of heat conducted per unit time is directly proportional to the temperature gradient and the area of conduction, and depends on the thermal conductivity of the material.

Malzemenin ısıl iletkenliği, ısı transfe.en: The thermal conductivity of a material is a critical parameter that determines the accuracy of heat transfer calculations.

Ters akış veya paralel akış düzenlemesin.en: For a heat exchanger in a counterflow or parallel-flow arrangement, the LMTD is calculated from the inlet and outlet temperature differences.

Eşanjörün ısı transfer kapasitesi LMTD k.en: The heat transfer capacity of a heat exchanger is calculated using the LMTD.

İzotermik süreçte sıcaklık sabit olduğun.en: In an isothermal process the temperature is constant, so for an ideal gas the change in internal energy is zero. By the first law, all the heat supplied to the system is transferred to the surroundings as work: Q = W.

Boyle yasası (PV = sabit) izotermik süre.en: Boyle's law (PV = constant) gives the pressure-volume relationship of the isothermal process.

Sabit hacimde iş yapılamaz (W = 0) çünkü.en: No work can be done at constant volume (W = 0), because work = P·ΔV and ΔV = 0. All the heat supplied is converted into a change in internal energy: Q = ΔU = m·cv·ΔT.

Otto çevriminde ısı ekleme ve atma süreç.en: In the Otto cycle, the heat addition and heat rejection processes are modeled as isochoric.

Konvektif ısı transferi, yüzey alanı, sı.en: Convective heat transfer depends on the surface area, the temperature difference and the convection coefficient.

Bir kabuk (shell) içine yerleştirilmiş b.en: Two fluids are passed separately across a tube bundle fitted inside a shell. Baffle plates create cross flow on the shell side and increase heat transfer.

Buhar kondenserler, yağ soğutucular ve y.en: Steam condensers, oil coolers and fuel heaters are built to this type.

Tipik bir WHRS: egzoz gazı ekonomizeri,.en: A typical WHRS may consist of an exhaust gas economizer, a power turbine, a steam turbine generator and/or an organic Rankine cycle (ORC) unit.

Büyük konteyner gemilerinde WHRS, ana ma.en: On large container ships, a WHRS can generate additional electrical power equal to about 8-11% of main engine power.

Pervaneyi çevirerek gemiye itme kuvveti.en: It drives the propeller to provide thrust to the ship. It may be a low-speed two-stroke engine (large ships) or a medium-speed four-stroke engine (medium-sized ships). The power range is 5000-80000 kW.

Jeneratör tahrik ederek gemi elektrik ih.en: It drives a generator to meet the ship's electrical demand. These are four-stroke medium- or high-speed engines. There are usually 3-4 on board; 1-2 are run at sea and 2-3 in port.

Büyük iki zamanlı motorlarda piston gene.en: In large two-stroke engines, the piston generally consists of two parts: a steel crown resistant to high temperature and a lighter skirt. Cooling oil or water circulates inside the crown.

Sıkıştırma segmanları gaz sızdırmazlığı,.en: Compression rings provide gas sealing, and oil rings control the oil film on the liner. The ring gap is measured periodically; an excessive increase indicates blow-by.

Crosshead motorlarda biyel kolu crosshea.en: In crosshead engines, the connecting rod connects the crosshead pin to the crankpin. In trunk piston engines, it is connected directly to the piston pin (gudgeon pin).

Alt uçta (big end) ve üst uçta (small en.en: There is a bearing at the lower end (big end) and at the upper end (small end). Bearing clearances are checked periodically.

Krank mili, motorun en ağır ve en pahalı.en: The crankshaft is the heaviest and most expensive part of the engine. It is made of forged steel or of semi-built construction. It consists of the crankpins, the main journals and the crank webs.

Krank mili saptırması (deflection) ölçüm.en: Crankshaft deflection measurement is the most important indicator of bearing wear and shaft alignment.

Ana yataklar (main bearings) krank milin.en: The main bearings support the main journals of the crankshaft. The crankpin bearings (crankpin/big end bearings) are located at the lower end of the connecting rod. The crosshead bearings support the crosshead pin.

Yatak malzemesi genellikle beyaz metal (.en: The bearing material is usually white metal (tin-based babbitt) or an Al-Sn alloy.

Yatak boşluğu (bearing clearance) kurşun.en: Bearing clearance is measured with lead wire or a feeler gauge. Excessive clearance causes low oil pressure and knocking.

İki zamanlı motorlarda yalnızca egzoz su.en: Two-stroke engines have only an exhaust valve, which is operated hydraulically or pneumatically. In four-stroke engines, the inlet and exhaust valves are operated mechanically by the camshaft.

Elektronik kontrollü motorlarda (ME tipi.en: In electronically controlled engines (ME type), valve timing is optimized according to load.

Spade (asma) dümen: Alt tarafta yatak yo.en: Spade rudder: there is no bearing at the bottom; its weight is carried by the rudder stock. High maneuvering capability.

Horn dümen: Alt yatak desteği vardır, ya.en: Horn rudder: it has lower bearing support and is structurally stronger.

Flap (Becker) dümen: Arka kenarda hareke.en: Flap (Becker) rudder: a movable flap is fitted at the trailing edge, which improves maneuverability at low speed.

Daha basit yapı, daha düşük maliyet ve d.en: It has a simpler construction and lower cost, and requires less maintenance. For astern, the engine has to run in the reverse direction.

Büyük iki zamanlı motorlarla direkt tahr.en: It is widely used on ships with direct drive from large two-stroke engines.

Yer değiştirme (displacement), hız (velo.en: Displacement, velocity and acceleration are the vibration quantities. At low frequencies displacement is the dominant indicator, and at high frequencies acceleration.

FFT (Hızlı Fourier Dönüşümü) analizi, ti.en: FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) analysis breaks the vibration signal down into its frequency components and identifies the source of the fault.

P (Oransal): Hata büyüklüğüyle orantılı.en: P (Proportional): produces an output proportional to the magnitude of the error. It gives a fast response but leaves a steady-state error.

I (İntegral): Hatanın zamanla birikimini.en: I (Integral): calculates the accumulation of the error over time and eliminates the steady-state error. Excessive integral action can cause oscillation.

D (Türev): Hatanın değişim hızına göre ç.en: D (Derivative): produces an output according to the rate of change of the error. It reduces overshoot but is sensitive to noise.

CII = Yıllık CO₂ emisyonu / (DWT × Mesaf.en: It is calculated with the formula CII = annual CO₂ emissions / (DWT × distance). CO₂ emissions are obtained from fuel consumption and the carbon conversion factor.

Gemiler A (çok iyi), B (iyi), C (orta),.en: Ships are rated A (very good), B (good), C (moderate), D (poor) or E (very poor). Ships rated D for 3 consecutive years or E for 1 year must prepare a corrective action plan.

Sürtünmesiz, sıkıştırılamaz, kararlı akı.en: For frictionless, incompressible, steady flow, the total energy along a streamline is constant.

P (Oransal): Anlık hataya orantılı çıkış.en: P (Proportional): output proportional to the instantaneous error. It responds quickly but leaves a steady-state error (offset).

I (İntegral): Birikmiş hatayı giderir (o.en: I (Integral): removes the accumulated error (eliminates the offset). Too much of it causes oscillation.

Metallerde üç temel kristal yapı gözleml.en: Three basic crystal structures are found in metals: Body-Centered Cubic (BCC), Face-Centered Cubic (FCC) and Hexagonal Close-Packed (HCP).

HFO, motorlarda kullanılabilmesi için ço.en: HFO goes through a multi-stage preparation process before it can be used in engines. This process consists of storage, settling, purification (purifier), service tank, heating, viscosity control and filtration.

Katalizör ince parçacıkları (Al+Si) aşın.en: Catalytic fines (Al+Si) cause wear and must be removed by the purifier. Asphaltenes can clog fuel filters. Mixing incompatible fuels causes sludge formation.

ECA bölgelerine girişte MGO'ya geçiş yap.en: On entering ECA areas, the ship changes over to MGO. Some of the auxiliary diesel generators are run on MGO. The emergency generator generally runs on MDO or MGO.

Her sınıf için viskozite, yoğunluk, flas.en: For each grade, limit values are set for parameters such as viscosity, density, flash point, water, sulfur, Al+Si and vanadium.

Bunker tanklarından alınan yakıt ilk ola.en: Fuel taken from the bunker tanks is first transferred to the settling tank. Here, water and heavy particles settle to the bottom under gravity.

Sıcaklık HFO için 60-70°C'de tutulur. Be.en: For HFO, the temperature is kept at 60-70°C. A settling time of at least 24 hours is recommended. Water and sludge are drained periodically through the drain valve at the bottom of the tank.

Purifier çıkışından gelen arıtılmış yakı.en: Purified fuel from the purifier outlet is transferred to the service tank. The engine fuel system is supplied from here.

SOLAS gereği en az 8 saatlik yakıt kapas.en: Under SOLAS, it must have a fuel capacity of at least 8 hours. It has a water detection and alarm system with autonomous sensors.

Numune, manifold hattına bağlı sürekli d.en: The sample must be taken by the continuous drip method (drip sampling) connected to the manifold line throughout the whole bunkering operation. A spot sample is accepted only when drip sampling is not possible.

Numune şişesi etiketlenir, her iki taraf.en: The sample bottle is labeled, signed by both parties (ship/supplier) and sealed.

Makine dairesi tahliye edildikten ve tüm.en: After the engine room has been evacuated and all personnel have been counted, the fixed CO₂ or FM200 (HFC-227ea) extinguishing system may be activated.

CO₂ sistemi devreye alınmadan önce: tüm.en: Before the CO₂ system is activated, all personnel must be outside, all doors and ventilation must be closed and the warning alarm must have been given.

Makine dairesi terk edilmeden önce kapsa.en: Before the engine room is left unattended, a thorough check round is made, all systems are monitored, the alarm system is tested and the UMS checklist is completed.

Nöbetçi mühendis taşınabilir alarm cihaz.en: The duty engineer takes the portable alarm unit with them and remains on call.

Yangın üçgeninin herhangi bir kenarı kal.en: If any side of the fire triangle is removed, the fire goes out: the fuel is cut off (quick-closing valve), the oxygen is cut off (CO₂, foam) or the temperature is lowered (water).

Arıza sonrası bakım (corrective/reactive.en: Corrective maintenance (corrective/reactive maintenance) is the approach of waiting for equipment to fail and then intervening. It can be economical for non-critical and redundant systems; however, on critical equipment it leads to unplanned downtime and high costs.

Gemi makine dairesinde tamamen correctiv.en: A system based entirely on corrective maintenance is not acceptable in a ship's engine room. However, corrective maintenance is, together with the other strategies, a component of every maintenance plan.

SOLAS ve klas kuruluşları gemilerde PMS.en: SOLAS and the classification societies make the implementation of a PMS (Planned Maintenance System) on ships mandatory.

7. Bakım sonrası yeni baz ölçüm alma..en: 7. Take a new baseline measurement after maintenance.

P-F eğrisi, ekipmanın potansiyel arıza (.en: The P-F curve shows the deterioration process of equipment between potential failure (point P) and functional failure (point F). The aim of CBM is to detect point P and carry out maintenance before point F is reached. The longer the P-F interval, the easier maintenance planning becomes.

Kestirimci bakım, büyük veri analizi, ma.en: Predictive maintenance uses big data analysis, machine learning algorithms and digital twin technologies to model equipment behavior and detect anomalies.

Sürekli veri toplama (IoT sensörleri) il.en: Real-time monitoring is carried out through continuous data collection (IoT sensors). The algorithm detects deviations from the normal behavior model and estimates the remaining useful life (RUL - Remaining Useful Life).

RCM analizi sonucunda her arıza modu içi.en: As a result of the RCM analysis, the most suitable maintenance strategy is selected for each failure mode: condition monitoring (CBM), scheduled restoration, scheduled replacement, failure finding (hidden failure), design change or run-to-failure.

Klas kuruluşları (DNV, Lloyd's, Bureau V.en: Classification societies (DNV, Lloyd's, Bureau Veritas) accept RCM-based maintenance plans. Applying RCM makes it possible to move from traditional calendar-based maintenance to condition-based maintenance, which reduces unnecessary dismantling and reassembly as well as costs.

Her ekipmanda running hour counter bulun.en: Every item of equipment has a running hour counter, which is updated regularly in the PMS. When the running hour threshold is reached, the PMS automatically generates a work order.

Bazı bakımlar takvim bazlıdır (yıllık, 2.en: Some maintenance is calendar-based (annual, every 2.5 years) and independent of running hours. The class survey schedule is binding.

CMS sistemi, ana ve yardımcı makinelerin.en: The CMS system allows the components of the main and auxiliary machinery to be inspected progressively over a 5-year period. Certain components are inspected each year, and the cycle is completed in 5 years.

CMS geminin kendi mühendisleri tarafında.en: CMS may be carried out by the ship's own engineers (owner's survey), with the class surveyor verifying the results. This system reduces the workload during dry-docking periods.

Her yedek parça için minimum ve maksimum.en: A minimum and a maximum stock level are set for each spare part. When the stock falls below the minimum level, an order is triggered (re-order point). The order quantity is calculated so as to bring the stock up to the maximum level.

Lead time (teslim süresi), denizde sipar.en: Lead time, the possibility of placing orders at sea and the plan for the next ports directly affect stock management.

Klas kuruluşları belirli kritik ekipmanl.en: Classification societies require a minimum stock of spare parts for certain critical equipment. These are called 'mandatory spares' and are checked during class inspections.

Saplama somunları üretici tarafından bel.en: The stud nuts must be tightened to the torque/tensioning pressure specified by the manufacturer and in the specified sequence. O-rings and gaskets must be renewed. A cooling system pressure test and a fuel system tightness test must be carried out after assembly.

Crosshead motorlarda piston yağ soğutmal.en: In crosshead engines the piston is oil-cooled, the oil being supplied through a telescopic pipe or a swinging link. The piston cooling oil outlet temperature is a performance indicator. A high temperature indicates a blocked cooling passage or melting in the crown area.

Aşınma hızı (wear rate) mm/1000 saat ola.en: The wear rate is calculated in mm/1000 hours.

Supap oturma yüzeyi (seat face) ve supap.en: The valve seating face (seat face) and the valve seat (seat insert) wear over time because of combustion gas erosion and corrosion. Grinding brings the two surfaces back into conformity.

Taşlama macunu ile el ile veya taşlama m.en: Grinding is done by hand with grinding paste or with a grinding machine. Coarse grinding is followed by fine grinding. After grinding, the tightness of the surfaces is checked with a marking test (blue marking).

Supap disk üst yüzeyi ile silindir kapağ.en: The distance between the top surface of the valve disc and the reference surface of the cylinder cover is measured. As the valve wears, this distance increases (the valve sinks). When the sinking limit is exceeded, the valve or the seat insert must be replaced.

Defleksiyon ölçümü, krank mili krank kol.en: Deflection is measured with a dial gauge fitted to the crank webs. The crankshaft is turned through 360° and the changes in the gauge readings are recorded. Measuring points: TDC, BDC, Port, Starboard and symmetrical intermediate points.

Defleksiyon değeri, krank milinin o sili.en: The deflection value shows the bending of the crankshaft in the region of that cylinder. A high positive or negative value indicates that the lower bearing is worn or raised.

Prob, malzeme yüzeyine ultrasonik darbe.en: The probe sends an ultrasonic pulse into the surface of the material. The sound wave is reflected from the back surface and returns. The thickness is calculated from the round-trip time and the speed of sound in the material.

FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) analizi, ti.en: FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) analysis breaks the vibration signal down into its frequency components, which makes it possible to identify the type of fault.

1× RPM baskın: Dengesizlik (unbalance)..en: 1× RPM dominant: unbalance. 2× RPM: misalignment. High frequency (kHz): bearing fault. Gear mesh frequency: gear damage.

Silindir yağı feed rate ayarı TBN seviye.en: The cylinder oil feed rate is adjusted according to the TBN level. If the TBN is low (insufficient neutralization of acids from sulfur-containing fuel), the feed rate is increased. If the TBN is very high, the feed rate is reduced to save oil. The target TBN is generally kept between 20 and 30 mg KOH/g.

En sık saha hatası, taşlama öncesi bilge.en: The most frequent field error is failing to clean up accumulations of oily rags/dirt in the bilge and under the platforms before grinding. Falling sparks can cause delayed ignition, which can turn into a fire that goes unnoticed during the watch handover.

Kategoriye uygun prewash yapılmadan lima.en: Leaving port without carrying out the prewash required for the category is a serious violation. The error most often seen in the field is leaving residue in the tank because the stripping line test has been skipped.

Sık görülen hata, özel alanda yiyecek at.en: A frequent error is applying the food waste discharge limits incorrectly in a special area. Waste transfers made without the GPS position being entered in the record constitute a serious nonconformity in inspections.

Sürtünme kaybı, sürtünme katsayısı, boru.en: Friction loss is proportional to the friction factor, the pipe length/diameter ratio and the square of the velocity. In laminar flow (Re < 2300), f depends only on Re; in turbulent flow, the relative roughness (ε/D) becomes decisive (Colebrook equation / Moody diagram).

Re ve ε/D bilindiğinde f, Moody diyagram.en: When Re and ε/D are known, f is read from the Moody diagram. At high Re and high roughness, f becomes constant (the 'fully turbulent' region). The diagram is a basic tool in selecting pump head and pipe diameter.

Her armatür için bir kayıp katsayısı (K).en: A loss coefficient (K) is defined for each fitting, and the loss is obtained by multiplying it by the velocity head. The K values of all fittings are added together to find the total local loss, which is added to the friction loss.

Seri bağlamada debi tüm borularda aynıdı.en: In series connection, the flow rate is the same in all pipes, and the total loss is the sum of the losses of each segment. In parallel connection, the pressure loss across each branch is the same, and the total flow rate is the sum of the flow rates of the branches (the branch with the lower resistance carries more flow).

Dişli (gear) ve vidalı (screw) pompalar,.en: Gear and screw pumps carry the volumes formed between the rotating elements from the suction side to the discharge side. Flow is proportional to speed; as pressure rises, the flow changes very little. For this reason, pressure rises dangerously when the discharge line is closed.

Pozitif deplasmanlı pompaların basma tar.en: Positive displacement pumps MUST have a safety/bypass valve on the discharge side; otherwise, when the pump runs against a closed valve, the pressure can burst the pipe/pump. This is the most fundamental difference from centrifugal pumps.

Normal (σ) ve kayma (τ) gerilmelerinin b.en: In a plane stress state where normal (σ) and shear (τ) stresses act together, the equivalent stress is calculated and compared with the yield strength. The condition σvm < σakma / SF (σakma: yield strength) must be met.

Emniyet gerilmesi, malzeme akma (veya ko.en: The allowable stress is obtained by dividing the yield (or ultimate/fatigue) strength of the material by the safety factor. The SF is selected according to the type of load (static/dynamic), the ductility of the material, the severity of the consequences and class rules.

Şaft, esas olarak burulma (tork) yükünü.en: The shaft mainly carries the torsional (torque) load; torque increases with the power/speed ratio. The rule formulas give the diameter as a function of power (P), speed (n), material strength (Rm) and the shaft type/design factor. Because of additional bending and corrosion, the tail shaft has a larger diameter than the intermediate shaft.

Sürtünmeli (friction) kavramalar (çok pl.en: Friction clutches (multi-plate, with hydraulic/pneumatic actuators) allow gradual engagement under load. Positive (toothed/dog) clutches engage only at standstill/low speed, but transmit full torque without slipping. SSS/freewheel-type clutches engage automatically in one direction.

Tahrik kuvvetinin frekansı sistemin doğa.en: When the frequency of the exciting force approaches the natural torsional frequency of the system, the vibration amplitude grows (resonance) and the shaft may suffer a fatigue fracture. For this reason, continuous operation within the relevant speed range is prohibited, and this range is passed through quickly. A torsional damper is used to reduce the amplitudes.

Cıvata sıkıldığında oluşan ön gerilme (p.en: The preload created when a bolt is tightened prevents the joint from separating under load and the bolt from fatiguing. The preload obtained from the applied torque is related to it through a coefficient that depends on friction.

Perçinli bağlantılar kalıcıdır; kayma ve.en: Riveted joints are permanent; they are designed for shear and bearing (crushing) stresses. Today they have largely been replaced by welding and high-strength bolts, but they are still used in some applications.

Yaygın tipler: katlanır (folding), kayar.en: Common types are folding, rolling (side/end rolling) and pontoon-type covers. Tightness is provided by steel-to-steel seating and the rubber packing around the cover; drainage channels and drain holes with non-return valves discharge any water that leaks in. Hydraulic cylinders or chain/wire systems are used when the covers are opened.

Conta ve oturma yüzeyi sızdırmazlık test.en: Tightness tests of the packing and the seating surfaces are carried out (chalk test, hose test or ultrasonic tightness measurement). Defective packing and worn seating lead to water ingress and cargo damage; they are frequently inspected in PSC inspections/surveys.

Kompresör sonrası soğutucu (after-cooler.en: The after-cooler downstream of the compressor separates the condensed water; the dryer (refrigerant or desiccant type) then removes moisture by lowering the dew point. Oil/particle filters (coalescing) clean the control air. Automatic condensate drains (auto-drain) drain the water from the air receivers.

Filtre elemanı üzerinde basınç farkı (ΔP.en: When the differential pressure (ΔP) across the filter element exceeds a set threshold, the system automatically backflushes or activates its self-cleaning mechanism (brush/blade), and the accumulated sediment is discharged. Usually a fine auto-filter works together with a protective coarse filter. A high ΔP alarm signals clogging.

Küresel kükürt sınırı %0,50 m/m; ECA (ör.en: The global sulfur limit is 0.50% m/m; in ECAs (e.g. the Baltic, the North Sea, North America) it is 0.10% m/m. Compliance can be achieved in three ways: (1) using a compliant low-sulfur fuel (VLSFO/MGO); (2) using high-sulfur fuel with an exhaust gas cleaning system (scrubber/EGCS) as an equivalent measure; (3) alternative fuels such as LNG. The Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) and the fuel sample are kept on board.

Uyum, IAPP sertifikası, BDN kayıtları, y.en: Compliance is demonstrated by the IAPP certificate, BDN records, fuel samples and (if a scrubber is used) the monitoring/recording systems. The fuel changeover must be completed and recorded before entering an ECA.

Reynolds sayısı akışkan hızı, karakteris.en: The Reynolds number depends on the flow velocity, the characteristic length and the kinematic viscosity.

İdeal akışkan için bir akım çizgisi boyu.en: For an ideal fluid, the total energy along a streamline is constant.

NPSHavailable: Sistemin emme noktasında.en: NPSHavailable: the pressure head that the system can provide at the suction point. NPSHrequired: the minimum pressure head that the pump needs in order to operate without cavitation (stated in the manufacturer's catalog).

Güvenli çalışma koşulu: NPSHa > NPSHr (g.en: Safe operating condition: NPSHa > NPSHr (usually with a margin of at least 0.5 m)

Kavitasyon, akışkan basıncının buharlaşm.en: Cavitation is the collapse, in a high-pressure region, of vapor bubbles formed when the fluid pressure falls below the vapor pressure, causing material damage, noise and a loss of performance. It causes pitting and erosion on the impeller vanes.

HCP (Sıkı Paket Altıgen): Çinko, magnezy.en: HCP (Hexagonal Close-Packed): metals such as zinc and magnesium have this structure.

Düşük karbonlu çelik (< %0.25 C): Kaynak.en: Low-carbon steel (< 0.25% C): weldable, structural use. Medium-carbon steel (0.25-0.60% C): shafts, gears, bolts. High-carbon steel (> 0.60% C): springs, cutting tools.

Gerilme σ = F/A formülüyle hesaplanır. D.en: Stress is calculated with the formula σ = F/A. Strain (unit elongation) is defined as ε = ΔL/L₀.

Elastik bölgede σ = E × ε bağıntısı geçe.en: In the elastic region, the relationship σ = E × ε applies. E (Young's modulus, or modulus of elasticity) is a measure of the stiffness of the material.

Dairesel kesitli bir mile tork uygulandı.en: When a torque is applied to a shaft of circular cross-section, shear stress develops.

S-N eğrisi, uygulanan gerilme genliği (S.en: The S-N curve shows the relationship between the applied stress amplitude (S) and the number of cycles to failure (N). In steel, failure does not occur below a certain stress value (the fatigue limit); this is generally about 40-50% of the tensile strength.

Korozif ortamda (deniz suyu) yorulma sın.en: In a corrosive environment (sea water), the fatigue limit falls considerably.

Elektrot ile iş parçası arasında oluşan.en: The electric arc formed between the electrode and the workpiece melts the metals. The electrode coating produces gas and slag, which protect the weld pool from the atmosphere.

Gövde onarımı, boru kaynağı, yapısal par.en: It is widely used for hull repairs, pipe welding, joining structural parts and build-up welding. Classification societies certify welder qualification.

Sıcak gazlar boruların içinden, su borul.en: The hot gases pass through the tubes and the water around the outside of the tubes. Thanks to its large water volume, it can cope with sudden load changes and keeps the steam pressure steady. Its advantages are simple construction, easy maintenance and tolerance of lower water quality.

Basınç genellikle 7-18 bar ile sınırlıdı.en: Pressure is generally limited to 7-18 bar, and the rate of steam generation is low. It is widely used as an auxiliary boiler and as an exhaust gas economizer.

Örnekler: Scotch marine (yatay, çok geçi.en: Examples: Scotch marine (horizontal, multi-pass), Cochran (vertical) and composite (both oil-fired and exhaust gas) boilers.

Su boruların içinden, sıcak gazlar dışın.en: The water passes through the tubes and the hot gases around the outside. It is suitable for high pressure (60+ bar) and large capacity. Because of its small water volume, it raises steam quickly and its explosion energy is low; however, water quality (oxygen, hardness, pH) is critical.

Buhar gemilerinde ve LNG taşıyıcılarda a.en: It is used as the main propulsion boiler on steamships and LNG carriers; it produces superheated steam by means of a superheater.

Örnekler: D-tipi (iki kazanlı: buhar kaz.en: Examples: D-type (two-drum: steam drum + water drum), header type, radiant type.

Motorlu gemilerde ana makine egzoz gazın.en: On motor ships, the waste heat of the main engine exhaust gas is used to produce steam in a fire-tube/water-tube economizer. At sea, it greatly reduces the fuel consumption of the auxiliary boiler.

Düşük yük/yavaş seyirde kurum birikmesi.en: At low load/slow steaming, soot build-up and the risk of a 'soot fire' must be monitored.

Evaporatör kabuğu içinde vakum oluşturul.en: A vacuum is created inside the evaporator shell, which lowers the boiling temperature of the water to 40-60°C. Main engine HT cooling water (70-85°C) is used as the heat source.

Buharlaşan su kondenserde yoğuşarak tatl.en: The evaporated water condenses in the condenser to give fresh water. The brine is discharged continuously.

Üretim kapasitesi HT soğutma suyu sıcakl.en: Production capacity depends directly on the HT cooling water temperature. If the engine load is low, the temperature falls and production decreases. Typical capacity is 10-30 t/day.

Yüksek hızla dönen tambur (6000-9000 rpm.en: In the bowl rotating at high speed (6000-9000 rpm), centrifugal force pushes the heavy components (water, solid particles) outward and the light component (clean fuel/oil) toward the center.

Disk yığını (disc stack) yüzey alanını a.en: The disc stack increases the surface area and raises the separation efficiency.

Purifier: Hem su hem katı partikülleri a.en: Purifier: separates both water and solid particles. The separation boundary is set by the gravity disc.

Clarifier: Yalnızca katı partikülleri ay.en: Clarifier: separates only solid particles. There is no gravity disc. It is generally used as a second stage.

HFO'nun viskozitesi 50°C'de 180-700 cSt.en: The viscosity of HFO at 50°C is between 180 and 700 cSt. For use, it must be heated to 130-150°C to reduce its viscosity to 10-15 cSt.

Yoğunluğu 15°C'de 960-991 kg/m³ arasında.en: Its density at 15°C is between 960 and 991 kg/m³ (ISO 8217 RMG/RMK grades). Its sulfur content varies between 1.0% and 3.5%.

VLSFO, farklı rafineri ürünlerinin karış.en: VLSFO is produced by blending different refinery products. For this reason, its properties can vary from producer to producer.

Stabilite sorunları (sludge oluşumu), uy.en: Stability problems (sludge formation), a risk of incompatibility and unexpected combustion behavior may be encountered. A compatibility test before bunkering is recommended.

Kalıntı yakıtlar: RMA, RMB, RMD, RME, RM.en: Residual fuels: RMA, RMB, RMD, RME, RMG, RMK – classified according to viscosity.

Her sınıf için viskozite, yoğunluk, kükü.en: Limits for viscosity, density, sulfur, water, ash, CCAI and Al+Si are set for each grade.

Enjeksiyon öncesi yakıt viskozitesi 10-1.en: Before injection, the fuel viscosity must be adjusted to 10-15 cSt. The heating temperature is 130-150°C for HFO and 80-100°C for VLSFO.

Viskometre, yakıt hattındaki viskoziteyi.en: The viscometer continuously measures the viscosity in the fuel line and automatically controls the heater.

Depolama tankı (storage tank) → Settling.en: Storage tank → settling tank (24-48 hours' settling, separation of water and sediment) → purifier/clarifier → service tank (fuel supply to the engine).

Servis tankı genellikle 8-24 saatlik yak.en: The service tank generally has a fuel capacity of 8-24 hours and ensures an uninterrupted supply to the engine.

BDN şu bilgileri içermelidir: Alıcı gemi.en: The BDN must contain the following information: name and IMO number of the receiving ship, fuel supplier, quantity (metric tonnes), density (at 15°C), sulfur content (%), fuel grade (ISO 8217), date and port of delivery.

BDN üç yıl boyunca gemide saklanmalıdır..en: The BDN must be kept on board for three years. The fuel sample must be retained for at least 12 months.

Soğutma COP'u, evaporatördeki ısı alımın.en: The refrigeration COP is the ratio of the heat absorbed in the evaporator to the compressor work input.

İki farklı metalin birleşim noktalarında.en: Based on the EMF produced by the temperature difference between the junctions of two dissimilar metals (Seebeck effect). Type K (Ni-Cr / Ni-Al) is the most common and is used between -200°C and 1260°C.

Egzoz sıcaklığı, silindir kapağı sıcaklı.en: Preferred for measuring exhaust temperature, cylinder cover temperature and boiler temperature.

Platinin elektrik direncinin sıcaklıkla.en: Based on the electrical resistance of platinum changing linearly with temperature. Pt100 (100 Ω at 0°C) is the most widely used type. It provides high accuracy (±0.1°C), but its response time is slower than that of a thermocouple.

Soğutma suyu, yağlama yağı ve yaşam alan.en: Used for measuring cooling water, lubricating oil and accommodation temperatures.

P (Oransal): Hatanın büyüklüğüyle orantı.en: P (Proportional): Produces an output proportional to the size of the error. Leaves a steady-state error (offset).

I (İntegral): Hatanın zamanla toplamına.en: I (Integral): Produces an output based on the error accumulated over time. Eliminates the steady-state error, but carries a risk of overshoot and oscillation.

D (Türev): Hatanın değişim hızına göre ç.en: D (Derivative): Produces an output based on the rate of change of the error. Responds quickly to sudden changes and reduces overshoot.

Devreden vardiyacı, tüm çalışan ekipmanl.en: The off-going watchkeeper hands over the status of all running equipment, ongoing maintenance work, the alarm history and pending tasks.

Devralan vardiyacı, round atarak ana mak.en: The relieving watchkeeper makes a round and checks the main engine, auxiliary machinery, boilers, tank levels and the general condition of the engine room.

Kuru iklimlerde hava nemlendirme gerekeb.en: In dry climates, the air may need to be humidified. Steam injection or ultrasonic humidifiers are used.

Otopilot (autopilot) entegrasyonu elektr.en: Autopilot integration is easier with an electric telemotor.

Beyaz metal veya polimer (Thordon, Orkot.en: White metal or polymer (Thordon, Orkot) bearing material is used. The bearing space is filled with oil. Sealing elements (lip seals or face seals) are fitted at the propeller end and at the engine room end.

Kauçuk (cutless rubber) yatak malzemesi.en: Rubber (cutless rubber) bearing material is used. It is lubricated by seawater. It is environmentally advantageous (no risk of oil leakage).

Sızdırmazlık yalnızca makine dairesi tar.en: Sealing is required only at the engine room end.

Uzun şaft hatlarında şaftın kendi ağırlı.en: On long shaft lines, they prevent the shaft from sagging under its own weight and from vibrating. White metal plain bearings are used.

Yatak sıcaklığı sürekli izlenir; 65°C al.en: Bearing temperature is monitored continuously; 65°C alarm and 75°C shutdown levels are typical.

Michell tipi kaymalı yatak en yaygın tip.en: The Michell-type plain bearing is the most common type. Tilting pads form a hydrodynamic oil film between themselves and the shaft surface.

İtme kuvveti bedplate'e ve oradan gemi y.en: The thrust is transmitted to the bedplate and from there to the ship's structure. On large two-stroke engines, the thrust bearing is integrated into the engine bedplate.

Jib (bom) vinçler: Döner kol üzerinde ha.en: Jib (boom) cranes: A moving wire rope system on a slewing arm. Common on general cargo ships.

Goose-neck vinçler: Tek bom, elektro-hid.en: Goose-neck cranes: Single boom, electro-hydraulic drive. Standard on modern dry cargo ships.

Gantry (portal) vinçler: Konteyner gemil.en: Gantry (portal) cranes: On container ships, they travel on mounted rails. SWL 30-50 tonnes.

Hava distribütörü, motor ateşleme sırası.en: The air distributor sends air to the correct cylinders in turn, according to the engine firing order. Air is admitted only to cylinders whose pistons are near top dead center.

Starting air hattında alev tutucu (flame.en: A flame arrester is fitted in the starting air line. A leaking starting valve can allow hot combustion gases to escape into the air line and cause an explosion.

Hava hattındaki emniyet supabı ve patlam.en: The safety valve and the bursting disc in the air line prevent overpressure.

ERM, makine dairesinin kendine özgü zorl.en: ERM takes into account the particular challenges of the engine room: high noise, limited visibility, complex equipment, extreme heat and physical fatigue.

Rutin operasyonlarda katılımcı veya dele.en: In routine operations, a participative or delegating style increases motivation and learning.

En kısa mesafe (great circle) her zaman.en: The shortest distance (great circle) is not always the most economical route. Strong winds, waves and currents cause loss of speed and increased fuel consumption.

Weather routing servisleri, hava tahminl.en: Weather routing services use weather forecasts to calculate the route that gives the minimum fuel consumption or the minimum voyage time.

Tipik tasarruf: %2-5 yakıt, bazı koşulla.en: Typical savings: 2-5% of fuel, up to 10% in some conditions. Avoiding heavy weather also prevents cargo and ship damage.

Pratikte bu süreç çok yavaş gerçekleştir.en: In practice, this process must take place very slowly so that the system remains in thermal equilibrium with its surroundings at all times. In ship systems, isothermal compression is approximated in multi-stage compressors with intercooling.

Sabit basınçta gazın ısıtılması veya soğ.en: Heating or cooling a gas at constant pressure is an isobaric process. In this process, volume and temperature change together. Charles's law applies.

Sabit hacimde W = 0 olduğundan, birinci.en: At constant volume W = 0, so the first law becomes Q = ΔU. All the heat supplied to the system is converted into internal energy.

Türbin çıkışında nem oranının artması so.en: An increase in moisture content at the turbine exhaust creates a risk of erosion in the last stages; for this reason, superheating (superheat) and, where necessary, reheating (reheat) are used.

MGO (DMA sınıfı): Tamamen distile edilmi.en: MGO (DMA grade): A fully distilled fuel, clear and bright in appearance. Its viscosity is in the range 2.0–6.0 cSt at 40°C. It needs no heating and can be supplied directly to the injection system.

MDO (DMB sınıfı): Distile yakıta az mikt.en: MDO (DMB grade): Distillate fuel blended with a small amount of residual fuel. Its viscosity can be up to 11.0 cSt at 40°C. It may need slight heating.

LNG, ağırlıklı olarak metan (CH₄, %85-95.en: LNG consists mainly of methane (CH₄, 85-95%). Its boiling point is −162°C, and it is stored as a liquid at atmospheric pressure. Its volumetric energy density is about 60% of that of HFO; it therefore needs larger fuel tanks.

SOx emisyonu sıfıra yakındır; NOx emisyo.en: SOx emissions are close to zero; NOx emissions can meet Tier III without additional after-treatment (in low-pressure gas engines). PM emissions are negligible.

LNG tankından buharlaştırıcıya (vaporize.en: Gas is fed from the LNG tank to the vaporizer and then through a pressure regulator to the engine. A gas pressure of 5-8 bar is used in low-pressure systems and around 300 bar in high-pressure systems.

Güvenlik zonları IGF Code (International.en: Safety zones are defined by the IGF Code (International Code of Safety for Ships Using Gases or Other Low-flashpoint Fuels).

CCAI, yakıtın yoğunluğu ve viskozitesind.en: CCAI is a dimensionless number, calculated from the density and viscosity of the fuel, that indicates ignition quality. A low CCAI value indicates good ignition quality.

FCC ünitesinden gelen katalizör parçacık.en: Catalyst particles from the FCC unit (cat fines) are 1-20 μm in size and have a hardness of 6-7 on the Mohs scale (harder than steel). These particles cause rapid abrasive wear of fuel injector nozzles, pump plunger surfaces, cylinder liners and piston rings.

ISO 8217 standardı Al+Si toplamını maksi.en: The ISO 8217 standard limits the Al+Si total to a maximum of 60 ppm. Engine manufacturers, however, aim for below 15 ppm in the fuel entering the engine.

Separatör (purifier): En etkili yöntemdi.en: Separator (purifier): The most effective method; operating at 98°C and at a low flow rate increases the cat fines removal efficiency.

Settling: 24-48 saat bekleme ile büyük p.en: Settling: Large particles settle to the bottom over a settling time of 24-48 hours.

Filtrasyon: Son aşama olarak otomatik ge.en: Filtration: Automatic back-flushing filters (10-25 μm) are used as the final stage.

Yakıt 95-98°C'ye ısıtılarak viskozitesi.en: The fuel is heated to 95-98°C to lower its viscosity and is fed to the purifier. A low flow rate increases separation efficiency; engine manufacturers recommend operating at 60-70% of nominal capacity.

Gravity disc (dam ring), yakıt-su ayrışm.en: The gravity disc (dam ring) determines the fuel-water interface. Correct gravity disc selection according to fuel density is essential; a wrong selection causes fuel loss or inadequate water separation.

Seri düzende ilk aşamada purifier (su +.en: In the series arrangement, the purifier (water + solids separation) runs in the first stage and the clarifier (solids separation only) in the second stage. In the parallel arrangement, two purifiers run simultaneously, increasing the total capacity.

Modern ALCAP (Alfa Laval) ve EPC-50/60 (.en: Modern ALCAP (Alfa Laval) and EPC-50/60 (Mitsubishi) systems do not need a gravity disc; they operate with automatic phase detection.

İki zamanlı motorlarda geri yol operasyo.en: On two-stroke engines, astern operation is achieved by cam or electronic changeover (by software on ME engines).

Kritik mesajlarda yazılı iletişim (not d.en: For critical messages, written communication (notebook, message board) is used in support.

2. Alıcı mesajı tekrarlar: 'Yakıt transf.en: 2. The receiver repeats the message: 'Closing the fuel transfer valve.'

Manevra komutları, vana operasyonları, e.en: Maneuvering orders, valve operations, electrical switching operations, emergency procedures. Where closed-loop communication is not used, errors such as opening or closing the wrong valve can occur.

Ortak çalışma dili olarak İngilizce stan.en: Standard English terminology is used as the common working language. Junior personnel are encouraged to ask questions and to object (assertiveness). Cultural awareness training is part of the ERM program.

Dar boğaz yaklaşmasında makine dairesi,.en: During a narrow channel approach, while executing successive 'half ahead - slow ahead' orders from the bridge, the engine room received a jacket cooling water low pressure alarm at the same time. Because the duty officer was focused on the maneuver, the alarm was assessed late and starting the auxiliary pump was delayed by 90 seconds.

Aynı zaman diliminde kontrol odasında ya.en: Having only one officer in the control room during this period caused monitoring of the alarm panel to clash with the telegraph orders; because the team had no shared picture of the situation, the order of response could not be clearly established.

Önceliklendirme yapılmadan tek kişiye bi.en: The main root causes were: several critical tasks being loaded onto one person without prioritization, not using a short time-critical checklist, and skipping confirmation of bridge–engine room orders.

İkincil kök neden, vardiya öncesi 'yükse.en: A secondary root cause was that no 'high-risk maneuver briefing' was held before the watch, and no task-split plan (alarm officer - telegraph officer) had been defined for the alarm/order workload.

İnsan faktörü açısından bakıldığında, za.en: From a human factors perspective, narrowing of attention under time pressure (tunnel vision) and confirmation bias (sticking to the first assumption) reduced the quality of decisions.

30-60 saniyelik 'Stop-Think-Act-Review'.en: A 30-60 second 'Stop-Think-Act-Review' mini-procedure should be made mandatory during maneuvering; when an alarm comes in, the team should first decide in the order 'ship safety - personnel safety - equipment safety'.

Manevra vardiyasında en az iki kişi akti.en: At least two people should be kept active on the maneuvering watch: one for telegraph/order execution, the other for monitoring alarms and the continuity of auxiliary systems. This task allocation should be confirmed with a written card before the watch.

Kritik komutlarda kapalı döngü iletişim.en: Closed-loop communication (order - repeat - confirmation) should be mandatory for critical orders; CCR records should be reviewed as case studies at the weekly ERM meeting.

Yüksek riskli liman yaklaşmalarında 'pre.en: A 'pre-arrival risk trigger list' should be used for high-risk port approaches (e.g. low pressure, PMS alarm, auxiliary pump unavailable). When a trigger occurs, the automatic call-out procedure for additional personnel should be activated.

Bu vaka, zaman baskısında doğru kararın.en: This case shows that the right decision under time pressure comes from team discipline, not individual speed. Being fast is different from rushing; fast teams are those that do not skip the standard procedure.

Benzer olayların tekrarlanmaması için si.en: To prevent similar incidents from recurring, the same scenario should be run in simulator drills at different workload levels; decision accuracy should be measured as well as decision time.

Gece vardiyasında purifier diferansiyel.en: On the night watch, a purifier differential pressure alarm was regarded as 'temporary' and deferred, and the settling tank water drain check was skipped on the same watch. The next day, the fuel viscosity fell below the target range, and irregular spraying at the injectors and an imbalance in the exhaust temperature distribution were observed.

Takip eden 6 saat içinde ana makinede yü.en: Over the following 6 hours, load fluctuations occurred on the main engine, and the bridge had difficulty maintaining the required speed. Although the incident looked like a technical failure, at its root were weaknesses in watchkeeping discipline and alarm management.

Alarmın erken aşamada 'nuisance alarm' e.en: The main causes were: the alarm being normalized at an early stage by labeling it a 'nuisance alarm', watch handover notes containing no measurable data (value, trend, duration), and maintenance deferral not being linked to a risk score.

Sistem seviyesinde kök neden, 'tek alarm.en: At system level, the root cause is the 'one alarm - one action' approach. Fuel system incidents, however, involve many parameters; purifier DP, viscosity, temperature, injector back-leakage and the exhaust trend must be monitored together.

Organizasyonel açıdan, ertelenen aksiyon.en: From an organizational point of view, because deferred actions were not followed up to closure, open risks were carried over from watch to watch.

Kritik alarm ertelemesi için zabit onayı.en: Deferring a critical alarm should require officer approval + a written justification + a re-evaluation time (e.g. 15 min / 30 min). When the time expires, the alarm should automatically return to critical level.

Her vardiya sonunda 'açık risk listesi'.en: At the end of each watch, the 'open risk list' should be updated, and three items of data must be passed on at handover: the current value, the trend over the last 4 hours and the expected next action.

Purifier alarmı, yakıt viskozitesi, sıca.en: The purifier alarm, fuel viscosity, temperature and injector performance should be monitored in correlation on a single performance screen; when a threshold is exceeded, the bridge should be informed that 'there may be an effect on speed'.

Aylık ERM incelemesinde en az bir 'zinci.en: In the monthly ERM review, at least one 'chain-breaking' case should be selected, and the team should analyze which intervention at which link of the chain could have prevented the incident.

Kazayı önleyen unsur çoğu zaman büyük te.en: What prevents an accident is often not a major technical intervention but a small act of discipline: the right note, the right confirmation, escalation at the right time.

Hata zinciri yaklaşımı kurum kültürüne y.en: When the error chain approach becomes embedded in the organizational culture, teams move from the question 'who made the mistake?' to 'which barrier did not work, and why?'; this provides sustainable safety.

MLC 2006 ve STCW gereği minimum dinlenme.en: Minimum rest periods under MLC 2006 and STCW: 10 hours in any 24 hours (may be divided into two periods, one of which must be at least 6 hours) and 77 hours in any 7 days.

Yorgunluk etkileri: yavaş reaksiyon, dik.en: Effects of fatigue: slow reactions, inattention, faulty decisions, micro-sleep. Similar to the effect of alcohol: being awake for 17 hours ≈ 0.05% blood alcohol level.

İş öncesi yapılan kısa toplantıdır. İçer.en: A short meeting held before the job. Content: the job to be done, hazards, responsibilities, emergency procedure, communication arrangements. STICC model: Situation, Task, Intent, Concerns, Calibrate (questions).

İş sonrası yapılan değerlendirmedir. Ne.en: An evaluation held after the job. What went well? What went badly? What did we learn? What should change in future? Debriefing is for learning, not for blame. Participation of all team members is encouraged.

Bir kişi vana operasyonu yaparken diğeri.en: While one person operates a valve, another checks that the correct valve is being opened. In electrical switching operations, one person reads and the other operates. In maintenance work, torque and measurement values are verified by a second person.

Karşılıklı izleme, birbirini suçlama değ.en: Mutual monitoring is a culture of protecting each other, not blaming each other.

Havacılıkta 'sterile cockpit' kuralı kri.en: In aviation, the 'sterile cockpit' rule prohibits unnecessary conversation during critical operations. Similarly, focus must be maintained in the engine room during maneuvering.

Savunmaya geçme, dinle ve anla. Açıklama.en: Do not become defensive; listen and understand. Ask for clarification. Say thank you. Draw up a development plan.

Konteyner gemisinde yüksek basınçlı yakı.en: On a container ship, fuel leaking from a high-pressure fuel pipe came into contact with the turbocharger casing (500°C) and ignited. The fire spread rapidly, and the CO₂ system was released.

Kök neden: Yakıt boru bağlantı noktasını.en: Root cause: Insufficient tightening torque at the fuel pipe connection and inadequate periodic checks.

Alınan ders: Yakıt boru bağlantıları per.en: Lesson learned: Periodic tightness checks of fuel pipe connections, insulation of hot surfaces, leak detection.

Süpürme bölgesinde biriken yağlama yağı.en: Lubricating oil and carbon residues accumulated in the scavenge space ignited as the temperature rose. Fire broke out in the scavenge drain and manifold areas.

Kök neden: Silindir yağlama dozajının ay.en: Root cause: Incorrectly adjusted cylinder lubrication feed rate and neglected cleaning of the scavenge drains.

Alınan ders: Scavenge drain düzenli temi.en: Lesson learned: The scavenge drains should be cleaned regularly, the cylinder oil feed rate optimized and the exhaust temperature trend monitored.

Prosedür: Acil jeneratör → neden tespiti.en: Procedure: Emergency generator → identify the cause → start a generator → take on critical loads in sequence → start the main engine.

Liman ayrılışında köprüüstü 'stand by en.en: On departure from port, the bridge gave the 'stand by engine' order, and the engine room interpreted it as preparation for going to 'dead slow ahead'. Because the order was not repeated back, the shaft revolutions rose earlier than expected and a risk arose during the mooring operation.

Olayda ekipman arızası yoktur; hata tama.en: There was no equipment failure in this incident; the error arose entirely from a communication breakdown concerning the meaning, timing and confirmation of the order.

Standart denizcilik terminolojisi yerine.en: The main root cause was the use of local/habitual expressions instead of standard maritime terminology, skipping the read-back/confirmation loop, and not agreeing a common order vocabulary before the maneuver.

İkincil olarak, yoğun operasyon anında i.en: Secondly, unnecessary traffic on the communication channel (non-essential talk) during intensive operations made critical orders harder to understand.

Manevra evresinde yalnızca standard mari.en: During the maneuvering phase, only standard marine communication phrases should be used; no order should be executed until the 'order - repeat - confirmation' loop has been completed.

Manevra öncesi 5 dakikalık ortak brifing.en: At a 5-minute joint briefing before the maneuver, the critical order set, the expected sequence and possible countermanding orders should be clarified.

Devir teslimlerde 'kritik beklenen komut.en: A list of 'critical expected orders' should be mandatory at handovers; a test call on the bridge–engine room voice line should be an item on the pre-maneuver checklist.

İletişim kalitesi aylık olarak near-miss.en: Communication quality should be measured monthly from near-miss records; targeted training should be given for recurring ambiguous order patterns.

İletişim kopukluğu çoğu zaman rapora 'ya.en: A communication breakdown is often entered in the report as a 'misunderstanding'; however, the root cause is always systemic: language standards, confirmation discipline and briefing quality.

İyi iletişim kültürü yalnızca kaza önlem.en: A good communication culture not only prevents accidents; it also increases operational efficiency, because the team sees the same situation at the same time and fewer corrective maneuvers are needed.
