5. Filoya yayma: Benzer gemilerde aynı r.en: 5. Fleet-wide dissemination: Preventing the same risk on similar ships.

6. Takip ve doğrulama: Aksiyonların uygu.en: 6. Follow-up and verification: Check that the actions have been implemented.

EEDI, ana ve yardımcı makine kaynaklı CO.en: EEDI is based on the principle of relating the CO₂ emission contributions of the main and auxiliary engines to the ship's reference transport work (capacity × reference speed). Engine SFOC, the carbon factor of the fuel type, the shaft generator/auxiliary load balance and efficiency technologies together affect the result.

Temel uygunluk yaklaşımı: Attained EEDI.en: Basic compliance approach: Attained EEDI ≤ Required EEDI. The Required EEDI value is determined by ship type and the IMO phase reduction factor; the design difference between two ships of the same class is directly visible in this inequality.

EEDI doğrudan günlük bir operasyon KPI'ı.en: EEDI is not directly a daily operational KPI; however, design decisions such as hull form, propeller selection, WHRS, air lubrication or an energy saving device set the baseline of daily bunker consumption.

Operasyonda yüksek sea margin (hedef hız.en: In operation, a high sea margin (increased power needed for the target speed) indicates a deviation from the design assumptions. This deviation usually results from fouling, propeller damage, incorrect trim or loss of machinery efficiency, and it makes the practical effect of EEDI visible.

Sea trial hız-güç eğrisi, gemi yaşam dön.en: The sea trial speed-power curve should be kept as a performance benchmark throughout the ship's life cycle. Without this reference, the cause of CII deterioration (design, operation or maintenance) cannot be correctly identified.

Baş mühendis ve kaptan, en az aylık peri.en: The Chief Engineer and the Master should compare speed-power performance with the sea trial baseline at least monthly and define deviation thresholds in the SMS.

Yeni retrofit kararlarında (pre-swirl, p.en: In new retrofit decisions (pre-swirl duct, propeller boss cap fins, etc.), EEDI/EEXI/CII should be evaluated together, not only the return on investment.

EEXI hesabında geminin MCR değeri, olası.en: The EEXI calculation uses the ship's MCR value, any EPL/ShaPoLi settings, the engine SFOC parameters and the reference transport capacity. Compliance is most often achieved by power limitation.

Attained EEXI ≤ Required EEXI kriteri sa.en: Even if the criterion Attained EEXI ≤ Required EEXI is met, compliance on paper may be fragile in practice if no operational risk analysis is carried out. Power reserve planning becomes critical, particularly in heavy weather, strong currents and safety maneuvers.

Doğrulama süreci IAPP/IEEC sertifikasyon.en: The verification process depends on IAPP/IEEC certification; however, sustainable compliance requires clearly defined operating procedures (override conditions, record-keeping discipline).

EPL uygulanan bir gemide hız/ETA planlam.en: On a ship with EPL applied, speed/ETA planning cannot be based on the old power assumptions. The Master and the Chief Engineer should model the risk of falling below safe speed in heavy weather windows at the route planning stage.

Makine tarafında turboşarj verimi, enjek.en: On the machinery side, turbocharger efficiency, injector balance, air cooler cleanliness and hull-propeller condition become more critical at limited power; even a small loss of efficiency can turn into a schedule deviation.

Acil durum override yetkisi, kriterleri.en: The emergency override authority, its criteria and the recording method should be defined in advance. Otherwise, a compliance dispute may arise after the power has been increased for safety.

EEXI uyumu tek başına teknik bir onay de.en: EEXI compliance is not just a technical approval in itself; it is also the establishment of a culture of 'safe operation at lower power'.

EPL ile uyumlu gemilerde operasyon başar.en: On ships complying through EPL, operational success is the sum of technical maintenance quality and bridge planning discipline.

CII hesaplaması yıllık toplam CO₂ emisyo.en: The CII calculation is based on the ratio of annual total CO₂ emissions to transport work. Therefore, not only fuel consumption but also the voyage profile, the cargo carried, the ballast ratio, waiting times and route quality affect the result.

Pratikte en sağlıklı yaklaşım aylık proj.en: In practice, the soundest approach is monthly tracking of the projected CII. Instead of waiting for the end of the year, the trio 'actual - target - year-end projection' should be monitored every month and action taken before the deviation grows.

Noon report, flowmeter, bunker delivery.en: If the noon reports, flowmeters, bunker delivery notes and port operation data do not match, CII management becomes misleading. For this reason, data quality should be tracked as a separate performance metric.

CII iyileştirmesi için hız optimizasyonu.en: For CII improvement, speed optimization, trim management, weather routing, reduction of port waiting time, hull-propeller cleaning and auxiliary engine load optimization should be considered together. A 'reduce speed' approach on its own may not be sustainable because of its commercial and safety implications.

Sefer bazlı karar seti oluşturulmalıdır:.en: A voyage-based decision set should be established: economical speed if there is ETA flexibility, route revision if the weather is worsening, just-in-time arrival in port congestion, trim and auxiliary load optimization on ballast passages.

Makine dairesi yakıt kayıtları ile köprü.en: A daily reconciliation should be made between the engine room fuel records and the bridge navigation data; discrepancies should be corrected before they are reflected in the DCS/MRV report. This discipline increases the reliability of the CII rating.

CII yönetimi, tek departman işi değildir.en: CII management is not the job of a single department; it is a joint control loop of the bridge, the engine room, operations planning and the company office.

Aylık projeksiyon, yıl sonu sürprizlerin.en: Monthly projection is the most powerful tool for avoiding year-end surprises. Delayed actions may not be recoverable within the same year.

CII = (Yıllık toplam CO₂ emisyonu) / (Ka.en: CII = (Annual total CO₂ emissions) / (Capacity × Total distance traveled)

Yakıt tüketimi gemi hızının yaklaşık küp.en: Fuel consumption is approximately proportional to the cube of ship speed (P ∝ V³). Because of this relationship, reducing speed by 10% reduces fuel consumption by approximately 27%.

Rota optimizasyonu minimum yakıt tüketim.en: Route optimization is carried out for one or more of the following objectives: minimum fuel consumption, minimum passage time or maximum safety.

Rüzgâr, dalga, akıntı ve görüş koşulları.en: Wind, wave, current and visibility conditions are considered. In large waves, added resistance can increase fuel consumption by 10-30%.

Profesyonel weather routing şirketleri,.en: Professional weather routing companies recommend the optimum route using a ship performance model and meteorological forecast data. Coastal safety, traffic separation schemes and emission control areas are also considered.

Hafif slime tabakası bile sürtünme diren.en: Even a light slime layer can increase frictional resistance by 7-10%. Moderate fouling causes a 20-30% increase in resistance, and heavy fouling 40-50%.

Fouling aynı zamanda gemi hızını düşürür.en: Fouling also reduces ship speed and propeller efficiency.

Egzoz gazı ekonomizeri: Egzoz gazı ısısı.en: Exhaust gas economizer: Generates steam from exhaust gas heat. Steam turbine: Drives an electrical generator with the steam produced. Power turbine: The exhaust gas drives the turbine directly (turbocompound).

Kombine sistem (ST + PT) toplam motorun.en: A combined system (ST + PT) can recover 8-11% of the engine's total fuel energy.

Gövde altına yerleştirilen hava dağıtıcı.en: Low-pressure air is supplied from air distributors fitted on the hull bottom. The resulting micro-bubble layer forms a low-friction interface between the hull and the water.

Tipik olarak %5-10 sürtünme direnci azal.en: Typically gives a 5-10% reduction in frictional resistance. Most effective on flat-bottomed ships (tankers, bulk carriers).

Kompresör kapasitesi, hava dağıtım borul.en: Compressor capacity, air distribution piping, the control system and energy consumption must be considered. The compressor energy consumption must be deducted from the net savings.

Dikey dönen silindirik yapıdır. Magnus e.en: A vertical rotating cylindrical structure. It produces thrust from the wind by the Magnus effect. The motor-driven rotor produces a force perpendicular to the wind direction.

Tipik olarak %5-20 yakıt tasarrufu sağla.en: Typically gives 5-20% fuel savings (depending on route and wind conditions). Norsepower and Anemoi are the main manufacturers.

Wing sail: Uçak kanadı profilinde rijit.en: Wing sail: A rigid sail with an aircraft wing profile. Optimal thrust is obtained by automatic angle adjustment.

Kite: Geminin pruvasından uçurulan büyük.en: Kite: A large kite flown from the ship's bow. It catches the strong winds at high altitude. A commercial application by Airseas (Seawing) exists.

Veriler bayrak devletine sunulur ve IMO.en: The data are submitted to the flag State and published in anonymized form in the IMO GISIS database.

1. SEEMP Part II'de veri toplama yöntemi.en: 1. The data collection methodology is defined in SEEMP Part II.

2. Yıl boyunca yakıt tüketimi ve seyir v.en: 2. Fuel consumption and voyage data are collected throughout the year.

3. Yıl sonunda rapor bayrak devletine su.en: 3. At the end of the year, the report is submitted to the flag State.

4. Doğrulama sonrası SoC (Statement of C.en: 4. After verification, an SoC (Statement of Compliance) is issued.

AB limanları arasındaki seferlerde ve AB.en: Emissions are reported for voyages between EU ports and for the EU port share (50%) of voyages arriving at or departing from an EU port.

IMO DCS'den farklı olarak AB limanlı sef.en: Unlike the IMO DCS, it requires detailed reporting on a per-voyage basis for voyages involving EU ports.

5000 GT üzeri gemiler, AB limanları aras.en: Ships above 5000 GT must purchase emission allowances for 100% of voyages between EU ports and 50% of voyages between an EU port and a non-EU port.

Kademeli geçiş: 2024'te %40, 2025'te %70.en: Phased introduction: payment covering 40% of emissions in 2024, 70% in 2025 and 100% in 2026.

BDN doğrulaması: Bunker Delivery Note mi.en: BDN verification: The Bunker Delivery Note quantities are compared with the tank measurements.

Flowmetre kalibrasyonu: Periyodik kalibr.en: Flowmeter calibration: Periodic calibration certificates are checked.

Cross-check: SFOC × güç × süre hesabı il.en: Cross-check: The SFOC × power × time calculation is compared with the measured consumption.

Bayrak devleti veya akredite doğrulayıcı.en: The flag State or an accredited verifier audits the DCS and MRV reports. Non-compliance: in the case of missing data, inconsistent figures or missing documents, the ship cannot obtain an SoC.

Senkron jeneratörde rotor, DC uyarma akı.en: In a synchronous generator, the rotor produces a magnetic field from the DC excitation current. When the rotor turns, this magnetic field cuts the stator windings and an EMF (electromotive force) is induced in accordance with Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction.

Çıkış frekansı, rotorun devir hızı ve ku.en: The output frequency depends on the rotor speed and the number of poles.

Stator sargısında indüklenen EMK etkin (.en: The effective (RMS) value of the EMF induced in the stator winding depends on the winding factor, the frequency, the magnetic flux and the number of turns.

Jeneratör verimi çıkış gücünün giriş güc.en: Generator efficiency is the ratio of output power to input power. The losses consist of copper losses, core losses, mechanical losses and windage losses.

AVR, jeneratör çıkış gerilimini sürekli.en: The AVR continuously measures the generator output voltage and compares it with the reference value. When a deviation is detected, it corrects the voltage by increasing or decreasing the rotor excitation current.

Yük artışında gerilim düşme eğilimi göst.en: When the load increases, the voltage tends to fall; the AVR increases the excitation current to bring the voltage back to the nominal value. When the load decreases, the excitation is reduced.

Elektrik yükü artığında jeneratöre binen.en: When the electrical load increases, the torque on the generator increases and the prime mover tends to slow down. The governor responds by increasing the fuel quantity and restores the speed.

İzole çalışan bir jeneratörde governör i.en: On a generator running in isolation, the governor operates in isochronous mode and keeps the frequency constant. In parallel operation, droop mode is used.

Bir jeneratörü baraya paralel bağlamak i.en: To connect a generator in parallel to the busbar, four conditions must be met:

Senkroskop, gelen jeneratör ile baranın.en: The synchroscope is an instrument that shows the voltage phase difference between the incoming generator and the busbar. If the pointer rotates slowly clockwise, the incoming generator is slightly faster than the busbar (fast). The breaker is closed as the pointer approaches the 12 o'clock position.

Otomatik senkronizer, gerilim, frekans v.en: The automatic synchronizer automatically checks the voltage, frequency and phase angle conditions and closes the breaker at the right moment.

Jeneratör kapasitesinin aşılması durumun.en: If generator capacity is exceeded, non-critical consumers are disconnected in stages. Order of priority: air conditioning compressors → deck cranes → provision refrigeration → galley equipment. SOLAS-mandatory consumers such as navigation lights, steering gear and bilge pumps are never disconnected.

Shore power bağlantısı için gemi gerilim.en: For a shore power connection, the ship's voltage and frequency must be compatible with the shore grid. Different countries have 50 Hz or 60 Hz grids at different voltage levels. A transformer and a frequency converter are used where necessary.

IEC/ISO/IEEE 80005-1 standardı yüksek ge.en: The IEC/ISO/IEEE 80005-1 standard defines the requirements for high-voltage shore connection (HVSC).

Shore power kullanımı limandaki egzoz em.en: Using shore power reduces exhaust emissions in port (SOx, NOx, PM) to zero. Under the EU Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR), the use of shore power will be mandatory for certain ports and ships from 2030.

MSB; jeneratör panelleri, bara sistemi,.en: The MSB consists of generator panels, the busbar system, distribution panels, measuring instruments, protection relays and control circuits. The main busbar is usually made of copper or aluminum conductors, and the generators and load circuit breakers are connected to this busbar.

ESB, makine dairesinin üzerinde, en üst.en: The ESB is located above the engine room, on the uppermost continuous deck or on the navigation deck.

Gemi kabloları IEC 60092 serisine göre ü.en: Ship's cables are manufactured to the IEC 60092 series. Flame retardance (IEC 60332), low smoke emission (IEC 61034) and halogen-free construction (IEC 60754) are the basic requirements.

Yaygın kablo tipleri: XLPE izoleli, EPR.en: Common cable types: XLPE-insulated, EPR-insulated and silicone-insulated cables. Each has different temperature resistance and flexibility characteristics.

Kablo kesiti belirlenirken akım taşıma k.en: When determining the cable cross-section, the current-carrying capacity, voltage drop and short-circuit withstand are considered.

IT sistemde jeneratör nötr noktası gemi.en: In an IT system, the generator neutral point is not connected directly to the ship's hull (earth). Thus, a single phase-to-earth fault does not complete the circuit, and the system continues to operate. However, if a second fault occurs, a two-phase short circuit results.

Bu nedenle ilk toprak kaçağı anında alar.en: For this reason, an alarm is given as soon as the first earth fault occurs, and the source of the fault must be found and eliminated.

Sürekli insülasyon izleme cihazı (IMD) t.en: The continuous insulation monitoring device (IMD) measures the insulation resistance to earth of all phases. It gives an alarm when the value falls below a set threshold (typically below 100 kΩ/V). The faulty phase is identified with a megger.

Megger (insülasyon tester), ölçülen devr.en: The Megger (insulation tester) applies a DC voltage to the circuit under test and measures the leakage current between the conductor and earth. The insulation resistance is calculated from the measured current.

Ölçüm gerilimi devre nominal gerilimine.en: The test voltage is selected according to the nominal voltage of the circuit: a 500V DC test voltage is applied for 440V circuits and 5000V DC for 6.6kV circuits.

Toplam güç talebi yaklaşık 4 MW'a kadar.en: On ships with a total power demand of up to about 4 MW, a 440V, 60 Hz (or 380V, 50 Hz) distribution system is used. In this system the cables are thicker, but the switchgear and protection devices are simpler and more economical.

Büyük konteyner gemileri, LNG taşıyıcıla.en: On ships with high power requirements, such as large container ships, LNG carriers, cruise ships and FPSOs, a 6.6kV or 11kV distribution system is used. High voltage means a lower current for the same power and therefore thinner cables.

Aşırı akım koruma iki ana bileşenden olu.en: Overcurrent protection consists of two main components: thermal protection (prolonged overload) and magnetic protection (instantaneous short circuit). The thermal element works on the I²t principle; the higher the current, the shorter the tripping time. The magnetic element opens the circuit within milliseconds at short-circuit current (6-12 × In).

Arıza noktasına en yakın devre kesicinin.en: The circuit breaker nearest the fault must open first. This is achieved by the upstream breaker opening later (time selectivity) or responding at a higher current (current selectivity). Poor coordination causes the whole system to be de-energized unnecessarily.

Kısa devre akımı, jeneratör subtransient.en: The short-circuit current is determined by the generator subtransient reactance and the system impedance.

Ters güç durumu, tahrik motorunun (dizel.en: A reverse power condition occurs when the prime mover (diesel engine) cannot produce power because of a fuel cut-off, governor failure or mechanical failure. The generator then runs as a motor, drawing active power from the busbar and starting to drive the prime mover.

Ters güç durumu tahrik motoruna mekanik.en: A reverse power condition can cause mechanical damage to the prime mover and overload the other generators.

Jeneratör yükü belirli bir eşiği (tipik.en: When the generator load exceeds a set threshold (typically 90-110%), the PMS starts the preferential trip sequence. The lowest-priority consumers are disconnected first; if the load is still high, the next stage operates.

Tercihli açma sırası gemi elektrik proje.en: The preferential trip sequence is defined in the ship's electrical design and never disconnects SOLAS-mandatory consumers.

IT sistemde tek faz toprak kaçağında dev.en: In an IT system, with a single phase-to-earth fault no current flows because the circuit is not completed, and the system continues to operate. The insulation monitoring device (IMD) detects the falling insulation resistance and gives an alarm. If a fault occurs on a second phase, a phase-to-phase short circuit results.

TN sistemde toprak kaçağında devre tamam.en: In a TN system, an earth fault completes the circuit and a high current flows. The RCCB (residual current circuit breaker) detects the earth fault current and opens the circuit. 30 mA RCCBs are commonly used on 220V socket circuits on ships.

Stator sargılarına uygulanan üç fazlı ge.en: The three-phase voltage applied to the stator windings creates a rotating magnetic field. This field induces current in the rotor conductors, and the resulting force turns the rotor. The rotor always turns slower than the rotating field; this difference is called slip.

Motor ilk olarak yıldız bağlantıyla çalı.en: The motor is first started in star connection; the voltage across the windings is reduced by a factor of 1/√3 and the current falls to 1/3. When the motor has accelerated, it is switched to delta connection. A brief current peak may occur at the changeover.

Y-Δ yol verme yalnızca düşük yükle başla.en: Y-Δ starting is suitable only for motors started at low load; at high load, the starting torque is insufficient.

Frekans dönüştürücü, motorun gerilim ve.en: The frequency converter controls the motor voltage and frequency, giving smooth, low-current acceleration from zero to nominal speed. It offers the advantages of energy saving, precise speed control and soft starting.

DC motor hızı üç yöntemle kontrol edilir.en: DC motor speed is controlled by three methods: varying the armature voltage (speed reduction), varying the field current (speed increase) and adding series resistance (an inefficient method).

Modern uygulamalarda thyristor doğrultuc.en: In modern applications, precise DC motor control is achieved with thyristor rectifiers or chopper circuits.

VFD üç ana bölümden oluşur: doğrultucu (.en: The VFD consists of three main sections: the rectifier (AC→DC), the DC intermediate circuit (filter) and the inverter (DC→AC). The inverter section uses IGBT switches to produce an AC output at the required frequency and amplitude.

Motor hızı çıkış frekansına doğrudan bağ.en: Motor speed is directly related to the output frequency (n = 120f/P). Keeping the V/f ratio constant gives constant torque over the whole speed range.

VFD'ler şebekeye harmonik akımlar üretir.en: VFDs generate harmonic currents in the supply network. The 5th, 7th, 11th and 13th harmonics are the most common. Harmonics can cause overheating in transformers, nuisance tripping of circuit breakers and interference in sensitive equipment.

Harmonik filtreleme için pasif filtre, a.en: Passive filters, active filters or multi-pulse rectifiers (12-pulse, 18-pulse) are used for harmonic filtering.

Seyir fenerleri SOLAS zorunlu tüketicile.en: Navigation lights are SOLAS-mandatory consumers and must never lose power. They are supplied from the emergency switchboard (ESB). The navigation light panel shows the status of each light and gives an audible/visual alarm in the event of a failure.

Modern gemilerde LED seyir fenerleri kul.en: Modern ships use LED navigation lights. LED lights have a service life of 50,000+ hours and low power consumption.

SOLAS Bölüm II-1 Kural 42 gereği acil ay.en: Under SOLAS Chapter II-1 Regulation 42, emergency lighting must come on automatically after loss of main power. A continuous operating period of 36 hours is required on passenger ships and 18 hours on cargo ships.

Acil aydınlatma ESB üzerinden acil jener.en: Emergency lighting is supplied via the ESB from the emergency generator or batteries.

IMO MSC.Res.A.752 standardına göre, yolc.en: According to the IMO MSC.Res.A.752 standard, passenger ships must have photoluminescent or electrically powered low-location lighting strips along escape routes at a height of 30 cm above the deck. These strips indicate the escape direction in smoke-filled corridors.

Akü şarj cihazları, sabit gerilim (CV),.en: Battery chargers operate in constant voltage (CV), constant current (CC) or combined CC-CV mode. Marine batteries usually have an IU (CC-CV) charging profile: they are first charged at constant current up to 80%, then at constant voltage with decreasing current until fully charged.

Eşitleme şarjı (equalizing charge), tüm.en: An equalizing charge is a controlled overcharge applied periodically to bring all cells to the same voltage.

Ex-proof ekipman bakımı yalnızca yetkili.en: Maintenance of Ex-proof equipment must be carried out only by authorized personnel. All screws, gaskets and cable entries on the equipment must be kept in their original condition. Damaged Ex-proof equipment must be taken out of service immediately.

Termokuple, iki farklı metalin birleşim.en: A thermocouple is a sensor based on the Seebeck effect, producing an EMF that depends on the temperature difference at the junction of two dissimilar metals. The temperature difference between the measuring point (hot junction) and the reference point (cold junction) determines the EMF.

RTD, metalin elektrik direncinin sıcaklı.en: An RTD works on the principle that the electrical resistance of a metal changes in proportion to temperature. Pt100 (100 Ω resistance at 0°C) is the most common type. RTDs are more accurate, repeatable and linear than thermocouples, but their response time is slower.

Bourdon tüpü, basınç uygulandığında açıl.en: The Bourdon tube is a C-shaped or helical metal tube that tends to straighten when pressure is applied. The end of the tube moves the pointer through a gear mechanism. It is mechanical, reliable and inexpensive; it is the most common pressure gauge in a ship's engine room.

C-tipi Bourdon: 0-60 bar arası, Heliks B.en: C-type Bourdon: 0-60 bar; helical Bourdon: 60-1000 bar; spiral Bourdon: low-pressure applications.

Piezoelektrik kristal (kuvartz), basınç.en: A piezoelectric crystal (quartz) sensor produces an electric charge when pressure is applied. Because of its very fast response, it is used for cylinder pressure measurement (indicator diagrams) and dynamic pressure measurements.

Yanıt süresi mikrosaniye mertebesindedir.en: Its response time is of the order of microseconds; it is not suitable for static pressure measurement (charge leakage).

Modern gemilerde tüm tank seviyeleri mer.en: On modern ships, all tank levels are transmitted to the central alarm and monitoring system (AMS). Level transmitters communicate via 4-20 mA or digital signals (HART, Modbus).

Yüksek seviye alarmı (high level alarm).en: The high level alarm and the high-high level alarm prevent overflow. The low level alarm prevents the pump from running dry.

Manuel sounding, seviye transmitter arız.en: Manual sounding is carried out when a level transmitter fails or for verification. A sounding pipe and a sounding tape are used. The measurement is taken as ullage (empty space) or innage (filled depth).

Coriolis debimetresi, titreşen tüplerden.en: A Coriolis flowmeter works on the principle that fluid passing through vibrating tubes creates a Coriolis force. It measures mass flow and density directly; no volumetric conversion is needed.

Yakıt tüketimi izlemede (bunker yönetimi.en: It is the most accurate method for monitoring fuel consumption (bunker management). It provides measurement compliant with IMO DCS and EU MRV.

4-20 mA akım döngüsünde ölçüm aralığının.en: In a 4-20 mA current loop, the lower limit of the measuring range is represented by 4 mA and the upper limit by 20 mA. Using 4 mA rather than zero as the lower limit makes it possible to distinguish a broken cable (0 mA) from the minimum measured value.

Akım sinyali, gerilim sinyaline göre kab.en: A current signal is less affected by cable length and noise than a voltage signal.

Açık döngü sistemde çıkış değeri ölçülme.en: In an open-loop system, the output value is not measured and there is no feedback. The control action follows a fixed or predetermined program. Example: a ventilation fan operated by a timer. It cannot adapt to external factors (load changes, ambient temperature).

Kapalı döngü sistemde çıkış değeri sürek.en: In a closed-loop system, the output value is measured continuously and compared with the reference value (set point). The deviation (error signal) is fed to the controller, and the controller applies corrective action.

Makine dairesinde soğutma suyu sıcaklık.en: Cooling water temperature control in the engine room is a typical closed-loop example: the temperature sensor measures → the controller compares → the thermostatic valve is adjusted.

P (Orantısal): Hatanın büyüklüğüyle oran.en: P (Proportional): Produces an output proportional to the size of the error. Responds quickly, but leaves a steady-state error (offset).

I (İntegral): Hatanın zamanla toplamını.en: I (Integral): Calculates the accumulated error over time and eliminates the steady-state error. However, it can cause excessive overshoot.

D (Türev): Hatanın değişim hızını ölçer.en: D (Derivative): Measures the rate of change of the error and reduces overshoot. It is sensitive to noise.

Orantısal Kazanç (Kp): Düşük Kp → yavaş.en: Proportional gain (Kp): Low Kp → slow response, large offset. High Kp → fast response, oscillation. Very high Kp → unstable system.

İntegral Zaman (Ti): Büyük Ti → yavaş of.en: Integral time (Ti): Large Ti → slow offset removal. Small Ti → fast offset removal, possible overshoot and oscillation. Very small Ti → integral saturation (windup).

Türev Zaman (Td): Td = 0 → türev etkisi.en: Derivative time (Td): Td = 0 → no derivative action. Increasing Td → less overshoot, but noise is amplified. Very large Td → oscillation caused by noise.

2. Kp'yi sürekli salınım oluşana kadar a.en: 2. Increase Kp until sustained oscillation occurs → this value is Ku (ultimate gain).

2. Kp'yi yavaşça artır; sistem kabul edi.en: 2. Increase Kp slowly until the system responds at an acceptable speed.

3. Ki'yi ekle; offset giderilene kadar a.en: 3. Add Ki; increase it until the offset is removed.

6. Tatmin edici performans elde edilene.en: 6. Fine-tune until satisfactory performance is obtained.

Modern PLC ve kontrolörler oto-tuning fo.en: Modern PLCs and controllers have an auto-tuning function. The system automatically performs a relay feedback test to determine the process dynamics and calculates the PID parameters. However, auto-tuning does not always give optimal results; manual fine-tuning is needed on critical loops.

Kaskad kontrolde iki iç içe döngü bulunu.en: Cascade control has two nested loops: the outer (master/primary) loop controls the main process variable; the inner (slave/secondary) loop controls a faster-changing intermediate variable.

Örnek: Kazan buhar sıcaklığı kontrolü. D.en: Example: Boiler steam temperature control. Outer loop: steam temperature → inner loop: fuel flow. A disturbance in fuel pressure is quickly corrected by the inner loop without affecting the outer loop.

İleri beslemede bozucu etki ölçülür ve e.en: In feedforward control, the disturbance is measured and corrective action is applied before it takes effect. When used together with feedback (feedforward + feedback), both fast disturbance rejection and offset removal are achieved.

Örnek: Kazan su seviye kontrolü. Buhar d.en: Example: Boiler water level control. The steam flow is measured (disturbance) and the feed water flow is adjusted accordingly; the level controller makes the fine adjustment (three-element control).

PLC programını sürekli tekrarlayan bir d.en: The PLC runs its program in a continuously repeating loop: 1) Read all inputs → 2) Execute the program → 3) Update all outputs → 4) Communication and housekeeping. Typical scan time is between 1-50 ms.

Pompa start/stop kontrolü: START butonu.en: Pump start/stop control: When the START button (NO) is pressed, the pump contactor is energized. When the STOP button (NC) is pressed, the circuit is broken. The seal-in (holding) contact is the pump contactor's own contact and keeps the circuit made after START is released.

Overload rölesi NC kontağı seri bağlanır.en: The NC contact of the overload relay is connected in series; it breaks the circuit on overload.

UMS sınıflandırması, makine dairesinin g.en: UMS classification requires the AMS to meet certain requirements so that the engine room can be left unmanned during the night watch. Alarms must be relayed to the bridge and the engineers' cabins, a dead-man alarm system must be fitted and all critical parameters must be monitored.

DCS, yerel kontrol istasyonları (I/O kab.en: The DCS consists of local control stations (I/O cabinets), central operator stations (HMI), an engineering station and a redundant communication network. Each local station carries out control in its own area independently; the central system provides monitoring and higher-level coordination.

Modern IAS sistemleri Ethernet tabanlı y.en: Modern IAS systems use an Ethernet-based redundant ring or star topology. At field level, sensors/actuators communicate via Modbus, Profibus or CANbus, while at control level data are shared between controllers via Ethernet/IP.

Operatör seviyesinde (HMI level) grafik.en: At operator level (HMI level), graphic displays, trend displays and alarm management are provided.

IMO MSC.428(98) kararı uyarınca gemi sib.en: Under IMO Resolution MSC.428(98), ship cyber security must be addressed within the scope of the ISM Code. Remote access must be protected by authorization, firewalls and network segmentation.

Diyot, yalnızca bir yönde akım geçiren i.en: A diode is a two-terminal semiconductor device that conducts current in one direction only. It consists of a P-N junction. It conducts when forward-biased (anode +, cathode −) and blocks in the reverse direction.

Güç diyotları doğrultucu devrelerde AC'y.en: Power diodes are used in rectifier circuits to convert AC to DC. In the brushless generator excitation system, the rotating diode assembly is mounted on the rotor.

SCR (Silicon Controlled Rectifier), gate.en: The SCR (Silicon Controlled Rectifier) is a three-terminal semiconductor device that is turned on by a gate trigger signal and conducts until the current falls to zero. The DC output voltage can be adjusted by controlling the gate firing angle.

Gemi uygulamaları: Jeneratör statik uyar.en: Ship applications: Generator static excitation system, DC motor speed control, controlled rectifier circuits.

Üç fazlı tam dalga köprü doğrultucu, gem.en: The three-phase full-wave bridge rectifier is the most widely used type in ship power electronics. It uses 6 diodes or SCRs. It produces 6 pulses per period and gives a low-ripple DC output.

İnvertör, IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar T.en: The inverter produces an AC output from the DC link voltage by the PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) technique, using IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor) switches. The RMS value and the frequency of the output voltage are controlled by varying the pulse widths.

V/f kontrolünde gerilim-frekans oranı sa.en: In V/f control, the voltage-to-frequency ratio is kept constant, giving constant flux (and therefore constant torque) over the whole speed range.

Anahtarlama frekansı (carrier frequency).en: The switching frequency (carrier frequency) is typically between 2-16 kHz. A higher switching frequency gives lower motor noise but higher switching losses.

Vektör kontrol (FOC) ve Direct Torque Co.en: Advanced algorithms such as vector control (FOC) and Direct Torque Control (DTC) give more precise speed and torque control.

Soft starter, her fazda ters paralel bağ.en: The soft starter uses two thyristors connected in inverse parallel (anti-parallel SCRs) in each phase. During starting, the firing angle of the SCRs is gradually reduced, raising the voltage applied to the motor from a low value to the nominal value.

Ramp süresi (tipik olarak 5-30 saniye) a.en: The ramp time (typically 5-30 seconds) is adjustable. The starting voltage is selected between 30-70%.

6 darbeli doğrultucu 5., 7., 11., 13. ha.en: A 6-pulse rectifier produces the 5th, 7th, 11th and 13th harmonics (rule h = 6n ± 1). VFDs, UPSs, SCR-controlled rectifiers and even saturated transformers are sources of harmonics.

Forward, midship ve aft draft'lar her ik.en: The forward, midship and aft drafts are read on both sides (6 readings); if there is a sea running, the wave effect is eliminated by averaging. The hog/sag correction (quarter mean / mean of means) is applied.

Kapaklar hidrolik/wire ile maker prosedü.en: The covers are opened/closed hydraulically or by wire according to the maker's procedure; the cleats, the seals (rubber packing) and the drainage are checked. On closing, all cleats are secured.

Sertifikalı ladder, manrope, life-buoy v.en: It is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, a lifebuoy and lighting; if required, a combination ladder is arranged at the correct angle. The rigging is verified with a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.

Yanlış kurulum ölümcüldür; her bileşen t.en: Incorrect rigging is lethal; each component is checked one by one.

Tug sayısı/pozisyon, yaklaşma açısı ve m.en: The number/position of tugs, the approach angle and the mooring sequence are planned; snap-back zones are managed. The bell book is kept.

Derinlik, dip cinsi ve trafiğe göre yer.en: The anchorage position is selected according to depth, nature of the bottom and traffic; the scope is typically planned as 5-7× the depth. Brought-up is verified; dragging is monitored by the anchor watch.

Uzun beklemelerde hava değişiminde sürük.en: During long waiting periods, the risk of dragging increases when the weather changes; monitoring is not relaxed.

Line tipleri sırayla verilir; halat kond.en: The lines are sent out by type in sequence; line condition/SWL and tension balance are checked. No one stands in snap-back zones.

Kopan halat snap-back yapar; eğitim ve f.en: A parting line snaps back; training and awareness prevent fatal accidents.

Sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA ve seyir e.en: Certificates must be valid; LSA/FFA and navigation equipment must be operational. Findings from previous PSC inspections/internal audits are closed out and evidenced. Bulk-specific areas (hatch covers, holds) receive particular attention.

Detention gemiyi durdurur; hazırlık titi.en: Detention stops the ship; preparation must be thorough and evidence-based.

Hasar fotoğraflanır, konum/zaman kaydedi.en: The damage is photographed, the location/time are recorded and an LoP is issued. The condition is documented by clausing the mate's receipt; the source of wetting (rain, hatch leakage, sweat) is identified.

Cargo sweat/ship sweat kaynaklı ıslanmad.en: In wetting caused by cargo sweat/ship sweat, the ventilation records are important for the defense.

Kâğıt haritalar standart yöntemle tashih.en: Paper charts are corrected by the standard method; ENC updates are applied in ECDIS. T&P notices are followed and a correction log is kept.

Tüm seyir/operasyon olayları, tatbikatla.en: All navigational/operational events, drills and checks are entered on time; statutory mandatory entries must be complete and signed.

Hava tahmini ve dalga durumu izlenir; ağ.en: The weather forecast and wave conditions are monitored; in heavy weather, speed/course is adjusted. For Group A (liquefiable) cargoes, moisture/behavior is monitored, and the route is altered if necessary.

Bulk Jupiter vakası, liquefaction'ın gem.en: The Bulk Jupiter case showed that liquefaction can capsize a ship.

Grab/vinç tel halat, fren ve hidrolik ba.en: Grab/crane wire ropes, brakes and hydraulics are maintained according to the PMS; the hatch cover hydraulic cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks.

Vinç arızası geared gemide yük operasyon.en: A crane failure on a geared ship stops cargo operations and results in demurrage.

Yük grup (A/B/C), stowage factor ve dens.en: The cargo is distributed according to its group (A/B/C), stowage factor and density; the loading sequence is planned within the approved limits of the loading manual. In alternate hold loading, shear force can reach a critical level.

Her yükleme adımı loadicator'da SF/BM ve.en: Each loading step is verified on the loadicator for SF/BM and GM; values above 85% are a signal for revision. The printouts are kept.

Sürekli look-out yapılır; çatışma riski.en: A continuous lookout is kept; risk of collision is assessed by radar/ARPA and visually. Early and substantial action is taken; on a large ship, the effect of a maneuver is delayed.

Büyük bulk gemisinin durma mesafesi uzun.en: A large bulk carrier has a long stopping distance; decisions must be made early.

Yangın/MOB/abandon ship ve enclosed spac.en: Fire/MOB/abandon ship and enclosed space entry & rescue drills are carried out; the muster list is kept up to date. Deficiencies are rectified through debriefing.

Bulk gemilerinde kapalı alan ölümleri ya.en: Enclosed space fatalities are common on bulk carriers; enclosed space drills must not be neglected.

DSC günlük/haftalık test edilir; EPIRB/S.en: DSC is tested daily/weekly; the EPIRB/SART are checked periodically (battery/HRU dates). The accuracy of AIS static/dynamic data is checked.

Pre-arrival/departure checklist (steerin.en: The pre-arrival/departure checklist (steering test, ECDIS, equipment, notifications) is applied; NAVTEX and port notifications are followed.

Ölçümler trim ve density ile düzeltilir;.en: The measurements are corrected for trim and density; the draft survey net cargo is calculated. The ship and shore figures are compared, and if the difference exceeds the tolerance, an LoP is issued.

Group B yüklerde sıcaklık izleme, hold v.en: For Group B cargoes, temperature monitoring, hold ventilation (on/off according to the cargo schedule), gas detection and control of ignition sources are applied. Ammonium nitrate-type cargoes require special precautions against fire/explosion.

Her yükün IMSBC schedule'ı bağlayıcıdır;.en: The IMSBC schedule of each cargo is binding; the ventilation and monitoring instructions are followed to the letter.

Rat guard halatlara takılır; yemleme ist.en: Rat guards are fitted on the mooring lines; bait stations and hygiene measures are applied. The Ship Sanitation Certificate is kept valid.

Zararlı bulgusu gıda yüklerinde reddedil.en: Evidence of pests can lead to rejection of food cargoes and quarantine.

OOW sürekli look-out yapar; radar/ARPA i.en: The OOW keeps a continuous lookout, assesses risk with radar/ARPA and applies COLREG. Rest hours and a clear handover are ensured; when in doubt, the Master is called.

Yük dağılımı sagging/hogging dengesini b.en: The cargo distribution determines the sagging/hogging balance; for high-density cargoes such as ore, the tank top load density limits are also checked.

Aşırı lokal yük yoğunluğu çift dip yapıs.en: Excessive local load density can cause damage to the double bottom structure.

Slack hold'larda tahıl yüzeyi kayarak he.en: In slack holds, the grain surface shifts and produces a heeling moment; this moment is checked against the grain stability criteria (GZ area, heel angle). Shifting is reduced by trimming/securing.

Hesap, onaylı grain loading booklet ile.en: The calculation is made with the approved grain loading booklet; NCB inspection is required in some ports. Grain is not loaded unless the criteria are met.

Hose test su jeti ile sızıntı arar (yük.en: The hose test looks for leaks with a water jet (risky when cargo is on board); the chalk test shows seal contact; the ultrasonic test measures leakage in a closed hold by the PFU value. The results are documented.

Hassas yüklerde yükleme öncesi ultrasoni.en: For sensitive cargoes, an ultrasonic test before loading is the most reliable evidence against wetting claims.

Temizlik; sweeping, washing (deniz + tat.en: Cleaning covers sweeping, washing (seawater + fresh water rinse), drying, deodorizing, bilge well cleaning and paint touch-up. The standard is determined by the charter party and the next cargo.

Hold inspection bizzat yapılır ve foto/v.en: The hold inspection is carried out in person and documented with photos/video; for grain, NCB/surveyor acceptance is obtained. A rejected hold is cleaned again.

Fumigasyon lisanslı fumigator tarafından.en: The fumigation is planned by a licensed fumigator; gas levels are monitored in the accommodation and adjacent spaces. Leak checks are made and warning signs are posted.

Fosfin hem öldürücü hem patlayıcıdır; at.en: Phosphine is both lethal and explosive; it is kept away from ignition sources, and the hold must not be entered without gas measurement. Entry before ventilation and gas-freeing is prohibited.

Loading sequence ve ballast planı BLU Co.en: The loading sequence and ballast plan are prepared in compliance with the BLU Code; the loading rate must be matched to the deballasting capacity. Otherwise, SF/BM limits will be exceeded or delays will occur.

Hızlı yüklemede ballast yetişemezse muka.en: In fast loading, if the ballast operation cannot keep pace, the strength limits can be exceeded quickly.

ENC güncellenir; safety contour/depth de.en: The ENCs are updated; the safety contour/depth is set according to the deepest draft + UKC allowance. As the UKC margin may be small on an ore-laden ship, the tidal window is planned.

Piston/liner/yatak/fuel injection runnin.en: Piston/liner/bearing/fuel injection overhauls are carried out according to running hours; clearance measurements are recorded. Turbocharger cleaning/balancing maintains performance.

Aşırı ısınan yatak oil mist üretir; dete.en: An overheated bearing produces oil mist; the detector and the relief valves protect against explosion. After an oil mist alarm, the crankcase must not be opened until it has cooled down.

Paralele alırken frekans/voltaj/faz eşit.en: When paralleling, frequency/voltage/phase are matched; load sharing must be balanced. A blackout recovery test is carried out.

Yanlış faz şaft/kuplaj kırabilir; insula.en: Wrong phasing can break the shaft/coupling; the insulation resistance is measured.

Operasyonlar doğru kodla, zamanında işle.en: Operations are entered on time with the correct code; each page is signed by the Master. Records must be consistent with the actual situation.

Nitrit/pH/kloride haftalık test edilir;.en: Nitrite/pH/chloride are tested weekly; the inhibitor dose is maintained. Cooler cleaning maintains heat transfer.

Disc'ler çalışma saatine göre temizlenir.en: The discs are cleaned according to running hours; the gravity disc is selected correctly; the filter ΔP is monitored.

Sıcak HFO sıçraması yanık yapar; izolasy.en: Splashing of hot HFO causes burns; insulation and PPE are provided.

Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve.en: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and safety valve testing are carried out; the air receivers are subject to periodic inspection. The risk of oil carry-over is monitored.

Yetersiz starting air manevrada ana maki.en: Insufficient starting air creates a risk of being unable to start the main engine during maneuvering.

Departure öncesi (12 saat içinde) main s.en: The main steering gear is tested before departure (within 12 hours); emergency steering is verified by an emergency steering drill held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). Hydraulic oil cleanliness is monitored.

CO2/foam yıllık/5 yıllık testlere tabidi.en: CO2/foam systems are subject to annual/5-yearly tests; quick-closing valves, dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before CO2 release, the space is cleared of personnel and a headcount is taken.

Günlük blow-down ve su kimyası testleri.en: Daily blowdown and water chemistry tests are carried out; soot blowing prevents soot build-up. The safety valves are tested annually.

Kurum birikimi soot fire riski yaratır;.en: Soot build-up creates a risk of soot fire; soot blowing is carried out regularly.

Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; kritik e.en: A monthly overdue report is produced; critical equipment is prioritized; work records are kept complete.

Yakıt/mesafe ile yıllık CII hesaplanır (.en: The annual CII is calculated from fuel/distance (A-E); SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures (speed optimization, hull/propeller cleaning).

Sensörler kalibre edilir; alarm noktalar.en: Sensors are calibrated; alarm points and the dead-man system are tested. In UMS mode, transfer of alarms to the bridge/cabins is verified.

Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar gerçek alarmı.en: Repeated false alarms lead to real alarms being missed; the root cause is eliminated.

Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug.en: A pre-bunker meeting is held; scupper plugs and SOPEP equipment are ready. The initial rate is slow; topping-up is done manually. Tank ullages are monitored.

Mühürlü MARPOL numunesi alınır ve saklan.en: A sealed MARPOL sample is taken and retained; the BDN is verified and entered in the record book. The sulfur content must be appropriate for the area of use.

Salinometer ile tuzluluk izlenir; limand.en: Salinity is monitored with a salinometer; production is stopped in port/near the coast because of contamination. Disinfection is applied.

OWS bypass'ı ağır cezalı kriminal suçtur.en: OWS bypass is a criminal offense with heavy penalties; records must be consistent with the actual situation.

Seal/bearing PMS'e göre yenilenir; kapas.en: Seals/bearings are renewed according to the PMS; performance is verified by a capacity test. A high deballasting capacity is necessary for the BLU sequence.

Yetersiz ballast kapasitesi hızlı yüklem.en: Insufficient ballast capacity can lead to SF/BM limits being exceeded during fast loading.

Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV doz izleni.en: After the pre-flow test, the TRO/UV dose is monitored; the system operates actively during ballasting/deballasting and is recorded in the BWRB. System capacity is critical at high ballast flow rates.

Silindirler ve hortumlar sızıntı açısınd.en: The cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks; hydraulic oil cleanliness checks and pressure tests are carried out. Correct operation together with the compression bars/seals is verified.

Basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı yaralanma yapar.en: A pressurized hydraulic leak causes injury; the pressure is released before maintenance.

Hidrolik silindir/pompa veya elektrik mo.en: Hydraulic cylinders/pumps or electric motors/contactors are maintained; wire ropes and brakes are inspected according to the PMS. The overload protection is verified.

Vinç arızası geared gemide yük operasyon.en: A crane failure on a geared ship stops cargo operations.

Sludge sounding alınır; bertaraf inciner.en: Sludge soundings are taken; disposal is by incinerator or to a shore reception facility. The incinerator flame failure trip must work correctly.

ENC kataloğu S-63 lisansına göre güncell.en: The ENC catalog is updated according to the S-63 license (including AIO, T&P). The safety contour, safety depth and shallow contour are set according to the ship's draft + UKC allowance; these values directly determine ECDIS danger highlighting.

Route planner ile waypoint'ler girilir;.en: Waypoints are entered with the route planner; the check route function generates warnings for no-go areas, shallows and prohibited areas. Each warning is assessed individually; an automatically generated route is not approved without a manual check.

Back-up ECDIS'e ENC ve route senkronize.en: The ENCs and the route are synchronized to the back-up ECDIS; check route is run again with the same safety parameters. It is verified that the GPS, gyro and log inputs are displayed correctly on both units.

Mevcut haritalar, sailing directions, ti.en: Available charts, sailing directions, tide/current, weather and port information are gathered; alternative routes and high-risk passages (TSS, narrow channels) are identified.

Waypoint, course, hız ve wheel-over nokt.en: Waypoints, courses, speeds and wheel-over points are defined; abort/contingency points are marked. On passage, XTD and UKC are monitored continuously.

Demir yeri derinlik, dip cinsi, akıntı v.en: The anchorage position is selected according to depth, nature of the bottom, current and traffic; the scope is typically planned as a length of cable 5-7 times the depth. Brought-up is verified.

Anchor watch ile sürüklenme (dragging) i.en: Dragging is monitored by the anchor watch (GPS/bearings); the engine is kept ready if necessary. When weighing anchor, the windlass load and the condition of the cable are observed.

Head/stern line, breast line ve spring l.en: Head/stern lines, breast lines and spring lines restrict the ship's fore-and-aft and lateral movement; they are sent out in the order of the pilot/Master's plan. Line condition and MBL/SWL are checked.

Kopan halat snap-back yapar; personel sn.en: A parting line snaps back; personnel do not stand in the snap-back zone. Mixed mooring (different materials) creates additional risk.

Tüm sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA ekipma.en: All certificates must be valid; LSA/FFA equipment, ECDIS, GMDSS and safety equipment must be operational. Previous PSC deficiencies must have been closed out and evidenced.

ISM uygulama eksikleri, LSA/FFA kondisyo.en: Deficiencies in ISM implementation, LSA/FFA condition and ECDIS/navigation records are frequent areas of findings; they are rectified in advance by internal audit.

Planlı iç denetimlerde uygunsuzluklar te.en: Non-conformities are identified in planned internal audits and closed out through root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA). Records must be traceable.

Near-miss ve hazard raporlama teşvik edi.en: Near-miss and hazard reporting is encouraged; the data are used to improve the system.

Windlass brake holding test (rendering t.en: The windlass brake holding test (rendering test), hydraulic oil and greasing are carried out according to the PMS; the condition of wire/steel ropes is inspected.

Windlass freninin tutmaması demir operas.en: Failure of the windlass brake to hold causes loss of control and damage during anchoring operations.

Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; LSA/FFA.en: A monthly overdue report is produced; maintenance of critical safety equipment such as LSA/FFA has priority. Work records are kept complete.

Kritik güvenlik ekipmanı overdue'su hem.en: Overdue maintenance of critical safety equipment is both an ISM NC and a risk to safety of life.

Yük dağılımı sagging/hogging dengesini b.en: The cargo distribution determines the sagging/hogging balance; on container ships, torsion is also critical because of the open deck structure. The loading computer verifies at each step that values are below 100% of the limit.

MOL Comfort vakası, mukavemet limitlerin.en: The MOL Comfort case showed that neglecting strength limits can lead to the loss of the ship.

Belirli dalga periyodu/karşılaşma açısı.en: Certain combinations of wave period/encounter angle trigger parametric rolling; this resonance is avoided by altering course/speed. Weather routing recommendations are evaluated.

Ağır havaya girmeden önce rota/hız karar.en: The route/speed decision is made before entering heavy weather; a late response leads to container losses.

OOW sürekli uygun gözcülük yapar; radar/.en: The OOW keeps a proper lookout at all times; risk of collision is assessed by radar/ARPA and by sight. Early and substantial action is taken in accordance with COLREG.

Yorgunluk yönetimi (rest hours) ve net v.en: Fatigue management (rest hours) and a clear watch handover are carried out; if in doubt, the Master is called.

Kâğıt haritalar standart yöntemle tashih.en: Paper charts are corrected by the standard method; ENC updates are applied in ECDIS. T&P notices are followed and a chart correction log is kept.

Chart correction log, güncelliğin kanıtı.en: The chart correction log is the evidence that charts are up to date and may be requested by PSC.

Ağır konteynerlerin alt tier'lara, hafif.en: It is verified that heavy containers are placed in the lower tiers and light ones on top; the weights declared by VGM (Verified Gross Mass) are reflected in the plan. Reefer plug positions, IMDG segregation and OOG positions are checked.

Plan stowage yazılımına yüklenir; GM, SF.en: The plan is loaded into the stowage software; GM, SF/BM, torsion and list values are checked. If a limit is exceeded, the plan is revised, and it is sent to the terminal after Chief Officer approval.

VHF/MF/HF DSC günlük/haftalık test edili.en: VHF/MF/HF DSC is tested daily/weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically (EPIRB battery/HRU expiry dates are tracked). The accuracy of AIS static/dynamic data is checked.

Yanlış AIS verisi (örn. yanlış draft/des.en: Incorrect AIS data (e.g. wrong draft/destination) create both navigational and legal problems.

Halatlar aşınma, kesik ve UV hasarı açıs.en: Mooring lines are inspected for wear, cuts and UV damage; retirement criteria are monitored with the line management plan. Tails and fenders are checked.

Zayıflamış halat mooring sırasında kopab.en: A weakened line may part during mooring; regular inspection reduces the snap-back risk.

Tanklar günlük sounding edilir; beklenme.en: Tanks are sounded daily; an unexpected change in level indicates a leak or transfer error. The results are entered in the log.

Düzenli sounding, sızıntı ve transfer ha.en: Regular sounding enables early detection of leaks and transfer errors.

Hasar fotoğraflanır, konum/zaman kaydedi.en: The damage is photographed, the location/time are recorded and an LoP is issued to the party concerned. The condition is documented by the mate's receipt/clausing.

Belgelenmeyen hasar, sonradan gemiye yük.en: Undocumented damage leaves the ship defenseless against claims brought against it later.

NOA ve gerekli liman bildirimleri zamanı.en: The NOA and required port notifications are made on time; the pre-arrival checklist (equipment tests, ECDIS, steering test) is applied. NAVTEX navigational warnings are followed.

Yangın, MOB ve abandon ship senaryoları.en: Fire, MOB and abandon ship scenarios are carried out at the specified frequency; lifeboat/davit, immersion suit and muster procedures are rehearsed. Deficiencies are rectified through debriefing.

Konteyner gemilerinde DG kaynaklı yangın.en: On container ships, DG-related fire scenarios should also be included in drills.

Her acil durum görevi (yangın ekibi, fil.en: Every emergency duty (fire team, lifeboat, first aid) and station is assigned; the muster list is updated at crew changes and posted. Familiarization is carried out.

Tüm seyir/operasyon olayları, tatbikatla.en: All navigational/operational events, drills and safety checks are entered on time; the Official Log Book contains the statutory mandatory entries (drills, inspections, etc.).

Tutarlı ve eksiksiz log, bir sorun çıktı.en: A consistent and complete log is the strongest defense when a problem arises.

Twist lock + lashing rod + turnbuckle ko.en: The twist lock + lashing rod + turnbuckle combination is applied according to the pattern in the CSM; tier limits, stowage on hatch covers and heavy/reefer positions are checked. Lashing tightness is physically verified.

Ağır yalpa (parametric rolling) lashing.en: If heavy rolling (parametric rolling) exceeds what the lashings can withstand, the stacks collapse. Weather routing and lashing tightness are managed together.

DG manifest, packing certificate ve stow.en: The DG manifest, packing certificates and stowage positions are checked; incompatible classes are kept apart according to the segregation table. EmS (emergency response) information must be readily available.

Yanlış beyan edilmiş DG (örn. kalsiyum h.en: Misdeclared DG (e.g. calcium hypochlorite) can cause a fire; CINS circulars and indicators of suspicious cargo are followed.

Alarm veren reefer hızlıca incelenir (pl.en: A reefer showing an alarm is investigated promptly (plug, defrost, compressor); if the problem cannot be resolved, the engine team and the company are informed and the incident is documented.

OOG yükler genelde flat-rack/platform üz.en: OOG cargoes are usually carried on flat-racks/platforms; additional lashing (chain/web) is planned with angle and MSL calculations. The overhang dimensions affect the use of adjacent slots.

Ağır/büyük OOG için lashing planı mühend.en: For heavy/large OOG, the lashing plan is applied on the basis of an engineering calculation and with Chief Officer/Master approval.

GM, IS Code minimumunun üzerinde ama par.en: GM is kept above the IS Code minimum but within an optimum range that will not trigger parametric rolling. A very high GM strains the lashings through short-period, violent rolling.

Her yükleme adımında SF/BM ve torsion %1.en: At each loading step, SF/BM and torsion are kept below 100% of the limit; above 85% is the alarm band, and the sequence is revised.

Yüksek fribordda accommodation ladder +.en: With a high freeboard, an accommodation ladder + pilot ladder combination is rigged; the transfer point, angle and trap door arrangement are verified. Manropes, lifebuoy, light and heaving line are ready.

Kurulum sorumlu zabit gözetiminde checkl.en: The rigging is verified with a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer; personnel meet the pilot.

Tug sayısı/pozisyonu, yaklaşma açısı, rü.en: The number/position of tugs, approach angle, wind/current effect and mooring sequence are agreed with the pilot. The large windage area of a container ship is critical in wind.

Pruva/kıç istasyonları ile net haberleşm.en: Clear communication is established with the forward/aft stations; line tension and snap-back zones are managed. The bell book is kept.

Standby öncesi makine ısıtılır, yakıt (g.en: Before standby, the engine is warmed up, fuel is changed over (to MGO if required), the air receivers are full and rpm limits are set. The telegraph test and bridge–ER communication are verified.

Manevra boyunca emirler tekrar edilerek.en: Throughout the maneuver, orders are repeated back and then executed (repeat-back); the bell book is kept. Continuous running in the barred speed range is avoided.

Reefer sayısına göre devreye alınan DG s.en: The number of DGs on line is adjusted to the number of reefers; when paralleling, frequency/voltage/phase are matched. The power management system (PMS) manages standby start and load sharing.

Black-out recovery testi yapılır; DG'ler.en: A black-out recovery test is carried out; DGs are overhauled according to running hours. Insulation and preferential tripping are verified.

Bilge high-level alarmları periyodik fon.en: Bilge high-level alarms are subject to periodic function tests; the OCM 15 ppm alarm is calibrated and the 3-way valve response is verified.

Çalışmayan 15 ppm alarmı hem MARPOL ihla.en: An inoperative 15 ppm alarm is both a MARPOL violation and an inspection finding.

Sludge sounding düzenli alınır; bertaraf.en: Sludge soundings are taken regularly; disposal is by incinerator or shore reception facility. The incinerator flame failure trip must work correctly.

Yağlamalı tipte header tank seviyesi ve.en: In the oil-lubricated type, the header tank level and bearing temperature are monitored; a drop in level indicates a leak at the sea-side seal. Use of EAL (environmentally acceptable lubricant) is mandatory in some areas.

Stern tube yağ kaçağı görünür deniz kirl.en: A stern tube oil leak causes visible pollution of the sea and must be reported.

Transfer öncesi valf line-up doğrulanır;.en: Before transfer, the valve line-up is verified; tank levels and overflow alarms are monitored. Large transfers are coordinated with the deck department with regard to trim/list.

İçerideki transfer dahi yanlış valfle ta.en: Even an internal transfer can overflow a tank through a wrong valve; the line-up is never skipped.

Wash water pH/PAH/türbidite monitör edil.en: Wash water pH/PAH/turbidity is monitored; in areas where open loop is restricted, the ship changes over to closed loop or to compliant fuel. The EGC Record Book is maintained.

Scrubber arızasında kısa sürede uyumlu y.en: A plan for changing over to compliant fuel at short notice must be ready in case of scrubber failure.

Yakıt tüketimi ve kat edilen mesafe ile.en: The annual CII is calculated from fuel consumption and distance traveled (rating A-E); SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures (speed optimization, hull cleaning, etc.).

CO₂/foam sistemi yıllık/5 yıllık testler.en: The CO₂/foam system is subject to annual/5-yearly tests; the quick-closing valves, fire dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before CO₂ release, the space is cleared of personnel and a head count is taken.

CO₂ boğulma riski taşır; release yalnız.en: CO₂ carries a risk of asphyxiation; release is made only after the space has been cleared and a head count taken, with the lockout in place.

Limandan ayrılmadan önce (12 saat içinde.en: The main steering gear is tested before leaving port (within 12 hours); emergency steering and communications are verified by the emergency steering drill held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). Hydraulic oil cleanliness is monitored.

Basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı cilt altına enj.en: A pressurized hydraulic leak can inject oil under the skin; the system is depressurized for maintenance.

İşler maker aralığına göre planlanır; iş.en: Jobs are planned to the maker's intervals; work records (hours, parts, measurements) are kept complete. A monthly overdue report is produced and critical overdue jobs are given priority.

Soot blowing düzenli yapılır; düşük yükt.en: Soot blowing is carried out regularly; prolonged running at low load increases soot buildup. Water chemistry and circulation are maintained.

Soot fire, sirkülasyon kesilince hızla i.en: A soot fire can quickly turn into an iron fire when circulation stops; temperature and circulation are monitored.

Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug.en: A pre-bunker meeting is held; scupper plugs, drip trays and SOPEP equipment are kept ready. The initial rate is slow, and topping-up is controlled manually. Tank ullages are monitored.

Mühürlü MARPOL numunesi alınır ve saklan.en: A sealed MARPOL sample is taken and retained; the BDN is verified and entered in the appropriate record book (ORB). The sulfur content must suit the area of use.

Düzenli rounds ile sızıntı, ısınma ve an.en: Regular rounds check for leaks, overheating and abnormal noise/vibration; in UMS mode, the dead-man alarm and the bridge/cabin alarm transfer must be working. The handover is made clearly.

UMS moduna geçmeden önce tüm kritik alar.en: Before changing to UMS mode, transfer of all critical alarms is verified.

ECA'ya girişte uyumlu yakıta geçiş zaman.en: On entering an ECA, the changeover to compliant fuel must be made in time and recorded.

Salinometer ile tuzluluk izlenir; eşik a.en: Salinity is monitored with the salinometer; if the threshold is exceeded, the dump valve operates. Production is stopped in port/coastal waters because of contamination.

İçme suyu için periyodik bakteriyolojik.en: Periodic bacteriological tests are carried out on drinking water.

OWS bypass'ı ağır cezalı kriminal suçtur.en: Bypassing the OWS is a criminal offense carrying heavy penalties; ORB I entries must be consistent with the actual situation.

Nitrit/pH/kloride haftalık test edilir;.en: Nitrite/pH/chloride are tested weekly; inhibitor dosing is maintained. On cold-climate voyages, the antifreeze concentration in the relevant circuits is checked.

Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve.en: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and safety valve tests are carried out; air bottles are subject to periodic internal inspection. Oil carry-over creates a fire/explosion risk.

Purifier disc'leri çalışma saatine göre.en: Purifier discs are cleaned according to running hours; the gravity disc is selected according to fuel density. Filter ΔP is monitored and auto back-flush is verified.

Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV dozu izlen.en: After the pre-flow test, the TRO/UV dose is monitored; the system operates during ballasting/deballasting and the operation is recorded in the BWRB.

Electrochlorination'da H2 birikimi venti.en: In electrochlorination, H2 that accumulates without ventilation causes an explosion; gas monitoring and venting are critical.

Plug ve soketler ısınma/oksitlenme açısı.en: Plugs and sockets are inspected for heating/oxidation (with a thermal camera if required); a loose connection creates an arc/fire risk. Load distribution is monitored.

Plug çalışmalarında uygun izolasyon/LOTO.en: During plug work, proper isolation/LOTO is applied; refrigerant leak detection is carried out.

Görev; PSV ikmali, AHTS/anchor handling,.en: The task is clearly defined as PSV supply, AHTS/anchor handling, diving, ROV/survey, pipe/cable laying, drilling, offshore loading, walk-to-work or heavy lift. Each task type brings its own watch circle, reference combination and stop criteria.

Faaliyeti güvenle durdurma süresi (termi.en: The time needed to stop the activity safely (terminate time), the least-risk escape direction, and the thrust/power that must remain available after the Worst Case Failure (WCF) are calculated. These three values directly determine the required DP class and redundancy.

Görev gereksinimi ile geminin gerçek tek.en: Assessing the task requirements together with the ship's actual technical condition, the required DP equipment class, redundancy level, number of personnel and position reference combination are agreed with the client.

Sonuçlar operasyon planı, task risk asse.en: The results are written into the operations plan, the task risk assessment and the ASOG inputs; in this way the bridge team sees the accepted limits and the response plan before starting the task.

Familiarisation kaydı, planlama paketi v.en: The familiarization record, planning package and task risk assessment are kept on file; when the task changes, these three are reviewed again.

Class 1'de tek hata pozisyon kaybına yol.en: In Class 1, a single fault may lead to loss of position; in Class 2, a single fault of an active component must not lead to loss of position; in Class 3, the loss of a single compartment through fire/flooding is also tolerated. The task determines which class it requires by its own risk level.

Worst Case Failure Design Intent (WCFDI).en: Worst Case Failure Design Intent (WCFDI) is the most severe single failure accepted in the ship's design. The thrust and power capacity remaining with the online equipment under this scenario is confirmed; if the actual configuration produces a loss exceeding the WCFDI, the task is not started.

Görev için gerekli sınıf sağlanamıyorsa.en: If the class required for the task cannot be met, the work is not started. Task Appropriate Mode (TAM) may be used only through an approved, risk-based process and with a reduced operating envelope; it does not automatically make missing redundancy acceptable.

Devralan DPO sistemi anlayıp kabul ettik.en: After the incoming DPO has understood and accepted the system, the checklist is signed by both DPOs.

Alarm tanınır; acknowledge etmeden önce.en: The alarm is recognized; before acknowledging, its source and time are read and the position/heading trend is checked. The ASOG status is declared, and the Master, the ECR and the task control centers are informed on the designated channel.

Alarm, DP, PMS/VMS ve iletişim kayıtları.en: Alarm, DP, PMS/VMS and communication records are preserved; authority to restart after the incident is obtained through the formal process.

Interface/bridging document ile prosedür.en: Differences between procedures and SMS are closed out with the interface/bridging document. Communication channels, call signs, alert words, loss-of-communication action and joint emergencies are agreed.

Kuvvetli tide ve eddy için hız-yön trend.en: In strong tides and eddies, speed/direction trends, thrust margin and reference deviations are monitored. At sites with soliton risk, radar/current indications and the possibility of a sudden surge are watched; when the environmental limit is approached, the task equipment is recovered safely.

Dive control ile green light, dalgıç/çan.en: Green light, diver/bell status, working depth and recovery time are continuously shared with dive control. Heading or position changes are notified to dive control in advance; no move is made without explicit approval.

Yellow/Red durumda dalış çanı geri alma.en: In Yellow/Red status, diving bell recovery and the emergency rescue plan are initiated in accordance with the ASOG.

Move/heading change talepleri küçük artı.en: Move/heading change requests are applied in small increments, with confirmation from ROV control at each step. In the event of lost telemetry, excessive umbilical tension or DP degradation, the recovery/abandon criteria are applied.

Final mevkide relative ve absolute refer.en: In the final position, the relative and absolute references are compared; environmental limits and thrust margin are monitored according to the ASOG. While a hose, crane load or personnel are on deck, no unauthorized setpoint/heading change is made.

Hava, güç, thruster, PRS veya hortum ger.en: If the weather, power, thruster, PRS or hose tension limit is exceeded, the transfer is stopped, the lines are disconnected and the ship moves out to a safe distance.

Aşırı tension, stabilite limiti, power/t.en: In the event of excessive tension, a stability limit, power/thruster degradation or loss of command, the emergency release/abort plan is applied.

S-lay'de joint boyuna uygun incremental.en: In S-lay, incremental moves matching the joint length are made; in J-lay and reel-lay, approved low-speed auto-track is used. In the event of welding/production delay, loss of tension, a DP excursion or WCF, the hold, laydown or abandon procedure is initiated.

Rock dumping'de survey doğrulamasıyla ço.en: In rock dumping, a multi-pass plan with survey verification is followed; in cable work, the catenary and minimum bend radius are monitored. If the vehicle becomes stuck, tension increases, telemetry is lost or DP degrades, the stop and recovery plan is applied.

CAMO, kritik faaliyette (dalış, ağır kal.en: CAMO imposes the most conservative configuration in order to maintain full redundancy during critical activities (diving, heavy lift, drilling). TAM allows operation with less equipment when the WCF outcome is acceptable for the task; however, this is always based on an approved table and a risk-based decision.

Onaylı CAMO/TAM tablosundan güç üretimi,.en: The status of power generation, bus-tie, thrusters, PRS, sensors, UPS, cooling and auxiliary systems is taken from the approved CAMO/TAM table. Each item of equipment is lined up according to the table and cross-checked by an independent person.

Konfigürasyon değiştiğinde ASOG statüsü.en: When the configuration changes, the ASOG status and the WCF outcome are re-assessed. CAMO/TAM is not changed in an uncontrolled manner while the task is in progress; a change is made only with MOC and the approval of an authorized person.

FSO/FPSO hareketi ve geminin coğrafi mev.en: The FSO/FPSO motion and the ship's geographical position are monitored together; the divergence alarm limits are verified. Drive-off/drift-off, hawser overload and relative PRS loss alarms are matched with ASOG actions.

Yellow/Red durumda transfer durdurulur;.en: In Yellow/Red status, the transfer is stopped; the ESD/ERS and disconnection sequence is carried out in accordance with the approved terminal procedure.

Riser angle monitoring ile DP pozisyon t.en: Riser angle monitoring is followed together with the DP position trend; relaxed position/heading is used only within the approved envelope. On WCF, drive-off/drift-off or reaching the environmental limit, the secure well, disconnect and escape route sequence is applied.

Transfer boyunca DPO, gangway operator v.en: Throughout the transfer, uninterrupted communication is maintained between the DPO, the gangway operator and the facility control room. As a limit is approached, new crossings are stopped; in Yellow/Red or on a gangway trip, the planned disconnect/recovery is carried out.

Pick-up, slew, transfer ve landing safha.en: During the pick-up, slew, transfer and landing phases, the position, heading, thrust, list and hook load trends are monitored. The DPO is warned before a load is suddenly picked up or released; setpoint and gain changes are made only as planned.

DP, crane, rigging veya hava limiti aşıl.en: If a DP, crane, rigging or weather limit is exceeded, the load is moved to the predetermined safe position.

Test sonucunun CAMO, ASOG, consequence a.en: The effect of the test result on CAMO, ASOG, the consequence analysis and emergency drills is assessed. After a modification or a recurring failure, the FMEA is updated as a living document.

DP loguna DP'ye giriş/çıkış zamanı, göre.en: The DP log records the times of entering/leaving DP, the task, position, heading, online equipment, PRS, environment, alarms and status changes. Maintenance, bypass, defect, test and drill records are linked to the relevant technical file.

Sequence of events ile initiating event,.en: The sequence of events is used to separate the initiating event, hidden failures, human factors and barrier failures. Corrective/preventive actions are assigned to a responsible person with a deadline; the FMEA, ASOG, procedures and training needs are updated.

Marine Technologies, LLC 2002'de kuruldu.en: Marine Technologies, LLC was founded in 2002, and its initial aim was to develop a DP system complying with the IMO guidelines for DP class 2. The first MT-equipped ship received DP-2 classification from ABS within 16 months. The company has delivered more than 100 DP systems to date, mostly on DP class 2 ships.

Merkez Mandeville, Louisiana (ABD); ayrı.en: The headquarters is in Mandeville, Louisiana (USA), with further offices in Egersund (Norway) and Singapore. This three-region structure is considered in planning with regard to how close service and spare parts support are to the operating area.

Bridge Mate ailesi DP'nin yanında itici.en: Besides DP, the Bridge Mate family also covers thruster control, the integrated bridge and position reference sensors. Knowing which products are installed on board is necessary to understand which layer is affected when assessing a failure.

Klasik yaklaşımda tüm sinyaller köprüüst.en: In the classic approach, all signals are routed to a central cabinet on the bridge. In Bridge Mate, however, not only the operator stations and DP control computers but also the thruster and sensor interface units are distributed. These units are built on a stand-alone IO unit specially designed for use on DP ships.

Her arayüz ünitesi, bağlandığı iticinin,.en: Each interface unit can be located close to the thruster, reference system or sensor it is connected to. The result is a marked reduction in cabling, which matters both for cost in newbuilding and for feasibility in retrofit.

MT, bu sağlam tasarımın özellikle servis.en: MT stresses that this robust design is particularly important on ships where a service and system specialist is not available around the clock. Offshore, when a failure occurs, the manufacturer's engineer is often hours or days away; it is critical that the system can keep running on its own.

Arayüz ünitesinin tasarımı, Bridge Mate.en: The design of the interface unit makes the Bridge Mate system suitable for retrofit and modernization in all equipment classes. Since the same hardware modules are used in different classes, a class upgrade usually means more of the same type of hardware rather than a new type of hardware.

Dağıtık mimari, arıza analizinde soruyu.en: A distributed architecture changes the question asked in failure analysis. Instead of "Which card failed?", the question is "Which IO unit dropped out and what was that unit feeding?" Therefore, the thruster, reference system, power supply and sensor group served by each IO unit must be mapped out in advance.

JX ve DP 0 sistemleri, DP 1, DP 2 ve DP.en: JX and DP 0 systems are based on the same distributed architecture as DP 1, DP 2 and DP 3 systems.
