This arrangement allows hardware components to be placed in practical locations: each interface unit (IO hardware) is placed close to the thrusters, rudders, engines and sensors it is connected to, reducing cabling and installation costs.

Her iki sistem de \"compact operator sta.en: Both systems can be delivered as a "compact operator station" or a "console" version; the console version is available in several different configurations to suit requirements. The JX system can easily be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems.

Class 1 sistem mimarisi tümüyle dağıtık.en: The Class 1 system architecture is based on a fully distributed concept. A DP 1 system has a single control computer, a single operator station and separate IO units interfacing the sensors, position reference system, power supply and thrusters.

Bridge Mate DP sistemine bağımsız bir jo.en: An independent joystick system can be interfaced to the Bridge Mate DP system. This is operationally important because it provides a separate means of maneuvering when the DP control path is lost.

DP 2 sistemi, DP 1 ile aynı modüllerden.en: The DP 2 system consists of the same modules as DP 1; however, to comply with Class 2 rules, the number of modules is increased for redundancy. A DP 2 system uses three control computers and typically two operator stations.

Üç kontrol bilgisayarı kullanılması, bil.en: Using three control computers enables majority voting between the computers and the rejection of a failed computer. The number of IO units is typically much higher in DP 2: there is a separate IO unit for each sensor set, each position reference system, the power supply and each thruster.

Bu konfigürasyon, tek bir arızanın mevki.en: This configuration is used to provide redundancy at all levels, so as to ensure that a single failure does not result in loss of position. All modules are interconnected via a redundant dual network.

DP 3 sistemi, DP 2'ye kıyasla genişletil.en: The DP 3 system has an extended hardware configuration compared with DP 2. Triple-redundant DP controllers are still used and at least three operator stations are required. Unlike the dual sensor sets typically used in a DP 2 configuration, there are three IO units for interfacing the components.

DP 3 sistemi ayrıca, Class 3 gereklerini.en: To meet Class 3 requirements, the DP 3 system also needs a physically separate, fire-resistant compartment in which one control computer, one operator station and one sensor IO unit must be located.

DP 1'den DP 2'ye yükseltme kolay bir sür.en: Upgrading from DP 1 to DP 2 is a straightforward process, because the same hardware modules are used in both system types; only the number of units differs. Similarly, a DP 0 system can be upgraded to a higher class by adding more of the same hardware components for increased redundancy.

Sınıf doğrulaması bir belge işlemi değil.en: Class verification is not a paperwork formality but part of the task acceptance decision. If the ship does not meet the requirements of its declared class at that moment, the restriction is entered in the ASOG and the task scope is narrowed accordingly. Task Appropriate Mode (TAM) may be used only through an approved, risk-based process; it does not by itself make missing redundancy acceptable.

Bridge Mate DP konsepti, yedeklilik ve a.en: Using a distributed architecture that emphasizes redundancy and separation philosophies, and keeping cabling to a minimum, the Bridge Mate DP concept can be integrated into the ship operator's chair. The DP Chair puts full ship control at the operator's fingertips with a 15-inch touchscreen monitor fitted in the armrest.

Manuel, joystick ve DP operasyonlarının.en: Manual, joystick and DP operations are all brought together at a single point. The DP Chair is available with DP 1 and DP 2 operator stations and can replace or complement the traditional stand-alone DP consoles on the bridge. Chair configurations that include a dedicated DP operator station and a Multi-Function Workstation for bridge applications are also available.

DP 2 kurulumunda tipik olarak iki, DP 3'.en: A DP 2 installation typically has two operator stations, and DP 3 at least three. At the start of each watch, it must be clearly confirmed which station is in command and how control is transferred. During a transfer, verbal confirmation and a log entry are decisive in any later incident investigation.

DP vardiya devir teslimi, gemi ve sistem.en: The DP watch handover covers the ship and system status as well as the task and environmental conditions. For Bridge Mate specifically, the station configuration and the active profile are also handed over.

Dokunmatik ekran, fiziksel butona kıyasl.en: A touchscreen carries a greater risk of a wrong touch than a physical button, especially when the ship is moving. Therefore, making critical mode changes with a confirmation step, and the operator reading the target value before executing the command, are part of general DP practice.

Multi-Function Workstation'da DP dışında.en: On the Multi-Function Workstation, it must be ensured that DP monitoring continues without interruption even while non-DP applications are open. Screen brightness is set with central dimming to a level that does not impair night vision; the alarm volume is not turned down.

Green normal operasyon; Advisory/Blue di.en: Green is normal operation; Advisory/Blue is caution and monitoring; Yellow is bringing the activity to a safe stage; Red is stopping/abandoning the activity. The colors are defined in the ship-specific ASOG, and no shift in meaning between different projects is allowed.

Bir limit aşıldığında ilgili renge geçil.en: When a limit is exceeded, the relevant color is declared, the parties are informed and the written action is carried out. Even if conditions improve, there is no return to a lower alert level without authorized approval and a re-check.

RadaScan, dinamik konumlandırma ve diğer.en: RadaScan is an advanced position reference sensor that uses radar technology for dynamic positioning and other ship control applications. It operates with high accuracy over a range of 10 m to 1000 m and complements GPS in close-range operations; it can replace traditional laser systems.

CyScan, deniz aracı kontrol uygulamaları.en: CyScan is a high-performance local position reference sensor specially designed for vessel control applications. It works as a primary or backup sensor and is compatible with all Marine Technologies DP systems.

Genel DP uygulamasında her referans, DP.en: In general DP practice, each reference is observed independently and compared with the existing references before being included in the DP model. Before a reference with a growing deviation is simply deselected, the cause is investigated, because the deviating sensor may sometimes be the correct one while the others share a common error.

Offshore tesise yaklaşımda DP genellikle.en: When approaching an offshore installation, DP is usually set up outside the zone and the system is allowed to stabilize; in the final approach phase, a second independent reference is brought online. Local references such as RadaScan and CyScan are decisive in this phase for the accuracy of the position relative to the target.

Lokal referanslarda en sık görülen kayıp.en: The most frequent cause of loss with local references is the target becoming invisible: shadowing of the reflector or transponder, the angle closing as the ship moves, or an intervening structure/crane boom. With satellite-based references, ionospheric scintillation, jamming and spoofing can affect all satellite-based sources at the same time.

Her Multi-Function Workstation, dokunmat.en: Each Multi-Function Workstation consists of a touchscreen and operator computers that run silently because they need no fan. Each MFW runs all applications in parallel and all are connected to redundant networks; this removes single-point-of-failure concerns.

Klavye, baş seçici (heading selector) ve.en: Operator devices such as the keyboard, heading selector and joystick are provided as appropriate for operating the system. Any workstation can be selected for any application at any time.

MT'nin Bridge Mate Integrated Bridge Sys.en: MT's Bridge Mate Integrated Bridge System has DNV NAUT-AW type approval, the most comprehensive bridge class notation in the industry. The Bridge Mate Autopilot, when used together with MT's conning display and ECDIS, achieves Wheel Mark approval and track-control-steering certification.

IBS ayrıca güç yönetim sistemi, otomasyo.en: The IBS can also be integrated with ship systems such as the power management system, automation, alarm system, navigation lights and searchlights, horn and wipers.

Köprüüstü genelinde uyumlaştırılmış (har.en: A harmonized HMI across the bridge means that the same operation is done in the same way at every station. This is an important human-factor advantage that reduces error rates at watch changeover and under stress. Central dimming allows night vision to be protected from a single point.

Track control ve otomatik rota tutmadan.en: When changing from track control and automatic course keeping to DP mode, the point at which control is handed over must be clearly defined. In general DP practice, this changeover is made gradually, after the speed has been reduced sufficiently and the ship has steadied.

IBS'in alarm sistemiyle entegrasyonunda,.en: When the IBS is integrated with the alarm system, it must be verified that DP-related alarms are not suppressed on the bridge. Every suppressed or disabled alarm is recorded and passed on at handover.

Bridge Mate DP sistemine bağımsız bir jo.en: An independent joystick system can be interfaced to the Bridge Mate DP system. This independence is operationally critical: when the DP control path is lost, the ability to maneuver via the joystick is preserved as a separate path.

Bridge Mate JX sistemi de aynı dağıtık m.en: The Bridge Mate JX system is also based on the same distributed architecture and can be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems.

Kademeli geçiş, her adımda geminin tepki.en: A gradual changeover allows the ship's response to be observed at each step and verified before moving on to the next. Going directly to full automatic mode means that a faulty thruster response or a wrong reference is noticed only after a position deviation has started.

Genel DP uygulamasında, DP'ye geçmeden ö.en: In general DP practice, before going into DP, each thruster and the main propeller are proved in both directions in manual control. Command, feedback and physical response are compared; the system is not taken over until all three have been verified as consistent.

İticiler prove edildikten sonra kontrol.en: After the thrusters have been proved, control is handed over gradually. First, automatic heading control is engaged in joystick mode and the ship's response is observed; once stable behavior is seen, position control is added.

Tam otomatik mevki tutmaya geçildikten s.en: After changing to full automatic position keeping, a stabilization period is allowed for the DP mathematical model to learn the environmental forces. During this period the ship settles and the system builds up its estimate of the wind, current and wave forces.

Her mod geçişi; komuttaki istasyon, saat.en: Every mode change is entered in the DP log together with the station in command, the time and the type of change. Having a second person supervise during the change breaks the one-person error chain.

Her geçişin bir geri dönüş yolu olmalıdı.en: Every changeover must have a way back. If unexpected behavior is seen in DP, reverting to joystick or manual control must be a pre-planned and rehearsed action. Regular testing of the independent joystick path is therefore an operational necessity.

Proje, müşteri veya uzun bakım sonrası m.en: After a new project, a new client or a long maintenance period, the mobilization checklist is completed; the task equipment installed, PRS additions and software changes are recorded.

Pre-DP checklistte mevcut konfigürasyonu.en: The pre-DP checklist checks that the current configuration matches the CAMO/TAM and the ASOG. Permit to commence operations is not given without the approval of the Master and the Chief Engineer.

500 m bölgesine giriş için tesisten izin.en: Permission to enter the 500 m zone is obtained from the installation and the pre-entry checklist is completed. DP is set up and stabilized outside the zone; in the last 250 m, a second independent reference is brought online.

Her thruster ve ana pervane manuel kontr.en: Each thruster and the main propeller are proved in both directions in manual control; command, feedback and physical response are compared. It is checked that the gyro, MRU/VRS, wind sensor and selected PRSs are healthy and correctly weighted.

Önce Auto Yaw ile baş stabilize edilir,.en: First the heading is stabilized with Auto Yaw, then the surge and sway axes are brought into Auto Position in a controlled manner. The position setpoint is chosen close to the current position; no sudden large setpoint or heading change is given.

Model çevresel kuvvetleri öğrenene kadar.en: The ship is held steady long enough for the model to learn the environmental forces, and actual performance is monitored. Work does not start until the capability, consequence analysis and footprint show the expected behavior.

Görev ve su derinliğine göre DGNSS, HPR/.en: Depending on the task and water depth, a combination of DGNSS, HPR/USBL, taut wire, laser, microwave or relative PRS is selected. It is taken into consideration that two GNSS units using the same satellite/correction source may not be truly independent.

Yeni referans önce monitor konumunda göz.en: A new reference is first observed in monitor mode; if residual, variance and trend are consistent, it is enabled in a controlled manner. If a reference deviates, rather than deselecting it immediately, common sensors, target, geometry and environmental causes are compared.

Sensör fark alarmında hatalı kaynak tren.en: On a sensor difference alarm, the faulty source is identified by trend, voting and independent observation. When a sensor is disabled, the consequence analysis and ASOG status are checked again.

Footprint plot ile gerçek pozisyon-baş d.en: The footprint plot records the actual position/heading distribution, thrust usage and environmental trend. If the model and the field performance do not match, the limits are reduced, the cause is investigated and action is taken according to the ASOG.

En büyük online jeneratör veya grup kayb.en: The spinning reserve, which evaluates the frequency and remaining capacity after loss of the largest online generator or group, is monitored. Before the load trend approaches the limit, the standby generator is started and synchronized, and the bridge is informed.

Blackout recovery sırası emergency gener.en: The blackout recovery sequence (emergency generator, essential auxiliaries, DG start, bus energization and thruster connection) is worked out specifically for the ship. At each reconnection, frequency/voltage stability and available power are checked; which thruster is brought online first is coordinated with the DPO according to the escape and drift direction.

Beklenmeyen etki hemen limitation/defect.en: An unexpected effect is immediately reported as a limitation/defect and reflected in the CAMO/ASOG. After close-out, a repeat test is evidenced; drawings, software version and FMEA revision are updated.

Uygulama sonrası alarm, controller switc.en: After implementation, alarms, controller switchover, PRS/sensor inputs, thruster commands and consequence analysis are tested. Version, parameters, test results and changed operating limits are documented, and familiarization is given to the team.

Tekrarlayan defect ve overdue maintenanc.en: The redundancy/ASOG impact of recurring defects and overdue maintenance is reported to the Master and the DPO. After maintenance, the return-to-service test and independent verification are completed.

Bridge Mate Thruster Control System, üç.en: The Bridge Mate Thruster Control System uses three control computers and redundant communication networks. It is compatible with most thruster types, engines and rudders, and works integrated with autopilot and joystick systems.

Bu mimari, itici kontrol katmanının DP k.en: This architecture gives the thruster control layer a level of redundancy similar to that of the DP control layer. Loss of a single control computer must not disable propulsion control; this is proven by FMEA tests.

TCS motor markasından bağımsız çalışır v.en: The TCS works independently of the motor make and can control any type of propulsion device, including tunnel thrusters, Voith propulsion systems, azimuth pods, retractable units and waterjets.

Dağıtık mimarinin en somut çıktılarından.en: One of the most tangible results of the distributed architecture is the reduction in the number of conductors run per thruster. In the traditional approach, separate cables are run for each thruster to the DP, TCS, backup TCS, VDR, autopilot, conning, independent joystick and automation systems. In the Bridge Mate arrangement, this is markedly reduced by using common paths.

TCS motor markasından bağımsız çalışsa d.en: Although the TCS works independently of the motor make, the interface parameters are set separately for each unit. Pitch/rpm/azimuth scaling factors, ramp times, forbidden angles and derating curves are determined and recorded during commissioning. These records are the reference point for every subsequent change.

Backup thruster kontrolü ve bağımsız joy.en: The backup thruster control and the independent joystick path must be separate from the main DP/TCS path. This separation is verified not only on the drawings but also at the level of physical cable routing and power supply.

Autopilot ve joystick entegrasyonunda ko.en: For autopilot and joystick integration, the way command priority and control transfer are resolved must be compared with the FMEA. A configuration in which more than one source can give commands at the same time must be prevented by design.

İtici akıntısının gövdeye veya başka bir.en: Thruster wash striking the hull or another thruster reduces the net thrust. The forbidden angles and interaction corrections defined in the TCS are needed for DP to correctly predict the thrust it will actually obtain. If these definitions are wrong, the capability plot will also be misleading.

TCS üzerinde yapılacak her müdahale — pa.en: Any intervention on the TCS (parameter change, card replacement, software update) directly affects DP capability. Before the work, a joint assessment is made with the bridge, the redundancy group that will be affected is identified and, if necessary, the ASOG status is changed.

Dağıtık operatör istasyonları ve DP kont.en: In addition to distributed operator stations and DP control computers, the Bridge Mate system includes distributed thruster and sensor interface units based on a stand-alone IO unit specially designed for use on DP ships. Each interface unit can be located close to the thrusters, reference systems and sensors it interfaces with.

JX ve DP 0 sistemlerinde de aynı düzen g.en: The same arrangement applies in JX and DP 0 systems: the IO hardware is placed close to the thrusters, rudders, engines and sensors it interfaces with, reducing cabling and installation costs.

İki ağ kolunun fiziksel olarak ayrı güze.en: It must be verified that the two network branches follow physically separate routes and are not lost together in a single fire or flooding event. This is the basic check that shows whether dual network redundancy exists only on paper or on board.

Ağ switch'i, IP adresleme ve konfigürasy.en: Network switch, IP addressing and configuration changes must be kept under controlled change management. A seemingly minor switch replacement can, without anyone noticing, make both branches dependent on a single device.

DP bilgisayarları, operatör istasyonları.en: Uninterrupted and mutually independent control power supplies for the DP computers, operator stations, position reference systems and sensors must be verified. In the Bridge Mate architecture, the power supply of each IO unit is traced from the single-line diagram and matched with the redundancy groups.

Kısmi veya tam blackout sırasında DP kon.en: Keeping the DP control layer alive during a partial or total blackout is a precondition for controlled recovery. If the control system loses power, it stays blind for a further period equal to its restart time after power is restored, and the loss of position grows.

Arayüz ünitesinin tasarımı, Bridge Mate.en: The design of the interface unit makes the Bridge Mate system suitable for retrofit and modernization in all equipment classes. The compact design and distributed architecture keep cabling work on existing ships limited.

Mevcut gemilerde MT, DP, köprüüstü enteg.en: On existing ships, MT retrofits DP, bridge integration and thruster control systems. A midlife upgrade typically involves replacing the control computers, operator stations, network switches and software, while the existing IO cabinets and cabling infrastructure are retained.

Bridge Mate JX sistemi DP 0'a kolayca yü.en: The Bridge Mate JX system can easily be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems. Similarly, a DP 0 system can be upgraded to a higher class by adding more of the same hardware components for increased redundancy. Upgrading from DP 1 to DP 2 is also a straightforward process; the same hardware modules are used in both system types, and only the number of units differs.

DP 3 hedefleniyorsa iş yalnızca elektrik.en: If DP 3 is the target, the job is not just electrical and automation work. To meet Class 3 requirements, a physically separate, fire-resistant compartment is needed to house one control computer, one operator station and one sensor IO unit. The layout changes for the third operator station and the third IO set must be engineered early.

Yükseltme sonrası FMEA revizyonu, provin.en: The chain of FMEA revision, proving trials and class survey after the upgrade must be planned before the work is finished. Hardware and software changes can invalidate the failure mode assumptions of the old FMEA; the revision is therefore not a formality but a technical re-assessment.

Yeni sistemin devreye alınması, ekibin o.en: Commissioning a new system does not mean that the team knows it. If the operator station and HMI have changed, familiarization training and a familiarization record are required for the DPOs; on the engine side, the new fault diagnosis flows must also be learned.

Failed/slow start bulgusu ASOG statüsüne.en: A failed/slow start finding is reflected in the ASOG status and the standby sequence is updated. After the test, all selectors, breakers and alarm bypasses are returned to their operational positions.

Planlı switching için risk değerlendirme.en: For planned switching, a risk assessment is made, DPO/Master permission is obtained and, where possible, the critical activity is stopped. After switching, the PMS/DP mimic, load sharing, consequence analysis and alarm status are cross-checked.

Battery autonomy/capacity testi planlı p.en: The battery autonomy/capacity test is carried out with a planned procedure and weak cells are trended. After a bypass, two people verify that the system has returned to its normal redundant configuration.

Local/remote, emergency stop, pitch-to-z.en: The local/remote, emergency stop, pitch-to-zero and drive protection functions are returned from test status to the operational position. A derated or unavailable thruster is correctly defined in the DP model and the capability/consequence analysis is updated.

DP'nin demanded ve delivered thrust değe.en: DP demanded and delivered thrust values are trended; a low response despite a high command is investigated. No setting change is made without MOC and the approval of the Master/DPO/Chief Engineer.

Duty/standby pump auto-start, low pressu.en: Duty/standby pump auto-start and the low pressure, high temperature and strainer differential alarms are tested. The effect of ventilation, fire dampers and machinery-space flooding boundaries on the redundant groups is checked.

İş sırasında yeni alarm veya konfigürasy.en: Any new alarm or configuration change during the work is reported to DP control immediately. On completion of the work, a function test is carried out, all bypasses/isolations are removed and the consequence analysis is verified.

Failure mode FMEA ve IMCA M247 component.en: The failure mode is matched against the FMEA and the IMCA M247 component list; the possibility of a common cause is investigated. Instead of a temporary reset, a safe configuration, ASOG status and permanent corrective action are determined.

Rampa hidrolik ile maker prosedürüne gör.en: The ramp is opened/closed hydraulically according to the maker's procedure; on closing, all locking devices (locking pins/cleats) are engaged and the "secured/closed" status is verified on the indicator panel. The bow visor/door interlock system is checked.

Gemi rıhtımdan ayrılmadan rampa/bow door.en: Before the ship leaves the berth, it is verified both physically and on the indicators that the ramp/bow door is closed and secured; going to sea with a door open or partly closed creates a risk of water ingress and rapid capsize.

Araçlar CSM'deki pattern'e göre en az 4.en: Vehicles are secured at a minimum of 4 points according to the pattern in the CSM; the MSL of the chain/web lashing is selected according to vehicle weight and sea conditions. Wheel chocks and brakes are applied.

Lashing gerginliği seyir sırasında kontr.en: Lashing tension is checked during the passage; lashings that have slackened are tightened again. When heavy weather is expected, additional lashings are applied.

Rampa, rıhtım link-span ile hizalanacak.en: The ship berths so that the ramp is aligned with the shore link-span; the bow thruster and a tug (if required) are used. Mooring safety is maintained even on quick turnarounds.

DG araçlar beyan edilir, segregation tab.en: DG vehicles are declared and stowed in compliance with the segregation table; ventilation, firefighting access and EmS readiness are ensured. Vehicle engines are switched off after stowage.

Kapalı araç güvertesinde DG yangını hızl.en: On a closed vehicle deck, a DG fire spreads rapidly; segregation and access are never neglected.

Araç yüksekliği güverte clearance ile, a.en: The vehicle height is compared with the deck clearance and its weight with the deck load density; a special lashing plan is made. If unsuitable, the vehicle is not accepted.

Tek bir ağır aracın yanlış konumu lokal.en: Wrong positioning of a single heavy vehicle can cause local deck damage.

Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; rampa/LS.en: A monthly overdue report is produced; critical equipment such as the ramp/LSA/FFA is given priority. Work records are kept complete.

Sertifikalar geçerli; rampa/kapı sızdırm.en: Certificates are valid; ramp/door watertightness, LSA/FFA and the escape arrangements are checked. Previous findings are closed out.

Araç güvertesi yangını ve yolcu tahliyes.en: Vehicle deck fire and passenger abandonment scenarios are rehearsed; MES/lifeboat use, muster and passenger guidance procedures are drilled. A debrief is held.

Araç güvertesinde yaya-araç ayrımı, PPE.en: On the vehicle deck, pedestrian/vehicle separation, PPE (hi-vis, hard hat), exhaust/CO management and lashing checks are applied with standard checklists.

Güverte/rampa aydınlatması ve acil aydın.en: Deck/ramp lighting and emergency lighting (emergency lighting, low-location lighting) are tested; defective light fittings are replaced.

DSC günlük/haftalık test edilir; EPIRB/S.en: DSC is tested daily/weekly; the EPIRB/SART are checked periodically. AIS data accuracy is checked.

Araç elleçleme sırasında ventilasyon tam.en: During vehicle handling, the ventilation runs at full capacity; CO levels are monitored. On a closed deck, inadequate ventilation causes a lethal buildup of CO.

Çalışan motorlar hızla CO biriktirir; ve.en: Running engines build up CO quickly; entry of personnel without ventilation is dangerous.

Ağır araçlar uygun güverteye/eksene yerl.en: Heavy vehicles are stowed on the appropriate deck/axis; the deck load density is not exceeded. Access and maneuvering space are maintained according to the discharge port sequence. A vehicle count (tally) is made.

Yanlış yerleştirme hem stabiliteyi bozar.en: Wrong stowage both impairs stability and causes delays in discharging.

Tüm olaylar, tatbikatlar ve kontroller z.en: All events, drills and checks are entered in time; statutory mandatory entries are complete and signed.

Sürekli look-out yapılır; risk radar/ARP.en: A continuous look-out is kept; risk is assessed by radar/ARPA and visually, and early and substantial maneuvers are made. On busy ferry routes, traffic separation is complied with.

Halatlar aşınma/kesik açısından denetlen.en: Mooring lines are inspected for wear/cuts; fender condition is checked. Because of the frequent operations, the retirement criteria are closely monitored.

Acil durum görevleri ve istasyonlar atan.en: Emergency duties and stations are assigned; on passenger ships, passenger guidance/counting duties are added. The list is updated at crew change and familiarization is carried out.

Araç güvertesine su girişi büyük serbest.en: Water entering the vehicle deck rapidly reduces GM through a large free surface effect; therefore door/ramp watertightness is part of stability. The loading condition must meet the intact and damage criteria.

Araç güvertesinde su birikmesi (water on.en: Water accumulating on the vehicle deck (water on deck) is the main cause of Ro-Ro capsizes; drainage and watertightness are managed together.

Fire door ve watertight door'ların kapan.en: Closing and securing of fire doors and watertight doors are tested; the drencher/sprinkler system (vehicle deck) must be ready. Status is monitored on the indicator panel.

Araç güvertesi yangını hızla yayılır; bö.en: A vehicle deck fire spreads rapidly; subdivision and the drencher are the critical defense.

Rubber seal/conta hasar açısından denetl.en: Rubber seals/gaskets are inspected for damage; the locking devices must close fully and compression must be achieved. Drainage and bilge alarm systems are tested.

Sızdıran rampa/kapı, araç güvertesine su.en: A leaking ramp/door leads to water ingress onto the vehicle deck and rapid loss of stability; watertightness is verified before going to sea.

ENC güncellenir; safety parametreleri dr.en: ENCs are updated; safety parameters are set according to the draft. On tightly scheduled routes, contingencies are defined for heavy traffic and narrow passages.

Sertifikalı ladder, manrope, life-buoy v.en: The arrangement is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, lifebuoy and lighting, and verified with a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.

Yanlış kurulum ölümcüldür; her bileşen k.en: Incorrect rigging is fatal; every component is checked.

Trim, rampa eğimini araç geçişi için uyg.en: Trim is adjusted to keep the ramp slope suitable for vehicle passage; excessive list upsets vehicle stability. Checked with the loadicator; BWTS active (D-2).

Araç ağırlıkları, DG beyanları ve çıkış.en: Vehicle weights, DG declarations and discharge ports are entered in the manifest; consistency with the actual cargo is verified. DG vehicles are additionally checked for segregation.

Silindir ve hortumlar sızıntı açısından.en: Cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks; the full closing/opening sequence of the locking actuators is tested. Hydraulic oil cleanliness is checked and a pressure test is carried out.

Rampa kilitleri tam kapanmazsa sızdırmaz.en: If the ramp locking devices do not close fully, watertightness and ship safety are compromised; hydraulic maintenance is an inseparable part of door watertightness.

Pervane (CPP ise pitch kontrolü), yağlam.en: The propeller (pitch control if CPP), lubrication and seals are inspected; the drive motor/insulation and the controls are tested. A function test is carried out before maneuvering.

Bow thruster arızası sık manevra yapan f.en: On a ferry that maneuvers frequently, a bow thruster failure makes berthing seriously more difficult.

Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve.en: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and safety valve tests are carried out; air bottles are subject to periodic inspection.

Sık manevrada yetersiz starting air ana.en: With frequent maneuvering, insufficient starting air creates a risk of being unable to start the main engine.

CO2 boğulma riski taşır; release yalnız.en: CO2 carries a risk of asphyxiation; release is made only after the space has been cleared and a head count taken.

Yakıt/mesafe ile yıllık CII hesaplanır (.en: The annual CII is calculated from fuel/distance (A-E); SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures.

Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV doz izleni.en: After the pre-flow test, the TRO/UV dose is monitored; the system operates during ballasting/deballasting and the operation is recorded in the BWRB.

Makine ısıtılır, yakıt geçişi yapılır, h.en: The engine is warmed up, the fuel changeover is made, the air receivers are full and the telegraph test is carried out. With frequent maneuvering, discipline in preparation is particularly important.

Paralele alırken frekans/voltaj/faz eşit.en: When paralleling, frequency/voltage/phase are matched; enough DGs are kept on line for sudden loads such as the ramp/thrusters. A black-out test is carried out.

Yanlış faz şaft/kuplaj kırabilir; insula.en: Paralleling out of phase can break a shaft/coupling; insulation is measured.

Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug.en: A pre-bunker meeting is held; scupper plugs and SOPEP equipment are ready. The initial rate is slow and topping-up is done manually. Ullages are monitored.

Mühürlü MARPOL numunesi alınır ve saklan.en: A sealed MARPOL sample is taken and retained; the BDN is verified and entered in the record book.

Salinometer ile tuzluluk izlenir; kıyı/l.en: Salinity is monitored with the salinometer; production is stopped near the coast/in port because of contamination. Disinfection is applied.

Fanlar belirlenen hava değişim oranını s.en: The fans run at a capacity that provides the specified air change rate; they are operated at full capacity during vehicle handling and at the required rate at sea. A fan failure is indicated by an alarm.

Yetersiz ventilasyon CO birikimi ve yakı.en: Inadequate ventilation creates a risk of CO buildup and of explosion caused by fuel vapor; the system is kept in continuous working order.

Trim/heeling pompası ile ballast hızlı t.en: Ballast is transferred quickly with the trim/heeling pump; list/trim is brought to the target. Pump seal/bearing maintenance is done according to the PMS.

Yük planının başlangıç noktası charter p.en: The starting point of the cargo plan is the charter party terms and the cargo nomination. The nomination specifies the number of parcels, the quantity of each parcel (bbl/MT), its API/density, the temperature requirement and the sequence of loading/discharge ports. The Chief Officer compares this information with the tank capacity tables (sounding/ullage tables) to work out which parcel will fit into which tank group.

Multi-grade (çoklu parsel) yüklerde her.en: For multi-grade (multiple parcel) cargoes, each parcel must be carried by a separate cargo system (pump, line, valve set) and segregated so as to prevent mixing (commingling). The use of slop tanks and intermediate tanks affects the integrity of the plan.

Tanklar asla %100 doldurulmaz; ısınma ka.en: Tanks are never filled to 100%; an allowance is left for thermal expansion. Typically 98% filling is targeted, and the expansion is calculated according to the type of cargo, the loading temperature and the temperature rise expected during the voyage. Overfilling creates a risk of overflow and of MARPOL violation.

Yük planının her ara aşaması (her tank d.en: Every intermediate stage of the cargo plan (each tank filling step) is simulated on the loadicator/loading computer. At each step, the shear force (SF), bending moment (BM), trim, draft (FP/AP/Mid), GM and list values are checked. Values are kept below the harbor and seagoing limits; the alarm band above 85% is a signal to revise the plan.

Slack (yarı dolu) tanklar serbest yüzey.en: Slack (partly filled) tanks reduce GM through the free surface effect (FSC). The plan is designed to keep the number of slack tanks as low as possible and not to leave more than one tank slack at the same time.

Final kondisyon yalnız intact değil, MAR.en: The final condition must meet not only the intact stability criteria but also the damage stability criteria under MARPOL Annex I Reg. 28. Side/bottom damage scenarios are checked with the loadicator damage case module. Print-outs are kept; they may be requested during PSC and SIRE inspections.

Yükleme üç aşamada planlanır: initial (d.en: Loading is planned in three stages: initial (low rate, line filling and static electricity control), bulk (full rate up to the terminal limit) and topping-up (rate reduced as the final ullage approaches). The topping-up sequence defines which tank will be closed last and how the final ullage measurement will be taken.

Boşaltma planı; pompa line-up'ını, termi.en: The discharge plan includes the pump line-up, the terminal rate limit, tank stripping without MARPOL violation and ROB (remaining on board) measurement. At the end of discharge, the tank bottoms are stripped with the eductor/stripping pump and the lines are drained.

Plan, terminal temsilcisi ile pre-transf.en: The plan is reviewed jointly with the terminal representative at the pre-transfer meeting; rate limits, ESD procedure, communication channels and emergency stop criteria are agreed. The Master gives final approval and all cargo officers are briefed on the plan. Everyone attending the briefing signs.

Operasyon sırasında parsel değişikliği,.en: If a parcel change, rate restriction or suspected contamination occurs during the operation, the plan is revised; the loadicator is run again and the revised plan is approved again. Every revision is recorded with date/time.

Onaylı cargo plan, loadicator çıktıları,.en: The approved cargo plan, loadicator print-outs, ullage reports and change records are filed. These records serve as evidence both for internal audits and for SIRE/CDI/PSC inspections.

İyi bir yük planı sadece \"ne kadar yükl.en: A good cargo plan shows not only "how much will be loaded" but also "what is happening to the ship at every moment"; that is why verification of the intermediate stages is more critical than the final condition.

Bağlantıdan önce manifold flanşları, con.en: Before connection, the manifold flanges, gaskets, bolts and drip tray are visually inspected. The correct manifold is selected for the parcel to be handled; unused manifolds are closed with blank (blind) flanges with the full number of bolts. Spill containment (drip trays) and scupper plugs must be in place.

Hortumlar kargo cinsine ve basınca uygun.en: Hoses must be suitable for the type of cargo and the pressure, certified and within their test date. If a cool-arm (chiksan/loading arm) is used, it is verified that it stays within its operating envelope and that the drift/limit alarms work.

Manifold bolt'ları yıldız (çapraz) sıray.en: Manifold bolts are tightened in a star (cross) pattern, with the torque applied in stages; tightening on one side only crushes the gasket and causes a leak. All bolt holes must be filled; a connection must never be made with bolts missing.

Gemi-kıyı arasında potansiyel farkı ve s.en: To prevent a potential difference and static sparks between ship and shore, the use of a bonding cable and/or an insulating flange is arranged in accordance with ISGOTT. Most modern terminals prefer an insulating flange; a wrongly applied bonding cable can create cathodic current problems.

Emergency Shutdown (ESD) link ve dry-bre.en: The Emergency Shutdown (ESD) link and the dry-break (emergency release) coupling are checked; it is verified that in an emergency release the line will separate safely and without spillage. The ESD activation time must be within the maker's specification.

Manifold, tanker güvenliğinin en yoğun r.en: The manifold is the point of highest risk concentration for tanker safety; the essential thing here is not to hurry but to verify each flange one by one.

SIRE 2.0; sabit soru setinden, gemiye/du.en: SIRE 2.0 has moved from a fixed question set to a dynamic question set specific to the ship and situation, with real-time reporting by the inspector on a tablet. The hardware, process and human (behavior) aspects are assessed separately.

VPQ (Vessel Particulars Questionnaire) v.en: The VPQ (Vessel Particulars Questionnaire) and HVPQ are kept up to date; a self-assessment is carried out against the SIRE 2.0 chapters. Previous PSC/SIRE findings must have been closed out and evidenced.

Crew matrix, eğitim kayıtları, sertifika.en: The crew matrix, training records, certificates and evidence of familiarization are prepared. Deck/manifold cleanliness, labeling, SOPEP equipment and safety equipment are checked.

CDI; kargo uyumluluğu, coating dayanımı,.en: CDI focuses on cargo compatibility, coating resistance, segregation and chemical safety procedures. The IBC Code and the ship-specific P&A Manual are the reference documents.

CDI questionnaire güncel tutulur; P&A Ma.en: The CDI questionnaire is kept up to date; the P&A Manual, coating list and compatibility tables must be accessible. The records of the last three cargoes and of tank cleaning are checked.

SBT, kargo tanklarından tamamen ayrıdır.en: SBT is completely separate from the cargo tanks and never mixes with cargo. Deballasting is done during loading and ballasting during discharge; each step is checked with the loadicator for SF/BM/GM.

Ballast alımı/değişimi BWTS aktif şekild.en: Ballasting/ballast exchange is carried out with the BWTS active, in compliance with the D-2 standard; the operation is recorded in the Ballast Water Record Book (BWRB).

Yarı dolu (slack) tanklar serbest yüzey.en: Partly filled (slack) tanks cause a virtual loss of GM through the free surface effect. More than one slack tank at the same time can lead to a critical loss of GM; the plan therefore limits the number of slack tanks.

MARPOL Reg. 28 kapsamında yan/dip yarala.en: Side/bottom damage scenarios under MARPOL Reg. 28 are checked with the loadicator damage module; the final condition must meet both the intact and the damage criteria.

ESD link, gemi ve terminalin acil durdur.en: The ESD link allows the ship and the terminal to share emergency shutdown signals; on activation, the pumps stop and the valves close in a safe sequence. Because rapid closure can create a pressure surge, the closing time must be within the maker's specification.

Transfer öncesi ESD aktivasyonu test edi.en: ESD activation is tested before transfer; it is verified that the system stops the pumps/closes the valves in the correct sequence. The result is entered in the ESD test log.

Bir madde sağlanamıyorsa transfere başla.en: If an item cannot be met, transfer is not started, or a transfer already under way is stopped. A missing or wrongly completed checklist is both a safety risk and a reason for PSC detention.

ENC kataloğu güncellenir (NtM, T&P), saf.en: The ENC catalog is updated (NtM, T&P); the safety contour, safety depth and shallow contour are set according to the ship's draft + UKC. With the check route function, no-go area, shoal and prohibited area warnings are assessed one by one.

Seyir boyunca XTD (cross-track distance).en: Throughout the passage, XTD (cross-track distance), wheel-over points and UKC are monitored; deviations are corrected early. The plan is approved by the Master.

STS operasyonu onaylı bir STS plan ve ri.en: The STS operation is carried out under an approved STS plan and risk assessment. The POAC has overall advisory control; the Masters of the two ships retain responsibility for their own ships. Weather/sea limits and abort criteria are defined in advance.

Yokohama fender'lar ve mooring pattern,.en: Yokohama fenders and the mooring pattern keep the two ships at a safe distance from each other. The berthing maneuver is made at low speed and under control. After the hoses are connected, a leak test is carried out.

Transfer süresince her iki gemide rate,.en: Throughout the transfer, rate, pressure, mooring line tension and weather are monitored on both ships; if an abort criterion is exceeded, a safe stop is made with the ESD.

Pilot geldiğinde Master ile manevra plan.en: When the pilot boards, the maneuvering plan (number of tugs, approach angle, speed, mooring sequence, manifold target) is shared with the Master. Tug lines are made fast safely through the panama chock and on the bitts.

Mooring head/breast/spring sırasıyla ver.en: Mooring lines are sent out in the order head/breast/spring. Line tension and snap-back zones are managed in accordance with MEG4; personnel do not stand in the snap-back zone.

Otomatik sistem (radar/CPAS) ile manuel.en: Automatic system (radar/CPAS) and manual (CTS) measurements are compared periodically; if there is a deviation, the system calibration is questioned. Custody transfer measurements are usually taken together with the shore surveyor.

Ölçülen ullage, geminin trim ve list değ.en: The measured ullage is corrected for the ship's trim and list using the trim correction in the tank calibration tables. The corrected ullage gives the gross observed volume (GOV) from the ullage table.

GOV, ortalama sıcaklık ve density ile AS.en: Using the average temperature and density and the ASTM/API tables (e.g. 54B/6B), the GOV is converted to gross standard volume (GSV) and to weight (vacuum/air). This value is the basis of the B/L and the cargo measurement report.

Manuel ölçümde dahi vapour'a maruz kalma.en: Even in manual gauging there is a risk of exposure to vapor; correct PPE (gas detector, suitable respiratory protection when required) and standing upwind are essential. Additional precautions are taken with cargoes containing H2S.

Sertifikalı pilot ladder, manrope, stanc.en: The certified pilot ladder is rigged with manropes, stanchions, lifebuoy and lighting; if required, a combination ladder (accommodation ladder + pilot ladder) is arranged. The rigging is done under the supervision of the responsible officer and verified with a checklist.

Kötü bakımlı basamak, yanlış sabitleme v.en: Poorly maintained steps, incorrect securing or insufficient lighting are fatal. Personnel stand by when the pilot boards or disembarks.

VR return line, vapour coupling ile bağl.en: The VR return line is connected with a vapor coupling; bonding is ensured and a flame arrester is fitted in the line. The flame arrester prevents flashback from shore to ship.

Vapour line patlayıcı karışım taşır; fla.en: The vapor line carries an explosive mixture; the flame arrester and pressure management are critical. The rate must not exceed the capacity of the VR line.

Sıvının türbülanslı akışı, serbest düşüş.en: Turbulent flow of the liquid, free fall, water droplets and filters generate static charge. Working at a low rate, especially in the first minutes of loading, limits the buildup.

Statik biriktiren kargolarda ölçüm/örnek.en: For static accumulator cargoes, the specified waiting (settling) times are observed before gauging/sampling; bonding is checked before metallic tools are lowered into the tank.

Smoke ve heat dedektörleri ile sample ex.en: Smoke and heat detectors and sample extraction systems (cargo hold) are tested periodically; correct zone indication on the alarm panel is verified.

Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar personeli duy.en: Repeated false alarms desensitize personnel; the root cause (dust, humidity, sensor age) is analyzed and eliminated.

P/V valf setpoint'i (yay gerginliği) per.en: The P/V valve setpoint (spring tension) is tested periodically; the flame screen is cleaned. A P/V valve stuck closed leads to tank rupture when pressure builds up.

IGS otomatik basınç kontrolü kalibre edi.en: The IGS automatic pressure control is calibrated; the tank is always kept at positive pressure. A sensor/actuator failure must be indicated by an alarm.

Coating hasarları onarılır; katodik koru.en: Coating damage is repaired; cathodic protection measurements are taken. Corrosion threatens structural integrity over time.

Yıldırım radarı ve hava raporları izleni.en: The lightning detection radar and weather reports are monitored; if lightning comes within the specified distance (e.g. < 5 NM), the transfer is stopped. Strong wind (gusts) is assessed with regard to mooring and hose tension.

Transfer durdurma kararı terminal ile ko.en: The decision to stop the transfer is taken in coordination with the terminal; lightning is the greatest risk while venting is in progress and the manifold is open.

Yangın (cargo deck dahil), SOPEP/spill v.en: Fire (including cargo deck), SOPEP/spill and MOB drills are held at the specified frequency; the scenarios are designed to be realistic and ship-specific. After each drill, the debrief and improvement notes are recorded.

SOPEP ekipmanı (absorbentler, scupper pl.en: SOPEP equipment (absorbents, scupper plugs, shovels, drums, etc.) is kept readily accessible; the notification list (coastal State, company) must be up to date.

Geminin ölçümünden (ship figure) elde ed.en: The quantity obtained from the ship's measurement (ship figure) is compared with the shore measurement (shore figure). If the difference exceeds the specified tolerance (e.g. 0.5%), a Letter of Protest is issued; otherwise the defense against later cargo claims is weakened.

B/L Master/yetkili tarafından imzalanır;.en: The B/L is signed by the Master or an authorized person; a clean B/L is not signed until quantity, description and condition have been verified. A wrong or unsigned B/L has serious commercial and legal consequences.

Kâğıt haritalarda düzeltmeler standart y.en: On paper charts, corrections are entered by the standard method (violet ink); in ECDIS, ENC updates are applied. T&P (temporary & preliminary) notices are also followed.

Chart correction log, harita güncelliğin.en: The chart correction log is the evidence that the charts are up to date; PSC may ask for this record and for the number of the last NtM applied.

Tank içi sıcaklık homojen değildir; özel.en: The temperature inside a tank is not uniform; there is a vertical gradient, especially in heated cargoes. Therefore readings are taken at top/middle/bottom points and a weighted average is calculated. A closed-system portable electronic thermometer (MMC type) is preferred.

Density numune üzerinden hidrometre (are.en: Density is determined on a sample by hydrometer (areometer) or by a laboratory method; the shore certificate of analysis (certificate of quality) is often used as the reference. The measurement temperature is recorded, because density depends on temperature.

Gross observed volume (GOV), ortalama sı.en: From the gross observed volume (GOV), the average temperature and the standard density, the gross standard volume (GSV) is obtained using ASTM table 54B; it is converted to weight (MT vacuum/air) with the WCF (weight correction factor).

Sıcak kargolarda (fuel oil, asfalt) ölçü.en: With hot cargoes (fuel oil, asphalt) there is a risk of splashes and burns during measurement; suitable PPE is essential. The results are entered in the cargo measurement report.

Yanma için yakıt (HC buharı), oksijen ve.en: Combustion requires fuel (HC vapor), oxygen and an ignition source. The IGS removes one side of this triangle by bringing the oxygen below the critical threshold. Below 8% O2, an HC/air mixture will not explode; in practice 5% is targeted as a safety margin.

Flue gas; scrubber'da soğutulur ve SOx/p.en: The flue gas is cooled in the scrubber and cleaned of SOx/particulates. The deck water seal is the critical barrier preventing gas backflow from the cargo tanks to the engine room; its water level is monitored continuously. A deck seal that runs dry creates a risk of backflow and explosion.

IGS startup; scrubber su akışı, deck sea.en: IGS startup is carried out with a checklist covering scrubber water supply, deck seal level, O2 analyzer calibration and blower start-up. Before inert gas is delivered to the tanks, the outlet O2 value (< 5%) is verified.

Boşaltma sırasında tank seviyesi düştükç.en: During discharge, inert gas takes the place of the cargo as the tank level falls; the tank is kept at positive pressure (typically around +200 mmWG). Negative pressure can lead to ingress of outside air and implosion of the tank.

P/V (pressure/vacuum) valfleri tankı aşı.en: P/V (pressure/vacuum) valves protect the tank against overpressure and vacuum; their flame screens are kept clean. The low pressure, high O2 and deck seal alarms must be active and tested.

IGS arızası kargo operasyonunu durdurma.en: An IGS failure is a reason to stop cargo operations; no loading/discharge is carried out unless the system is working safely.

COW; clingage (duvara yapışan yağ) mikta.en: COW increases outturn (the quantity discharged) by reducing clingage (oil adhering to the tank walls), and reduces the need for water washing and therefore the amount of slops. MARPOL makes COW mandatory for crude oil tankers above a certain tonnage.

COW yalnız tank O2'si %8'in altında iken.en: COW is carried out only when the tank O2 is below 8%. COW carried out with high O2 can lead to an explosion caused by static electricity sparks.

COW Manual'a göre tank washing makineler.en: According to the COW Manual, a single-stage or multi-stage washing pattern is selected for the tank washing machines; machine angles (top/bottom wash) and durations are set for each tank. The bottom wash directs the sediment at the bottom toward the stripping suction.

Yıkama, boşaltmanın uygun aşamasında baş.en: Washing is started at the appropriate stage of discharge; records are kept for each tank before, during and after washing. The hydrocarbon/oxygen level and line pressure are monitored. Because crude oil is used instead of wash water, the tank bottom is stripped continuously.

Makinelerin döndüğü (rotasyon kontrolü).en: It is verified that the machines are rotating (rotation check) and that the nozzles are not blocked; low pressure or a machine that does not rotate prevents effective washing.

COW, doğru yapıldığında çevresel ve tica.en: When carried out correctly, COW brings environmental and commercial gains; but the inert atmosphere requirement is a precondition without exception.

İlk akış düşük rate ile başlatılır; hatl.en: The initial flow is started at a low rate; it is verified that the lines lead to the correct tank, that there are no leaks and that static electricity buildup stays limited. The low rate in the first ~30 minutes is critical with regard to static electricity.

Hat doğrulandıktan sonra terminal limiti.en: Once the line has been verified, the rate is increased to the bulk rate, up to the terminal limit; IGS positive pressure is maintained. When a tank is 90% full, the rate is reduced to the topping-up rate and the final ullage is followed by manual/closed gauging.

Yükleme sırasında yer değiştiren tank at.en: During loading, the displaced tank atmosphere is discharged through venting/vapor return; the rate must not exceed the venting capacity, otherwise overpressure occurs and the P/V valves are overstressed.

Yükleme sonunda hatlar son tanka veya te.en: At the end of loading, the lines are cleared toward the last tank or the terminal (line clearing); cargo left in the line can cause contamination in the next operation.

Boşaltmadan önce pompa-hat-valf hattı (l.en: Before discharge, the pump-line-valve line-up is verified; a wrong valve position causes contamination or a pressure surge. Air is removed by priming the pump, preventing cavitation.

Discharge rate terminal kabul limitini a.en: The discharge rate does not exceed the terminal's acceptance limit. As the tank level falls, the pump suction conditions become more difficult; cavitation (vapor bubbles caused by vacuum) damages the pump. Therefore the rate is reduced in the final stage and stripping is started.

Eductor veya stripper pompası ile tank d.en: The tank bottoms and lines are given a final stripping with the eductor or stripping pump. At the end of discharge, the quantity remaining in each tank (ROB) is measured and reported; a high ROB causes commercial loss and cargo claims.

Inert (oksijensiz, HC'li) bir tank doğru.en: If an inert (oxygen-free, HC-containing) tank is ventilated directly with air, the HC concentration passes through the flammable range (critical dilution line) as it goes from rich to lean, and since oxygen is also entering, an explosive atmosphere is formed. To prevent this, the tank is first purged with inert gas to bring the HC well below the flammable limit (e.g. < 2% by volume); only then is air introduced.

Purge aşamasında inert gaz ile HC seyrel.en: In the purging stage, the HC is diluted with inert gas; then, by ventilating with air, the O2 is brought to 21% and the HC below the LFL (1% LFL). In all stages, continuous gas measurement at multiple points (O2, HC/LEL, and H2S and benzene if required) is carried out.

Gas free certificate alınmadan tanka gir.en: No tank entry is made before a gas free certificate has been obtained. The enclosed space entry permit includes the conditions of continuous gas measurement, standby personnel, communication, a rescue plan and continued ventilation. Regular enclosed space entry/rescue drills are held under SOLAS III/19.

Tank yıkama suları ve COW kalıntıları sl.en: Tank washings and COW residues are collected in the slop tank; oil and water separate over time (settling). The slop level and the oil/water interface are monitored.

Mümkün olduğunda slop'taki yağ fazı, bir.en: Where possible, the oil phase in the slop tank is recovered by loading the next cargo on top of it (load-on-top); this gives both environmental and commercial advantages.

Mechanical seal ve bearing PMS aralıklar.en: The mechanical seal and bearings are replaced at PMS intervals; the impeller is inspected for wear/erosion. Vibration analysis is used for early fault detection.

Kapasite testi, discharge sırasında rate.en: The capacity test is done by measuring the rate during discharge; reduced performance indicates seal/impeller wear. A high rate at low level causes cavitation.

Hidrolik yağ analiz edilir; seal sızıntı.en: The hydraulic oil is analyzed; seal leakage (cofferdam drain) is monitored, because hydraulic oil mixing with the cargo causes contamination. Motor insulation is measured periodically.

Cofferdam drain'de hidrolik yağ tespiti.en: Hydraulic oil found at the cofferdam drain is an early sign of seal failure; neglecting it leads to cargo claims.

Jacket water sıcaklığı yeterli olduğunda.en: The evaporator is run when the jacket water temperature is high enough (e.g. > 50°C); salinity is monitored with the salinometer (e.g. < 10 ppm). Production is stopped in port/near the coast because of contamination.

Potable su için dezenfeksiyon (klorlama/.en: Disinfection (chlorination/UV) and mineralization are applied to potable water; periodic bacteriological tests are carried out.

OWS'i bypass eden herhangi bir düzenek (.en: If any arrangement that bypasses the OWS (magic pipe) is detected, heavy fines and imprisonment follow; ORB I entries must be consistent with the actual situation.

Piston, liner, yatak ve fuel injection e.en: Pistons, liners, bearings and fuel injection equipment are overhauled according to running hours; clearance and wear measurements are recorded. Turbocharger cleaning and balancing maintain performance.

DG'ler paralele alınırken frekans, volta.en: When DGs are paralleled, frequency, voltage and phase sequence are matched; faulty synchronization causes mechanical damage through sudden torque. Load sharing must be balanced.

Black-out recovery testi periyodik yapıl.en: The black-out recovery test is carried out periodically; insulation resistance is measured. Automatic standby start and preferential tripping must work correctly.

Her operasyon ilgili kodla işlenir; giri.en: Each operation is entered with the relevant code; entries are made in time and each page is signed by the Master. The records must be consistent with the actual situation (soundings, tank contents).

PSC, ORB ile fiziksel kanıtı karşılaştır.en: PSC compares the ORB with the physical evidence; any inconsistency is grounds for detention and prosecution.

Sludge tank sounding düzenli alınır; ber.en: Sludge tank soundings are taken regularly; disposal is by incinerator or shore reception facility. The incinerator flame failure trip must work properly.

Incinerator çalışırken flame failure tri.en: While the incinerator is running, the flame failure trip and the emission limits (MARPOL VI) are monitored.

Purifier disc'leri belirli çalışma saati.en: Purifier discs are cleaned at the specified running hours; auto back-flush and ΔP are monitored on the filters. When working with hot HFO there is a risk of splashes/burns.

Sıcak HFO açığa çıkarsa ciddi yanık yapa.en: Hot HFO causes serious burns if released; isolation and PPE are ensured before maintenance.

Nitrit/pH/kloride değerleri haftalık tes.en: Nitrite/pH/chloride values are tested weekly; the correct inhibitor dosing prevents corrosion. Cooler cleaning maintains heat transfer.

Bakımda CIP kimyasalları kullanılırsa SD.en: If CIP chemicals are used during maintenance, PPE in accordance with the SDS is mandatory.

Limandan ayrılmadan önce (12 saat içinde.en: The main steering gear is tested before leaving port (within 12 hours); emergency steering and communications are verified by the emergency steering drill held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). Hydraulic oil cleanliness (ISO 4406) is monitored.

Yüksek basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı cilt alt.en: A high-pressure hydraulic leak can inject oil under the skin; the system is depressurized for maintenance.

CO2/foam sistemi yıllık ve 5 yıllık test.en: The CO2/foam system is subject to annual and 5-yearly tests; portable extinguishers, quick-closing valves, fire dampers and emergency stops are tested. Before CO2 release, the space is cleared of personnel and the lockout is applied.

CO2 deşarjı boğulma riski taşır; release.en: CO2 discharge carries a risk of asphyxiation; release is made only after the space has been completely cleared and a head count taken. The lockout system prevents accidental discharge.

Scrubber temizliği, deck seal su seviyes.en: Scrubber cleaning, deck seal water level checks and O2 analyzer calibration are carried out regularly. Blower bearings/vibration are monitored.

IGS düzgün çalışmadan kargo operasyonu y.en: Cargo operations cannot be carried out unless the IGS is working properly; the maintenance plan is coordinated with the cargo program.

Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO (total residu.en: After the pre-flow test, the TRO (total residual oxidant) or UV dose is monitored; the system operates during ballasting/deballasting. The operation is recorded in the BWRB.

Electrochlorination ünitelerinde açığa ç.en: Hydrogen released in electrochlorination units forms an explosive atmosphere without proper ventilation; venting and gas monitoring are critical.

Scrubber'lı gemilerde wash water pH/PAH/.en: On ships with scrubbers, wash water pH/PAH/turbidity is monitored; ships without scrubbers use compliant fuel (e.g. 0.5% sulfur). In areas where open loop is restricted, the appropriate mode is selected.

Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; kritik e.en: A monthly overdue report is produced; overdue jobs on critical equipment are closed immediately or justified. Maintenance records (hours, parts, measurements) are kept complete.

Kritik ekipman overdue'ları ISM uygunsuz.en: Overdue jobs on critical equipment create an ISM non-conformity (NC); class surveys rely on the PMS records.

Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve.en: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and safety valve tests are carried out regularly; the air bottles are subject to periodic internal inspection. Oil carry-over creates a fire/explosion risk.

Basınçlı hava cilde enjekte olabilir; ba.en: Compressed air can be injected into the skin; during maintenance the system is depressurized and isolated.

Sensörler periyodik kalibre edilir; alar.en: Sensors are calibrated periodically; alarm points and the dead-man alarm are tested. In UMS mode, the transfer of alarms to the bridge/cabins is verified.

Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar gerçek alarmı.en: Repeated false alarms lead to real alarms being missed; the root cause is eliminated and alarm suppression is recorded.

Kazan suyu testleri (pH, kloride, fosfat.en: Boiler water tests (pH, chloride, phosphate, etc.) are carried out regularly; deposits are removed by daily blowdown. Soot blowing prevents soot buildup.

Kurum birikimi soot fire riski yaratır;.en: Soot buildup creates a risk of soot fire; safety valve testing secures the last line of protection against overpressure.

Seal ve bearing PMS'e göre yenilenir; ka.en: Seals and bearings are renewed according to the PMS; performance is verified with a capacity test. Line segregation is maintained so that the SBT does not become contaminated with oil.

SBT kontaminasyonu ağır MARPOL ihlalidir.en: Contamination of the SBT is a serious MARPOL violation; line segregation is strictly maintained during maintenance.

Recip stripper'da valve clearance ayarla.en: On a reciprocating stripper, the valve clearance is adjusted; on an eductor stripper, nozzle wear is checked. A worn nozzle reduces suction efficiency.

İyi stripping düşük ROB demektir; bu hem.en: Good stripping means a low ROB; this is both a commercial and an environmental gain.

CIP (cleaning in place) periyodik yapılı.en: CIP (cleaning in place) is carried out periodically; in plate-type exchangers, the plates are inspected for wear/cracks. Suitable PPE is essential for CIP chemicals.

CIP kimyasalları aşındırıcıdır; SDS'e gö.en: CIP chemicals are corrosive; PPE and ventilation are provided in accordance with the SDS.

Viscometer periyodik kalibre edilir ve f.en: The viscometer is calibrated periodically and its filter is cleaned; the viscosity control loop is verified together with the fuel heater.

Yanlış viskozite enjektör/pompa hasarı y.en: Wrong viscosity damages injectors/pumps; calibration is never neglected.

Heating coil sızıntı testi yapılır (karg.en: Heating coils are leak tested (a water/steam leak into the cargo causes contamination). The heat-up rate is applied in a controlled manner according to the cargo instructions; the temperature is kept within the target range.

Aşırı ısıtma kargonun flashpoint'ine yak.en: Overheating brings the cargo close to its flashpoint and causes it to deteriorate; the upper temperature limit is monitored.

Operasyon öncesi pre-bunker toplantısı y.en: A pre-bunker meeting is held before the operation; the sequential tank plan, rate and emergency stop are agreed. The initial flow is started slowly and topping-up is controlled manually. Scupper plugs and bonding are ensured.

MARPOL numunesi mühürlü olarak alınır ve.en: The MARPOL sample is taken sealed and retained for the specified period (e.g. 12 months). The BDN contents are verified and entered in ORB I with the appropriate code (Code H).

Yolcular boarding pass ve ISPS güvenlik.en: Passengers go through boarding pass checks and ISPS security screening and are entered in the manifest. The flow on and off the ship is organized with gangway safety and crowd management.

Gemideki yolcu/personel sayısı her zaman.en: The number of passengers/personnel on board must always be current and accurate; in an emergency, the manifest is the basis of search and rescue (persons with special needs are marked).

Brifing; alarm sinyalleri, muster statio.en: The briefing covers the alarm signals, the muster station, donning the lifejacket and the escape route; it is reinforced via cabin TV and the public address/video. It is given shortly after departure.

Yolcular acil durumda ilk kez öğrenmemel.en: Passengers must not learn this for the first time in an emergency; the briefing must be early and easy to understand.

IS Code yolcu gemileri için passenger cr.en: For passenger ships, the IS Code includes heeling moment criteria for passenger crowding (passengers gathering on one side) and for turning. Passenger/baggage weight is allowed for using standard assumptions.

Yolcu gemilerinde stabilite kriterleri e.en: On passenger ships, the stability criteria are stricter because of the additional (crowding/turning) moments.

Lifeboat/davit, life raft (servis tarihi.en: Lifeboats/davits, liferafts (service date), lifejackets and the MES are subject to periodic testing/maintenance; release gear maintenance is done according to the maker's procedure. It is verified that the capacity is sufficient for the number of passengers.

Yolcu gemisinde LSA eksikliği toplu can.en: On a passenger ship, an LSA deficiency means a risk of mass loss of life; maintenance allows no compromise.

Smoke/heat dedektörleri, sprinkler ve A-.en: Smoke/heat detectors, sprinklers and A-class boundary/fire door systems are tested; zone indication on the alarm panel is verified. Coverage in passenger spaces must be complete.

Yolcu gemisi yangınında erken algılama v.en: In a passenger ship fire, early detection and subdivision prevent mass loss of life.

PRM tahliyesi önceden planlanmazsa genel.en: If the escape of PRM passengers is not planned in advance, it also slows down the escape of everyone else.

Yolcu/bagaj X-ray ve metal detektör ile.en: Passengers/baggage are screened by X-ray and metal detector; unauthorized entry is prevented by access control points. Measures are stepped up according to the security level.

Ağır hava beklentisinde açık güverteler/.en: When heavy weather is expected, open decks/pools are closed and outdoor activities are stopped. Passengers are warned by announcement, and movable items are secured.

Yolcu alanları, kaymaz yüzey ve korkuluk.en: Passenger areas are maintained with attention to non-slip surfaces and railing safety; wet floors are marked. Paint/corrosion maintenance is carried out regularly.

Radar/ECDIS/AIS fonksiyon testleri ve ka.en: Radar/ECDIS/AIS function tests and calibration are carried out; the sensor (gyro/GPS/log) inputs are verified. Back-up equipment is kept in working order.

DSC günlük/haftalık test edilir; EPIRB/S.en: DSC is tested daily/weekly; the EPIRB/SART are checked periodically. Battery/HRU dates are monitored.

Yolcular alarm sonrası muster station'a.en: After the alarm, passengers are directed to the muster station; the lifejacket and the procedure are demonstrated. Attendance is verified by counting/marking. Where possible, it is held before departure.

Costa Concordia'da (2012) muster drill h.en: On the Costa Concordia (2012), the accident happened before the muster drill had been held; this is why holding the drill early is a critical lesson learned.

Operasyon öncesi alan gevşek eşyalardan.en: Before the operation, the area is cleared of loose items; the fire team and FFA (foam) are kept ready. Wind/relative wind and communications are coordinated with the pilot.

Embarkation/debarkation ile manifest ger.en: The manifest is updated in real time with embarkation/disembarkation; PRM/special needs are marked. Consistency with the authorized copy ashore is ensured.

Sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA, evacuatio.en: Certificates are valid; LSA/FFA, evacuation arrangements, sanitation and previous findings are checked. Passenger ship inspections are comprehensive.

Acil durum ve yolcu yönlendirme görevler.en: Emergency and passenger guidance duties are assigned for every voyage; the list is updated whenever crew/cruise staff change, and familiarization is carried out.

MES, lifeboat ve life raft koordineli ku.en: The MES, lifeboats and liferafts are used in coordination; passenger guidance, muster and counting are rehearsed. The abandonment time and bottlenecks are assessed.

Tahliye darboğazları (dar koridor, asans.en: Escape bottlenecks (narrow corridors, elevators) must be identified and eliminated in advance.

Pre-arrival güvenlik bilgisi PFSO ile pa.en: Pre-arrival security information is shared with the PFSO; if there is a difference in security level or a special situation, a Declaration of Security is completed. Access control is coordinated.

Gemi revin ile ilk müdahale yapılır; ger.en: First aid is given in the ship's hospital; if required, TMAS (telemedical advice) is obtained and a medevac (helicopter or tender) is planned. The patient transfer is coordinated safely.

Etkinlik alanlarında kapasite ve çıkış y.en: In event areas, capacity and clear exit routes are managed; personnel are trained in crowd management. In an emergency, the guidance procedure is applied.

Galley, kabin, public space ve makine da.en: Galley, cabin, public space and engine room fire scenarios are rehearsed; fire team response, closing of subdivisions (fire doors), sprinklers and passenger guidance are drilled.

Yolcu gemisinde yangının yayılması paniğ.en: On a passenger ship, the spread of fire can lead to panic and mass loss of life; subdivision and rapid response are essential.

MOB alarmında pozisyon işaretlenir; Will.en: On a MOB alarm, the position is marked; a Williamson/Anderson/Scharnow turn is carried out and the rescue boat is prepared. Lookout and communications are coordinated.

Lifeboat ve life raft indirme/launch, mu.en: Lifeboat and liferaft lowering/launching, muster and passenger guidance are drilled; davits, brakes and release gear are tested. The abandonment time is monitored.

Lifeboat drill'lerinde on-load release g.en: In lifeboat drills, accidents involving on-load release gear have caused deaths in the past; attention is paid to the maker's procedure and to the use of fall preventers.

Tender embarkation platformu/gangway güv.en: The tender embarkation platform/gangway is rigged safely; if the weather/sea limits are exceeded, the operation is stopped. Passengers are counted on each tender and lifejackets are provided.

Tender iniş-binme, özellikle yaşlı/PRM y.en: Boarding and leaving the tender is the most frequent point of injury, especially for elderly/PRM passengers.

ENC güncellenir; safety parametreleri ay.en: ENCs are updated; safety parameters are set. Deviation from the approved plan (e.g. a display passage close to the coast) is made only with a risk assessment and the Master's approval.

Costa Concordia, onaylı rotadan plansız.en: The Costa Concordia showed that an unplanned deviation from the approved route can lead to disaster; deviations must be controlled and documented.

Sertifikalı ladder, manrope, life-buoy v.en: Rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, lifebuoy and lighting; if required, a combination ladder at the correct angle. Verified with a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.

Tug, bow/stern thruster ve (varsa) azipo.en: Maneuvering is done with tugs, bow/stern thrusters and (if fitted) azipods; the large lateral area of cruise ships is critical in wind. Mooring is managed safely.

FWG ve RO birlikte çalıştırılarak yüksek.en: High demand is met by running the FWG and RO together; salinity/conductivity is monitored, and production is stopped near the coast/in port. Disinfection (chlorine/UV) and mineralization are applied.

Yolcu gemisinde su kaynaklı salgın (örn..en: On a passenger ship, quality is monitored critically because of the risk of water-borne outbreaks (e.g. Legionella).

STP biyolojik/kimyasal arıtma ile çıkış.en: The STP brings the effluent up to standard by biological/chemical treatment; discharge complies with the distance/area rules. In special areas, discharge is restricted.

Yetersiz arıtmayla deşarj çevre ihlali v.en: Discharge with inadequate treatment is an environmental violation and creates a public health risk.

CO2/foam/water-mist yıllık/5 yıllık test.en: CO2/foam/water-mist systems are subject to annual/5-yearly tests; quick-closing valves, dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before CO2 release, the space is cleared and a head count is taken.

Scrubber wash water izlenir veya uyumlu.en: Scrubber wash water is monitored, or compliant fuel is used; ECA/port rules are complied with. The annual CII is calculated and SEEMP measures are applied.

Birçok cruise limanı shore power/emisyon.en: Many cruise ports pay particular attention to shore power/emission rules.

Chiller ve hava işleme üniteleri bakıma.en: Chillers and air handling units are maintained; filters are cleaned/replaced. Cooling towers and humidifiers are disinfected because of the Legionella risk.

Kötü bakımlı HVAC, hava kalitesi sorunla.en: Poorly maintained HVAC creates air quality problems and a risk of Legionella outbreaks; disinfection is never neglected.

Havuz suyu filtre edilir ve klor/pH süre.en: Pool water is filtered and chlorine/pH is monitored continuously; circulation and water renewal are ensured. In water parks/jacuzzis, Legionella and microbiological control are critical.

Yetersiz dezenfeksiyon gastrointestinal.en: Inadequate disinfection creates a risk of gastrointestinal outbreaks and Legionella; water quality is monitored continuously.

Emergency generator otomatik başlatma (b.en: The emergency generator is tested with an automatic start (blackout simulation); it is verified that it supplies the critical loads within the specified time. The UPS batteries and autonomy time are checked.

Acil güç, tahliye sistemlerinin (aydınla.en: Emergency power is vital for the operation of the emergency escape systems (lighting, public address).

Gangway ve shell door hidroliği, fren ve.en: Gangway and shell door hydraulics, brakes and locking systems are maintained; the SWL and safety net/railings are checked. A safe condition for passenger use is verified.

Gangway, yolcu yaralanmalarının sık yaşa.en: The gangway is a frequent point of passenger injuries; maintenance and safety are important.

Yüksek gerilim shore connection (HVSC),.en: High-voltage shore connection (HVSC) involves cable connection, earthing, phase/voltage synchronization and load transfer; the changeover from the ship's generators to shore power is made safely and without interruption.

HVSC yüksek gerilim taşır; interlock, to.en: HVSC carries high voltage; interlock, earthing and LOTO discipline are strictly followed. Emergency disconnection is kept ready.

Fin stabilizer açılma/kapanma ve hidroli.en: Fin stabilizer extension/retraction and the hydraulic system are maintained; in anti-roll tank systems, water transfer/control is verified. The fins are housed in port.

Dışarıda kalan fin, yanaşmada rıhtım/tek.en: A fin left extended creates a risk of contact with the quay or other craft when berthing.

Pervane (CPP ise pitch), yağlama ve seal.en: The propeller (pitch, if CPP), lubrication and seals are inspected; the drive motor/insulation and controls are tested. A function test is carried out before maneuvering.
