Pod seal/yatak izlenir (seal sızıntısı k.en: Pod seals/bearings are monitored (seal leakage is critical), electric motor insulation and cooling are checked; azimuth control and feedback are calibrated.

Pod seal arızası su girişi ve büyük onar.en: A pod seal failure means water ingress and a major repair; multi-pod redundancy supports maneuvering safety.

Otel + propulsion yüküne göre DG sayısı.en: The number of DGs is adjusted by the PMS according to the hotel + propulsion load; synchronization and balanced load sharing are ensured. The black-out recovery test is carried out.

Cruise gemisinde black-out hem propulsio.en: On a cruise ship, a black-out affects both the propulsion and the hotel load; redundancy and quick recovery are critical.

Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug.en: A pre-bunker meeting is held; scupper plugs and SOPEP equipment are ready. The initial rate is slow and topping-up is done manually. With passengers on board, additional safety/communication measures are applied.

OWS bypass'ı ağır cezalı kriminal suçtur.en: Bypassing the OWS is a criminal offense carrying heavy penalties; records must be consistent with the actual situation. Large fines have been imposed in the cruise sector in the past.

Soğutma kompresörleri ve refrigerant sis.en: Refrigeration compressors and the refrigerant system are maintained; store temperatures are monitored continuously and kept alarmed. A hygiene and defrost program is applied.

Soğuk zincir kaybı gıda kaynaklı salgın.en: Loss of the cold chain increases the risk of food-borne outbreaks (norovirus, etc.).

Bir D/G seti; sabit devirde çalışan bir.en: A D/G set consists of a diesel engine running at constant speed and a synchronous alternator coupled to it. Since the frequency (50/60 Hz) depends on engine speed, the governor keeps the speed constant. The alternator produces its magnetic field by excitation; the output voltage is held constant by the AVR.

AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator), yük d.en: The AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) keeps the terminal voltage constant by adjusting the alternator excitation as the load changes. Reactive load sharing (in parallel operation) is managed by the AVR droop setting; a faulty AVR causes over/under-voltage and load sharing problems.

Bir jeneratörü çalışan şebekeye almak (p.en: To connect a generator to the live switchboard (paralleling), four conditions must be met: the same voltage, the same frequency, the same phase sequence and phase agreement. The synchroscope and check-synch relay verify these conditions; incorrect paralleling causes a large current surge and damage.

Paralel jeneratörlerde aktif yük (kW) go.en: With generators in parallel, the active load (kW) is shared by the governor and the reactive load (kVAr) by the AVR. Unbalanced sharing leads to one set being overloaded. A modern PMS (Power Management System) manages load sharing, automatic start/stop and the connection of the standby set.

Şebeke aşırı yüklenince blackout'u önlem.en: To prevent a blackout when the network is overloaded, preferential tripping disconnects non-essential loads (HVAC, heaters, etc.) in a predefined order. Generator protections include reverse power, overcurrent, under/over-voltage and frequency relays.

Tüm jeneratörler durursa blackout oluşur.en: If all generators stop, a blackout occurs; the ship is left dark and without propulsion. The emergency generator starts automatically and supplies the essential safety loads. Black start is the starting of a main generator using emergency power and compressed air, and the re-establishment of the network.

Bakım; motor tarafında supap/enjektör/ya.en: Maintenance covers valve/injector/oil-filter work on the engine side and, on the alternator side, insulation resistance (megger), bearings and brushes/diodes (if fitted). Regular test runs and protection relay tests are carried out.

Fire-tube (alev borulu) kazanda sıcak ga.en: In a fire-tube boiler, the hot gases pass through the tubes and the water is in the shell; it is simple and low-pressure. In a water-tube boiler, the water passes through the tubes and the gases are outside; it gives high pressure and rapid steam generation. On many motor ships, a composite boiler is heated both by fuel and by exhaust gas.

Besleme suyu (feed water), besleme pompa.en: Feed water is pumped into the boiler by the feed pump; it is turned into steam by heat and, after use, returns as condensate to the cascade/hotwell tank and is fed again. The steam trap separates the condensate from the steam. The water level is monitored with the gauge glass and the level sensor.

Oil-fired kazanda brülör (burner) yakıtı.en: In an oil-fired boiler, the burner atomizes the fuel, the fan supplies air and firing is switched on and off according to steam pressure (on/off or modulating). The air/fuel ratio is optimized for efficiency and emissions; too little air produces soot/smoke, too much air reduces efficiency.

Kazan en kritik emniyet sistemlerinden b.en: The boiler is one of the most safety-critical systems. Low water level protection (low-low water cut-off), flame failure protection, high pressure protection and safety valves are mandatory. Low water can cause the tubes to overheat and burst.

Kazan suyu; korozyon, kireç (scale) ve k.en: Boiler water is conditioned to prevent corrosion, scale and foaming (carryover). pH/alkalinity, chloride, phosphate and dissolved oxygen are tested regularly and controlled by chemical dosing and blowdown. Hardness and oxygen corrosion directly affect tube life.

Exhaust gas economizer, ana makine egzoz.en: The exhaust gas economizer turns the main engine exhaust heat into steam; soot and oil accumulated at low load can ignite (soot fire / iron fire). Regular soot blowing, water washing and low-load warnings reduce this risk. A high exhaust outlet temperature can be an early sign.

Bakım; brülör temizliği, gauge glass pur.en: Maintenance covers burner cleaning, gauge glass purge, safety valve testing, water-side/gas-side cleaning, refractory (firebrick) inspection and EGE soot blowing/water washing. The safety valve set pressure is verified regularly.

Separatör, yüksek devirde dönen bowl (ka.en: The separator spins the liquid in a bowl rotating at high speed; because of the density difference, the heavy phase (water, solids) collects at the outside and the light phase (clean fuel/oil) toward the inside. The disc stack increases the separating surface and speeds up settling. Sludge is discharged periodically or automatically.

Purifier modunda su fazı vardır ve su sü.en: In purifier mode there is a water phase and water is discharged continuously; the water/fuel interface is set with the gravity disc. In clarifier mode there is no water and only solids are separated; as there is no water inflow, a blind plug is used instead of a gravity disc. A purifier→clarifier arrangement in series gives the best cleaning.

Purifier'da gravity disc (dam ring) çapı.en: In the purifier, the diameter of the gravity disc (dam ring) is selected according to fuel density and temperature; a wrong disc upsets the water/fuel interface (fuel escapes with the water, water escapes with the fuel). The maker's nomogram and the fuel density/temperature are used for correct selection.

Modern separatörler self-cleaning (otoma.en: Modern separators work with self-cleaning (automatic bowl discharge) and water content monitoring (water transducer); there is no gravity disc, and water discharge is controlled by the sensor. This reduces the need for manual adjustment over a wide density range.

Cat fines (alüminyum-silikon katalizör k.en: Cat fines (aluminum-silicon catalyst residues) are hard abrasive particles in HFO; they rapidly wear liners, piston rings and injection equipment. ISO 8217 sets an Al+Si limit for bunkers, but the value at the engine inlet must be much lower. Separator efficiency is the main means of reducing cat fines.

Bakım; bowl/disc seti sökme-temizleme, c.en: Maintenance covers dismantling and cleaning of the bowl/disc stack, replacement of seals (O-rings), checking of the gearbox/friction clutch, testing of the water seal and vibration monitoring. Regular cleaning maintains separation efficiency.

Marş havası genelde ~30 bar gerektirir;.en: Starting air generally requires ~30 bar; compression in a single stage causes overheating and loss of efficiency. Therefore two-stage compression is used: the first stage raises the air to an intermediate pressure, the intercooler cools it, and the second stage completes the compression to the final pressure. Cooling increases efficiency and reduces oil carbonization.

Sıkışan hava nem ve yağ buharı içerir; a.en: Compressed air contains moisture and oil vapor; the after-cooler and moisture separator remove the water, and for control air an air dryer additionally removes moisture. Wet/oily air clogs instrument valves and creates an explosion risk in the starting air line; draining is done regularly.

Hava şişesinden gelen yüksek basınçlı ha.en: High-pressure air from the air bottle goes via the main starting valve and the air distributor to the cylinder starting valves; it is admitted to the cylinders in the correct order and turns the engine. Wrong timing or a leaking starting valve can cause a blowback/explosion.

Marş hattında flame arrester (alev tutuc.en: Flame arresters are fitted in the starting air line, safety valves on each bottle, and bursting discs. Air bottles are subject to class survey; internal corrosion and thickness are checked.

Bakım; supap (suction/discharge) temizli.en: Maintenance covers cleaning of the valves (suction/discharge), piston ring/liner wear, cleaning of the intercooler/after-cooler, safety valve testing, automatic drains and checking of the unloader. Air bottles are internally inspected and drained regularly.

Santrifüj (dinamik) pompalar, çark (impe.en: Centrifugal (dynamic) pumps give velocity to the liquid with an impeller and convert it into pressure; they are ideal for high flow, low-to-medium pressure and low viscosity (seawater, ballast, fire). Positive displacement (PD) pumps move a fixed volume per revolution; they are suitable for high viscosity and pressure (fuel, oil, hydraulics).

Santrifüj pompanın debisi (Q) arttıkça b.en: As the flow (Q) of a centrifugal pump increases, the head (H) decreases (H-Q curve). The operating point is the intersection of the pump curve and the system resistance curve. Throttling a valve increases the system resistance and reduces the flow; if the pump runs against a closed valve (shut-off), it heats up.

Pompa emişindeki mevcut net pozitif emme.en: If the net positive suction head available (NPSHa) at the pump suction falls below the value required by the pump (NPSHr), the liquid vaporizes and cavitation occurs; this causes impeller erosion, noise, vibration and loss of flow. The risk increases with hot/volatile liquids, a clogged strainer or a high suction lift.

PD pompa kapalı vanaya karşı çalışırsa b.en: If a PD pump runs against a closed valve, it raises the pressure without limit and bursts the line/pump. Therefore a relief (safety/bypass) valve is mandatory on every PD pump line. Unlike a centrifugal pump, a PD pump is never throttled against a closed discharge.

Santrifüj pompa kendiliğinden emiş yapam.en: A centrifugal pump cannot prime itself; priming (filling with water) or a self-priming arrangement is required. Pumps connected in parallel increase the flow; connected in series, they increase the head. Standby pumps can cut in automatically.

Bakım; mekanik salmastra (mechanical sea.en: Maintenance covers the mechanical seal/gland packing, impeller wear rings, bearings/lubrication, alignment and vibration, and strainer cleaning. A mechanical seal leak is dealt with early.

Atmosfer basıncında su 100 °C'de kaynar;.en: At atmospheric pressure water boils at 100 °C, but main engine jacket water is only ~70-90 °C. The FWG creates a vacuum inside (with an ejector) and lowers the boiling point to ~40-60 °C; in this way seawater is evaporated with low-grade waste heat. The vapor is condensed to obtain fresh water, and the salt is left behind.

Modern FWG'ler plakalı (plate) ısı eşanj.en: Modern FWGs use plate heat exchangers: one plate pack heats and evaporates the seawater with jacket water (evaporator), the other condenses the vapor with seawater (condenser). They are compact, efficient and easy to clean.

Ters ozmoz, deniz suyunu yüksek basınçla.en: Reverse osmosis forces seawater at high pressure (50-70 bar) through a semi-permeable membrane; the water passes and the salt ions are retained. It needs no heat source, runs on electricity and gives high capacity at low temperature. Pre-filtration (sand/cartridge) and membrane chemistry are critical maintenance issues.

Üretilen suyun tuzluluğu salinometre ile.en: The salinity of the water produced is measured continuously with the salinometer; if the salt exceeds a set threshold (typically ~10 ppm), the solenoid dump valve diverts the water to sea/drain instead of to the tank. In this way salty or poor-quality water does not get into the fresh water tank.

Liman, haliç ve kıyıya yakın kirli/sığ s.en: Running the FWG in polluted/shallow waters in port, in estuaries and near the coast is prohibited; these waters contain bacterial and chemical pollution (bilge water, waste). Production is done in the open sea, in clean water. Drinking water additionally passes through UV/chlorination and, if required, remineralization.

Evaporatörde periyodik kireç sökme (acid.en: In the evaporator, periodic descaling (acid cleaning), plate cleaning, ejector performance and vacuum tightness are checked. In the RO plant, pre-filters are replaced, membranes are cleaned (CIP) and the HP pump is maintained.

Plakalı tip, ince oluklu (chevron desenl.en: The plate type consists of thin corrugated (chevron-pattern) stainless steel or titanium plates clamped together with gaskets. The hot and cold fluids flow in opposite directions through adjacent channels; the corrugations create turbulence and increase heat transfer. It gives a very large transfer surface in a compact volume, and the plates can be removed and cleaned mechanically/chemically.

Bir akışkan boru demetinin içinden (tube.en: One fluid passes inside the tube bundle (tube side), the other through the shell between the tubes (shell side); baffles direct the shell-side flow. It withstands high pressure and temperature, is robust and is tolerant of fouling. It is preferred for F.O. heaters, steam heaters and some large condensers.

Turboşarj sonrası sıkışan (ve ısınan) em.en: After the turbocharger, the compressed (and heated) intake air is cooled in a cooler with a finned tube bundle. Cooler air is denser; more oxygen enters the cylinder, and power and combustion efficiency increase. The water side is supplied with seawater or LT fresh water.

Transfer edilen ısı; toplam ısı transfer.en: The heat transferred depends on the overall heat transfer coefficient (U), the surface area (A) and the log mean temperature difference (ΔTlm). ΔTlm is the logarithmic mean of the temperature differences between the two fluids at the inlet and outlet, and is highest in a counter-flow arrangement. This is why heat exchangers are designed for counter-flow as far as possible.

Yüzeyde biriken tortu, biyofilm, kireç v.en: Deposits, biofilm, scale or an oil layer building up on the surface create an additional thermal resistance (fouling factor); U falls and less heat is transferred through the same area. Symptoms: a rise in the outlet temperature of the cooled fluid and an increase in pressure difference (ΔP). Performance is monitored by comparison with the reference values in clean condition.

Merkezi soğutmada deniz suyu (SW) yalnız.en: In central cooling, seawater (SW) enters only the central cooler and returns to the sea from there. The machinery is cooled by fresh water (FW) circuits with low salinity and inhibitor treatment. The high-temperature (HT) circuit cools the main engine jackets; the low-temperature (LT) circuit cools the L.O. cooler, charge air cooler and auxiliaries. A thermostatic three-way valve keeps the temperature constant.

Deniz suyu korozyonu ve deniz canlısı ki.en: Seawater corrosion and marine growth fouling are confined to the central cooler and the short SW line. Since the internal FW circuit stays clean and controlled, the machinery coolers have a long life, maintenance intervals are extended and temperature control is more stable.

İç tatlı su devresine korozyon inhibitör.en: Corrosion inhibitor (typically nitrite-based) is dosed into the internal fresh water circuit and tested periodically; if the level drops, corrosion starts on the internal surfaces. On the seawater side, contact between different metals (steel–bronze–titanium) produces galvanic corrosion; this is why sacrificial anodes and suitable material selection are used.

SW tarafı en hızlı kirlenen bölümdür. St.en: The SW side is the part that fouls fastest. The strainer is cleaned regularly; plates/tubes are periodically descaled chemically (acid) and brushed mechanically. Chlorination (MGPS — marine growth prevention system) suppresses marine growth.

Giriş/çıkış sıcaklık ve ΔP değerleri düz.en: Inlet/outlet temperatures and ΔP values are recorded regularly; a deviation from the reference indicates fouling. When a plate cooler is opened, the plate order/orientation is marked and the gaskets are checked and renewed if necessary. The seawater strainer is cleaned frequently, and chemical cleaning of plates/tubes is done at planned intervals.

Basınçlı sistemde flanş/cıvata gevşetmed.en: Before flanges/bolts are loosened on a pressurized system, it is isolated and depressurized. In chemical (acid) cleaning, suitable PPE is used, and after the work neutralization and thorough rinsing are carried out. On the seawater side, the condition of anodes/coating is checked regularly.

Geleneksel tankerlerde pompa dairesinde.en: On conventional tankers, centrifugal cargo pumps are located in the pump room; they are driven by a shaft from the engine room or by a steam turbine. On modern product/chemical tankers, each tank has its own deepwell/hydraulically driven pump (e.g. Framo) at the bottom; segregation and efficiency are superior and there is no pump room.

Booster pompa, uzun hat veya yüksek term.en: A booster pump is added in series with the main pump to maintain the flow with a long line or a high terminal back pressure. The stripping pump takes the last liquid at the tank bottom (the low level that the centrifugal pump cannot reach); it is usually a positive displacement pump or an eductor.

Kargo manifoldu, gemi hatlarının termina.en: The cargo manifold is the central point where the ship's lines are connected to the terminal arms (loading arm/hose). For multi-grade cargoes, each parcel must be carried with a separate pump/line/valve set (segregation); mixing (commingling) is not acceptable. The valve arrangement and line diagram are made clear before the operation.

Santrifüj kargo pompası, tank seviyesi d.en: When the tank level falls, a centrifugal cargo pump cavitates because of insufficient suction (low NPSH); in addition, with volatile cargoes, gas can collect inside the pump (gas-binding/vapor lock) and the flow can stop. In this case the rate is reduced, stripping mode is used or the pump is primed again.

Acil durdurma (ESD — Emergency Shutdown).en: The emergency shutdown (ESD) system works in sync with the terminal and, in an emergency, stops pumps/valves in a safe sequence. Pumping against a closed valve overpressurizes the line; therefore valve sequence and pressure monitoring are critical. Gas detection and ventilation in the pump room are mandatory.

Bakım; mekanik salmastra ve sızdırmazlık.en: Maintenance covers mechanical seals and sealing (cofferdam monitoring), bearings, the hydraulic system (Framo) oil and pressure, manifold valves and wear rings. Pump room gas detectors and the bilge alarm are tested regularly.

Ham petrol kendi tortusunu çözen bir çöz.en: Crude oil is a solvent that dissolves its own residues; the heavy residue adhering to the tank walls (clingage) is dissolved by pressurized crude oil jets and discharged together with the cargo. Compared with water washing, this produces far less waste (slops) and allows more cargo to reach the terminal (increased outturn).

Tanklara sabit, programlanabilir yıkama.en: Fixed, programmable washing machines (fixed tank cleaning machines) are installed in the tanks; the rotating jets sweep the tank surfaces at different angles. Washing is supplied by cargo pump pressure, and the washing oil is removed by stripping.

COW yalnızca tank atmosferi inert (≤%8 O.en: COW may only be carried out when the tank atmosphere is inert (≤8% O₂); otherwise, the static electricity created by the crude oil jet and the hydrocarbon vapor can lead to an explosion. The IGS must run continuously, O₂ must be monitored and washing must be stopped if the limit is exceeded.

Yıkama aşamalı yapılır: boşaltmanın başı.en: Washing is done in stages: top wash is applied at the start of discharge while the upper parts are exposed, and bottom wash as the level drops and the tank bottom becomes exposed. The machines are programmed to cover all surfaces (including shadow areas); after washing, the bottom is cleaned by stripping.

MARPOL, yıkama sonrası tankın yeterince.en: MARPOL requires the tank to be sufficiently dry after washing; bottom drainage is achieved with trim and the last liquid is removed by stripping. This reduces the quantity of slops and the contamination of subsequent ballast water.

Bakım; yıkama makinesi dişli/nozul kontr.en: Maintenance covers checks of the washing machine gears/nozzles, line pressure testing, O₂ analyzer calibration and checks of the drain line. It is periodically verified that the machines sweep all surfaces.

Sounding, tank dibinden sıvı yüzeyine ol.en: Sounding is the distance from the tank bottom to the liquid surface; ullage is the space from the top of the tank (reference point) to the liquid surface. In tanker operations, ullage is normally measured and converted to volume with the tank capacity table (calibration table); the standard volume (m³/bbl) is obtained with the temperature correction.

UTI cihazı tek ölçümde ullage, sıcaklık.en: The UTI instrument gives ullage, temperature and the water/oil interface in a single measurement; the volume is corrected for temperature and the water under the cargo (free water) is determined. Accurate temperature is the basis of the commercial volume calculation (custody transfer).

Petrol/kimyasal tankerlerde tank atmosfe.en: On oil/chemical tankers, measurement without opening the tank atmosphere (closed gauging) is mandatory; otherwise there is a risk of gas release and an explosive atmosphere. Fixed (radar/float) systems provide closed gauging; the UTI carries out restricted gauging through a vapor lock valve.

Yükleme sırasında taşmayı önlemek için b.en: To prevent overflow during loading, there are independent high-level and high-high level alarms; the high-high alarm is usually linked to automatic shutdown/ESD. These alarms must work with sensors independent of the main level system, so that a single failure cannot lead to an overflow.

Bakım; radar/float verici kalibrasyonu,.en: Maintenance covers calibration of radar/float transmitters, alarm function tests, checks of the UTI tape/sensor and the tightness of the vapor lock valve. Automatic and manual readings are compared regularly.

Dökme yük gemilerinde side-rolling (yana.en: On bulk carriers, side-rolling covers give a wide hatch opening and full clearance for grab handling. On container ships, pontoon (lift-away) covers are lifted by crane and containers are stowed on top of them. Folding covers are common on general cargo ships.

Su geçirmezlik, coaming üzerindeki compr.en: Watertightness is achieved by the compression bar on the coaming pressing continuously and evenly into the rubber gasket around the cover (set-down). Cleats/quick-acting cleats press the panel down onto the coaming. The set-down mark must be continuous; a crushed or oily gasket will leak.

Conta kanalında biriken su, drenaj kanal.en: Water collecting in the gasket channel is discharged overboard through the drain channel and the non-return (check) valve. If the non-return valve is blocked or fitted the wrong way round, water enters the hold. Coaming integrity and corrosion control are the basis of watertightness.

Hortum testi (kapalı kapağa basınçlı su).en: The hose test (pressurized water on the closed cover) is the classic method; when cargo is on board, ultrasonic testing (transmitter inside, receiver scanning outside) is preferred. The test locates leakage points along the gasket line.

Bakım; conta esneklik/değişim, compressi.en: Maintenance covers gasket elasticity/replacement, compression bar straightness, cleaning of the drain non-return valves, cleat adjustment, and checks of wheels/rails and hydraulics. A gasket that has taken a permanent set is replaced.

Yelpaze gibi yalpalama (roll), baş-kıç v.en: Fan-like rolling (roll), pitching (pitch) and vertical motion (heave) create inertial forces on the cargo; the most critical transverse force comes from roll. The lashing equipment must withstand these forces and prevent the cargo from shifting and tipping over. The force increases with acceleration × mass.

Her lashing elemanının MSL'i (Maximum Se.en: Each lashing item has an MSL (Maximum Securing Load); the working load is limited by a safety factor. The ship's approved Cargo Securing Manual (CSM) defines which equipment is used and how, the stowage arrangement and the calculations; securing must be done in accordance with the CSM.

Konteynerler köşe kutularından twistlock.en: Containers are secured to each other and to the ship at their corner castings with twistlocks; the lower tiers are tensioned to the lashing bridge/deck with lashing rods and turnbuckles. As the stowage height increases, the load from the upper containers and the risk of toppling increase; therefore heavy containers are stowed at the bottom.

Kötü hava beklentisinde rota/hız ayarı (.en: When bad weather is expected, course/speed adjustment (weather routing), additional lashing checks and avoidance of heavy rolling are applied. Excessive GM (stiff ship) causes violent, rapid rolling that strains the lashings; very low GM creates a dangerous roll period. The lashings are checked periodically throughout the voyage.

Ro-ro gemilerinde araç/trailer'lar güver.en: On ro-ro ships, vehicles/trailers are secured to the deck lashing points with web slings/chains and tensioners; wheel chocks are added. The lashing angle and the number of lashings are selected according to vehicle weight, in accordance with the CSM.

Lashing donanımı; çatlak, deformasyon, k.en: Lashing equipment is inspected regularly for cracks, deformation, corrosion and wear. Twistlock function, turnbuckle threads and lashing rod straightness are checked. A damaged item is taken out of service immediately.

Reefer ünitesi standart soğutma çevrimiy.en: The reefer unit works on the standard refrigeration cycle: the compressor compresses the refrigerant gas, the (air-cooled) condenser rejects the heat to the outside, the expansion valve reduces the pressure and the evaporator cools the cargo by drawing heat from inside the container. The set temperature (e.g. -18 °C frozen, +2 °C fresh) is maintained by a microcontroller.

Taze meyve/sebze solunum yapar (CO₂/etil.en: Fresh fruit and vegetables respire (producing CO₂/ethylene); the fresh air vent setting controls these gases. In controlled atmosphere (CA) reefers, the O₂/CO₂ ratio is actively managed and ripening is slowed down. These settings are made according to the carrying instructions.

Gemi, reefer alanlarında standart 440V/3.en: The ship provides standard 440V/3-phase sockets (reefer plugs) in the reefer areas. The total number of reefers determines the ship's required reefer power capacity (kVA); the generator load is planned accordingly. The sockets must be water/corrosion resistant, earthed and circuit-protected.

Reefer'lar düzenli olarak fiziksel veya.en: Reefers are monitored regularly, physically or remotely; set temperature, actual temperature, alarms and power supply status are recorded (reefer monitoring). Before loading, a PTI (Pre-Trip Inspection) verifies that the unit is sound. The temperature record is evidence in cargo claims.

Reefer soketleri ıslak güverte ortamında.en: Reefer sockets operate in a wet deck environment; earthing, insulation monitoring and circuit breaker protection are essential. Plugs must be connected with the power off; damaged cables/sockets must not be used.

Gemi tarafında bakım; soket/kablo bütünl.en: On the ship's side, maintenance covers socket/cable integrity, circuit breaker and earthing tests, the monitoring system and checks of the power distribution board. Refrigeration maintenance inside the unit is usually a shore service; on board, faults are diagnosed and recorded.

Ro-ro gemilerinde stern ramp/door (kıç),.en: Ro-ro ships have a stern ramp/door (aft), a bow visor + bow ramp (forward), side ramps (on the ship's side) and internal ramps/lifts. Ramps act both as a cargo route and, when closed, as a watertight barrier. They are usually moved by hydraulic cylinders/winches.

Kapı/rampa kapandıktan sonra çok sayıda.en: After the door/ramp has closed, a large number of hydraulic/mechanical locking devices (cleats) press the panel against the hull to seal it. All locking devices must be fully engaged; incomplete locking leads to the door opening at sea and to flooding.

Rampa/kapı çevresinde conta (rubber seal.en: The rubber seal around the ramp/door prevents seawater ingress; water collecting in the gaps is discharged overboard through drains and non-return valves. A crushed or torn seal leaks. The second barrier between the bow visor and the inner ramp (inner door) provides additional protection.

Bow/stern door açık/kapalı ve kilitli du.en: The open/closed and secured status of the bow/stern doors must be shown continuously on the bridge (indication system); there may also be leak detection/TV monitoring for water ingress. The ship cannot proceed to sea until the door is fully closed and secured; this is ensured by procedure and by the indicators.

Rampa, ağır araç yükünü yapısal olarak t.en: The ramp must be structurally strong enough to carry heavy vehicle loads; axle load limits must not be exceeded. Vehicle traffic on the ramp is controlled and speed-limited.

Bakım; hidrolik sistem (sızıntı/basınç),.en: Maintenance covers checks of the hydraulic system (leaks/pressure), locking devices and hinge pins, seal condition, indication sensors and drain non-return valves. It is regularly tested that the indication system works correctly (that it does not give a false 'closed').

Modern gemilerde döner hidrolik jib/knuc.en: On modern ships, a slewing hydraulic jib/knuckle boom crane allows fast cargo handling with a single operator. The classic derrick system, in a union purchase arrangement, moves loads between fixed points with two derricks; it is cheap but slow and has limited maneuverability.

Kaldırma donanımı; tel halat, blok/makar.en: Lifting gear consists of wire rope, blocks/sheaves, hooks, shackles, slings and swivels. Each item has an SWL; the weakest item in the chain determines the limit of the whole system. As the sling angle increases, the leg load increases.

Vinçte SWL sabit değildir; yarıçap arttı.en: On a crane, the SWL is not fixed; as the radius increases, the permitted load decreases so that the load moment (load × radius) stays constant. The operator must comply with the load chart; an overload is stopped by the overload cut-off.

Kaldırma donanımı proof load testinden g.en: Lifting gear undergoes a proof load test and is documented in the "Register of Lifting Appliances and Cargo Handling Gear"; inspection by a competent person is required by ILO 152. The certificates are checked during PSC/inspections.

Kaldırma sırasında işaretçi (signalman/b.en: During lifting, a signalman/banksman, taglines, not standing under the load and clear communication are essential. Snatch lifts, overloading and uncontrolled swinging are prohibited. Stability and list are checked during heavy lifts.

Bakım; tel halat tel kopması/aşınma kont.en: Maintenance covers checking wire ropes for broken wires/wear, block/sheave bearings, hook safety latches, the hydraulic system and testing of the overload cut-off. Wire rope discard criteria (broken wires/reduction in diameter) are strictly applied.

Tank temizleme; deniz suyu (soğuk/sıcak).en: Tank cleaning is done by seawater (cold/hot) washing, crude oil washing (COW) and, for stubborn residues, chemical cleaning. The method is chosen according to the remaining cargo, the next cargo (compatibility) and the gas-free objective. Fixed/portable washing machines sweep the entire surface.

Eductor, hareketli parçası olmayan bir j.en: An eductor is a jet pump with no moving parts: as a high-velocity driving flow (cargo/water) passes through a nozzle, it creates low pressure by the venturi effect and draws up the liquid at the tank bottom. It is ideal for stripping/draining and is resistant to clogging and wear, but it depends on the driving flow rate.

Yıkama suyu ve kalıntı slop tankında top.en: Washing water and residues are collected in the slop tank, where the oil separates to the top and the water to the bottom (settling). In the load-on-top method, the separated water is discharged to sea within the permitted criteria and the new cargo is loaded on top of the oily part; in this way waste and pollution are reduced.

MARPOL Annex I, yağlı suyun denize deşar.en: MARPOL Annex I makes the discharge of oily water to sea subject to strict criteria (e.g. instantaneous rate of discharge of oil ≤30 L per nautical mile, a total limit, distance from land, ship en route). The ODME (Oil Discharge Monitoring Equipment) measures the oil content continuously; if a criterion is exceeded, it stops the discharge automatically and keeps a record (Oil Record Book).

Bakım; eductor nozul/aşınma, yıkama maki.en: Maintenance covers eductor nozzles/wear, washing machines, ODME calibration and checks of the slop tank level/interface measurement.

Modern gemilerde ırgat genellikle baş ka.en: On modern ships the windlass is usually located on the forecastle, above the forepeak compartment, and has a separate gypsy (wildcat) for each anchor. In some designs, the windlass and the forward mooring winches share a common drive unit (windlass-mooring winch combination).

IACS Unified Requirements (UR A1/A2), he.en: IACS Unified Requirements (UR A1/A2) determine the anchor mass and the cable diameter and length according to each ship's equipment number (EN). The windlass must be able to heave in this cable at a certain speed. Typical class requirement: the windlass must be able to heave in three shackles (~82.5 m) of submerged cable and the anchor at a mean speed of at least 9 m/min.

Zincir, gypsy'den spurling pipe (zincir.en: The cable goes down from the gypsy through the spurling pipe into the chain locker. The bitter end is secured in the locker safely, but in such a way that it can be cut free in an emergency.

Band freni (brake band), gypsy'nin dış k.en: The brake band is a band that wraps around the outer drum of the gypsy and is tightened with a handwheel. It is the main static element holding the ship at anchor. The clutch connects/disconnects the gypsy and the drive shaft. The chain stopper (devil's claw / guillotine) takes the load off the windlass by holding the cable mechanically once anchoring is completed.

Hidrolik ırgatlar, makine dairesi veya g.en: Hydraulic windlasses are supplied from a hydraulic power unit (HPU) in the engine room or below deck. A variable-delivery pump sends pressurized oil to the windlass motor; speed and torque are adjusted by pressure/flow. The hydraulic system gives natural protection against overload: as the load increases, the pressure rises and the relief valve opens, stopping the windlass ("stall") and thus preventing mechanical damage.

Elektrikli ırgatlarda kademeli (pole-cha.en: Electric windlasses use pole-changing or frequency converter (VFD) controlled motors. Overload protection is provided by thermal relays and current limiting. Electric systems are easy to maintain, but the motor is strained by a sudden overload; therefore a torque limiter or slip clutch may be added.

Demir atmadan önce ırgat çalıştırılır, k.en: Before anchoring, the windlass is started, the clutch is engaged and the anchor is walked back (under control) down to the water. When the bridge gives the "let go" command, the clutch is disengaged, the brake band is released and the anchor falls freely. The cable speed is controlled by the brake band; excessive speed damages the cable and the gypsy.

Irgat bakımı; dişli kutusu yağ seviyesi/.en: Windlass maintenance covers gearbox oil level/analysis, brake band lining thickness, hydraulic pressure testing, greasing of the clutch and shaft bearings, and checking gypsy wear. A weekly running test and an annual detailed inspection are defined in the PMS (Planned Maintenance System).

Aşağıdaki tablo saha arızalarını ve müda.en: The table below summarizes field failures and the action to take.

Klasik derik sistemi (union purchase/yum.en: The classic derrick system (union purchase) is based on two derrick booms carrying the load with wires in fixed positions; it is cheap but slow and limited. Modern ship cranes are slewing hydraulic jib/knuckle boom cranes that allow fast and precise cargo handling with a single operator.

Kaldırma donanımı; tel halat (wire rope).en: Lifting gear consists of wire rope, blocks/sheaves, hooks, slings, shackles and swivels. Each item has its own SWL, and the weakest item in the chain determines the limit of the whole system.

SWL (Safe Working Load), vincin emniyetl.en: SWL (Safe Working Load) is the maximum load that the crane can safely lift. However, the SWL is not fixed: as the radius increases, the overturning moment increases and the load that can be lifted decreases. The load moment (M = Load × Radius) cannot exceed the crane's design moment.

Ağır kaldırmada yük gemi merkezinden uza.en: In heavy lifts, as the load moves away from the ship's centerline, a moment arises that heels the ship; this affects both the ship's stability and the crane radius. Ballast adjustment and list control are mandatory in heavy lift operations.

Vinç üç temel hareketi yapar: hoisting (.en: The crane makes three basic movements: hoisting (lifting/lowering), luffing (boom angle) and slewing (rotation). Each movement is driven by a hydraulic cylinder or motor and is controlled proportionally by joystick.

Modern vinçlerde yük momenti sınırlayıcı.en: Modern cranes have a load moment limiter (overload/moment limiter), speed limitation, hose burst valves and an emergency stop. When the load exceeds the SWL, the system stops automatically.

Kaldırma donanımı periyodik olarak proof.en: Lifting gear is periodically tested with a proof load (a test load above the SWL) and documented in the "Register of Lifting Appliances and Cargo Handling Gear" (cargo gear register). Inspection by a competent person is required by ILO 152.

Split drum vinçlerde tambur iki bölmelid.en: In split drum winches, the drum has two sections: the working (tension) section and the storage section. Only one layer of line (single layer) carries tension in the working section; this prevents the brake holding capacity from falling with line diameter and the number of layers. On an undivided drum, the brake holding capacity decreases as the line is wound in layers on top of each other.

Otomatik gergili (auto-tension) vinçler.en: Auto-tension winches try to keep the line at a preset tension: if the tension drops they heave in, and if it increases they pay out (render). However, with tide and draft changes, continuous rendering can compromise the ship's safety; for this reason many terminals prohibit auto-tension while the ship is moored.

MBL (Minimum Breaking Load), halatın kop.en: MBL (Minimum Breaking Load) is the load at which the line breaks. Ship Design MBL (SDMBL) is the reference MBL for which the mooring system is designed. The winch brake is set to slip (render) before the line breaks; in this way it is the brake that gives way, not the line.

Fren %60 MBL'de kaymaya ayarlanır ki aşı.en: The brake is set to slip at 60% MBL so that, when an overload occurs, the brake renders (controlled slipping) before the line parts. This protects both the line and personnel: the snap-back of a parting line is lethal.

Bağlamada çelik tel, yüksek modüllü sent.en: Steel wire, high-modulus synthetic (HMPE/Dyneema) and polyester/nylon lines are used for mooring. Elasticity (elongation) and snap-back energy vary with the material; nylon is elastic but has high snap-back energy, while HMPE stretches little and is light.

Tipik bağlama düzeni baş/kıç hat (head/s.en: A typical mooring pattern consists of head/stern lines, breast lines and springs. The springs resist longitudinal forces and the breast lines resist transverse forces. It is important that the lines are of the same material and length so that the load is evenly distributed.

Bağlama, gemideki en tehlikeli operasyon.en: Mooring is one of the most dangerous operations on board. A well-drilled team, clear communication, keeping clear of snap-back zones and the use of gloves/hard hats are essential. While a line is under tension, nobody may step over it or stand inside a bight.

Vinç ve fren bakımı bağlama emniyetinin.en: Winch and brake maintenance is the foundation of mooring safety.

Folding (katlanır) kapaklar, panelleri m.en: Folding covers have panels hinged to each other and are folded like an accordion by hydraulic cylinders; they are common on container and general cargo ships. Side-rolling covers are preferred on bulk carriers; the panels roll sideways on wheels and open the hatchway completely.

Kapaklar hidrolik silindir, zincir veya.en: The covers are moved by hydraulic cylinders, chains or wire ropes. After closing, the cleats and the quick-acting cleat system press the panels onto the coaming and compress the gasket. The watertightness of the cover depends on this compressive force.

Conta (rubber packing), panel çevresinde.en: The rubber packing (gasket) sits in the channel around the panel and is compressed by the compression bar. Water collecting between the gasket and the coaming is drained through the drain channel and the non-return (check) valve. A blocked drain valve lets water leak into the hold.

Klasik weathertight testi, kapalı kapağa.en: The classic weathertightness test consists of spraying water at the closed cover from a specified pressure and distance and observing whether any water leaks inside. However, it is difficult to apply when the hold is loaded or in cold weather.

Ultrasonik (ses) sızdırmazlık testinde a.en: In ultrasonic tightness testing, a transmitter placed inside the hold emits sound, and a receiver outside is scanned along the gasket line. If the sound leakage raises the measured level (% or dB) above a set threshold, there is a sealing defect at that point. It can be applied even with cargo on board.

Bakım; conta esnekliği/yırtık kontrolü,.en: Maintenance covers checks of gasket elasticity/tears, compression bar straightness, drain valve cleaning, cleat function, wheel/rail condition and the hydraulic system. When the gasket has taken a permanent set, tightness is lost and it must be replaced.

Capstan dikey eksende döner; halat tambu.en: The capstan rotates about a vertical axis; the line is wound several turns around the drum and held by friction (capstan effect). The operator controls the friction by pulling on the slack end of the line (tail); pulling hauls the line in, easing off lets it slip. This gives a controlled pull without winding the line on permanently.

Warping, gemiyi rıhtım boyunca halatlarl.en: Warping is moving the ship along the quay with lines; it is done with a capstan or a winch drum (warping drum/gypsy head). Mooring winches are usually fitted with a warp head; capstans are found as independent units on small craft and special ships.

Bitt/bollard (baba), halatın volta edild.en: The bitt/bollard is a pair of posts on which the line is made fast (figure-of-eight); its SWL must be compatible with the MBL of the line. The fairlead guides the line at the correct angle and is a roller or a panama chock. A pedestal roller leads the line horizontally across the deck.

Halatın fairlead'den çıkış açısı (lead a.en: The sharper the angle at which the line leaves the fairlead (lead angle), the greater the friction and wear. In an ideal arrangement, the line leaves the fairlead as straight as possible. A wrong angle both chafes the line and causes uneven spooling on the winch drum.

Sabit donanımın muayenesi; kaynak bölgel.en: Inspection of fixed fittings covers checks for cracks, corrosion and deformation in weld areas, greasing of roller bearings and smoothing of sharpened surfaces. SWL markings must be legible.

Balast suyu; yüksüz/kısmen yüklü gemide.en: Ballast water is taken on/discharged in an unladen or partly laden ship for draft, trim, stability, strength (hull stress) and propeller immersion. However, this water contains organisms from the port where it was taken on and carries them to where it is discharged. The BWM Convention aims to prevent this biological pollution.

D-1 (ballast water exchange) açık denizd.en: D-1 (ballast water exchange) requires the water to be exchanged in the open sea; D-2 (performance standard) requires the number of viable organisms in the discharged water to be below specified limits. Once the transition period is complete, all ships must meet D-2 (i.e. have an approved BWMS).

Yaygın bir yaklaşım: alımda filtrasyon (.en: A common approach: filtration at uptake (retaining large organisms/sediment) + UV irradiation (preventing reproduction through DNA damage). It leaves no chemical residue and needs no neutralization at discharge; however, UV efficiency drops in turbid water and it requires high power.

Alternatif: filtrasyon + elektroklorinas.en: Alternative: filtration + electrochlorination/chemical treatment (in-line generation of the active substance). It gives strong treatment but requires neutralization and monitoring of residuals (TRO — Total Residual Oxidant) before discharge. Efficiency varies in cold/low-salinity water.

BWMS, IMO BWMS Code'a göre tip onaylı ol.en: The BWMS must be type approved under the IMO BWMS Code. The port State may take samples of the discharge water and check D-2 compliance. Operating parameters (flow, UV/TRO dose) must be kept within the approval limits.

Bakım; otomatik filtre geri yıkama (back.en: Maintenance covers automatic filter backflushing and element checks, UV lamp life/transparency or electrochlorination cell cleaning, TRO/sensor calibration and flow/pressure monitoring. A sensor failure can invalidate the compliance record.

OWS iki aşamayla çalışır: birinci kademe.en: The OWS works in two stages: in the first stage, large oil droplets collect at the top through the density difference (gravity); in the second stage, coalescer elements enlarge and separate the small oil droplets. The separated oil goes to the sludge/oil tank and the cleaned water to the 15 ppm monitor.

15 ppm bilge alarmı (oil content monitor.en: The 15 ppm bilge alarm (oil content monitor) continuously measures the oil concentration in the outlet water. If the value exceeds 15 ppm, the automatic 3-way valve stops the overboard discharge, diverts the water back (bilge holding/slop tank) and raises an alarm. In this way water exceeding the criterion never goes to sea.

MARPOL, makine dairesi sintine suyunun d.en: MARPOL makes the discharge of machinery space bilge water to sea subject to these conditions: the ship en route, oil content ≤15 ppm, and an approved OWS + monitor in operation. In special areas, the rules are stricter.

\"Magic pipe\" — OWS'i by-pass ederek ya.en: The "magic pipe" (an illegal arrangement that bypasses the OWS and pumps oily water directly overboard) is one of the most heavily punished MARPOL violations. The authorities look for flange marks, extra hose connections and inconsistencies between the Oil Record Book and actual consumption/generation.

Bakım; coalescer eleman temizlik/değişim.en: Maintenance covers cleaning/replacement of the coalescer elements, cleaning and calibration of the 15 ppm monitor glass/sensor, function testing of the 3-way valve and checks of the feed pump. Monitor test/calibration records are kept.

Black water tuvalet (lağım) atığıdır ve.en: Black water is toilet (sewage) waste and carries pathogens; grey water is waste from sinks/showers/galley. MARPOL Annex IV regulates black water; in some areas (e.g. the Baltic special area) stricter rules apply, including for grey water. The STP treats the waste biologically/chemically and disinfects it.

Yaygın yöntem biyolojik aktif çamur (aer.en: The common method is biological activated sludge (aerobic bacteria break down organic matter) + settling + chlorination/UV disinfection. Modern MBR (membrane bioreactor) systems give an effluent with very low pollution through membrane filtration. Electrochemical/chemical systems are also used.

Biyolojik sistemlerde bakteri kültürünün.en: In biological systems, the health of the bacterial culture is critical; excessive chemicals (detergent, chlorine) kill the bacteria and the treatment process collapses. Maintenance covers the aeration blower, disinfection dosing, sludge level and (in MBR units) membrane cleaning/replacement.

İnsineratör, brülörle ısıtılan yanma oda.en: The incinerator burns waste at high temperature (typically ~850-1200 °C) in a combustion chamber heated by a burner. Sludge (waste oil) is fed through a separate burner; solid waste (garbage) is fed through the loading door. Sufficient temperature and air are essential for complete combustion and low emissions.

Yükleme kapağı yanma sırasında açılmamal.en: The loading door must not be opened during combustion; there is a risk of blowback/flame. Ash is not removed until it has cooled sufficiently. The temperature and water content of the sludge service tank are checked; sludge containing excessive water disturbs combustion and may cause an explosion.

Bakım; brülör temizliği, refraktör (ateş.en: Maintenance covers burner cleaning, inspection of the refractory (firebrick), ash removal, and checks of the flue/fan and temperature sensors.

HVAC merkezinde bir soğutma çevrimi (chi.en: At the heart of the HVAC system is a refrigeration cycle (chiller / direct expansion); the compressor-condenser-evaporator circuit extracts heat by means of the refrigerant. The air handling unit (AHU) cools/heats and dehumidifies the air and distributes it to the spaces through ducts. Return air is mixed with fresh air.

Hava soğutucu serpantinde yoğuşan nem al.en: Moisture condensing on the air cooler coil is removed (dehumidification); if necessary, the air is reheated (reheat) to provide comfort. Excessive humidity causes mold/corrosion, and excessive dryness causes discomfort. Humidity and temperature are controlled by thermostat/hygrostat.

Yaşam mahalli genelde pozitif basınçta t.en: The accommodation is generally kept at positive pressure, so that air flows outward through doors/openings and engine room smoke/odors and (on tankers) cargo vapors cannot enter. Adequate fresh air exchange prevents the buildup of CO₂ and odors.

Pompa dairesi, boya deposu ve akü odası.en: Hazardous spaces such as the pump room, paint store and battery room are continuously purged by mechanical (ex-proof) ventilation to prevent the accumulation of explosive gas. In the event of fire, fire dampers close the ducts, isolating flame/smoke and making the space tight for extinguishing.

HVAC nemli yüzeyleri ve su soğutmalı kul.en: Damp HVAC surfaces and water-cooled towers are environments in which Legionella can grow; regular cleaning, disinfection and filter replacement are mandatory for health. A dirty filter reduces both air quality and system efficiency.

Bakım; filtre temizlik/değişim, soğutucu.en: Maintenance covers filter cleaning/replacement, refrigerant charging and leak checks, drain pan cleaning, fan/belt and damper movement, and thermostat/sensor checks. Refrigerant gas leaks are significant for both the environment (F-gas) and efficiency.

Hidrofor, içinde hava yastığı (air cushi.en: The hydrophore is a pressure tank containing an air cushion; the pump forces water into the tank, compressing the air and creating pressure. When a tap is opened, the compressed air pushes the water out; when the pressure falls to the lower limit, the pump starts automatically (pressure switch). In this way pressure is maintained without the pump running continuously.

İçme suyu, ayrı (sadece içme suyuna ayrı.en: Drinking water is supplied from a separate fresh water tank (dedicated solely to drinking water); the tank and lines must be of food-safe coating/material and must not mix with technical water. Backflow preventers (non-return) and the prohibition of cross-connections prevent contamination.

Sıcak su, calorifier'da (elektrik veya b.en: Hot water is heated in the calorifier (electrically or by steam/jacket water) and distributed through a circulation line. For Legionella control, hot water temperature is kept above a certain level (generally ≥60 °C in storage); cold water, on the other hand, is kept cool.

İçme suyu klorlama veya UV ile dezenfekt.en: Drinking water is disinfected by chlorination or UV; demineralized water from the FWG is remineralized if necessary. Tanks are periodically cleaned and disinfected, and water samples are tested. Low chlorine or stagnant water invites bacterial growth.

Bakım; hidrofor hava yastığı kontrolü, p.en: Maintenance covers the hydrophore air cushion check, pressure switch setting, pump and non-return valve, calorifier anode/heating element, tank cleaning and disinfection dosing. Water sample testing is carried out regularly.

Soğutma çevrimi: kompresör soğutucu gazı.en: Refrigeration cycle: the compressor compresses the refrigerant gas (hot/high pressure), the condenser (seawater- or air-cooled) rejects the heat and liquefies the gas, the expansion valve reduces the pressure, and the evaporator (inside the cold room) absorbs heat from the room as the refrigerant evaporates at low pressure. Modern systems use environmentally friendly (low-GWP) refrigerants.

Bir kompresör ünitesi birkaç depoyu (et.en: One compressor unit serves several cold rooms (meat freezer ~-18 °C, fish ~-25 °C, vegetables/daily stores ~+2..+5 °C); the evaporator of each room is kept at its own temperature by a thermostatic expansion valve and a solenoid valve. The compressor load is adjusted according to the low-temperature demand.

Evaporatör üzerinde biriken buz (frost).en: Ice (frost) building up on the evaporator reduces heat transfer; periodic defrosting (hot gas/electric) melts this ice. Excessive humidity causes rotting in the vegetable room, and low humidity causes drying out; ventilation and humidity balance preserve food quality.

Gıda güvenliği için depo sıcaklıkları dü.en: For food safety, cold room temperatures are monitored and recorded regularly; if the cold chain is broken, provisions spoil. Cross-contamination is prevented (raw meat kept separate) and the rooms are kept clean. The MLC requires food that is adequate and properly stored.

Bakım; soğutucu şarj ve kaçak kontrolü,.en: Maintenance covers refrigerant charge and leak checks, compressor oil level, cleaning of the condenser (seawater side), the defrost function, and checks of door gaskets and thermostats. Refrigerant gas leaks are significant for both the environment and efficiency.

Starting air yüksek basınçtır (~30 bar).en: Starting air is high pressure (~30 bar) and is stored in air receivers; control/instrument air is at lower pressure (~7 bar) but must be very clean and dry; working air is for general use (cleaning, pneumatic hand tools). Generally, starting air is also supplied, at reduced pressure, to the control/service air system.

Sıkışan hava nem ve yağ içerir; after-co.en: Compressed air contains moisture and oil; the after-cooler and moisture separator remove the water, and for control air an air dryer (adsorption/refrigerated type) further reduces the moisture. Wet/oily control air causes valve and positioner failures, freezing and instrument blockage.

Marş havası şişeden basınç düşürücü (red.en: Starting air is supplied from the receiver to the control/service line through a pressure reducing valve (reducing valve). Because loss of control air can paralyze critical automation, continuity is ensured by a separate control air receiver (reserve).

En az iki kompresör ve iki hava şişesi y.en: At least two compressors and two air receivers provide redundancy; safety valves protect each pressure zone. The starting air line is fitted with a flame arrester and a bursting disc (against a starting air explosion). Air receivers are subject to class survey.

Bakım; kompresör supap/segman, intercool.en: Maintenance covers compressor valves/piston rings, intercooler/after-cooler, dryer element/regeneration, automatic drains, safety valve testing, and internal inspection/draining of the air receivers. Inadequate draining leads to moisture accumulation.

Kazandan çıkan buhar, dağıtım hattıyla t.en: Steam leaving the boiler goes through the distribution line to the consumers (HFO heater, tank heating coils, calorifier, fuel oil module). After giving up its heat, the steam condenses (condensate); the condensate returns through the condensate line to the cascade/hotwell tank and is pumped back to the boiler by the feed pump. The closed circuit minimizes water loss.

Buhar tuzağı, oluşan kondensi ve havayı.en: The steam trap passes condensate and air while holding back the steam; the heat thus stays in the consumer and the line is protected from water hammer. A faulty trap that stays open passes steam (energy loss); a trap that stays closed stops the heating.

HFO depolama/settling/service tankları v.en: HFO storage/settling/service tanks and heaters are heated with steam to reduce viscosity; on tankers, heavy cargoes (asphalt, crude oil) are made pumpable by means of heating coils. Overheating causes fuel/cargo degradation, and insufficient heating causes pumping problems.

Isıtma serpantininde delik olursa yakıt/.en: If a heating coil is holed, fuel/cargo leaks into the condensate and carries oil to the boiler (oil contamination); this causes foaming, carryover and a hazard in the boiler. Oil traces are monitored in the condensate observation tank; contaminated condensate is not taken into the boiler but is dumped.

Bakım; steam trap test/temizlik, kondens.en: Maintenance covers steam trap testing/cleaning, oil monitoring in the condensate observation tank, the feed pump and line tightness, insulation and water chemistry checks. The condensate return rate (recovery) is monitored; a drop is a sign of leakage.

Fire main, makine dairesindeki yangın po.en: The fire main is supplied by the fire pumps in the engine room and distributed along the deck through fire hydrants. Isolation valves are fitted in the line; while a damaged section is isolated, the rest of the line remains pressurized. The line is kept permanently pressurized or ready to be brought into service quickly.

Uluslararası kıyı bağlantısı, gemi yangı.en: The international shore connection is a standard flange that allows the ship's fire main to receive water in port/from another ship. Its dimensions are to an international standard; it is provided on every ship and its location is known. If the ship's pumps fail, it allows supply from shore/from another ship.

Yangın pompaları, en uzak/yüksek hydrant.en: Fire pumps must have sufficient capacity to provide adequate pressure and jet throw even at the most remote/highest hydrant. SOLAS requires two jets to operate simultaneously at a specified pressure (depending on ship type). Pump capacity is related to ship size and to the bilge/ballast pump capacity.

Ana makine dairesinde yangın çıkıp pompa.en: If a fire breaks out in the main engine room and the pumps are lost, the emergency fire pump, located outside the engine room (in a separate compartment) and driven by an independent power source (its own diesel/emergency generator), is brought into service. It must have its own sea suction and priming, and must be able to operate without passing through the engine room.

Her hydrant'ta hortum ve çift maksatlı (.en: Each hydrant is provided with a hose and a dual-purpose (jet/spray) nozzle. Hoses undergo regular pressure testing; the jet/spray/shut-off function of the nozzle is checked. Equipment must be easily accessible and marked.

CO₂ yanmayı, ortamdaki oksijeni yanmayı.en: CO₂ extinguishes a fire by reducing the oxygen in the space to a level that cannot sustain combustion (generally below ~15%); it also provides some cooling. It does not chemically interrupt the flammable vapor, it only dilutes the oxygen; therefore closing (sealing) the space is essential.

Sistem; yüksek basınçlı CO₂ tüpleri bata.en: The system consists of a bank of high-pressure CO₂ cylinders (or a low-pressure bulk tank), manifold, pilot cylinders, master valve, distribution piping and nozzles. Discharge is initiated from the release cabinet in the CO₂ room (by pilot CO₂); the pilot gas both opens the master valve and directs the gas to the relevant space.

Makine daireleri için CO₂ miktarı, korun.en: For machinery spaces, the quantity of CO₂ is calculated to fill a certain percentage of the protected volume (and the machinery structure); for machinery spaces SOLAS requires a quantity of CO₂ corresponding to approximately 40% of the gross volume (or a larger calculation including the engine casing). A different (lower) percentage is used for cargo spaces.

Makine daireleri için gazın büyük kısmı.en: For machinery spaces, most of the gas must be released in a short time (approximately 2 minutes) so that the concentration quickly reaches the extinguishing level and re-ignition is prevented. The pipe diameter and nozzle design provide this flow rate.

CO₂ insanı boğarak öldürür. Bu yüzden de.en: CO₂ kills people by asphyxiation. Therefore, before discharge: the space is cleared of personnel, an automatic audible/visual alarm sounds, opening the release cabinet stops the fans/fuel/ventilation (interlock), a time delay gives personnel time to get out, and only then is the gas released. Discharge is not carried out until a head count (muster) has been made.

Deşarj için havalandırma fanları durmalı.en: For discharge, the ventilation fans must be stopped, the fuel valves closed and the dampers closed; otherwise the gas escapes and the concentration drops. After extinguishing, the space is thoroughly ventilated and gas measurements are taken before re-entry.

Bakım; tüp tartımı/seviye (CO₂ kaybı tes.en: Maintenance covers cylinder weighing/level measurement (to detect CO₂ loss), pilot line and valve testing (without releasing gas), alarm and time delay testing, checks of nozzles/pipes for blockage and function testing of the release cabinet. Cylinders are subject to periodic pressure testing.

Köpük, yanan sıvı üzerinde sürekli bir b.en: Foam forms a continuous blanket over the burning liquid: it seals the fuel surface off from the air (oxygen exclusion), suppresses the release of flammable vapor and cools with the water it contains. Coverage of the surface must be continuous; if the foam blanket breaks down, re-ignition occurs.

Genleşme oranı (expansion ratio), köpük.en: The expansion ratio is the ratio of the foam volume to the volume of the liquid mixture. Low expansion (≤20:1) is used for long-range monitors/nozzles, medium expansion (20-200:1) for limited areas, and high expansion (>200:1) for totally filling a space (engine room).

Köpük konsantresi su ile doğru oranda (t.en: Foam concentrate must be mixed with water in the correct proportion (typically 1%, 3% or 6%); mixing is done by an inductor (venturi), a balanced pressure proportioner or a bladder tank. An incorrect proportion produces weak foam or no foam at all.

Tankerlerde güverte köpük sistemi; köpük.en: On tankers, the deck foam system consists of the foam tank/proportioner, main line, monitors (foam cannons) and foam applicators at the hydrants. A foam stock sufficient to cover the entire cargo deck area at a specified rate for a specified time (e.g. at least 20 min) is mandatory.

Makine dairesi sıvı yakıt yangınları içi.en: For liquid fuel fires in the engine room, a fixed high-expansion foam system or a local application system may be fitted; in addition, portable foam applicators (portable foam applicator) are supplied from the fire main.

Bakım; köpük konsantresi periyodik anali.en: Maintenance covers periodic analysis of the foam concentrate (degradation/sedimentation), proportioner and monitor testing, line blow-through, and checks of tank level and expiry date. As the concentrate ages, extinguishing efficiency decreases.

Sprinkler sistemi sürekli basınçlı su il.en: The sprinkler system is permanently charged with pressurized water (wet pipe). Each head has a glass bulb that breaks with heat or a fusible link; only the head in the fire area opens and sprays water, and the pressure drop triggers the pump/alarm. Water is thus applied only where it is needed.

Sistem, basınçlı su tankı (pressure tank.en: The system supplies the initial water immediately from a pressure water tank (pressure tank, with an air cushion); the automatic sprinkler pump then starts and maintains a continuous supply. The tank holds an initial charge of fresh water; the pump ensures continuity by drawing seawater. Sections are monitored separately.

Water mist, suyu yüksek basınçla çok inc.en: Water mist breaks water up into very fine droplets (microns) at high pressure; the large surface area gives rapid evaporation and strong cooling, and the steam formed dilutes the oxygen locally. It uses little water (low water damage), creates a non-conductive environment and can be a people-safe alternative to CO₂.

Makine dairesinde water mist hem total f.en: In the engine room, water mist is applied both as total flooding and as local application (localized) for high-risk equipment (burners, separators, main engine); it rapidly brings oil leak fires under control.

Sprinkler bölgeleri (sections) köprü/yan.en: Sprinkler sections are monitored separately on the bridge/fire control panel; which section has been activated is seen immediately. Water flow (flow switch) and pressure sensors help to locate the fire.

Bakım; pompa otomatik start testi, basın.en: Maintenance covers the automatic pump start test, pressure tank air cushion/level, section valve and flow switch testing, visual inspection of the heads (paint/damage) and checks of water mist nozzles for blockage. Heads must not be painted or obstructed.

Yanma için yakıt, oksijen ve tutuşma kay.en: Combustion requires fuel, oxygen and an ignition source. In a tanker's cargo tank, hydrocarbon vapor and static electricity/sparks may be unavoidable; the IGS breaks the triangle by controlling the oxygen. When the tank atmosphere is kept at ≤8% O₂, an explosion cannot occur whatever the vapor concentration.

IG iki şekilde üretilir: kazan baca gazı.en: IG is produced in two ways: from boiler flue gas (flue gas, which contains little O₂) or from an independent inert gas generator (by burning fuel). On product tankers, a generator/nitrogen may be preferred for high purity. The gas produced is hot, sulfurous and laden with soot; it must be conditioned before use.

Scrubber (yıkayıcı), gazı deniz suyuyla.en: The scrubber washes the gas with seawater, removing most of the SOx and soot, and cools it. A demister/dryer then removes the moisture. Gas that has not been cleaned causes corrosion in the tank and cargo contamination.

Kargo tankından gelen patlayıcı gazın ma.en: To prevent explosive gas from the cargo tanks escaping back to the generating side in the engine room, the deck water seal (water seal) and a mechanical non-return (check) valve work together. This double barrier prevents blowback of flame/vapor; the water seal level is maintained at all times.

Basınç/vakum (P/V) valfleri tankı aşırı.en: Pressure/vacuum (P/V) valves protect the tank against overpressure and vacuum. The PV breaker (liquid-filled safety device) provides the final protection for the main line. The low IG pressure alarm and the automatic blower stop protect the integrity of the system.

Boşaltma sırasında IG, inen sıvının yeri.en: During discharging, IG fills the space left by the outgoing liquid (the tank does not go into vacuum). During loading, the displaced gas is vented. Tank cleaning (COW/washing) is carried out in an inert atmosphere; the "purging" and "gas-freeing" procedures are controlled by O₂ and hydrocarbon measurements.

Bakım; O₂ analizör kalibrasyonu, scrubbe.en: Maintenance covers O₂ analyzer calibration, scrubber/demister cleaning, deck seal level and non-return valve testing, and checks of the blowers and P/V valves.

Duman dedektörleri (iyonizasyon/optik) e.en: Smoke detectors (ionization/optical) detect particles at an early stage; heat detectors operate on fixed temperature or a rapid temperature rise (rate-of-rise); flame detectors (UV/IR) see the radiation of an open flame. The most suitable detector is selected according to the type of space.

Mutfak gibi normalde duman/buhar olan ye.en: Heat detectors are used in places where smoke/steam is normally present, such as the galley; smoke detectors in cabins/corridors; and a combination of flame + smoke + heat detectors in the engine room. The wrong type causes either false alarms or late detection.

Konvansiyonel sistemde dedektörler bölge.en: In a conventional system, detectors are monitored on a zone basis; the panel indicates which zone the fire is in. In an addressable system, each detector has a unique address; the panel shows the exact detector and its status (fire/fault/contamination), which makes maintenance easier.

Kargo ambarlarında, her ambardan sürekli.en: In cargo holds, sample extraction smoke detection is used, which continuously draws air samples from each hold and brings them to detectors at the control station; the same system may be combined with the CO₂ extinguishing line. The pipelines must not become blocked and must be marked for the correct hold.

Yangın algılandığında panel sesli/görsel.en: When a fire is detected, the panel gives an audible/visual warning and indicates the zone/detector. The general alarm that alerts the crew may be operated separately or be integrated. The bridge must be under continuous supervision and alarms must be recorded.

Bakım; dedektör fonksiyon testi (test ga.en: Maintenance covers detector function testing (test gas/heat source), cleaning of contamination, manual call point testing, the panel battery/standby power, and sample line flow checks. Each detector tested is recorded, and the system is reactivated after maintenance.

Yangınlar yanan maddeye göre sınıflandır.en: Fires are classified according to the burning material: A (solids: wood/paper), B (flammable liquids: fuel/oil), C (gases), D (combustible metals), F/K (cooking oil). The extinguisher must be selected to suit the class of fire; the wrong choice can make the fire bigger or cause electric shock/an explosion.

Su (A için iyi, B/elektrikte tehlikeli),.en: Water (good for A, dangerous on B/electrical fires), foam (A/B), dry chemical powder (A/B/C, versatile but leaves a residue), CO₂ (B and electrical, no residue but a risk in enclosed spaces), wet chemical (class F, galley). For fires in electrical equipment, CO₂ or dry powder is preferred.

Söndürücüler; her mahalde yangın riskine.en: Extinguishers are placed in each space in a type and number suited to the fire risk, in visible and easily accessible positions close to exits. There are separate requirements for the engine room, galley and accommodation areas. Their locations are marked on the fire plan (fire control plan).

Bakım; basınç göstergesi (manometre) kon.en: Maintenance covers pressure gauge (manometer) checks, seal/pin integrity, weighing (CO₂), checks of the hose/nozzle and of the shell for corrosion, and periodic pressure testing (hydrostatic test) and refilling. Each unit is labeled and recorded.

EEBD, dumanlı/oksijensiz bir mahalden gü.en: The EEBD is an escape hood that supplies air/oxygen for a short time (typically ≥10 min) to allow escape from a smoke-filled/oxygen-deficient space to a safe area. It is NOT USED for firefighting or for entering a hazardous space; it is for escape only. It is simple to use and quick to don.

EEBD'ler; makine dairesi, yaşam mahalli.en: EEBDs are kept in sufficient numbers in the engine room, the accommodation and along escape routes, in visible and marked positions. Their number and locations are shown on the fire control plan. During training, every crew member practices donning one.

SCBA; yüksek basınçlı hava tüpü (genelde.en: The SCBA consists of a high-pressure air cylinder (generally ~6-9 L, ~300 bar), a pressure reducer and demand regulator (demand valve), a full face mask, a backplate, and a pressure gauge and low-pressure whistle (whistle). The mask is kept at positive pressure to prevent smoke leaking in.

Tüpteki hava süresi, iş yüküne göre deği.en: The air duration of the cylinder varies with workload; it is used up quickly under heavy exertion. The team must leave a sufficient margin for the return (generally a reserve of the amount used on the way in) and head for the exit before the low-pressure whistle sounds. Entry control (entry control) and communication are mandatory.

Yangın müdahale takımı (fireman's outfit.en: The firefighting outfit (fireman's outfit) includes protective clothing, helmet, gloves, boots, lifeline (lifeline), hand lamp, axe and SCBA. A specified number of complete outfits are kept on board in easily accessible and widely separated positions. Regular checks and training are essential.

Bakım; tüp basıncı kontrolü ve dolum, ma.en: Maintenance covers cylinder pressure checks and recharging, mask tightness and cleaning, regulator function testing, gasket/strap checks and monitoring of EEBD expiry dates. A used SCBA cylinder is recharged immediately; the sets are always kept charged/ready.

Quick closing valve, yakıt/yağ tankların.en: The quick closing valve is a valve fitted at the outlet of fuel/oil tanks (settling, service, lub oil, HFO storage) that can be closed remotely with a single action. In the event of fire, they are all triggered together from a position outside the engine room (generally a wire-operated/pneumatic/hydraulic cabinet); the flow of fuel to the fire is thus cut off.

Quick closing valfler kapandıktan sonra.en: After closing, quick closing valves are reset manually one by one (locally); accidental triggering stops the machinery. For this reason, the trigger points are protected and marked. Regular testing verifies that the valves actually close.

Makine dairesi dışından uzaktan durdurul.en: Equipment that must be capable of being stopped remotely from outside the engine room: fuel transfer/booster pumps, lubricating oil pumps, separators, fans (ventilation) and the boiler burner. This "emergency stop" arrangement isolates the space from fuel and air.

CO₂/köpük deşarjı öncesi havalandırma fa.en: Before CO₂/foam discharge, the ventilation fans must be stopped and the dampers (fire dampers) closed; otherwise the extinguishing gas escapes and oxygen enters from outside. Dampers can generally be closed remotely, from outside the space.

Makine dairesi skylight'ları, kapıları v.en: Engine room skylights, doors and other openings must be capable of being closed in the event of fire; remote closing or rapid manual closing arrangements are provided. The closing sequence and the persons responsible are defined in the fire plan and the emergency procedure.

Tipik sıra: personel tahliyesi ve sayımı.en: Typical sequence: withdrawal and head count of personnel → emergency stop (pumps, fans) → quick closing valves → closing of openings/dampers → verification that the space is sealed → CO₂/foam discharge. This sequence is critical both for the safety of life and for extinguishing effectiveness.

Bakım; quick closing valf test (kapanma.en: Maintenance covers quick closing valve testing (verification of closing) and resetting, emergency stop circuit testing, and checks of damper movement and tightness.

GMDSS dokuz işlevi garanti eder; en krit.en: The GMDSS ensures nine functions; the most critical are: distress alerting (ship-to-shore, shore-to-ship, ship-to-ship), SAR coordination, on-scene communications, locating (SART), maritime safety information (MSI) and general communications. The aim is that no distress call goes unnoticed.

DSC (Digital Selective Calling), tehlike.en: DSC (Digital Selective Calling) sends a distress call digitally (with the ship's identity (MMSI), position and nature of distress) at the push of a single button; the coast station and ships receive this call automatically and give an alarm. This removes the need to listen continuously for voice calls, and the call is not missed.

GMDSS ekipmanı, geminin seyrettiği deniz.en: GMDSS equipment is determined by the sea area in which the ship operates. A1: range of a VHF coast station (~20-30 miles). A2: range of an MF coast station (~100-150 miles). A3: Inmarsat (GEO satellite) coverage (~70°N-70°S). A4: polar regions (outside Inmarsat coverage, HF required).

Ekipman gereksinimi kümülatiftir: A3 gem.en: The equipment requirement is cumulative: an A3 ship also carries A1 and A2 equipment. Every ship also carries an EPIRB, SART and portable VHF (survival craft). Equipment is selected according to the ship's most distant operating area.

GMDSS, ana güç kaybında bile çalışmalıdı.en: The GMDSS must operate even on loss of main power; therefore a separate battery (reserve source of energy) supplies the GMDSS equipment for a specified period (typically 1-6 hours, depending on the configuration). Equipment availability is ensured by the "duplication" or "shore-based maintenance" method.

GMDSS ekipmanını yetkili operatör (GOC/R.en: GMDSS equipment is operated by an authorized operator (holding a GOC/ROC certificate). Depending on the maintenance method, periodic tests (daily/weekly/monthly) are carried out and the radio log is kept. If a false distress alert is transmitted, it is canceled immediately.

VHF deniz bandı belirli kanallara ayrılm.en: The VHF maritime band is divided into specific channels. Channel 16 (156.8 MHz) is the distress, safety and calling channel; it is monitored continuously. Channel 70 is for DSC (not used for voice). Channel 13 is for bridge-to-bridge (maneuvering safety), channel 06 for ship-to-ship, and other channels for port/VTS and general communications.

Simpleks kanalda aynı frekansta sırayla.en: On a simplex channel, the parties talk in turn on the same frequency (ship-to-ship); on a duplex channel, two frequencies are used (telephone connection). Output power can be set to high (25 W) or low (1 W); low power is preferred for short-range communications and to avoid unnecessary interference.

DSC distress butonu (korumalı kapak altı.en: The DSC distress button (under a protective cover) sends the MMSI, position (if GPS is connected) and nature of distress on channel 70 with a single action.
