When the call is received, the stations concerned give an automatic alarm and voice follow-up is made on channel 16. The call is sent by holding the button down for 4-5 seconds.

VHF görüş hattı (line of sight) ile çalı.en: VHF works by line of sight; range depends on antenna height. A higher antenna gives a longer range. The antenna position is selected taking into account shadowing and interference with other antennas. A damaged antenna/coaxial cable seriously reduces range.

Filika/sallarda kullanılmak üzere taşına.en: Portable GMDSS VHF radios (generally yellow/orange, waterproof) are carried for use in lifeboats/liferafts; they provide communication with SAR units and the ship during life-saving operations. They have separate (spare) batteries and are tested regularly.

Günlük DSC testi (kıyı/başka istasyonla.en: A daily DSC test (with the coast station/another station, or self-test), antenna/coaxial cable checks, and battery and portable VHF tests are carried out; the radio log is kept. Care is taken during testing not to press the actual distress button by mistake.

Lifeboat gemiyi terk etmek (çok kişiyi u.en: The lifeboat is for abandoning the ship (getting many people away); the rescue boat, on the other hand, is for active rescue — reaching a person who has fallen overboard and marshalling liferafts. The rescue boat must therefore be fast, highly maneuverable and easy/quick to launch. On some ships, a lifeboat is also approved as the rescue boat.

FRB genelde sertgövde-şişme (RIB) yapıda.en: The FRB is generally of rigid-hull inflatable (RIB) construction; it is propelled by an outboard motor or a water jet (water-jet). The water jet reduces the risk of propeller injury in shallow water and when recovering people. The FRB must have high speed (maneuvering in bad weather) and a self-righting capability.

FRB davit'i, botu kötü havada bile hızlı.en: The FRB davit must be able to launch the boat quickly even in bad weather and — critically — recover it quickly while the ship is making way/in a seaway. A constant tension/shock-absorbing winch system damps the sudden load difference between the boat and the ship during recovery. Recovery is the most difficult and dangerous part of a MOB response.

MOB durumunda: alarm + can simidi/duman.en: In an MOB situation, the following steps are applied: alarm + releasing a lifebuoy/smoke signal, turning back by a maneuver (Williamson/Anderson turn), posting a lookout, preparing and launching the rescue boat, recovering the person and returning to the ship. If the water temperature is low, time is critical because of hypothermia; a rapid response saves lives.

Rescue boat/FRB ekibi düzenli eğitim ve.en: The rescue boat/FRB crew carries out regular training and drills; SOLAS requires a specially trained crew for the FRB and periodic launching/maneuvering drills. Cold-water protective clothing (immersion/exposure suits) is provided for the crew.

Bakım; motor/su jeti çalıştırma testi, y.en: Maintenance covers the motor/water jet start test, fuel and battery, inflatable tube pressure/damage (RIB), the davit winch and constant-tension system, and checks of the release gear and equipment. The boat is always kept ready and capable of being launched quickly.

MF (yaklaşık 1.6-4 MHz) gündüz ground wa.en: MF (approximately 1.6-4 MHz) gives a range of ~150-300 miles by day by ground wave (surface wave); at night the range is extended by sky wave. HF (3-30 MHz) reaches thousands of miles, even global range, by reflection from the ionosphere (sky wave); however, the range varies with frequency, time of day and ionospheric conditions.

MF DSC tehlike frekansı 2187.5 kHz'tir;.en: The MF DSC distress frequency is 2187.5 kHz; on HF there are separate DSC distress frequencies in the 4, 6, 8, 12 and 16 MHz bands. The distress alert is sent by DSC on the appropriate frequency; the receiving coast station picks it up automatically. Voice (radiotelephony) and NBDP (telex) distress frequencies are also defined.

DSC ile çağrı kurulduktan sonra sesli (R.en: Once the call has been set up by DSC, the content is transferred by voice (RT) or by NBDP (Narrow Band Direct Printing/telex). NBDP transmits text reliably in the noisy HF environment. After a distress alert, the coast station mostly follows up by voice.

MF/HF, uzun tel/whip anten ve otomatik a.en: MF/HF is matched to different frequencies by means of a long wire/whip antenna and an automatic antenna tuner (ATU). A good RF ground system (hull/sea ground) determines efficiency; a poor ground reduces range and output power. An ATU fault prevents transmission on certain bands.

A2 gemisi MF DSC taşır; A4 (kutup) gemis.en: An A2 ship carries MF DSC; HF DSC is mandatory for an A4 (polar) ship because Inmarsat GEO satellites do not provide coverage in the polar regions. A3 ships may also carry MF/HF as an alternative/backup to Inmarsat.

Günlük/haftalık DSC testi, anten/tuner v.en: Daily/weekly DSC tests, antenna/tuner and ground system checks and battery tests are carried out, and the radio log is kept. The test is not carried out on the actual distress frequency but by the appropriate test procedure.

Inmarsat-C, jeostatik (GEO) uydular üzer.en: Inmarsat-C operates via geostationary (GEO) satellites; the ship terminal links to the satellite, and the satellite to the land station (LES — Land Earth Station). The NCS (Network Coordination Station) manages network traffic. GEO satellites cover the area between ~70°N and ~70°S (A3); the polar regions (A4) are outside coverage.

Inmarsat-C gerçek zamanlı ses taşımaz; m.en: Inmarsat-C does not carry real-time voice; it packages messages and sends/receives them by the "store-and-forward" method. A low data rate is sufficient because it is designed for distress alerts and telex/email-type text. The antenna is small and omnidirectional (no pointing required).

Korumalı distress butonu, GPS konumu ve.en: The protected distress button sends the distress alert, with the GPS position and ship identity, via the selected LES to the relevant MRCC (rescue coordination center). Because the alert contains the nature of distress and the position, SAR is initiated quickly.

EGC (Enhanced Group Call) üzerinden Safe.en: Via EGC (Enhanced Group Call), the SafetyNET service automatically delivers navigational warnings, weather forecasts and SAR information to the ship on the open sea (A3); FleetNET is for commercial group messages. These MSI broadcasts are received and recorded automatically; SafetyNET is the open-sea complement to NAVTEX.

A3 gemisi GMDSS yedekliliğini Inmarsat +.en: An A3 ship provides GMDSS redundancy with an Inmarsat + MF/HF combination or with dual Inmarsat. The GMDSS is now becoming multi-provider; low earth orbit (LEO) systems such as Iridium offer global coverage including the polar regions and can therefore also cover A4.

Performans testi (LES üzerinden), anten.en: A performance test (via the LES), antenna line-of-sight and cable checks, the GPS feed, verification of EGC reception and backup battery testing are carried out. Uninterrupted reception of EGC messages is monitored.

EPIRB aktive olunca 406 MHz'de dijital t.en: When activated, the EPIRB transmits a digital distress signal on 406 MHz; this signal is received by Cospas-Sarsat satellites (LEO + GEO + MEOSAR) and relayed to ground stations (LUT). The digital message contains the ship's unique identity (hex ID/MMSI); the position is determined by the built-in GPS or by Doppler. In addition, a 121.5 MHz homing signal guides SAR units.

EPIRB, float-free braket içinde dış güve.en: The EPIRB is stowed on the open deck in a float-free bracket. If the ship sinks, the hydrostatic release unit (HRU) cuts the securing strap at a certain water depth (~1.5-4 m); the EPIRB floats to the surface and activates automatically on contact with water. Manual activation is also possible.

HRU'nun son kullanma tarihi vardır (gene.en: The HRU has an expiry date (generally 2 years) and is replaced on time; an expired HRU may fail to release. The EPIRB battery and mounting bracket are also checked periodically.

EPIRB, gemi ve irtibat bilgileriyle ilgi.en: The EPIRB must be registered with the relevant authority together with the ship and contact details (registration). Correct registration allows SAR to identify the ship quickly, reach its owner and distinguish a real alarm from a false one. The registration is updated on a change of ship/owner.

Bakım; self-test fonksiyonu (gerçek yayı.en: Maintenance covers the self-test function (without an actual transmission), battery and HRU expiry dates, and checks of the bracket/mounting and casing. Annual and periodic (shore-based) inspections are carried out. No actual distress transmission is sent during testing.

Radar-SART, 9 GHz (X-band) arama radarın.en: When a Radar-SART receives the pulse of a 9 GHz (X-band) searching radar, it transmits a series of response pulses on the same frequency; on the radar screen this appears as a line of 12 dots (blips) extending outward from the SART. As the range closes, the dots turn into arcs. This pattern clearly shows the position of the SART.

AIS-SART, radar yerine AIS üzerinden çal.en: The AIS-SART operates via AIS instead of radar: it broadcasts its built-in GPS position as a special AIS message; the SART position appears as a symbol on the AIS display of nearby ships. It is an alternative/complement to the Radar-SART and gives the position numerically.

Menzil yüksekliğe bağlıdır; SART ne kada.en: Range depends on height; the higher the SART is held (e.g. raised on a mast in the liferaft), the greater the range. It is typically detected at ~8 miles from a ship and at much greater distances from aircraft. Range is reduced if the SART is close to the water surface.

Gemi terk edilirken SART filikaya/sala a.en: When the ship is abandoned, the SART is taken into the lifeboat/liferaft and activated; it is held as high as possible. An activated SART enables SAR units to find the survival craft with the help of both radar and AIS. The SART is kept on the bridge in an easily accessible position, ready to be carried.

Bakım; batarya son kullanma tarihi, self.en: Maintenance covers the battery expiry date, self-test (test mode near a radar), casing/watertightness and bracket checks. The test is carried out according to the manufacturer's test procedure, without an actual SAR transmission.

BNWAS belirli bir süre (dormant period,.en: The BNWAS waits for a reset (movement/button) from the officer during a set period (dormant period, adjustable ~3-12 min). When the period expires, it first gives an audible/visual warning on the bridge; if the officer still does not respond, an alarm sounds in the cabins of the Master and the backup officers; finally, a general alarm may be given throughout the ship. In this way the officer's condition is safeguarded.

Reset, köprüdeki reset butonu veya harek.en: Reset is made with the reset button on the bridge or by motion sensors (motion detector); the physical presence of the officer on the bridge is detected. Reset cannot be made from outside the bridge; this prevents anyone else from silencing it remotely.

BNWAS modları: Automatic (otopilot/seyir.en: BNWAS modes: Automatic (activated automatically with the autopilot/when under way), Manual ON (permanently on) and OFF. OFF and the dormant period setting are restricted to the Master (password/key protected); the officer cannot switch it off at will. It is generally activated automatically when under way.

BNWAS özellikle otopilotta (kimse aktif.en: The BNWAS is especially important on autopilot (when nobody is actively steering), because the risk of the officer falling asleep increases during passive monitoring. The system can be set to activate automatically when the autopilot is engaged.

Bakım; alarm kademelerinin fonksiyon tes.en: Maintenance covers function testing of the alarm stages, the motion sensor/reset button, the cabin alarm speakers and the power supply. The test verifies that the actual chain of stages (bridge→cabin→ship) works.

VDR; köprü sesi (mikrofonlar), VHF haber.en: The VDR records, with a time stamp, bridge audio (microphones), VHF communications, radar/ECDIS images, position/speed/heading, depth, rudder and engine orders, alarms, wind and other sensors. This multi-source recording allows the moment of the accident to be reconstructed (reconstruction).

Veriler, yangın ve derin basınç/çarpmaya.en: The data are stored in a protective recording medium (protective capsule) resistant to fire, deep-water pressure and impact. Modern VDRs have both a fixed capsule (fixed, recovered after the ship has sunk) and a float-free capsule (which floats to the surface and transmits a signal like an EPIRB). The float-free capsule makes it easier to recover data from a sunken ship.

VDR son belirli süreyi (kapsülde tipik e.en: The VDR stores the most recent specified period (typically at least 48 hours in the capsule, longer in internal memory under modern standards) by continuously overwriting (loop). After an accident/significant event, this loop must be stopped and the data protected (save/lock); otherwise the data are overwritten.

S-VDR (Simplified), tam VDR'ye göre daha.en: The S-VDR (Simplified) records less data than the full VDR (e.g. radar images may not be mandatory); it was used on existing (retrofit) ships for cost reasons. The full VDR is standard on new ships.

VDR yılda bir APT (Annual Performance Te.en: The VDR is tested once a year by an authorized service provider in an APT (Annual Performance Test), and a certificate of compliance is issued. In the event of an accident, the Master must stop the recording and preserve the data (preserve) to prevent it from being overwritten, and hand it over to the authorities.

Bakım; APT, mikrofon/ses kanalı kontrolü.en: Maintenance covers the APT, microphone/audio channel checks, correct recording of sensor inputs (radar, GPS, gyro), capsule condition, battery (backup power) and checks of the float-free HRU expiry date.

Gravity davit, filikayı kendi ağırlığıyl.en: The gravity davit lowers the lifeboat out and down by its own weight (under brake control); it is the most common type. The free-fall davit releases the lifeboat into free fall and uses a separate hoist for recovery. The davit must be strong enough to carry the weight of the fully loaded lifeboat safely.

Filika kancası (release hook); off-load.en: The lifeboat hook (release hook) may be off-load (opens only when waterborne, with no load on it) or on-load (can be opened under load, before the boat is waterborne). On-load release allows rapid release but, if misused, causes the lifeboat to fall from a height. For this reason, the interlock and the hydrostatic interlock (which prevents opening before the boat is waterborne) are important.

Mürettebat embarkasyon güvertesinde fili.en: The crew board the lifeboat at the embarkation deck; when the davit brake is released, the lifeboat descends under control. The brake (centrifugal/band brake) limits the lowering speed. When the boat is waterborne, the release is opened and the boat moves away from the ship with the help of the painter (securing line). Through drills, the whole process must be known well enough to be carried out without rehearsal.

SOLAS, filikaların düzenli denize indiri.en: SOLAS requires lifeboats to be launched regularly and their engines to be run; the davit brake, winch and release system undergo periodic load testing. The abandon ship drill is held regularly; the crew know their duties and stations (muster list).

Filika; SOLAS donanımı (kürek, işaret fi.en: The lifeboat is equipped with SOLAS equipment (oars, pyrotechnic flares, first aid kit, water/food, compass, SART/VHF, painter). It is checked regularly that these items are complete and in date (expiry).

Bakım; davit winch/fren, tel halat (fall.en: Maintenance covers the davit winch/brake, the wear/renewal period of the wire rope (fall wire), the release mechanism and hydrostatic interlock, the engine and battery, hull integrity and equipment expiry checks. The fall wire is turned end for end/renewed at specified intervals.

Throw-over (atılır) liferaft, kapsül (ca.en: The throw-over liferaft is stowed on deck in a container (canister); when thrown into the sea, it inflates when the painter is pulled. The davit-launched liferaft, on the other hand, is boarded from the ship and lowered by davit; on high-sided ships it reduces the risk of jumping into the water. Both work on the same inflation principle.

Painter (bağlama halatı) belirli uzunluk.en: When the painter (securing line) is pulled out to a certain length, it opens the gas cylinder valve; the CO₂/nitrogen mixture inflates the raft within seconds and the container splits in two. If the raft inflates upside down, one person can right it with the righting strap. After inflation, the painter remains attached to the ship; once the raft has been boarded, it is cut/released.

HRU, liferaft kapsülünü krezete (cradle).en: When the ship sinks and reaches a certain water depth (~1.5-4 m), the HRU automatically cuts, by water pressure, the lashing that secures the liferaft container to the cradle. The container floats free and rises to the surface; meanwhile, as the painter is still attached to the ship, the raft inflates automatically.

Painter, gemiye bir weak link (zayıf bağ.en: The painter is attached to the ship through a weak link. If the ship continues to sink after the raft has inflated and is afloat, the weak link breaks at a certain load and saves the raft from being dragged down with the sinking ship. The weak link must be strong enough to keep the raft attached to the ship so that it inflates, but weak enough that the raft does not follow the sinking ship.

Liferaft, içindeki SOLAS donanım paketiy.en: The liferaft comes with the SOLAS equipment pack inside (A or B pack: flares, water, food, first aid kit, paddles, lifeline, sponges, repair kit). The capacity (number of persons) is marked on the container; the total liferaft + lifeboat capacity on board must accommodate all personnel.

Liferaft, yetkili servis istasyonunda pe.en: At an approved service station, the liferaft is periodically (generally annually, extended for some systems) opened, inflated and pressure-tested, its equipment is renewed and it is repacked. The HRU expiry date (generally 2 years) is monitored and the unit is replaced on time.

Gemide bakım; kapsül/cradle bütünlüğü, H.en: On board, maintenance covers the integrity of the container/cradle, correct fitting of the HRU and weak link, the painter attachment, the last service/HRU dates and lashing checks. Internal servicing is carried out only at an approved station.

İki zamanlı çevrimde her krank dönüşünde.en: In the two-stroke cycle, one power stroke is produced for every crank revolution: compression as the piston moves up, fuel injection/combustion at the top, power as it moves down, and scavenging/exhaust in the lower region. Modern large engines use uniflow scavenging: scavenge air enters through ports at the bottom of the liner and exhaust leaves through the single exhaust valve in the cylinder head; this gives a clean charge and high efficiency.

Pervane verimi düşük devirde ve büyük ça.en: Propeller efficiency is high at low rpm and large diameter. The two-stroke engine runs directly at this speed, eliminating gearbox losses. A large stroke/bore ratio (ultra-long stroke) raises thermal efficiency above 50%.

Ana parçalar: silindir gömleği (liner),.en: Main components: cylinder liner, piston and piston rings, piston rod, crosshead, connecting rod, crankshaft and main bearings. The crosshead design keeps the side thrust off the liner; liner wear is thus reduced and cylinder lubrication is managed separately.

Piston rod, silindir alanı ile karter (c.en: The piston rod passes from the cylinder space to the crankcase through the stuffing box. This prevents dirty cylinder oil from mixing with the clean crankcase oil. Cylinder oil (high BN, separate system) and system/crankcase oil are independent of each other.

Geleneksel motorlarda yakıt pompası ve e.en: In conventional engines, the fuel pump and exhaust valve are driven by the camshaft. In modern electronically controlled engines (MAN ME, WinGD RT-flex), common rail high-pressure fuel and hydraulic servo systems optimize injection timing and valve movement for each load/rpm; the camshaft is eliminated.

Egzoz gazı turboşarjı çevirir; kompresör.en: Exhaust gas drives the turbocharger; the compressor delivers the scavenge air, the air cooler (air cooler) cools the compressed air, increasing its density, and the air is supplied to the cylinders through the scavenge receiver. At low load, the auxiliary blower (auxiliary blower) cuts in to provide sufficient air.

Silindir başına egzoz sıcaklığı, maksimu.en: Exhaust temperature per cylinder, maximum combustion pressure (Pmax), scavenge air pressure/temperature, turbocharger rpm and bearing temperatures are monitored continuously. Imbalance (one cylinder deviating) indicates an injector, valve or load distribution problem.

Çevrim dört stroktan oluşur: emme (intak.en: The cycle consists of four strokes: intake (intake), compression (compression), power (power) and exhaust. One power stroke is produced every two crank revolutions (720°). The intake and exhaust valves are timed by the camshaft; valve overlap (valve overlap) allows the cylinder to be scavenged with fresh air and increases turbocharger efficiency.

Dört zamanlı motor daha yüksek devirde (.en: The four-stroke engine runs at higher speed (~500-1000 rpm), uses a trunk piston (no crosshead) and is lubricated by a single oil circuit (shared by the cylinders and the crankcase). Its power density is high; however, for the propulsion of large ships it is generally combined with a gearbox or electric propulsion.

Orta devirli motorlar MDO/MGO ile çalışa.en: Medium-speed engines can run on MDO/MGO and can also burn HFO with heating and viscosity control. Generator engines can change over to light fuel (MGO) during maneuvering/in port. Heating the fuel to the correct viscosity (~10-15 cSt at injection) is critical for atomization and efficiency.

Jeneratör motorlarında sabit devir (frek.en: Generator engines require a constant speed (frequency); the governor (regulator) therefore keeps the speed constant by adjusting the fuel as the load changes. In propulsion engines, on the other hand, the governor sets the speed according to the operator's command. For generators running in parallel, load sharing (load sharing) is managed by the governor droop setting.

Egzozla çevrilen turboşarj, emme havasın.en: The turbocharger, driven by the exhaust gas, pressurizes the intake air; the intercooler (charge air cooler) cools the air, increasing its density and reducing NOx. Charge air temperature and pressure are direct indicators of performance.

Bakım; supap klerans ayarı, enjektör tes.en: Maintenance covers valve clearance adjustment, injector testing, piston ring/liner wear measurement, bearing clearance checks, turbocharger and cooler cleaning, and oil/fuel filter changes. PMS is applied according to running hours.

Şaft hattı, makineden pervaneye doğru sı.en: From the engine to the propeller, the shaft line consists, in order, of the thrust shaft, the intermediate shaft(s) and the propeller (tail) shaft. They are connected by flanged couplings (coupling). The tail shaft passes through the stern tube and carries the propeller.

Pervane itkisi (ileri/geri) şaft üzerind.en: Propeller thrust (ahead/astern) is transmitted through the shaft to the thrust block (thrust bearing); the thrust block transfers this axial force to the ship's hull (seating), moving the ship ahead/astern. Tilting-pad thrust bearings run on an oil film; temperature and oil flow are monitored.

Tail shaft, stern tube yatağında döner..en: The tail shaft rotates in the stern tube bearing. The conventional system is oil-lubricated (white metal bearing, pressure from a gravity tank). The environmentally friendly alternative is the water-lubricated system (composite/lignum vitae bearing); it eliminates the risk of oil leakage, but bearing wear is monitored differently.

Stern tube seal (örn. lip seal/Simplex),.en: The stern tube seal (e.g. lip seal/Simplex) prevents seawater entering and oil escaping around the shaft. With multiple lip rings, the spaces between them are fed with oil. Seal wear results in oil leakage (marine pollution) or water ingress (bearing damage).

Şaft hattı, gövde deformasyonu ve sıcakl.en: The shaft line is aligned so that the bearings are evenly loaded despite hull deflection and temperature (bearing reaction / sag & gap). Incorrect alignment leads to bearing overload, overheating and vibration. Alignment is measured at the shipyard and, when necessary, verified for service conditions.

Şaft hattının burulma (torsional) ve eği.en: The torsional and bending (whirling) natural frequencies of the shaft line must not cause resonance within the engine speed range. Certain speed ranges may be prohibited (barred speed range); the engine is not run continuously in this range.

Tail shaft, klas tarafından periyodik su.en: The tail shaft is subject to periodic survey by class (withdrawal or an in-place condition monitoring program). Stern tube oil analysis (water/metal content), seal checks, bearing temperature and measurement of the shaft position (poker gauge/wear down) are carried out regularly.

Pitch (hatve), pervanenin bir tam dönüşt.en: Pitch is the distance the propeller should theoretically advance in one complete revolution. Diameter, number of blades and blade area ratio (BAR — blade area ratio) determine thrust and efficiency. Large diameter/low rpm increases efficiency; the number of blades affects vibration and cavitation.

FPP (Fixed Pitch Propeller) sabit hatvel.en: The FPP (Fixed Pitch Propeller) has a fixed pitch; for maneuvering and going astern, the engine reverses its direction of rotation. The CPP (Controllable Pitch Propeller) adjusts thrust and direction at constant rpm by changing the blade angle; it gives high maneuverability and is compatible with a shaft generator, but is mechanically complex and expensive.

Slip, teorik ilerleme (pitch × devir) il.en: Slip is the difference between the theoretical advance (pitch × revolutions) and the actual advance. Apparent slip is calculated with the GPS speed, and real slip with the actual speed through the water. Slip rising above normal indicates hull fouling (fouling), weather/current or propeller damage.

Pervane yükü tahmininde \"propeller law\.en: The "propeller law" is used to estimate propeller load: torque ~ rpm², power ~ rpm³. Therefore, even a modest increase in speed increases the power requirement cubically. A fouled hull or heavy weather makes the propeller heavier; the engine reaches the same rpm with more fuel (heavy running).

Kanat üzerindeki basınç buhar basıncının.en: When the pressure on the blade falls below the vapor pressure, the water turns into vapor bubbles (cavitation); the bubbles collapse in the high-pressure region, eroding the blade surface (erosion), producing noise and vibration and reducing efficiency. Overload, a damaged blade or incorrect pitch increase cavitation.

Havuzlamada pervane yüzeyi parlatılır (p.en: During dry-docking, the propeller surface is polished (polishing — for efficiency), blade edge damage is repaired and the balance is checked. On a CPP, hub tightness and the pitch mechanism are tested. The rope guard and propeller hub are checked.

Dümeni çeviren güç hidroliktir. Ram tipi.en: The power that turns the rudder is hydraulic. In the ram type, cylinders push the tiller (rudder arm); in the rotary vane type, vanes attached to the rudder stock rotate under pressure. The pumps (generally two, of variable delivery) drive the rudder to the ordered angle.

Ana dümen donanımı, gemi tam yüklü ve se.en: The main steering gear must be capable of putting the rudder over from 35° on one side to 30° on the other side in not more than 28 seconds, with the ship fully loaded and at service speed. The auxiliary steering gear must be able to do 15°-15° in 60 seconds (at half speed). These criteria are the basis of maneuvering safety.

Dümen kontrolü köprüden iki bağımsız sis.en: It must be possible to control the steering from the bridge by two independent systems; in the event of failure of the main system, it must be possible to change over to the auxiliary system from the bridge, and local (emergency) control must be available in the steering gear room. On tankers, continued steering capability after a single failure (single failure criteria) is required.

Köprüdeki dümen komutu, telemotor (eski.en: The helm order given on the bridge is transmitted to the steering gear room by the telemotor (older hydraulic or modern electric). In follow-up mode, the rudder stops at the ordered angle; in non-follow-up mode, it moves for as long as the button is held down. The autopilot (autopilot), for its part, corrects the rudder automatically according to the course error.

Dümen etkisi pervane akımına bağlıdır; p.en: The effect of the rudder depends on the propeller wash; when the propeller stops, rudder effectiveness falls. Maneuvering parameters such as transverse thrust (propeller side effect), pivot point and advance/transfer must be known by the bridge team. As the rudder angle increases, stall (flow separation) and loss of speed occur.

Bakım; hidrolik yağ seviyesi/analizi, sı.en: Maintenance covers hydraulic oil level/analysis, leak checks, ram/vane seals, the rudder stock bearing and carrier bearing, the feedback linkage and safety/limit settings. Regular testing and alarm checks are mandatory.

Radar, anten üzerinden çok kısa süreli y.en: The radar transmits very short, high-power microwave pulses through the antenna. The pulse strikes a target and returns; the range is calculated from the round-trip time (R = c·t/2), and the bearing from the direction of the antenna. On the display, own ship is at the center and targets are shown against the range rings.

X-band (~9 GHz, 3 cm) yüksek çözünürlük.en: X-band (~9 GHz, 3 cm) provides high resolution and detection of small targets but is affected by rain; SART and racon detection is on X-band. S-band (~3 GHz, 10 cm) penetrates rain/fog better and is stable at long range. SOLAS V/19 requires ships of 3000 GT and upwards to have a second radar in addition to the 9 GHz radar (3 GHz/S-band or, where the Administration considers it appropriate, a second 9 GHz/X-band); the two radars must be capable of operating independently of each other.

ARPA, seçilen veya otomatik kazanılan he.en: ARPA tracks selected or automatically acquired targets and calculates their speed/course vector and the CPA (Closest Point of Approach) and TCPA (Time to CPA) values. Vectors can be displayed in "true" or "relative" mode; the relative vector is used to assess the risk of collision, and the true vector to understand the target's actual movement.

ARPA trial (deneme) manevrası, planlanan.en: The ARPA trial maneuver simulates the new CPA/TCPA, with all tracked targets, of a planned course/speed change. It is used to verify that the maneuver is adequate and made early enough, but the delay time (delay) must be set realistically.

Deniz yüzeyinden (sea clutter) ve yağmur.en: Echoes from the sea surface (sea clutter) and from rain (rain clutter) can mask real targets. The sea clutter (STC/anti-clutter sea) and rain clutter (FTC/anti-clutter rain) controls suppress this noise; however, excessive suppression may also wipe out small real targets.

Yan loblar (side echoes), çok yollu yans.en: Side lobes (side echoes), multiple reflections (multiple/indirect echoes), shadowing (shadow sectors) and interference (interference from other radars) lead to misinterpretation. Recognizing these artifacts is essential for reading the display correctly.

SOLAS V/19, tonaja göre bir veya iki rad.en: SOLAS V/19 requires one or two radars depending on tonnage (the second being S-band). The performance monitor (PM) indicator is used to check the transmitter power and receiver sensitivity on the display; tuning and the PM are checked regularly.

ENC (Electronic Navigational Chart), vek.en: The ENC (Electronic Navigational Chart) is a vector-based, layered and "intelligent" official chart; objects can be queried and can generate alarms. The RNC (Raster Navigational Chart), on the other hand, is a scanned image of a paper chart; it has no intelligence and is used only in RCDS mode together with an appropriate portfolio of paper charts. Full ECDIS compliance requires ENCs.

ENC'ler S-63 standardıyla şifrelenir; ge.en: ENCs are encrypted to the S-63 standard; the ship receives cell permits (permits) and weekly updates through a subscription. Regular loading of updates is mandatory for legal and safety reasons; an outdated chart gives rise to liability in the event of a navigational accident.

ECDIS; GNSS (konum), gyro (heading), log.en: ECDIS receives data from GNSS (position), gyro (heading), log (speed), radar/ARPA (targets), AIS, echo sounder (depth) and the course/steering control systems. The accuracy of the position source (e.g. a GPS failure) directly affects navigational safety; an alarm is given if the sensors are inconsistent.

ECDIS tek arıza noktası olmamalıdır. SOL.en: ECDIS must not be a single point of failure. SOLAS requires a second ECDIS with an independent power supply (back-up ECDIS) or an appropriate portfolio of paper charts. The back-up system must be able to continue navigation without interruption if the main unit fails.

Safety contour (emniyet konturu), gemini.en: The safety contour is the safe depth limit based on the ship's draft; ECDIS highlights this contour and gives an alarm if it is crossed. The safety depth and shallow/deep contour settings determine the color coding. The guard zone / look-ahead gives advance warning if there is a safety contour or a dangerous object ahead.

Planlanan rota, ECDIS'in otomatik rota k.en: The planned route is scanned against the safety parameters by the ECDIS automatic route check (route check) function; legs that cross the contour, contain a dangerous object or go outside the XTD are flagged. This check must also be verified visually on the bridge.

Yanlış ayarlanmış emniyet parametreleri.en: Incorrectly set safety parameters generate a large number of unnecessary alarms; this "alarm fatigue" leads to real dangers being overlooked. The parameters are set carefully according to the ship's draft and the navigation area, and alarms are not silenced at will.

Sınıf A AIS, SOLAS gemilerinde zorunludu.en: Class A AIS is mandatory on SOLAS ships; it transmits more frequently, at high power (12.5 W) and with SOTDMA access. Class B is lower powered, transmits less frequently and is intended for non-commercial/small craft. Class A sees Class B, but has priority.

AIS üç tür bilgi yayınlar: statik (IMO n.en: AIS broadcasts three types of information: static (IMO number, call sign, name, dimensions), dynamic (position, COG, SOG, heading, ROT) and voyage-related (draft, cargo type, destination port, ETA). Static and voyage data are entered manually; an incorrect entry broadcasts false information.

AIS, iki özel VHF kanalında (AIS 1 / AIS.en: AIS operates on two dedicated VHF channels (AIS 1 / AIS 2) and divides time into 2250 slots per minute. With SOTDMA (Self-Organizing Time Division Multiple Access), each station avoids conflicts by selecting a free slot; the network organizes itself and requires no central control.

AIS yalnızca AIS taşıyan ve cihazı açık.en: AIS shows only targets that carry AIS and have it switched on; it does not see craft without AIS, land or other objects. Radar is therefore the primary tool for collision avoidance; AIS is complementary. Before maneuvering on the basis of an AIS target, radar/visual verification must be carried out.

AIS, hedefin gerçek rota/hızını verdiği.en: Because AIS gives the target's actual course/speed, it supports the assessment of CPA/TCPA; however, AIS data may be delayed or erroneous. COLREG maneuvering decisions are made after confirmation by radar/ARPA.

300 GT üstü uluslararası sefer ve 500 GT.en: Ships of 300 GT and upwards on international voyages, all ships of 500 GT and upwards, and passenger ships carry AIS. AIS is kept switched on at all times; however, the Master has the authority to switch it off for safety reasons (e.g. a piracy area), and this is recorded.

GPS alıcısı, en az dört uydudan gelen si.en: The GPS receiver measures the travel time of the signals from at least four satellites. Trilateration is performed using the known position of each satellite and the range calculated from the signal time (pseudorange); three satellites give the position, and the fourth resolves the receiver clock error. Because the signal travels at the speed of light, nanosecond-level timing is required.

Konum hatasına iyonosferik/troposferik g.en: Ionospheric/tropospheric delay, satellite orbit and clock errors, multipath (reflection from structures/the water surface) and receiver noise contribute to position error. The total of these errors is of the order of a few meters in standard GPS.

DOP (Dilution of Precision), uyduların g.en: DOP (Dilution of Precision) is the effect of the distribution of the satellites in the sky on accuracy. If the satellites are close to each other (poor geometry), HDOP rises and the position error increases. The receiver generally gives a warning when HDOP is high.

DGPS (Differential GPS), konumu bilinen.en: DGPS (Differential GPS) works by a shore reference station of known position broadcasting the error it measures; by applying this correction, the ship improves accuracy from a few meters to sub-meter level. IALA radio beacons and SBAS (e.g. EGNOS/WAAS) provide this correction.

GNSS sinyali çok zayıf olduğundan karışt.en: Because the GNSS signal is very weak, it is vulnerable to jamming (drowning out the signal) and spoofing (a false position from a fake signal). In certain areas, loss of GPS or a sudden jump in position may be a sign of spoofing; in this case independent positioning (radar fix, terrestrial, dual GNSS) is brought into use.

İki bağımsız GNSS alıcısı, dead reckonin.en: Two independent GNSS receivers, dead reckoning (DR) capability and the ability to take terrestrial fixes provide redundancy. On loss of GNSS, the officer must be able to continue navigating by DR and radar/visual fixes.

Gyro pusula, yüksek hızda dönen bir roto.en: The gyro compass makes use of the conservation of angular momentum of a rotor spinning at high speed (gyroscopic inertia) and its interaction with the earth's rotation (precession). By means of a gravity/damping arrangement, the rotor axis seeks true north (north-seeking) and stays there (north-settling). A true north reference independent of the magnetic field is thus obtained.

Gyro pusula bazı sistematik hatalar göst.en: The gyro compass shows certain systematic errors: latitude (settling) error, speed/course/latitude error (the error caused by the ship's speed and latitude) and ballistic deflection during maneuvers. Modern gyros correct these automatically, but the principle must be understood.

Manyetik pusula manyetik kuzeyi gösterir.en: The magnetic compass indicates magnetic north. The angle between true north and magnetic north is variation, which is taken from the chart/with the annual change. The error caused by the ship's own magnetic field, on the other hand, is deviation; it varies with the ship's heading/cargo and is given for each compass heading by the deviation card (deviation card).

Compass → True dönüşümünde sapma ve deği.en: In the Compass → True conversion, deviation and variation are applied in turn. The rule for subtracting/adding easterly (E) errors must be memorized; the classic mnemonic "CADET — Compass ADd East (to get True)" is used. Compass error is measured regularly by bearings of celestial bodies (sun/star) or by two objects in line (transit).

Gyro heading; köprü repeater'ları, dümen.en: Gyro heading is distributed to the bridge repeaters, the steering system, radar/ECDIS, AIS and the autopilot. Repeaters must follow the master gyro exactly; if there is a discrepancy, synchronization is checked. The magnetic compass can be read from the bridge by means of a periscope/mirror (reflector).

Transducer (dönüştürücü), elektrik enerj.en: The transducer converts electrical energy into a sound pulse; the pulse travels to the seabed, is reflected and returns. Depth is calculated from the round-trip time and the speed of sound in water (≈1500 m/s): D = (c·t)/2. The result is shown on the display and as a record (echo trace).

Echo sounder derinliği transducer'dan öl.en: The echo sounder measures depth from the transducer. The value shown on the display can be set with an offset so that it is referenced to the transducer, the lowest point of the hull (keel) or the water surface. The reference must be clearly known for UKC assessment.

Yumuşak çamur tabanda zayıf yankı, yoğun.en: A weak echo from a soft mud bottom, a dense school of fish or a thermocline layer may show a false depth. A double echo (multiple echo) may appear at a multiple of the true depth. In shallow and critical waters, the echo sounder reading is cross-checked with other sources (chart, draft).

UKC (karina altı boşluk), squat, gel-git.en: UKC (under-keel clearance) changes with the effects of squat, tide, waves and salinity. The echo sounder shows the actual clearance under the keel in real time, and this is compared with the planned UKC. In shallow-water navigation it is monitored continuously and the alarm is set appropriately.

SOLAS V/19, derinlik ölçüm cihazı taşıma.en: SOLAS V/19 makes the carriage of an echo-sounding device mandatory. The shallow water (shallow) alarm gives an audible/visual warning when the depth falls below the selected safe depth; it is kept active on the bridge.

Yatay tip (horizontal shaft) windlass, t.en: In the horizontal shaft (horizontal shaft) windlass, all components are on deck. It allows easy maintenance and is common on medium-sized ships.

Kombine windlass/mooring winch, hem zinc.en: In the combined windlass/mooring winch, both the cable lifter and the rope drum are on the same shaft. It saves space and cost.

Elektrik tahrikli windlass: AC veya DC m.en: Electrically driven windlass: operates with an AC or DC motor. Speed control is easy. It is used on most modern ships.

Hidrolik tahrikli windlass: Hidrolik pom.en: Hydraulically driven windlass: operates with a hydraulic pump and motor. Its advantages are high torque capacity, compact size and overload protection. It is common on tankers and bulk carriers.

Elektro-hidrolik windlass, elektrik moto.en: The electro-hydraulic windlass operates with a hydraulic motor or cylinder supplied by a hydraulic pump driven by an electric motor.

Çift bumbalı vinç: İki bumba ile daha ge.en: Twin-jib crane: provides a wider working area with two jibs.

Gantry crane (portal vinç): Konteyner ge.en: Gantry crane (gantry crane): a crane that travels above the hatch covers on container ships. It provides high speed and precise positioning.

Derrick (çubuk bumba): Eski tip gemilerd.en: Derrick (derrick boom): a lifting arrangement found on older ships, working with a derrick boom and ropes. With the union purchase method, two derricks can be operated simultaneously for a fast operation.

Safe Working Load (SWL), onaylı yük diya.en: The Safe Working Load (SWL) is the upper limit permitted for the boom angle/radius and working configuration in the approved load diagram; the weights of the hook block, spreader and loose gear are included.

Muayene, kapsamlı muayene ve proof-load.en: The scope of inspections, thorough examinations and proof-load tests is not verified from a fixed internet table but from the flag State's practice, SOLAS II-1/3-13, MSC.1/Circ.1663, the applicability of ILO 152 and the ship's Register of Lifting Appliances/Cargo Gear Book records.

Head line: Baş taraftan rıhtıma ileriye.en: Head line: a line leading forward from the bow to the quay. It pulls the ship toward the quay.

Stern line: Kıç taraftan rıhtıma geriye.en: Stern line: a line leading aft from the stern to the quay.

Breast line: Gemiden rıhtıma dik olarak.en: Breast line: a line leading from the ship to the quay at right angles. It keeps the ship close to the quay.

Halat türleri: Polipropilen (PP), poliam.en: Rope types: polypropylene (PP), polyamide (nylon), polyester, HMPE (Dyneema), wire rope. Different types have different elongation and breaking characteristics; mixed use is dangerous.

Sentetik halatlar tel halatlardan çok da.en: Synthetic lines store much more energy than wire ropes; they are much more dangerous at the moment of parting. Snap-back is the leading cause of death in mooring operations.

Otomatik gerilim özellikli vinçler, hala.en: Winches with auto-tension keep the line tension constant at the set value. They compensate for the effects of tide, changes in loading and wind.

Hidrolik veya frekans kontrollü elektrik.en: They operate with a hydraulic or frequency-controlled electric motor. A tension sensor (load cell) continuously measures the force in the line.

Kauçuk contalar (rubber packing), compre.en: Rubber packing (rubber packing), compression bars, cross-joints and drains together provide weathertight integrity; replacing the packing alone does not correct incorrect panel alignment or inadequate cleat adjustment.

Hose test: Onaylı test düzenine göre dış.en: Hose test: water is applied from outside in accordance with the approved test arrangement and any ingress is observed from inside; the water pressure, nozzle distance and rate of travel are not chosen at random.

Ultrasonic test: Daha güvenilir bir yönt.en: Ultrasonic test: a more reliable method in which the tightness of the packing is measured with an ultrasonic transmitter inside the hold and a receiver outside.

Tebeşir testi: Contaya tebeşir sürülerek.en: Chalk test: chalk is applied to the packing and the cover is closed; when the cover is opened, the chalk mark on the steel surface must be evenly distributed.

Capstan, windlass'tan farklı olarak yaln.en: Unlike the windlass, the capstan is used only for hauling lines; it cannot hold chain. The line is wound a few turns around the vertical drum and is hauled in by friction.

Elektrik veya hidrolik tahriklidir. Baş.en: It is electrically or hydraulically driven. It is located on the forecastle and the poop deck. It is used for heaving in mooring lines and for warping operations.

Capstan tamburuna sarılan halattaki sürt.en: The friction force in a line wound around a capstan drum is calculated with Euler's formula.

Bollard: Halatın bağlandığı sabit sütun..en: Bollard: a fixed post to which a line is made fast. It may be single, double or T-type. Its SWL is marked on it.

Fairlead (panama chock): Halatı yönlendi.en: Fairlead (panama chock): a lead used to guide the line. It may be of the roller or closed type.

Pedestal roller: Halat yönlendirme makar.en: Pedestal roller: a roller for leading the line. It reduces friction.

Bitts: İkili bağlama babası. Halat 8 şek.en: Bitts: a double mooring bollard. The line is made fast by turning it around them in a figure of eight.

Magnetronlu veya solid-state verici, sca.en: A magnetron or solid-state transmitter sends electromagnetic energy through the scanner. The round-trip time of the echo returning from the target gives the range, and the azimuth position of the antenna gives the relative bearing. When gyro heading is added, true bearings and north-up/course-up presentations can be produced.

Receiver ve signal processor çok zayıf e.en: The receiver and signal processor amplify the very weak echo while trying to suppress sea clutter, rain clutter and interference. Excessive use of the gain or clutter controls can wipe out not only the noise but also real targets such as small craft, buoys, low coastlines or targets among the waves.

Radarın operasyonel değeri yalnız ekoyu.en: The operational value of radar is not only that it shows echoes: correct presentation/motion selection, an appropriate range scale, EBL/VRM measurement, parallel indexing, trails and ARPA target tracking are different layers of evidence in the same picture.

X-band yaklaşık 9 GHz/3 cm dalga boyunda.en: X-band operates at approximately 9 GHz/3 cm wavelength; it gives high discrimination of small targets and coastline detail and interrogates the radar SART, but can be more affected by precipitation. S-band is at approximately 3 GHz/10 cm wavelength; it can give a more stable long-range picture in heavy precipitation and some sea conditions, but does not show the classic radar SART response.

İki radar varsa aynı ayar ve range'de ko.en: If there are two radars, they must not be used as duplicate displays at the same settings and range. With different band, range, pulse/presentation and clutter settings, independent pictures are created that reduce common blind spots.

Önce brilliance/contrast ve background,.en: First brilliance/contrast and background are set, then orientation and motion are selected with an appropriate range scale. Head-up unstabilized gives a simple relative picture; gyro-stabilized course-up or north-up makes comparison with the chart and with true bearings easier. Relative motion and true motion are the motion reference for the whole radar picture, not for the target vectors.

Gain, boş alanda hafif speckle görülecek.en: Gain is verified manually by turning it back slightly from the level at which a light speckle is visible in a clear area. Sea clutter suppresses wave echoes in the immediate vicinity; rain clutter suppresses precipitation cells. The controls are kept at the lowest necessary level and rechecked at different ranges to confirm that small targets are not lost.

Kısa pulse yakın hedef ayrımını, uzun pu.en: A short pulse supports the discrimination of close targets, while a long pulse/appropriate processing supports the energy returned from distant targets. Pulse-compression/auto modes on solid-state equipment are manufacturer-specific; the user must know from the display which automatic function is active.

Shadow/blind sector; mast, baca, crane v.en: A shadow/blind sector is the weakening or disappearance of targets on certain bearings because of a mast, funnel, crane or cargo. These sectors are managed using the bridge poster/inspection information and the other radar/visual lookout.

Side-lobe, multiple echo, indirect echo,.en: Side-lobe, multiple echo, indirect echo, second-trace and interference returns can resemble real targets. They are distinguished by their movement relative to fixed objects, their behavior when the range is changed, and by checks with the other radar and visual checks.

Ducting, yoğun yağış, sea state, hedef r.en: Ducting, heavy precipitation, sea state, the target's radar cross-section and antenna height change the detection range. The fact that a target beyond the radar horizon or with a low RCS is not visible does not mean that the target is not there.

EBL/VRM ile ölçülen bearing/range; curso.en: Bearings/ranges measured with the EBL/VRM provide quantitative evidence on which decisions can be based, instead of the cursor or estimation by eye on the screen. If relative bearings are used, the gyro/heading error and the own-ship heading reference are dealt with separately.

Parallel index, sabit bir radar objesini.en: Parallel indexing shows the cross-track situation by monitoring the movement of a fixed radar object relative to the planned PI line; it is not a copy of the electronic route line. The PI is prepared using a suitable radar-conspicuous object, the correct range/bearing and the clearing distances calculated on the passage plan.

Bir sabit objenin EBL bearing trendi, ra.en: The EBL bearing trend of a fixed object supports checking radar bearing alignment and compass error. Because radar overlay alignment may share the same GNSS/gyro error, it does not on its own count as an independent position check.

ARPA ardışık radar ölçümlerinden hedef t.en: ARPA builds the target track from successive radar measurements; with own-ship heading and speed input, it produces estimates of relative/true course-speed, CPA and TCPA. The solution for a newly acquired target, a maneuvering target, a target whose echo merges with another or a target within clutter may be unstable.

Relative vector, mevcut hareketler sürer.en: The relative vector shows the path the target will follow relative to own ship if present movements continue; the true vector shows the actual direction and speed relative to the selected ground/water speed reference. Looking only at the tip of the arrow without reading the vector mode/time leads to misinterpretation of maneuvers.

Trial manoeuvre karar desteğidir; gecikm.en: The trial maneuver is a decision aid; it depends on the delay time, the planned course/speed change and the assumption that targets maintain their current track. The result does not take over COLREG responsibility, the visual lookout or the bridge team's assessment.

Rule 5 tüm uygun araçlarla gözcülük; Rul.en: Rule 5 requires a lookout by all available means; Rule 6 a safe speed; Rule 7 determination of risk of collision by all available means; Rule 8 early, readily apparent and safe avoiding action. A bearing that remains constant or does not change appreciably, together with a decreasing range, is a sign of serious risk; at close range, risk may exist even if the bearing is changing.

Kısıtlı görüşte Rule 19 uygulanır. Radar.en: In restricted visibility, Rule 19 applies. Whether the radar target is forward of or abaft the beam, the risk of a close-quarters situation and the direction of the course alteration are considered together; a COLREG maneuver is not based solely on the AIS name or a VHF agreement.

Radar plotting bir defalık CPA okuması d.en: Radar plotting is not a one-off CPA reading. The target is acquired, the solution is allowed to settle, the bearing/range-vector trend is monitored, and the effect of the maneuver made is rechecked after a sufficient time.

Performance monitor/BITE sonucu, sea ret.en: The performance monitor/BITE result, the sea return and the appearance of known radar-conspicuous objects are the daily evidence of operational performance. In magnetron systems the warm-up/tuning behavior, and in solid-state systems the self-test and module status, are monitored in accordance with the manufacturer's manual.

Heading/speed input kaybında radar ekosu.en: On loss of heading/speed input, radar echoes may still be present, but stabilization and the reliability of ARPA true data are degraded. The user isolates the faulty layer, reverts to relative measurements and manual plotting/other radar and visual methods, informs the Master and records the fault.

ECDIS carriage requirement tüm SOLAS gem.en: The ECDIS carriage requirement is not the same for all SOLAS ships; ship type, GT, date of construction and the applicable transitional provisions are verified from the Record of Equipment. The carriage requirement and the backup arrangement are also separate matters: a second independent ECDIS, an up-to-date paper chart folio or another adequate arrangement accepted by the Administration is defined in the ship's approved documentation.

ECDIS ancak resmî Hydrographic Office ye.en: ECDIS provides the legal chart function only when it is used in the approved operating mode with up-to-date ENC/ENDS issued under the authority of an official Hydrographic Office. ECS, web charts, pilot applications or unofficial charts do not meet the SOLAS chart carriage requirement, even if they appear on the ECDIS screen.

RNC'nin bulunduğu RCDS modunda ECDIS'in.en: In RCDS mode, in which RNCs are used, the vector alarm/query capabilities of ECDIS are reduced. RCDS use is managed together with the required up-to-date paper charts and a procedure covering the flag/route scope; opening a raster chart on the screen does not automatically provide legal equivalence.

Legacy ECDIS'te resmî vektör ENC esas ol.en: In legacy ECDIS, the official vector ENC is distributed mainly in the IHO S-57 transfer standard; it is loaded via the S-63 data protection/permit mechanism and converted losslessly into the SENC in the manufacturer's internal format. On-screen symbols/colors and display categories comply with the IHO S-52 Presentation Library and the equipment performance standard.

S-101, S-100 tabanlı yeni nesil ENC ürün.en: S-101 is the S-100-based next-generation ENC product and cannot be opened on every existing S-57 ECDIS. MSC.530(106) accepts either MSC.232(82) or the new standard for equipment installed between 1 January 2026 and 31 December 2028; ECDIS installed from 1 January 2029 onward will be to the new/S-100-capable standard. This does not mean that all ships' ENCs switch to S-101 overnight.

Base cell, new edition ve incremental up.en: The sequence of base cell, new edition and incremental updates, permit validity, the update log/rejections and presentation library/software compatibility are checked together. Updates are applied as they are issued by the official service; although most services use a weekly package, 'pressing a button once a week' is not the only proof of being up to date.

Passage appraisal, kalkıştan varışa ve c.en: The passage appraisal checks the official ENC coverage from departure to arrival and to contingency/abort ports, the appropriate usage band/compilation scale, permits, latest updates, services such as the T&P/AVCS information overlay, and the necessary nautical publications.

Overscale, underscale, no data, better-s.en: The overscale, underscale, no data, better-scale ENC available and datum shift indications are read for what they mean. Zooming does not create new detail; when the source/compilation scale is exceeded, the position and geometry of objects can give a false sense of precision.

CATZOC/quality of bathymetric data ve so.en: CATZOC/quality of bathymetric data and the source diagram describe the survey quality and uncertainty of the depth information; safe water is not as certain as the 'blue-white color' suggests. In UKC/route decisions, this quality is assessed together with squat, tide and ship motion.

Safety depth, spot sounding'lerin vurgul.en: The safety depth is the threshold for highlighting spot soundings; on its own it is not an alarm limit. The safety contour is used as the boundary between safe and dangerous water — where no contour equal to the user value exists, the next deeper contour available in the ENC is selected — and it feeds the crossing/approach warning logic.

Shallow ve deep contour esas olarak renk.en: The shallow and deep contours mainly govern the color bands and situational awareness. XTD is the route corridor; it may differ for each leg according to channel width, traffic, positioning accuracy, bank/turning and the abort area. The look-ahead/time-or-distance sector, on the other hand, depends on the manufacturer's interface and is set according to the ship's actual stopping/turning needs.

Safety settings şirket UKC politikası ve.en: Safety settings are derived from the company UKC policy and the Master-approved passage plan. The effects of squat, heel/list, wave response/density allowance, required UKC and height of tide are added to the static draft with an explicit sign convention; a single draft field in ECDIS is not to be taken as having done this calculation on its own.

Route, berth-to-berth hazırlanır; waypoi.en: The route is prepared berth to berth; waypoints/legs, turn radius/wheel-over, speed plan, XTD, clearing ranges/PI, reporting points, no-go/limiting danger lines, abort points, contingency anchorages and pilotage notes are linked within a single passage plan logic.

Automatic route check seçili safety cont.en: Automatic route check generates warnings according to the selected safety contour and mariner objects, but it cannot be relied upon to catch objects outside the screen, wrong display/scale, user charts, T&P information, chart quality or gaps in software interpretation. Zero warnings is not a certificate of a safe route.

OOW rotayı appropriate largest scale/usa.en: The OOW visually inspects the route leg by leg on the appropriate largest scale/usage band, resolves and justifies each alarm/indication, and after the Master's approval uses it as a protected route. A last-minute route revision goes through the same appraisal-check-visual review-approval chain.

Monitoring modunda active route/leg, cro.en: In monitoring mode, the active route/leg, cross-track, next waypoint/turn, selected position-heading-speed sensors, chart scale and alarms are monitored simultaneously. If there is a track-control/autopilot connection, mode awareness and readiness for manual takeover are particularly maintained.

Primary GNSS position, mümkün olan bağım.en: The primary GNSS position is cross-checked against an independent second PNT source where possible and against radar/visual/terrestrial fixes. Two ECDIS using the same GNSS/gyro/log do not provide two independent verifications. Radar overlay, too, often shares the same heading/position input.

Manual fix yalnız sembol koymak değil; s.en: A manual fix is not just placing a symbol; it is a record of the source, time, accuracy and discrepancy. When a position jump/freeze, spoofing/jamming, datum mismatch or charted object misalignment is observed, dependence on track control is ended, the Master is called and safe speed/sea room is reassessed.

Alarm, warning ve caution/indication üre.en: Alarms, warnings and cautions/indications may have different priorities and audible behavior depending on the manufacturer and the applicable performance standard. Acknowledging only manages the sound; it does not remove the danger or the sensor failure. Alarms are not silenced en masse without reading the alarm list, source and consequence.

Alarm yorgunluğu çoğunlukla yanlış safet.en: Alarm fatigue mostly arises from incorrect safety settings, unnecessary user layers, inappropriate look-ahead/XTD or unresolved chart objects. The solution is not to desensitize the system but to correct the passage plan and settings for the operational context.

Over-reliance yalnız pencereden dışarı b.en: Over-reliance is not just failing to look out of the window: accepting the automatic route check as absolute, believing two same-source displays to be independent, thinking that chart zoom increases accuracy, and reading a predicted position as a measured fix are also examples of over-reliance.

ECDIS failure; black screen kadar positi.en: ECDIS failure may be not only a black screen but also loss of the position/heading source, frozen data, a corrupted SENC, permit/update failure, wrong time, network lag, unsafe settings, or the backup unit being dependent on the same common-mode fault.

Backup arrangement primary ECDIS arızala.en: The backup arrangement must be ready for use as soon as the primary ECDIS fails and must be up to date, and the method of transferring/re-creating the passage plan must be known. If the second ECDIS is affected by the same switchboard, GNSS or network failure, true independence is addressed in the company risk assessment.

Arızada OOW önce seyri emniyete alır: ma.en: In the event of failure, the OOW first makes navigation safe: manual steering/appropriate mode, safe speed, additional lookout/fix frequency, alternative chart/navigation method and calling the Master. Rebooting/servicing is carried out in accordance with the maker/SMS after the navigational risk has been brought under control.

STCW'ye göre ECDIS kullanan zabit gerekl.en: Under STCW, an officer using ECDIS must have the required generic ECDIS competence. On joining the ship, familiarization with that manufacturer/model, menu logic, alarms, route transfer, sensor selection and backup is required under the ISM/SMS. It should not be stated as if a single, uniform, separate international certificate called a 'type-specific certificate' were mandatory in every case; flag/company requirements are checked separately.

1 Ocak 2026-2028 arasında yeni kurulan E.en: ECDIS newly installed between 1 January 2026 and 2028 may conform to the MSC.232(82) or the MSC.530(106) family; from 1 January 2029, new installations move to the revised standard supporting the S-100 product family. The user should know the type-approval baseline and the software/presentation library version of their own equipment from the service records.

Class A taşıma zorunluluğu 'tüm SOLAS ge.en: The Class A carriage requirement cannot be generalized as 'all SOLAS ships'; it is verified through the ship type, voyage type and GT thresholds in SOLAS V/19 and the Record of Equipment. Class A reports with higher priority on a SOTDMA basis.

Class B, ilgili ulusal kurallar veya gön.en: Class B may be found on small commercial ships and craft under the relevant national rules or as voluntary fitting. Power, access method and reporting interval vary according to the device subclass.

AIS sürekli açık tutulmalıdır; kaptan gü.en: AIS must be kept on at all times; the Master may switch it off for safety reasons, but this decision must be recorded in the deck logbook.

AIS verileri tek başına çatışma önleme k.en: AIS data must not be used on its own for collision avoidance decisions; it must be assessed together with radar and visual lookout.

MMSI numarası bayrak devleti tarafından.en: The MMSI number is assigned by the flag State and is unique.

GPS, en az 4 uydudan gelen sinyal ile al.en: GPS calculates the receiver's position and time from the signals of at least 4 satellites. Each satellite broadcasts its own position and the time at which the signal was sent. The receiver calculates the range from the travel time of the signal.

Gösterilen fix kalitesi; uydu geometrisi.en: The quality of the displayed fix depends on satellite geometry, the antenna's view of the sky, the ionosphere, multipath, integrity monitoring and the augmentation used. A single '± meters' value does not prove the reliability of the position at that moment.

Differential GPS, kıyı istasyonlarından.en: Differential GPS improves accuracy by means of correction data received from shore stations. It is important in port approaches and coastal navigation.

SBAS (Satellite Based Augmentation Syste.en: SBAS (Satellite Based Augmentation System): satellite-based correction systems such as WAAS (USA), EGNOS (Europe) and MSAS (Japan) improve accuracy regionally.

Jiroskopik prensiple çalışan pusula, dün.en: The compass working on the gyroscopic principle aligns itself with the earth's axis of rotation and indicates true north. Its error (gyro error) is small and can be corrected.

Fiber optik jiroskop (FOG) ve ring laser.en: The fiber optic gyroscope (FOG) and the ring laser gyroscope (RLG) are modern solid-state types. They have no moving parts and are more reliable.

Gyro pusula tekrarlayıcıları (repeater).en: Gyro compass repeaters are fitted on the bridge, on the bridge wings and in the steering gear room.

Variation (iğne sapması) coğrafi konuma.en: Variation depends on geographical position and is read from the chart. It has an annual change.

Toplam hata = Variation + Deviation. CDM.en: Total error = Variation + Deviation. CDMVT rule: Compass → Deviation → Magnetic → Variation → True

Transducer, ses darbesi gönderir ve deni.en: The transducer sends a sound pulse and receives the echo reflected from the seabed. Depth is calculated from the round-trip time.

Suda ses hızı sıcaklık, tuzluluk ve bası.en: The speed of sound in water varies with temperature, salinity and pressure. Standard calibration assumes 1 500 m/s, but the actual value may vary between 1 450 and 1 540 m/s.

Bar check: Transducer altına bilinen der.en: Bar check: the echo sounder is calibrated by lowering a metal plate to a known depth below the transducer.

İki zamanlı motorda her krank mili dönüş.en: In a two-stroke engine, there is one power stroke for every revolution of the crankshaft. As the piston moves down, it uncovers the exhaust ports; the scavenge air drives the burnt gases out of the cylinder and fills it with fresh air.

Uniflow scavenging: Hava alttan girer, e.en: Uniflow scavenging: air enters at the bottom and exhaust leaves through the exhaust valve at the top. It is the standard method in modern two-stroke engines.

Crosshead yapısı sayesinde piston kolu v.en: Thanks to the crosshead design, there is a crosshead pin connection between the piston rod and the crankshaft; the piston moves only vertically. As a result, cylinder lubrication and crankcase lubrication are separate from each other.

Common-rail, elektronik-hidrolik veya ka.en: Common-rail, electronic-hydraulic or cam-driven mechanical injection may be used. Rail/servo and injection pressures vary with the load point and engine design; alarm/trip and maintenance limits are taken only from the maker's manual and shop-trial data.

VIT (Variable Injection Timing): Yük dur.en: VIT (Variable Injection Timing): injection timing is varied according to the load. Early injection at low loads and late injection at high loads give optimum combustion.

Dört zamanlı motorda emme, sıkıştırma, i.en: The four-stroke engine has 4 strokes: intake, compression, power and exhaust. There is one power stroke for every two crank revolutions.

Trunk piston tasarımı kullanılır; crossh.en: A trunk piston design is used; there is no crosshead. The engine is more compact and lighter, but the power per cylinder is lower than in a two-stroke engine.

Turbocharger ile doldurulan hava, interc.en: The air supplied by the turbocharger is cooled by passing through the intercooler and is delivered to the intake manifold.

İtme yatağı (Michell tipi): Tilting pad.en: Thrust bearing (Michell type): transfers the propeller thrust to the ship's structure by means of a tilting pad bearing design. It runs on an oil film.

Stern tube: Pervane şaftının gemi gövdes.en: Stern tube: provides bearing support and sealing at the point where the propeller shaft leaves the hull.

Şaft hizalaması lazer alignment veya sag.en: Shaft alignment is carried out by laser alignment or by the sag-gap method. Misalignment can cause bearing wear, vibration and shaft fracture.

Torsional vibration (burulma titreşimi):.en: Torsional vibration: a periodic torsional moment arising from the engine cylinders firing at different times. Resonance can occur at critical speeds; a barred speed range is established.

Pervane kanat yüzeyinde yerel basıncın s.en: Cavitation: the collapse of vapor bubbles formed when the local pressure on the propeller blade surface falls below the vapor pressure of the water. It causes erosion, noise, vibration and loss of efficiency.

Kavitasyon türleri: Sheet (yüzey), tip v.en: Types of cavitation: sheet (surface), tip vortex (blade tip), bubble, cloud and supercavitation.

Kavitasyonu azaltmak için kanat profili.en: To reduce cavitation, blade profile optimization, blade tip shaping and appropriate loading are applied.

Elektrik motoru ile tahrik edilen hidrol.en: A hydraulic pump driven by an electric motor sends pressurized oil to the steering gear actuators. Rapson slide or rotary vane type actuators are used.

Güç ünitesi, kontrol devresi ve ayrım dü.en: The power unit, control circuit and separation arrangement are approved according to the ship's size and the applicable paragraphs of SOLAS II-1/29. The presence of two pumps is not, on its own, proof of full independence.

Ana steering gear için yaygın SOLAS krit.en: The usual SOLAS criterion for the main steering gear is to put the rudder over from 35° on one side to 35° on the other side at the deepest draft and maximum ahead service speed, and in any case from 35° on one side to 30° on the other side in not more than 28 seconds.

Auxiliary steering gear için kriter, yin.en: The criterion for the auxiliary steering gear is, again at the defined draft and at not less than 7 knots or one half of the maximum ahead service speed, to put the rudder over from 15° on one side to 15° on the other side in not more than 60 seconds; exceptions and equivalent arrangements are checked against the approved documentation.

Alternatör, 3 fazlı AC gerilim üretir. G.en: The alternator generates 3-phase AC voltage. The ship's main busbar voltage is usually 440 V or 6.6 kV.

İki jeneratörü aynı baraya bağlamak için.en: To connect two generators to the same busbar, their frequency, voltage, phase sequence and phase angle must be equal.

Synchroscope veya synchronizing lamps il.en: Phase matching is checked with a synchroscope or synchronizing lamps. The breaker is closed as the synchroscope pointer approaches the 12 o'clock position.

Otomatik senkronizasyon sistemleri freka.en: Automatic synchronizing systems adjust the frequency and voltage difference automatically and close the breaker at the right moment.

Paralel çalışan jeneratörler arasında ak.en: Between generators running in parallel, active power (kW) sharing is achieved by the governor setting, and reactive power (kVAR) sharing by the AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) setting.

Droop mode: Her jeneratörün frekansı yük.en: Droop mode: the frequency of each generator falls slightly as the load increases; natural load sharing is achieved.

Isochronous mode: Frekans sabit tutulur;.en: Isochronous mode: the frequency is kept constant; the load is distributed equally by the load sharing controller.

pH, alkalinite, iletkenlik/TDS, klorür,.en: The targets for pH, alkalinity, conductivity/TDS, chloride, phosphate and oxygen scavenger are determined according to boiler pressure, metallurgy and the treatment program used. A single range taken from the internet does not apply to all boilers.

Klorür trendi condenser/deniz suyu kaçağ.en: A chloride trend may indicate a condenser/seawater leak; the acceptance and blowdown limit is the value given by the water-treatment supplier and in the maker's manual.

Sertlik ve besi suyu kontaminasyonu scal.en: Hardness and feed water contamination create a risk of scale/overheating; the measurement method and the corrective step are recorded according to the test-kit procedure.

Kimyasal seçimi gelişigüzel yapılmaz; ba.en: Chemicals are not selected at random; some oxygen scavengers have health/environmental restrictions. Dosing is carried out only in accordance with the approved treatment program and the SDS.

Emniyet valfi: Kazan basıncı ayar değeri.en: Safety valve: opens automatically when the boiler pressure exceeds the set value. At least 2 must be fitted.

Su seviye alarmı: Düşük su seviyesi (low.en: Water level alarm: the low water alarm and the low-low water trip.

Alev gözü (flame eye): Brülör alevini iz.en: Flame eye (flame eye): monitors the burner flame; if the flame goes out, the fuel is cut off.

Kapak kilitleme (interlock): Furnace kap.en: Door interlock (interlock): the burner cannot operate while the furnace door is open.

Santrifüj kuvvet, ağır partikülleri dışa.en: Centrifugal force throws the heavy particles outward. The disc stack (disc stack) increases the separating surface. The bowl rotates at 6 000-9 000 rpm.

Purifier: Hem su hem katı madde ayırır..en: Purifier: separates both water and solids. The position of the interface is controlled by the gravity disc (water ring).

Clarifier: Yalnızca katı partikülleri ay.en: Clarifier: separates only solid particles; there is no water outlet.

Gravity disc çapı, yakıtın yoğunluğuna g.en: The gravity disc diameter is selected according to the density of the fuel. Selecting the wrong disc causes fuel to escape through the water outlet or water to remain mixed with the fuel.

HFO arıtma sırası: Settling tank → Purif.en: HFO treatment sequence: Settling tank → Purifier → Clarifier → Service tank → Engine.

Yakıt ön ısıtmasını sabit 98 °C'ye değil.en: Do not set the fuel preheating to a fixed 98 °C; set it according to the density/viscosity in the analysis and the separator maker's separation-temperature nomogram, and do not exceed the flash point and closed-system limits.

Debi ayarı kritiktir; yüksek debi ayrışm.en: Flow rate adjustment is critical; a high flow rate reduces separation quality. The manufacturer's recommended flow rate must not be exceeded.

Ana makine starting-air receiver sayısı,.en: The number, isolation and total capacity of the main engine starting-air receivers are verified according to SOLAS II-1 and the class/maker arrangement. The general capacity criterion is 12 consecutive starts without replenishment by the compressor for reversible engines and 6 starts for non-reversible engines; it is not generalized as 'each receiver 6 starts'.

Kompresör kademeleri arasında ara soğutm.en: Intercooling (intercooler) between the compressor stages and aftercooling (aftercooler) are provided. There is an automatic drain (auto-drain) at the outlet of each stage.

Hava şişesi emniyet valfi, basınç şişeni.en: The air receiver safety valve opens when the pressure exceeds the design pressure of the receiver.

Kontrol havası (instrument air): 5-7 bar.en: Control air (instrument air): dried and filtered air at a pressure of 5-7 bar. It is used for pneumatic control valves and automation systems.

Servis havası (general service air): Güv.en: Service air (general service air): for deck work, tank cleaning and general-purpose use. After the air dryer, it is reduced to 5-7 bar by a pressure regulator.

Ana motor jacket water ısısı (yaklaşık 8.en: Seawater is evaporated at low pressure (under vacuum) using the heat of the main engine jacket water (approximately 80°C). Because the evaporation temperature is lowered to 40-60°C, no extra fuel is consumed.

Plate tipi veya shell-tube tipi ısı eşan.en: A plate-type or shell-and-tube heat exchanger is used. The vapor is condensed by cooling water in the condenser to produce fresh water.

Salinometre (tuzluluk ölçer) üretilen su.en: The salinometer continuously checks the quality of the water produced. If the salinity rises above 10 ppm, the water is automatically returned to the sea.

Yüksek basınç pompası (55-70 bar) deniz.en: A high-pressure pump (55-70 bar) forces seawater through a semi-permeable membrane. Salts and minerals remain on the other side of the membrane.

RO sistemi motor ısısına bağlı değildir;.en: The RO system does not depend on engine heat; it can also operate in port. Membrane life is 3-5 years; chemical cleaning (CIP) must be carried out regularly.

Enerji tüketimi evaporatöre göre daha yü.en: Energy consumption is higher than that of the evaporator, but it has been reduced in modern systems with energy recovery.

Yanma odası refrakter tuğla ile kaplı, s.en: It includes a combustion chamber lined with refractory brick, a sludge tank, a dosing pump, a burner (burner) and an air fan.

Sludge ön ısıtması/viskozitesi burner ve.en: Sludge preheating/viscosity is set according to the atomization band in the burner and dosing-pump manual; a fixed 90 °C is not safe for every sludge composition.

Katı atık (kağıt, gıda) charge door'dan.en: Solid waste (paper, food) is loaded through the charge door; after preheating, it is burned by the flame.

Baca: cyclone/scrubber + sıcaklık sensör.en: Stack: cyclone/scrubber + temperature sensor + emission control.

1. kademe (gravity separator): yoğunluk.en: 1st stage (gravity separator): free oil and large droplets separate out at the top because of the difference in density.

2. kademe (coalescer / filter): emülsifi.en: 2nd stage (coalescer / filter): emulsified droplets are coalesced in the coalescing medium and separated.
