15 ppm bilge alarm (OCM — Oil Content Mo.en: 15 ppm bilge alarm (OCM — Oil Content Monitor): approved under IMO MEPC.107(49); at ≥15 ppm it diverts the 3-way valve to the tank side.

Sludge ve yağ toplama tankı (slop/sludge.en: Sludge and oil collecting tank (slop/sludge tank) and overboard line.

Biyolojik (extended aeration): 3 hücreli.en: Biological (extended aeration): 3 compartments — aerobic (digestion by microorganisms) → settling (sedimentation) → chlorination → discharge. The conventional and most common type.

Elektrolitik: deniz suyu elektrolizle hi.en: Electrolytic: produces hypochlorite by electrolysis of seawater; carries out direct chemical disinfection.

MBR (Membrane Bioreactor): biyolojik pro.en: MBR (Membrane Bioreactor): biological process + ultrafiltration membrane; the effluent is of very high quality.

Plakalı (plate): İnce oluklu paslanmaz/t.en: Plate type (plate): thin corrugated stainless steel/titanium plates; high efficiency, small volume, easy cleaning. Common for the central cooler and the L.O. cooler.

Gövde-boru (shell & tube): Bir akışkan b.en: Shell and tube (shell & tube): one fluid passes through the tubes and the other through the shell. Resistant to high pressure/temperature; used in F.O. heaters and steam heaters.

Charge air cooler (hava soğutucu): Turbo.en: Charge air cooler (air cooler): cools the intake air compressed by the turbocharger; increases the charge density (and power).

Transfer edilen ısı, toplam ısı transfer.en: The heat transferred depends on the overall heat transfer coefficient (U), the area (A) and the logarithmic mean temperature difference (ΔTlm).

Kirlenme (fouling) U değerini düşürür; p.en: Fouling reduces the U value; the drop in performance is noticed as a rise in outlet temperature.

Deniz suyu (SW) yalnızca merkezi (centra.en: Seawater (SW) enters only the central cooler; the machinery is cooled by a low-salinity fresh water (LT/HT FW) circuit.

Yüksek sıcaklık (HT) devresi ceket suyun.en: The high-temperature (HT) circuit cools the jacket water, and the low-temperature (LT) circuit cools the L.O., the charge air and the auxiliaries; a thermostatic valve keeps the temperature constant.

Avantaj: deniz suyu korozyonu sadece cen.en: Advantage: seawater corrosion is confined to the central cooler and the SW line; maintenance and service life benefit.

Et odası -18 °C, balık -25 °C, sebze +4.en: Typical: meat room -18 °C, fish -25 °C, vegetables +4 °C, dairy +2 °C, dry provisions +10 °C.

Genellikle iki kompresör (duty/standby),.en: Generally two compressors (duty/standby), one condenser (water-cooled), and an expansion valve for each room.

Defrost: sıcak gaz veya elektrikli rezis.en: Defrost: periodic de-icing by hot gas or electric heater.

Solenoid valf, oda termostatına göre eva.en: The solenoid valve opens/closes the refrigerant flow to the evaporator according to the room thermostat.

Acil jeneratör, ana makine dairesi dışın.en: The emergency generator is located in its own space, outside the main engine room, above the uppermost continuous deck and aft of the collision bulkhead. The aim is that the source can operate even if the engine room is flooded or on fire.

Düzen kendi yakıt tankı, soğutma, yağlam.en: The arrangement must be independent of the main system, with its own fuel tank, cooling, lubrication and starting source. The flash point of the fuel and its fluidity in cold weather conditions are assessed together with space heating and the engine block heater.

Marş düzeni akü, hidrolik akümülatör vey.en: The starting arrangement may be batteries, a hydraulic accumulator or an independent air receiver; in every case it is essential that it is not supplied from the main source of power and that it retains the capability for consecutive starts.

Ana bara gerilimi kaybolduğunda düşük ge.en: When the main busbar voltage is lost, the undervoltage relay gives a start command to the generator; when the set reaches nominal voltage and frequency, the emergency busbar breaker closes. During this changeover, emergency lighting and communications are supplied from the transitional source of power.

Otomatik devreye girme süresi ve besleme.en: The automatic connection time and the supply duration are verified from the applicable SOLAS II-1 provisions according to ship type, tonnage and date of construction; the requirements for cargo ships and passenger ships are not the same.

Beslenecek tüketici listesi gemiye özgüd.en: The list of consumers to be supplied is ship-specific and is shown in the approved electrical diagram: emergency lighting, navigation lights, GMDSS and internal communications, fire detection, the fire pump, watertight doors and, depending on the arrangement, the steering gear may be included in this list.

Yalnız yüksüz çalıştırma gerçek koşullar.en: Running without load alone does not represent real conditions. Prolonged no-load running leads to unburnt fuel and soot accumulating on the exhaust side (wet stacking); periodic running under real load is recommended.

Denetimlerde en sık rastlanan bulgular;.en: The most common findings during inspections are: the set not being returned to automatic mode after testing, a faulty battery charger, the space being used as a store, and the fuel tank level being left low.

Düzen, makinenin serbest ucundan (front-.en: The arrangement is made with a machine fitted at the free end of the engine (front-end PTO), on the gearbox or directly on the shaft. The same electrical machine can work both as a generator and as a motor.

Hibrit düzenlerde şaft makinesi batarya.en: In hybrid arrangements, the shaft machine is combined with batteries or fuel cells and used for load balancing (peak shaving) and for reducing emissions during maneuvering.

Şaft devri değiştiğinde üretilen frekans.en: When the shaft speed changes, the frequency generated also changes. A constant frequency is achieved in two ways: keeping the shaft speed constant with a controllable pitch propeller (CPP), or using a frequency converter (converter) to produce a constant output frequency at variable speed.

Konvertörlü düzenler, ana makine devrini.en: Converter arrangements allow the main engine speed to be varied freely and thus allow fuel optimization; on the other hand, harmonic filtering, cooling and converter redundancy are separate design items.

Manevra, liman ve düşük devirli seyirde.en: During maneuvering, in port and when navigating at low rpm, shaft generator power drops or the shaft generator is disconnected; in these phases, a changeover is made to the auxiliary diesel generators. Whether the changeover is made without interruption depends on the PMS (power management system) logic.

Ana makine trip ettiğinde şaft jeneratör.en: When the main engine trips, the shaft generator is also lost; the blackout risk is therefore assessed together with the automatic start time of the stand-by generator. Class and the flag State may impose additional conditions before the shaft generator can be regarded as the sole source of electrical power.

Tünel tipi itici, gövdedeki tünel içinde.en: The tunnel thruster operates inside a tunnel in the hull and produces transverse force only. Retractable and azimuth thrusters, on the other hand, produce force that can be directed through 360°, providing dynamic positioning (DP) and maneuvering capability.

Elektrik tahrikli düzenlerde motor gücü.en: In electrically driven arrangements, the motor power loads the main busbar directly; therefore, sufficient generator capacity is brought on line before the thruster is used. Starting current and sudden load changes are the main sources of blackout risk.

İticinin ürettiği yanal kuvvet, gemi ile.en: The lateral force produced by the thruster decreases rapidly as the ship gains headway. The flow at the tunnel outlet interacts with the flow field along the hull and cancels part of the force; thrusters are therefore typically effective only at very low speeds, and the maneuvering plan is made with this limit in mind.

Tünel ızgarası (grid), deniz canlısı ve.en: The tunnel grid (grid) prevents marine organisms and foreign objects from entering; its fouling both reduces thrust and causes cavitation and vibration. During dry-docking, the grid, propeller blades and tunnel coating are checked together.

Dişli kutusu ve hatve mekanizması yağla.en: The gearbox and pitch mechanism operate in oil; the oil header tank is located above the waterline so that, in the event of a leak, a drop in level is observed instead of seawater entering the oil. The level and pressure alarms are the first indication of a seal failure.

Su altındaki yağ dolu bölmelerden kaynak.en: Leakage from oil-filled underwater compartments can cause a pollution incident. The use of environmentally acceptable lubricants (EAL) at lubrication points in contact with seawater is verified against the rules applicable to the trading area.

Deniz suyu, yüksek ve alçak deniz sandık.en: Seawater is taken from the high and low sea chests (high/low sea chest). In shallow, muddy or icy waters, selecting the appropriate sea chest determines the risk of blockage and of drawing in air.

Süzgeç (strainer) fark basıncı, tıkanman.en: The strainer differential pressure is the most reliable indicator of blockage. The sea chest steam/air blowing line is used in case of icing and blockage; an MGPS (anode or electrolysis) arrangement may be fitted against marine growth.

Deniz suyu pompaları genellikle çift olu.en: Seawater pumps are usually duplicated, one being on stand-by; the automatic start logic is triggered by a drop in pressure.

HT (yüksek sıcaklık) devresi ana makine.en: The HT (high-temperature) circuit circulates the main engine jacket water and typically operates in the 80–90 °C range; the temperature is controlled by a three-way thermostatic valve. Running too cold leads to cold corrosion on the liner surface and the accumulation of fuel residues.

LT (düşük sıcaklık) devresi yağ soğutucu.en: The LT (low-temperature) circuit serves the oil cooler, the air cooler (charge air cooler), the auxiliary machinery and the compressors; the temperature at the central cooler inlet is usually kept constant by an automatic valve.

Genleşme tankı, devrenin en yüksek nokta.en: The expansion tank is located at the highest point of the circuit; it serves for venting, thermal expansion and filling. A continuous drop in tank level indicates a leak, while a continuous rise indicates internal leakage from a heat exchanger or a liner.

Kapalı devre suyunun kimyasal şartlandır.en: Chemical conditioning of the closed-circuit water prevents corrosion and cavitation erosion. Typical parameters measured are the nitrite/inhibitor level, pH and chloride content; the limits are taken from the ranges specified by the chemical supplier and the engine manufacturer.

Yüksek klorür, deniz suyu veya kötü kali.en: High chloride indicates that seawater or poor-quality make-up water has entered the circuit. Filling with distilled water and correct dosing directly affect the life of the heat exchangers and liners.

Zincir; depo tankı → çökeltme (settling).en: The chain runs as follows: storage tank → settling tank → separator → service tank → supply pump → mixing tank → booster pump → final heater → viscometer → engine. Hot fuel returning from the engine goes back to the mixing tank.

Besleme pompası hat basıncını yükseltere.en: The supply pump raises the line pressure to prevent the fuel from vaporizing when heated and gassing (gassing); the booster pump, on the other hand, provides the necessary circulation at the engine. This two-stage arrangement is necessary for stable injection with heavy fuel.

Otomatik ters yıkamalı filtre ve fark ba.en: The automatic backflushing filter and the differential pressure alarm are the first indication of an increase in solid contaminants. A rapid rise in filter differential pressure usually signals that separator performance has deteriorated.

Enjeksiyon kalitesini belirleyen büyüklü.en: The quantity that determines injection quality is not temperature but viscosity. The viscometer controls the final heater according to the value it measures; the target viscosity range is taken from the engine manufacturer's instructions and maintained so that it does not change from one fuel to another.

Viskozite çok yüksek kalırsa püskürtme k.en: If viscosity remains too high, atomization becomes coarse and late combustion and soot result; if it is too low, lubrication of the pump elements is lost and leakage increases. With distillate fuels, a cooler may be needed to avoid going below the lower viscosity limit.

Yakıt değişimi (changeover) sırasında sı.en: During fuel changeover (changeover), the rate of temperature change is limited; a rapid change causes sticking of and leakage from the pump elements. The changeover is completed in a planned manner before entering an emission control area and is recorded.

Servis tankı drenajı her vardiyada alını.en: The service tank is drained every watch; accumulation of water and sediment is the most frequent cause of combustion problems. Tank heating is kept within a range that maintains the fluidity of the fuel without causing loss of the light fractions through overheating.

Yakıt tanklarının seviyesi, sıcaklığı ve.en: The level and temperature of the fuel tanks and leaks from the heating steam line are monitored regularly; water passing into a tank from a steam coil both disturbs combustion and increases the load on the separator.

Karter veya ayrı yağ tankından alınan ya.en: Oil drawn from the sump or a separate oil tank is pressurized by the pump; it passes through the cooler and the full-flow filter and is distributed to the engine bearings. The return oil comes back to the tank and the circulation continues.

By-pass hattındaki separatör, sistemden.en: The separator in the by-pass line continuously draws a small flow from the system and removes water and solids. This continuous cleaning directly determines oil life and bearing safety.

Düşük yağ basıncı, makinenin en kritik k.en: Low oil pressure is one of the most critical protections of the engine; the alarm and automatic shutdown chain is not disabled for operational convenience.

Silindir yağı gömlek yüzeyine ölçülü doz.en: Cylinder oil is fed to the liner surface in metered doses. The feed rate is set according to engine load and the minimum specified by the manufacturer; too low a feed rate leads to wear and scuffing marks, while too high a feed rate leads to deposit buildup and unnecessary cost.

Yağın alkalinitesi (BN), yakıttaki kükür.en: The alkalinity (BN) of the oil is selected to neutralize the acid formed from the sulfur in the fuel. After a changeover to low-sulfur fuel, using a high-BN oil can lead to the buildup of calcium compounds and piston ring/liner problems.

Kazıma (scrape-down) yağ analizi, demir.en: Scrape-down oil analysis, through its Fe content and residual alkalinity, is the most practical feedback showing whether the feed rate is correct.

Yağ yağlamalı düzenlerde kıç şaft yatağı.en: In oil-lubricated arrangements, the stern tube bearing is supplied from a header tank above the waterline. The height of the tank provides an internal pressure higher than the seawater pressure, making it harder for water to enter; the tank level is therefore a critical indicator.

Baş tank seviyesinin düşmesi denize yağ.en: A drop in header tank level may mean oil leaking to sea, and a rise may mean water entering the shaft bearing. Both situations require the seal to be inspected, and in the case of leakage the obligation to report pollution is considered.

Deniz suyuyla temas eden yağlama noktala.en: The use of environmentally acceptable lubricants (EAL) at lubrication points in contact with seawater is verified against the rules applicable to the ship's trading area. In water-lubricated stern tube arrangements, on the other hand, the bearing material and water flow are monitored.

Balast pompaları genellikle santrifüj ti.en: Ballast pumps are usually of the centrifugal type and are connected to the tanks via the main ballast line. Valves are mostly hydraulically/pneumatically remote-controlled; the indication on the mimic panel may not always match the actual valve position, so local verification is carried out during critical operations.

Tank dibinde kalan suyun alınması için e.en: An eductor (ejector) is used to remove the water remaining at the bottom of a tank; it creates a vacuum with driving water and draws up the low-level water. If the driving pressure the eductor needs is not provided, no suction is created and the tank cannot be stripped.

Balast operasyonu yükleme/tahliye planıy.en: The ballast operation is carried out simultaneously with the loading/discharging plan; in the intermediate stages, draft, trim and strength limits are monitored with the loading computer. Ballast water management requirements and records also apply.

Sintine kuyularında yüksek seviye alarmı.en: Bilge wells are fitted with high level alarms; when the engine room is unattended (UMS), this alarm is the basic early warning of flooding. If the well strainers and suction lines are blocked, the water cannot be pumped out even if the alarm sounds.

Makine dairesinde, en yüksek kapasiteli.en: The engine room has an emergency bilge suction arrangement that takes suction directly through the highest-capacity pump. The valve position, accessibility and working condition of this arrangement are verified as part of drills; material stowed in front of it is a typical finding.

Sintine suyu, onaylı 15 ppm ekipmanından.en: Bilge water cannot be discharged to sea without passing through approved 15 ppm equipment. Non-return valves and blind flanges that prevent cross-connection between the bilge and ballast lines are specifically examined during inspections.

Sintine suyunun aktarımı, denize verilme.en: The transfer of bilge water, its discharge to sea or its delivery to a shore facility is entered in the Oil Record Book. Ballast operations, on the other hand, come under the ballast water management plan and record book.

Kayıtların operasyonla ve tank sounding.en: During an inspection, the consistency of the records with the operations and with tank sounding values is more decisive than the equipment merely being in working order.

Bir HPU; yağ tankı, değişken deplasmanlı.en: An HPU consists of an oil tank, a variable displacement or fixed displacement pump, a relief valve, filters, a cooler, an accumulator and directional control valves. The lines to the consumers are also fitted with pilot-operated check valves and load-holding valves.

Değişken deplasmanlı pompalar, talep olm.en: Variable displacement pumps reduce the flow when there is no demand, reducing heating and energy consumption. In fixed displacement arrangements, on the other hand, the excess flow returns through the relief valve and the oil temperature rises quickly.

Filtreler dönüş ve basınç hatlarında bul.en: Filters are fitted in the return and pressure lines; a differential pressure indicator warns of contamination. If the filter bypass remains open, the system runs unfiltered and wear accelerates.

Akümülatör, azot gazı ile önceden şarj e.en: The accumulator stores energy by means of a chamber precharged with nitrogen gas. The precharge pressure is set to the value given by the manufacturer; in general practice it is kept slightly below the minimum working pressure.

Ön şarj düşerse akümülatör kapasitesi az.en: If the precharge falls, the accumulator capacity decreases and the pump cuts in frequently; if it is too high, the oil volume cannot be used and shock damping is lost. The pressure can be read correctly only after the system side has been depressurized.

Hidrolik arızalarının büyük bölümü kirli.en: Most hydraulic failures are caused by contamination. The target cleanliness class is specified by the manufacturer; water content and particle count are monitored periodically. If the tank breather filter is neglected, the system becomes open to moisture and dust.

Güvertede yüksek basınçlı yağ kaçağı cid.en: A high-pressure oil leak on deck is a serious injury risk; hands or bare skin are not used when searching for leaks. Hoses are inspected regularly for age, cracks and kinks.

Denizle temas eden hidrolik düzenlerde (.en: In hydraulic arrangements in contact with the sea (steering gear, windlass, cranes, hatch covers), the use of environmentally acceptable oils and the leak records are verified against the rules applicable to the ship's trading area.

Transfer pompaları genellikle vidalı vey.en: Transfer pumps are generally positive displacement pumps of the screw or gear type; they provide a stable flow with viscous fuel. A relief valve is fitted on the discharge side, because a positive displacement pump discharging against a closed valve can burst the line.

Tank ısıtma serpantinleri yakıtın pompal.en: Tank heating coils keep the fuel pumpable. A coil leak both mixes water into the tank and carries oil into the condensate line, causing contamination; the condensate observation tank is therefore checked regularly.

Tank seviye göstergeleri, yüksek seviye.en: Tank level gauges, the high level alarm and the overflow tank are the most important layers of protection during transfer. Transfer is not an operation that can be left unattended while moving on to other work.

Sludge kaynakları; separatör boşaltmalar.en: Sources of sludge are separator discharges, filter cleaning, tank drains, fuel/oil leaks and the oil phase of the bilge tank. The quantity generated is directly related to the quality of the fuel used and the separator settings.

Bertaraf yolları sınırlıdır: onaylı insi.en: The disposal routes are limited: incineration in an approved incinerator or delivery to a shore reception facility. The absence of any direct connection from the sludge tank to the sea, and the discharge line having a standard connection, are among the first points checked during inspections.

Sludge tankı seviyesi, üretim ve bertara.en: The consistency between the sludge tank level and the quantities generated and disposed of (mass balance) is critical from both an operational and an inspection point of view. A mismatch between the records and the actual levels is, on its own, a serious finding.

Bunker öncesi tank planı, kapasite hesab.en: Before bunkering, the tank plan, capacity calculation, communications and emergency stop method are agreed with the other party. Deck scuppers (scupper) are plugged, drip trays are emptied and SOPEP equipment is kept ready.

Alım sırasında temsili numune alınır ve.en: During receipt, a representative sample is taken and retained; the sample is the only objective evidence in disputes over fuel quality and sulfur compliance.

Operasyon boyunca sürekli gözetim, seviy.en: Throughout the operation, continuous supervision, level monitoring and staged tank changeover are applied. The moments of highest overflow risk are the tank changeover and the final topping-off stage.

Ana yangın pompaları makine dairesinde,.en: The main fire pumps are located in the engine room, while the emergency fire pump is located in a separate compartment outside the engine room.

Hat üzerinde basıncı koruyan jokey pompa.en: A jockey pump (jockey/pressure maintenance pump) and a hydrophore tank that maintain the pressure in the line may be fitted.

Yüksek basınç (HP) CO₂ silindirleri ~50.en: High-pressure (HP) CO₂ cylinders contain liquid CO₂ at a pressure of ~50 bar; this is the most common type on ships.

Pilot silindir, master valfi ve manifold.en: The pilot cylinder provides the control gas that opens the master valve and the manifold valves.

Time delay (zaman geciktirici) personeli.en: The time delay provides a waiting time of 20–60 s for personnel to leave the space.

Discharge nozülleri korunan hacme dağıtı.en: The discharge nozzles are distributed throughout the protected space; the CO₂ quantity, discharge time and distribution are approved according to the FSS Code design calculation and the definition of the net/gross volume of the space.

AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam), hidrok.en: AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam) forms a thin film on hydrocarbons; the common marine type.

Alcohol Resistant (AR-AFFF), polar çözüc.en: Alcohol Resistant (AR-AFFF) foam is used on polar solvent fires (alcohol, ketones).

High-expansion foam (genleşme oranı 200–.en: High-expansion foam (expansion ratio 200–1000) rapidly fills enclosed spaces.

Sprinkler başlığındaki cam ampul belirli.en: The glass bulb in the sprinkler head bursts at a certain temperature (generally 68 °C) and releases the water.

Hat basınçlı tutulur (wet pipe); su deşa.en: The line is kept pressurized (wet pipe); when water is discharged, the alarm valve is activated.

Water mist, 70–200 bar basınçta 100 µm a.en: Water mist produces droplets below 100 µm at a pressure of 70–200 bar; it extinguishes by oxygen displacement and steam cooling.

Flue gas scrubber, kazan baca gazını den.en: The flue gas scrubber washes the boiler flue gas with seawater to remove SO₂ and carbon.

Blower'lar gazı tank atmosferine basar;.en: The blowers deliver the gas into the tank atmosphere; typical pressure is 800–1500 mmWC.

Deck water seal ve non-return valf, hidr.en: The deck water seal and the non-return valve prevent hydrocarbons escaping back to the engine room.

P/V kırıcı (pressure/vacuum breaker) tan.en: The P/V breaker (pressure/vacuum breaker) is the last item of safety equipment protecting the tanks against excessive pressure/vacuum.

İyonizasyon ve fotoelektrik duman dedekt.en: Ionization and photoelectric smoke detectors are used in cabins, corridors and control rooms.

Sıcaklık dedektörleri (sabit veya ROR –.en: Heat detectors (fixed temperature or ROR – rate of rise) are preferred in places with high humidity/steam, such as the galley and laundry.

Alev dedektörü (UV/IR) hidrokarbon yangı.en: Flame detectors (UV/IR) are used for hydrocarbon fires; helicopter deck, pump room.

Aspirating smoke detection (HSSD/VESDA).en: Aspirating smoke detection (HSSD/VESDA) provides high-sensitivity early detection for cargo holds.

A sınıfı (katılar): su, AFFF köpük, çok.en: Class A (solids): water, AFFF foam, multipurpose dry chemical.

B sınıfı (sıvılar): köpük, CO₂, kuru kim.en: Class B (liquids): foam, CO₂, dry chemical.

C sınıfı (gazlar): kuru kimyasal — önce.en: Class C (gases): dry chemical — the gas flow must be shut off first.

D sınıfı (metaller): özel D tozu (alümün.en: Class D (metals): special class D powder (for aluminum and magnesium fires).

Elektrik (eski E): CO₂ veya kuru kimyasa.en: Electrical (formerly E): CO₂ or dry chemical — water is never used.

EEBD minimum 10 dakikalık hava sağlar, s.en: The EEBD provides a minimum of 10 minutes of air and is for escape only; it is not used for firefighting.

SCBA tipik 1200/1800/2000 L hava ile 30–.en: The SCBA typically offers a working duration of 30–45 minutes with 1200/1800/2000 L of air.

SCBA seti: tüp, basınç regülatörü, deman.en: The SCBA set includes a cylinder, pressure regulator, demand valve, full face mask, backplate (carrying frame) and low-pressure whistle.

Quick closing valves (QCV) makine daires.en: Quick closing valves (QCV) are triggered from a panel outside the engine room; they close the valves on the fuel tanks, lubricating oil tanks and service tanks.

Fan stop ve damper kapatma sistemi makin.en: The fan stop and damper closing system cuts off engine room ventilation and reduces the oxygen.

Yakıt pompası ve purifier emergency stop.en: The emergency stop buttons for the fuel pumps and purifiers are located outside the fire zone.

Skylight, jaluzi ve havalandırma kanalı.en: Skylights, louvers and ventilation duct covers can be closed manually or pneumatically.

Santrifüj kargo pompaları: ham petrol ve.en: Centrifugal cargo pumps: operate at 1500–6000 m³/h on crude oil and product tankers; they are located in the pump room and are driven by steam turbine or electric motor.

Submerged (deepwell) pompalar: kimyasal.en: Submerged (deepwell) pumps: on chemical tankers, separate hydraulically driven pumps for each tank, fitted at the tank bottom; they eliminate the risk of cross-contamination.

Stripping pompaları: pozitif deplasmanlı.en: Stripping pumps: positive displacement type (screw or reciprocating); used to draw off the last ~5–20 m³ of cargo remaining at the bottom of the tank.

Booster pompası: terminalin manifold bas.en: Booster pump: if the terminal's manifold pressure is high, it is connected in series at the main pump discharge to increase the line pressure.

Programlı dönen tank washing makineleri.en: Programmed rotating tank washing machines (Butterworth, Toftejorg) operate at the top and bottom of the tank at set angles/speeds.

COW pompası ham petrolü 8–12 bar basınçl.en: The COW pump supplies crude oil to the machines at a pressure of 8–12 bar.

IGS, COW boyunca tank atmosferini ≤%8 O₂.en: Throughout COW, the IGS keeps the tank atmosphere at ≤8% O₂ and at positive pressure; the inert gas supplied to the deck main must be ≤5% O₂. The analyzer reading is verified by appropriate sampling and calibration.

Fixed gas freeing fan ve hat purje düzen.en: The fixed gas-freeing fan and the line purge arrangement make the tank gas-free after washing.

Radar gauge: tank tepesinden mikrodalga.en: Radar gauge: measures the ullage from the tank top with a microwave signal; standard on crude oil/product tankers.

Pressure gauge (hidrostatik): tank dibi.en: Pressure gauge (hydrostatic): calculates the level by measuring the pressure at the tank bottom; common for ballast and double bottom tanks.

Independent overfill alarm (IOA): yüksek.en: Independent overfill alarm (IOA): gives an alarm at high level independently of the main system.

Folding (katlanır) tip: hidrolik silindi.en: Folding type: the cover panels are opened by hydraulic cylinders and folded at the end of the hatch.

Piggyback: iki panel arka arkaya kayar,.en: Piggyback: two panels slide one behind the other, with one riding over the other.

Twist-lock: container köşelerine geçen,.en: Twist-lock: a fitting that engages the container corners and can be locked; semi-automatic and fully automatic variants exist.

Lashing rod: container köşesinden güvert.en: Lashing rod: a steel rod running from the container corner to the D-ring on deck; tensioned with a turnbuckle.

Turnbuckle: lashing rod'un gerilimini ay.en: Turnbuckle: a threaded tensioning element that adjusts the tension of the lashing rod.

Stacking cone: container'ları üst üste h.en: Stacking cone: a passive element that aligns containers on top of each other.

Bridge fitting: yan yana iki container'ı.en: Bridge fitting: connects two adjacent containers to each other at their top corners.

Reefer plug socket: 32 A / 4 pin / 440 V.en: Reefer plug socket: 32 A / 4 pin / 440 V CEE-form; for the power connection of each container.

Reefer monitoring system (RMS): set sıca.en: Reefer monitoring system (RMS): monitors set temperature, return-air, supply-air and alarm conditions.

Power management system (PMS): toplam re.en: Power management system (PMS): balances the total reefer load against generator capacity.

Container içi ünitede kompresör, kondens.en: The container's own unit contains a compressor, condenser, evaporator and fan.

Stern ramp: kıç tarafta açılan, en yaygı.en: Stern ramp: the most common loading ramp, opening at the stern; the quarter ramp variant opens to the side at a set angle.

Side ramp: gemi yan tarafından açılır, t.en: Side ramp: opens from the ship's side; its use depends on the terminal structure.

Bow visor + ramp: baş tarafta açılan kap.en: Bow visor + ramp: doors opening at the bow; the visor provides weathertight protection and the ramp provides access for loading.

Internal ramp: güverteler arası araç har.en: Internal ramp: fixed or movable ramps for vehicle movement between decks.

Deck crane: 360° döner, hidrolik tahrikl.en: Deck crane: slews through 360°, hydraulically driven; 25–60 t SWL on bulkers and general cargo ships.

Derrick: tek veya çift halatlı sistem; b.en: Derrick: single or double rope system; simple, for light loads.

Stülcken derrick: iki direk arasında ağı.en: Stülcken derrick: can handle heavy loads (200+ t) between two masts.

Gantry crane: konteyner gemilerinde rays.en: Gantry crane: travels on rails on container ships.

Tank washing makineleri (portable Butter.en: Tank washing machines (portable Butterworth or fixed) wash with hot/cold water or a chemical solution.

Slop tankı, yıkama suyunu ve yağlı atığı.en: The slop tank holds the washing water and oily waste for a period so that they separate (decanting).

Eductor (jet pump): yıkama suyunu vakum.en: Eductor (jet pump): draws the washing water by vacuum and transfers it to the slop tank; it has no moving mechanical parts.

Heated washing line, viskoz ürünler için.en: The heated washing line supplies water at 60–80 °C for viscous products.

Filtre + UV (ultraviyole) sistemleri: 40.en: Filter + UV (ultraviolet) systems: a 40 µm disc/screen filter retains the large organisms; the UV reactor damages DNA, removing the ability to reproduce. No distinction between fresh and salt water is required.

Filtre + Elektroklorinasyon (EC) sisteml.en: Filter + electrochlorination (EC) systems: produce active chlorine from seawater by electrolysis; disinfection takes place in the tank with chlorine. Neutralization (sodium thiosulfate) is required at deballasting.

Kimyasal dozajlı sistemler: peraset asit.en: Chemical dosing systems: operate by dosing peracetic acid or chlorine dioxide; a reserve stock of chemicals is kept.

Chiller: R134a/R407C/R513A soğutucu akış.en: Chiller: produces chilled water (chilled water 7 °C) using R134a/R407C/R513A refrigerant.

AHU: chilled water coil + ısıtıcı (steam.en: AHU: contains a chilled water coil + heater (steam or electric) + humidifier + filter + fan.

Kanal sistemi: supply ve return; her mah.en: Duct system: supply and return; a grille/diffuser and damper in each space.

Reefer kompartmanı (provision room) ayrı.en: The reefer compartment (provision room) is kept between -20 °C and +5 °C by a separate expansion circuit.

Tatlı su tankı (FWT): soğuk su deposu; e.en: Fresh water tank (FWT): cold water storage; epoxy-coated or stainless steel.

Hidrofor pompası: santrifüj, tipik 4–6 b.en: Hydrophore pump: centrifugal, typical discharge pressure 4–6 bar.

Basınç tankı (pressure vessel): membran.en: Pressure tank (pressure vessel): membrane type; 100–500 L volume; the air cushion reduces the frequency of pump starts/stops.

Kalorifer (calorifier): elektrik veya bu.en: Calorifier (calorifier): an electrically or steam-heated hot water tank.

UV sterilizator ve mineral dozaj: içme s.en: UV sterilizer and mineral dosing: for drinking water quality.

Ana hava kompresörü (main air compressor.en: Main air compressor (main air compressor): 2-stage, 30 bar; charges the main receiver.

Start-air receiver toplam kapasitesi, re.en: The total capacity of the starting-air receivers is assessed against the criterion of at least 12 consecutive starts without replenishment by the compressor for a reversible main engine, and at least 6 starts for a non-reversible arrangement, together with the approved piping/isolation arrangement.

Reducing valve: 30 bar → 7 bar control/w.en: Reducing valve: 30 bar → 7 bar for control/working air.

Auxiliary boiler: yakıtlı (HFO/MGO) veya.en: Auxiliary boiler: oil-fired (HFO/MGO) or exhaust gas economizer; produces saturated steam at 7–10 bar.

Buhar kollektörü ve dağıtım hatları: izo.en: Steam header and distribution lines: insulated, fitted with drain valves.

Steam trap (kondens kapanı): kondensi ay.en: Steam trap: separates the condensate and prevents loss of steam.

Hot well tank: kondensi toplar, sıcaklığ.en: Hot well tank: collects the condensate and controls its temperature (for the oxygen scavenger).

Feed water pompası: hot well'den kazana.en: Feed water pump: pumps water from the hot well to the boiler.

Deaerator: feed water'dan O₂ ve CO₂ uzak.en: Deaerator: removes O₂ and CO₂ from the feed water.

A1, bir Contracting Government tarafında.en: A1 is the area within the continuous DSC alerting coverage of at least one VHF coast station, as defined by a Contracting Government; it is not a fixed 20–30 NM circle.

A2, A1 dışında en az bir MF coast statio.en: A2 is the area, excluding A1, within the continuous DSC alerting coverage of at least one MF coast station; propagation range alone does not create sea-area status.

A3, A1/A2 dışında gemideki tanınmış mobi.en: A3 is the area, excluding A1/A2, within the continuous alerting coverage supported by a recognized mobile-satellite service ship earth station on board; the modern GMDSS is not equated solely with the Inmarsat geostationary region.

A4, A1/A2/A3 dışındaki alandır. HF DSC/r.en: A4 is the area outside A1/A2/A3. The HF DSC/radiotelephony arrangement and the MSI route are verified against current SOLAS IV and the Radio Record; NBDP is no longer assumed to be a general requirement.

Ch 16: tehlike, acil ve çağrı kanalı (15.en: Ch 16: distress, urgency and calling channel (156.800 MHz).

Ch 70: DSC tehlike kanalı (156.525 MHz).en: Ch 70: DSC distress channel (156.525 MHz) — voice use prohibited.

Ch 13: bridge-to-bridge gemi manevra hab.en: Ch 13: bridge-to-bridge communications for ship maneuvering (156.650 MHz).

Distress alert: tek tuş ile gemi MMSI, p.en: Distress alert: sent to the RCC at the push of a single button, with the ship's MMSI, position, nature of distress and UTC.

EGC SafetyNET: NAVAREA uyarısı, SAR mesa.en: EGC SafetyNET: NAVAREA warnings, SAR messages and weather reports, received automatically.

EGC FleetNET: armatör veya ticari grup m.en: EGC FleetNET: shipowner or commercial group messages.

Genel haberleşme: e-posta, teleks, SMS (.en: General communications: email, telex, SMS (via the LES — Land Earth Station).

406 MHz dijital beacon: gemi kimlik, poz.en: 406 MHz digital beacon: transmits the ship's identity, position and emergency type.

121.5 MHz homing beacon: SAR helikopter/.en: 121.5 MHz homing beacon: for direction finding by SAR helicopters/ships.

GNSS'li beacon encoded position gönderir.en: A beacon with GNSS transmits an encoded position; the actual accuracy and update rate depend on the beacon type approval, the antenna's view of the sky and the GNSS fix status. Without GNSS, the independent Cospas-Sarsat location solution may be slower/less accurate.

HRU (Hydrostatic Release Unit): 1.5-4 m.en: HRU (Hydrostatic Release Unit): releases the bracket on reaching a depth of 1.5-4 m; the EPIRB floats to the surface and is activated by water.

Radar SART, 9 GHz X-band sorgulamasını a.en: The radar SART detects a 9 GHz X-band interrogation and generates responses that sweep the band; on the radar screen, 12 blips at intervals of approximately 0.64 NM are seen, which may turn into arcs/circles at close range.

AIS-SART: AIS sinyali yayınlar, AIS rece.en: AIS-SART: transmits an AIS signal and shows an MOB symbol on the AIS receiver; its range is shorter, but it gives a digital position.

Lifeboat içinde özel bracket veya raftak.en: It is kept in a special bracket in the lifeboat or in the container in the liferaft.

Dormancy period 3–12 dakika arasında seç.en: The dormant period is selected between 3 and 12 minutes; at the end of this period, a visual indication starts on the bridge.

Görsel indication 15 saniye içinde reset.en: If the visual indication is not reset within 15 seconds, the first-stage audible alarm sounds on the bridge.

First-stage audible başladıktan 15 saniy.en: If there is still no reset 15 seconds after the first-stage audible alarm starts, the second-stage remote audible alarm sounds at the location of the designated back-up officer and/or the Master.

Second-stage remote audible başladıktan.en: If there is no reset 90 seconds after the second-stage remote audible alarm starts, the third-stage alarm, alerting other crew members capable of taking action, is activated; on a cargo ship, an approved combined arrangement may be fitted, and the total escalation time may not exceed the performance standard.

Bridge audio: conning station, radar/ECD.en: Bridge audio: coverage sufficient to distinguish conversations and audible alarms at the conning station, radar/ECDIS and communication workstations.

Radar/ECDIS image: installation standard.en: Radar/ECDIS image: the display source(s) recorded according to the installation standard and the available interface.

GNSS, heading, speed, depth, AIS, rudder.en: GNSS, heading, speed, depth, AIS, rudder, engine/propulsion command-response, alarms and other required sources; the scope depends on the installation date/performance standard.

Capsule (Hardened/Float-free): yangın/su.en: Capsule (hardened/float-free): resistant to fire/water/depth; indicates its position by means of a pinger.

Totally Enclosed Lifeboat (TEL): tam kap.en: Totally Enclosed Lifeboat (TEL): fully enclosed, engine + air supply + sprinkler (fire-protected for tankers).

Free-fall lifeboat: tankers ve bulk için.en: Free-fall lifeboat: common on tankers and bulk carriers; drops into the water from an inclined ramp.

Partially Enclosed: yolcu gemilerinde, d.en: Partially enclosed: on passenger ships, faster boarding.

Davit: Gravity (gravity-roller veya luff.en: Davit: gravity (gravity-roller or luffing arm) or free-fall ramp.

SOLAS A Pack, LSA Code'daki tam emergenc.en: SOLAS A Pack is the full emergency equipment set in the LSA Code; the item/quantity list is verified from the service certificate and the pack marking.

SOLAS B Pack yalnız Administration'ın iz.en: SOLAS B Pack is a reduced pack only for short international voyage arrangements permitted by the Administration; it is not selected on the basis of an arbitrary '24-hour' limit.

Painter line: konteyner içindeki ipin uc.en: Painter line: the end of the line inside the container is attached to the ship; when the ship sinks, it becomes taut and the raft inflates.

Rescue boat: rigid (RIB) veya inflatable.en: Rescue boat: rigid (RIB) or inflatable; capacity of 5+ persons.

Fast Rescue Boat (FRB): ro-ro passenger.en: Fast Rescue Boat (FRB): at least one is required on ro-ro passenger ships; on other ships it depends on the approved arrangement. The speed/endurance criteria may differ with the full complement.

Davit: tek nokta veya çift nokta; hızlı.en: Davit: single-point or two-point; the single-fall davit is common for rapid launching.

Donanım: outboard veya inboard motor, fe.en: Equipment: outboard or inboard motor, fender, painter, paddles, first aid kit, light, anchor.
